````rust
 74: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 75: pub struct OrthoBasis {
 76:     pub turn: QuarterTurn,
 77: }
 78: 
 79: impl OrthoBasis {
 80:     pub fn to_local(self, dx: f32, dz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
 81:         match self.turn {
 82:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (dx, dz),
 83:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (dz, -dx),
 84:         }
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     pub fn to_world(self, lx: f32, lz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
 88:         match self.turn {
 89:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (lx, lz),
 90:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (-lz, lx),
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     pub fn local_axis_in_world(self, axis: Axis2) -> Axis2 {
 95:         match (self.turn, axis) {
 96:             (QuarterTurn::Zero, a) => a,
 97:             (QuarterTurn::Clockwise, Axis2::X) => Axis2::Z,
 98:             (QuarterTurn::Clockwise, Axis2::Z) => Axis2::X,
 99:         }
100:     }
101: }
102: 
103: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
104: pub struct OrientedFootprint {
105:     pub center: Position,
106: 
107:     pub half_x: f32,
108:     pub half_z: f32,
109:     pub basis: OrthoBasis,
110: }
111: 
112: impl OrientedFootprint {
113:     pub fn local_coords(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
114:         self.basis.to_local(wx - self.center.x, wz - self.center.z)
115:     }
116: 
117:     pub fn world_coords(&self, lx: f32, lz: f32) -> Position {
118:         let (dx, dz) = self.basis.to_world(lx, lz);
119:         Position::new(self.center.x + dx, self.center.z + dz)
120:     }
121: 
122:     pub fn contains(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
123:         let (x, z) = self.local_coords(wx, wz);
124:         x.abs() <= self.half_x && z.abs() <= self.half_z
125:     }
126: 
127:     pub fn boundary_distance(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> f32 {
128:         let (x, z) = self.local_coords(wx, wz);
129:         (self.half_x - x.abs()).min(self.half_z - z.abs())
130:     }
131: 
132:     pub fn normalized_depth(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> f32 {
133:         (self.boundary_distance(wx, wz) / self.half_x.min(self.half_z).max(0.001)).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
134:     }
135: 
136:     pub fn bounds(&self) -> WorldBounds {
137:         let (hx, hz) = match self.basis.turn {
138:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (self.half_x, self.half_z),
139:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (self.half_z, self.half_x),
140:         };
141:         WorldBounds::new(
142:             self.center.x - hx,
143:             self.center.z - hz,
144:             self.center.x + hx,
145:             self.center.z + hz,
146:         )
147:     }
148: }
149: 
150: pub(super) fn decode_axis(value: u32) -> Option<Axis2> {
151:     match value {
152:         0 => Some(Axis2::X),
153:         1 => Some(Axis2::Z),
154:         _ => None,
155:     }
156: }
157: 
158: pub(super) fn decode_direction(value: u32) -> Option<AxisDirection> {
159:     match value {
160:         0 => Some(AxisDirection::Negative),
161:         1 => Some(AxisDirection::Positive),
162:         _ => None,
163:     }
164: }
````

````rust
188:         let min_lz = corners
189:             .iter()
190:             .map(|point| point.1)
191:             .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
192:         let max_lz = corners
193:             .iter()
194:             .map(|point| point.1)
195:             .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
196:         let ix0 = ((min_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).floor() as i64 - 1;
197:         let ix1 = ((max_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).ceil() as i64 + 1;
198:         let iz0 = ((min_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).floor() as i64 - 1;
199:         let iz1 = ((max_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).ceil() as i64 + 1;
200: 
201:         let mut hazards = Vec::new();
202:         for iz in iz0..=iz1 {
203:             for ix in ix0..=ix1 {
204:                 let lx = lattice.phase_x + ix as f32 * lattice.spacing_x;
205:                 let lz = lattice.phase_z + iz as f32 * lattice.spacing_z;
206:                 let center = self.world_coords(lx, lz);
207:                 if !self.contains(center.x, center.z)
208:                     || self.boundary_distance(center.x, center.z) < lattice.side
209:                     || !bounds.expanded(lattice.side).contains(center.x, center.z)
210:                 {
211:                     continue;
212:                 }
213: 
214:                 if lz.abs() < self.skeleton_half_width + lattice.side {
215:                     continue;
216:                 }
217: 
218: 
219:                 let recovery =
220:                     self.world_coords(lx + lattice.spacing_x * 0.5, lz + lattice.spacing_z * 0.5);
221:                 let id = mix64(self.id ^ (ix as u64).rotate_left(17) ^ (iz as u64).rotate_left(43));
222:                 hazards.push(PitHazard {
223:                     id,
224:                     instance_id: self.id,
225:                     center,
226:                     half_side: lattice.side * 0.5,
227:                     depth: lattice.depth,
228:                     recovery,
229:                 });
230:             }
231:         }
232:         hazards.sort_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
233:         hazards.dedup_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
234:         hazards
235:     }
236: }
````

````rust
136: impl TransitionState {

157:     state

160: 
161: fn advance_red_threshold(
162:     mut state: TransitionState,
163:     next_epoch: u32,
164:     direction: AxisDirection,
165:     forward: AxisDirection,
166: ) -> TransitionState {
167:     if direction == forward {
168:         state.phase = RedRoomPhase::Sealed;
169:         state.epoch = next_epoch;
170:     }
171:     state
172: }

180: const LOOPS_TO_OPEN_ESCAPE: u8 = 7;
181: 
182: fn advance_red_loop(mut state: TransitionState, next_epoch: u32) -> TransitionState {
183:     match state.phase {
184:         RedRoomPhase::Sealed => {
185:             state.loop_count = state.loop_count.saturating_add(1);
186:             if state.loop_count >= LOOPS_TO_OPEN_ESCAPE {
187:                 state.phase = RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen;
188:             }
189:             state.epoch = next_epoch;
190:         }
191:         RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen => {
192:             state.phase = RedRoomPhase::Sealed;
193:             state.loop_count = 0;
194:             state.epoch = next_epoch;
195:         }
196:         RedRoomPhase::Outside => {}
197:     }
198:     state
199: }
200: 
201: 
202: 
203: 
204: fn advance_red_escape(state: TransitionState) -> TransitionState {
205:     state
206: }
207: 
208: fn transition_for(
209:     gate: &TraversalGate,
210:     direction: AxisDirection,
211:     existing: Option<&AnomalyStateStamp>,
212:     next_epoch: u32,
213: ) -> TransitionState {
214:     let state = TransitionState::before(existing, next_epoch);
215:     match gate.kind {
216:         TraversalGateKind::Remap => advance_remap(state, next_epoch),
217:         TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold => {
218:             advance_red_threshold(state, next_epoch, direction, gate.forward)
219:         }
220:         TraversalGateKind::RedLoop => advance_red_loop(state, next_epoch),
221:         TraversalGateKind::RedEscape => advance_red_escape(state),
222:     }
223: }

409:     fn hash_words(words: &[u32]) -> u64 {
410:         let mut hash = 0xCBF2_9CE4_8422_2325u64;
411:         for &word in words {
412:             hash ^= word as u64;
413:             hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x100_0000_01B3);
414:         }
415:         mix64(hash)
416:     }

418:     pub fn fingerprint(&self) -> u64 {
419:         let words = self.words_without_fingerprint();
420:         Self::hash_words(&words)
421:     }
422: 
423:     fn words_without_fingerprint(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
424:         let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(
425:             4 + self.stamps.len() * Self::STAMP_WORDS
426:                 + self.drifts.len() * Self::DRIFT_WORDS
427:                 + self.consumed_supplies.len() * 2,
428:         );
429:         out.push(Self::MAGIC);
430:         out.push(self.stamps.len() as u32);
431:         for stamp in &self.stamps {
432:             out.extend_from_slice(&[
433:                 stamp.instance_id as u32,
434:                 (stamp.instance_id >> 32) as u32,
435:                 stamp.epoch,
436:                 stamp.gate_plane_milli as u32,
437:                 (stamp.gate_axis as u32)
438:                     | ((stamp.travel_direction as u32) << 8)
439:                     | ((stamp.phase as u32) << 16)
440:                     | ((stamp.loop_count as u32) << 24),
441:                 stamp.last_gate_id as u32,
442:                 (stamp.last_gate_id >> 32) as u32,
443:             ]);
444:         }
445:         out.push(self.drifts.len() as u32);
446:         for drift in &self.drifts {
447:             out.extend_from_slice(&[
448:                 drift.cell_x as u32,
449:                 (drift.cell_x >> 32) as u32,
450:                 drift.cell_z as u32,
451:                 (drift.cell_z >> 32) as u32,
452:                 drift.epoch,
453:             ]);
454:         }
455:         out.push(self.consumed_supplies.len() as u32);
456:         for &id in &self.consumed_supplies {
457:             out.push(id as u32);
458:             out.push((id >> 32) as u32);
459:         }
460:         out.push(self.delirium as u32);
461:         out
462:     }
463: 
464:     pub fn to_words(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
465:         let mut out = self.words_without_fingerprint();
466:         let fingerprint = Self::hash_words(&out);
467:         out.push(fingerprint as u32);
468:         out.push((fingerprint >> 32) as u32);
469:         out
470:     }
471: 
472:     pub fn from_words(words: &[u32]) -> Result<Self, RealitySnapshotDecodeError> {
473:         if words.len() < 5 || words[0] != Self::MAGIC {
474:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Header);
475:         }
476:         let count = words[1] as usize;
477:         let drift_header = 2 + count.saturating_mul(Self::STAMP_WORDS);
478:         if words.len() < drift_header + 4 {
479:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Length);
480:         }
481:         let drift_count = words[drift_header] as usize;
482:         let supply_header = drift_header + 1 + drift_count.saturating_mul(Self::DRIFT_WORDS);
483:         if words.len() < supply_header + 4 {
484:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Length);
485:         }
486:         let supply_count = words[supply_header] as usize;
487:         let delirium_at = supply_header + 1 + supply_count.saturating_mul(2);
488:         let body_len = delirium_at + 1;
489:         if words.len() != body_len + 2 {
490:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Length);
491:         }
492:         if words[delirium_at] > MAX_DELIRIUM as u32 {
493:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value);
494:         }
495:         let expected = words[body_len] as u64 | ((words[body_len + 1] as u64) << 32);
496:         if Self::hash_words(&words[..body_len]) != expected {
497:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Fingerprint);
498:         }
499: 
500:         let mut stamps = Vec::with_capacity(count);
501:         for chunk in words[2..drift_header].chunks_exact(Self::STAMP_WORDS) {
502:             stamps.push(AnomalyStateStamp {
503:                 instance_id: chunk[0] as u64 | ((chunk[1] as u64) << 32),
504:                 epoch: chunk[2],
505:                 gate_plane_milli: chunk[3] as i32,
506:                 gate_axis: decode_axis(chunk[4] & 0xff).ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
507:                 travel_direction: decode_direction((chunk[4] >> 8) & 0xff)
508:                     .ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
509:                 phase: decode_phase((chunk[4] >> 16) & 0xff)
510:                     .ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
511:                 loop_count: ((chunk[4] >> 24) & 0xff) as u8,
512:                 last_gate_id: chunk[5] as u64 | ((chunk[6] as u64) << 32),
513:             });
514:         }
515:         let mut drifts = Vec::with_capacity(drift_count);
516:         for chunk in words[drift_header + 1..supply_header].chunks_exact(Self::DRIFT_WORDS) {
517:             drifts.push(FabricDriftStamp {
518:                 cell_x: chunk[0] as u64 as i64 | (((chunk[1] as u64) << 32) as i64),
519:                 cell_z: chunk[2] as u64 as i64 | (((chunk[3] as u64) << 32) as i64),
520:                 epoch: chunk[4],
521:             });
522:         }
523:         let mut consumed = Vec::with_capacity(supply_count);
524:         for chunk in words[supply_header + 1..delirium_at].chunks_exact(2) {
525:             consumed.push(chunk[0] as u64 | ((chunk[1] as u64) << 32));
526:         }
527:         let decoded = Self::with_drifts_and_supplies(stamps, drifts, consumed)
528:             .with_delirium(words[delirium_at] as u8);
529:         if decoded.to_words() != words {
530:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value);
531:         }
532:         Ok(decoded)
533:     }
534: }

536: fn decode_phase(value: u32) -> Option<RedRoomPhase> {
537:     match value {
538:         0 => Some(RedRoomPhase::Outside),
539:         1 => Some(RedRoomPhase::Sealed),
540:         2 => Some(RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen),
541:         _ => None,
542:     }
543: }
````

````rust
 31: impl TraversalGate {

 33: 
 34:     pub fn crossing(&self, old: [f32; 2], new: [f32; 2]) -> Option<AxisDirection> {
 35:         let (a0, a1, b0, b1) = match self.axis {
 36:             Axis2::X => (old[0], new[0], old[1], new[1]),
 37:             Axis2::Z => (old[1], new[1], old[0], new[0]),
 38:         };
 39:         let delta = a1 - a0;
 40:         if delta.abs() < 1e-6 {
 41:             return None;
 42:         }
 43:         let t = (self.plane - a0) / delta;
 44:         if !(0.0 < t && t <= 1.0) {
 45:             return None;
 46:         }
 47:         let across = b0 + (b1 - b0) * t;
 48:         if across < self.span_min || across > self.span_max {
 49:             return None;
 50:         }
 51:         Some(if delta > 0.0 {
 52:             AxisDirection::Positive
 53:         } else {
 54:             AxisDirection::Negative
 55:         })
 56:     }

 64:             self.instance_id as u32,
 65:             (self.instance_id >> 32) as u32,
 66:             self.anomaly_kind as u32,

 75:             self.affected_bounds.max_x.to_bits(),
 76:             self.affected_bounds.max_z.to_bits(),
 77:         ]
 78:     }

 86:             instance_id: words[2] as u64 | ((words[3] as u64) << 32),
 87:             anomaly_kind: decode_kind(words[4])?,
````

````rust
139: #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
140: pub struct Polygon2 {

142:     pub vertices: Vec<(f32, f32)>,
143: }
144: 
145: impl Polygon2 {
146: 
147:     pub fn rect(x: f32, z: f32, w: f32, d: f32) -> Self {
148:         Self {
149:             vertices: vec![(x, z), (x + w, z), (x + w, z + d), (x, z + d)],
150:         }
151:     }
152: 
153: 
154:     pub fn contains(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> bool {
155:         let v = &self.vertices;
156:         let mut inside = false;
157:         let mut j = v.len() - 1;
158:         for i in 0..v.len() {
159:             let (xi, zi) = v[i];
160:             let (xj, zj) = v[j];
161:             if ((zi > z) != (zj > z)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (z - zi) / (zj - zi) + xi) {
162:                 inside = !inside;
163:             }
164:             j = i;
165:         }
166:         inside
167:     }
168: 
169: 
170:     pub fn bounds(&self) -> (f32, f32, f32, f32) {
171:         let mut b = (f32::MAX, f32::MAX, f32::MIN, f32::MIN);
172:         for &(x, z) in &self.vertices {
173:             b.0 = b.0.min(x);
174:             b.1 = b.1.min(z);
175:             b.2 = b.2.max(x);
176:             b.3 = b.3.max(z);
177:         }
178:         b
179:     }
180: }

299: pub struct CirculationSpine {

302:     pub spine_kind: SpaceProgram,
303: 
304:     pub path: Vec<Position>,
305: 
306:     pub width: f32,
307: }
308: 
309: impl CirculationSpine {
310: 
311:     pub fn distance(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
312:         self.nearest(x, z).0
313:     }
314: 
315: 
316: 
317: 
318: 
319:     pub fn nearest(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> (f32, f32, bool) {
320:         let mut best = (f32::MAX, 0.0, true);
321:         for seg in self.path.windows(2) {
322:             let (a, b) = (seg[0], seg[1]);
323:             let (dx, dz) = (b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
324:             let len2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
325:             let t = if len2 > 0.0 {
326:                 (((x - a.x) * dx + (z - a.z) * dz) / len2).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
327:             } else {
328:                 0.0
329:             };
330:             let (px, pz) = (a.x + t * dx, a.z + t * dz);
331:             let d2 = (x - px) * (x - px) + (z - pz) * (z - pz);
332:             if d2 < best.0 {
333:                 let horizontal = dx.abs() >= dz.abs();
334:                 best = (d2, if horizontal { px } else { pz }, horizontal);
335:             }
336:         }
337:         (best.0.sqrt(), best.1, best.2)
338:     }
339: }
````

````rust
228:             (CarpetDepth::Shallow, _) | (_, CarpetCondition::Dry) => VOXEL_DRY_CARPET,
229:             (CarpetDepth::Deep, CarpetCondition::WetSticky) => match self.wall {
````

````rust
 10: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 11: pub struct ProbeGrid {

 18: 
 19: impl ProbeGrid {
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26:     pub fn new(width: usize, height: usize, depth: usize) -> Self {
 27:         let size = width.saturating_mul(height).saturating_mul(depth).saturating_mul(3);
 28:         Self {
 29:             width,
 30:             height,
 31:             depth,
 32:             data: vec![0; size],
 33:         }
 34:     }
 35: 
 36: 
 37:     pub fn empty() -> Self {
 38:         Self::new(1, 1, 1)
 39:     }
 40: 
 41: 
 42:     pub fn dimensions(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
 43:         (self.width, self.height, self.depth)
 44:     }
 45: 
 46: 
 47:     pub fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
 48:         &self.data
 49:     }
 50: 
 51: 
 52:     #[inline]
 53:     fn index(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> usize {
 54:         (z * self.height * self.width + y * self.width + x) * 3
 55:     }
 56: 
 57: 
 58:     pub fn set_probe(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize, rgb: [u8; 3]) {
 59:         if x < self.width && y < self.height && z < self.depth {
 60:             let idx = self.index(x, y, z);
 61:             self.data[idx] = rgb[0];
 62:             self.data[idx + 1] = rgb[1];
 63:             self.data[idx + 2] = rgb[2];
 64:         }
 65:     }
 66: 
 67: 
 68:     pub fn get_probe(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> [u8; 3] {
 69:         if x < self.width && y < self.height && z < self.depth {
 70:             let idx = self.index(x, y, z);
 71:             [self.data[idx], self.data[idx + 1], self.data[idx + 2]]
 72:         } else {
 73:             [0, 0, 0]
 74:         }
 75:     }
 76: 
 77: 
 78: 
 79: 
 80: 
 81: 
 82: 
 83: 
 84:     pub fn from_voxel_grid(
 85:         grid: &VoxelGrid,
 86:         target_width: usize,
 87:         target_height: usize,
 88:         target_depth: usize,
 89:     ) -> Self {
 90:         let mut probe_grid = Self::new(target_width, target_height, target_depth);
 91:         if grid.width() == 0 || grid.height() == 0 || grid.depth() == 0 {
 92:             return probe_grid;
 93:         }
 94: 
 95:         let vox_w = grid.width();
 96:         let vox_h = grid.height();
 97:         let vox_d = grid.depth();
 98: 
 99:         for pz in 0..target_depth {
100:             let z_start = (pz * vox_d) / target_depth;
101:             let z_end = (((pz + 1) * vox_d) / target_depth).max(z_start + 1).min(vox_d);
102: 
103:             for py in 0..target_height {
104:                 let y_start = (py * vox_h) / target_height;
105:                 let y_end = (((py + 1) * vox_h) / target_height).max(y_start + 1).min(vox_h);
106: 
107:                 for px in 0..target_width {
108:                     let x_start = (px * vox_w) / target_width;
109:                     let x_end = (((px + 1) * vox_w) / target_width).max(x_start + 1).min(vox_w);
110: 
111:                     let mut sum_r: u32 = 0;
112:                     let mut sum_g: u32 = 0;
113:                     let mut sum_b: u32 = 0;
114:                     let mut count: u32 = 0;
115: 
116:                     for vz in z_start..z_end {
117:                         for vy in y_start..y_end {
118:                             for vx in x_start..x_end {
119:                                 let vtype = grid.get(vx, vy, vz);
120: 
121:                                 if vtype == VOXEL_AIR || count == 0 {
122:                                     let [r, g, b] = grid.get_light_rgb(vx, vy, vz);
123:                                     sum_r += r as u32;
124:                                     sum_g += g as u32;
125:                                     sum_b += b as u32;
126:                                     count += 1;
127:                                 }
128:                             }
129:                         }
130:                     }
131: 
132:                     if count > 0 {
133:                         let avg_rgb = [
134:                             (sum_r / count).min(255) as u8,
135:                             (sum_g / count).min(255) as u8,
136:                             (sum_b / count).min(255) as u8,
137:                         ];
138:                         probe_grid.set_probe(px, py, pz, avg_rgb);
139:                     }
140:                 }
141:             }
142:         }
143: 
144:         probe_grid
145:     }
146: }
147:
````

````rust
  1: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  2: pub enum SvoNode {
  3: 
  4:     Leaf {
  5:         voxel_type: u8,
  6:         color: u32,
  7:         light_rgb: [u8; 3],
  8:         face_occlusion: u8,
  9:     },
 10: 
 11:     Internal {
 12: 
 13:         child_base_index: u32,
 14: 
 15:         child_mask: u8,
 16:     },
 17: }
 18: 
 19: 
 20: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
 21: pub struct SparseVoxelOctree {
 22:     pub root: usize,
 23:     pub nodes: Vec<SvoNode>,
 24:     pub depth: u32,
 25:     pub world_size: f32,
 26: }
 27: 
 28: impl SparseVoxelOctree {
 29: 
 30:     pub fn new(depth: u32, world_size: f32) -> Self {
 31:         let root_node = SvoNode::Leaf {
 32:             voxel_type: 0,
 33:             color: 0,
 34:             light_rgb: [0; 3],
 35:             face_occlusion: 0,
 36:         };
 37:         Self {
 38:             root: 0,
 39:             nodes: vec![root_node],
 40:             depth,
 41:             world_size,
 42:         }
 43:     }
 44: 
 45: 
 46:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
 47:         match self.nodes[self.root] {
 48:             SvoNode::Leaf { voxel_type, .. } => voxel_type == 0,
 49:             SvoNode::Internal { child_mask, .. } => child_mask == 0,
 50:         }
 51:     }
 52: 
 53: 
 54:     pub fn get(&self, x: u32, y: u32, z: u32) -> Option<(u8, u32, [u8; 3], u8)> {
 55:         let max_coord = 1 << self.depth;
 56:         if x >= max_coord || y >= max_coord || z >= max_coord {
 57:             return None;
 58:         }
 59:         self.get_recursive(self.root, x, y, z, self.depth)
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     fn get_recursive(
 63:         &self,
 64:         node_idx: usize,
 65:         x: u32,
 66:         y: u32,
 67:         z: u32,
 68:         depth: u32,
 69:     ) -> Option<(u8, u32, [u8; 3], u8)> {
 70:         if node_idx >= self.nodes.len() {
 71:             return None;
 72:         }
 73: 
 74:         match self.nodes[node_idx] {
 75:             SvoNode::Leaf {
 76:                 voxel_type,
 77:                 color,
 78:                 light_rgb,
 79:                 face_occlusion,
 80:             } => Some((voxel_type, color, light_rgb, face_occlusion)),
 81:             SvoNode::Internal {
 82:                 child_base_index,
 83:                 child_mask,
 84:             } => {
 85:                 if depth == 0 {
 86:                     return None;
 87:                 }
 88: 
 89:                 let bit = depth - 1;
 90:                 let octant_x = (x >> bit) & 1;
 91:                 let octant_y = (y >> bit) & 1;
 92:                 let octant_z = (z >> bit) & 1;
 93:                 let octant_idx = (octant_z << 2) | (octant_y << 1) | octant_x;
 94: 
 95: 
 96:                 if (child_mask & (1 << octant_idx)) == 0 {
 97:                     return Some((0, 0, [0; 3], 0));
 98:                 }
 99: 
100:                 let child_node_idx = child_base_index as usize + octant_idx as usize;
101:                 let mask = (1 << bit) - 1;
102:                 self.get_recursive(child_node_idx, x & mask, y & mask, z & mask, depth - 1)
103:             }
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107: 
108:     pub fn set(
109:         &mut self,
110:         x: u32,
111:         y: u32,
112:         z: u32,
113:         voxel_type: u8,
114:         color: u32,
115:         light_rgb: [u8; 3],
116:         face_occlusion: u8,
117:     ) {
118:         let max_coord = 1 << self.depth;
119:         if x >= max_coord || y >= max_coord || z >= max_coord {
120:             return;
121:         }
122:         self.set_recursive(
123:             self.root,
124:             x,
125:             y,
126:             z,
127:             self.depth,
128:             voxel_type,
129:             color,
130:             light_rgb,
131:             face_occlusion,
132:         );
133:     }
134: 
135:     fn set_recursive(
136:         &mut self,
137:         node_idx: usize,
138:         x: u32,
139:         y: u32,
140:         z: u32,
141:         depth: u32,
142:         v_type: u8,
143:         col: u32,
144:         ll: [u8; 3],
145:         fo: u8,
146:     ) {
147:         match self.nodes[node_idx] {
148:             SvoNode::Leaf {
149:                 voxel_type,
150:                 color,
151:                 light_rgb,
152:                 face_occlusion,
153:             } => {
154:                 if voxel_type == v_type && color == col && light_rgb == ll && face_occlusion == fo {
155:                     return;
156:                 }
157: 
158:                 if depth == 0 {
159:                     self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Leaf {
160:                         voxel_type: v_type,
161:                         color: col,
162:                         light_rgb: ll,
163:                         face_occlusion: fo,
164:                     };
165:                     return;
166:                 }
167: 
168: 
169:                 let child_base_index = self.nodes.len() as u32;
170:                 let child_mask = if voxel_type == 0 { 0 } else { 0xFF };
171: 
172:                 for _ in 0..8 {
173:                     self.nodes.push(SvoNode::Leaf {
174:                         voxel_type,
175:                         color,
176:                         light_rgb,
177:                         face_occlusion,
178:                     });
179:                 }
180: 
181:                 self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Internal {
182:                     child_base_index,
183:                     child_mask,
184:                 };
185: 
186:                 self.set_recursive(node_idx, x, y, z, depth, v_type, col, ll, fo);
187:             }
188:             SvoNode::Internal {
189:                 child_base_index,
190:                 mut child_mask,
191:             } => {
192:                 let bit = depth - 1;
193:                 let octant_x = (x >> bit) & 1;
194:                 let octant_y = (y >> bit) & 1;
195:                 let octant_z = (z >> bit) & 1;
196:                 let octant_idx = (octant_z << 2) | (octant_y << 1) | octant_x;
197: 
198:                 let child_node_idx = child_base_index as usize + octant_idx as usize;
199: 
200:                 if v_type != 0 {
201:                     child_mask |= 1 << octant_idx;
202:                 }
203: 
204:                 self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Internal {
205:                     child_base_index,
206:                     child_mask,
207:                 };
208: 
209:                 let mask = (1 << bit) - 1;
210:                 self.set_recursive(
211:                     child_node_idx,
212:                     x & mask,
213:                     y & mask,
214:                     z & mask,
215:                     depth - 1,
216:                     v_type,
217:                     col,
218:                     ll,
219:                     fo,
220:                 );
221: 
222: 
223:                 self.collapse_if_uniform(node_idx);
224:             }
225:         }
226:     }
227: 
228:     fn collapse_if_uniform(&mut self, node_idx: usize) {
229:         if let SvoNode::Internal {
230:             child_base_index, ..
231:         } = self.nodes[node_idx]
232:         {
233:             let first_child_idx = child_base_index as usize;
234:             let mut uniform = true;
235:             let mut first_val = None;
236: 
237:             for i in 0..8 {
238:                 match self.nodes[first_child_idx + i] {
239:                     SvoNode::Internal { .. } => {
240:                         uniform = false;
241:                         break;
242:                     }
243:                     SvoNode::Leaf {
244:                         voxel_type,
245:                         color,
246:                         light_rgb,
247:                         face_occlusion,
248:                     } => {
249:                         if let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
250:                             if vt != voxel_type
251:                                 || col != color
252:                                 || ll != light_rgb
253:                                 || fo != face_occlusion
254:                             {
255:                                 uniform = false;
256:                                 break;
257:                             }
258:                         } else {
259:                             first_val = Some((voxel_type, color, light_rgb, face_occlusion));
260:                         }
261:                     }
262:                 }
263:             }
264: 
265:             if uniform {
266:                 if let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
267:                     self.nodes[node_idx] = SvoNode::Leaf {
268:                         voxel_type: vt,
269:                         color: col,
270:                         light_rgb: ll,
271:                         face_occlusion: fo,
272:                     };
273:                 }
274:             }
275:         }
276:     }
277: }
````

````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::position::Position;
 2: 
 3: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
 4: #[repr(u8)]
 5: pub enum SupplyKind {
 6: 
 7:     AlmondWater = 0,
 8: 
 9:     Ration = 1,
10: }
11: 
12: pub(crate) fn decode_supply_kind(value: u32) -> Option<SupplyKind> {
13:     match value {
14:         0 => Some(SupplyKind::AlmondWater),
15:         1 => Some(SupplyKind::Ration),
16:         _ => None,
17:     }
18: }
19: 
20: 
21: 
22: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
23: pub struct SupplyItem {
24:     pub id: u64,
25:     pub kind: SupplyKind,
26:     pub position: Position,
27:     pub rest_y: f32,
28: }
29: 
30: impl SupplyItem {
31:     pub const WORDS: usize = 6;
32: 
33:     pub fn within_reach(&self, x: f32, z: f32, reach: f32) -> bool {
34:         let dx = x - self.position.x;
35:         let dz = z - self.position.z;
36:         dx * dx + dz * dz <= reach * reach
37:     }
38: 
39:     pub fn to_words(self) -> [u32; Self::WORDS] {
40:         [
41:             self.id as u32,
42:             (self.id >> 32) as u32,
43:             self.kind as u32,
44:             self.position.x.to_bits(),
45:             self.position.z.to_bits(),
46:             self.rest_y.to_bits(),
47:         ]
48:     }
49: 
50:     pub fn from_words(words: &[u32]) -> Option<Self> {
51:         if words.len() != Self::WORDS {
52:             return None;
53:         }
54:         Some(Self {
55:             id: words[0] as u64 | ((words[1] as u64) << 32),
56:             kind: decode_supply_kind(words[2])?,
57:             position: Position::new(f32::from_bits(words[3]), f32::from_bits(words[4])),
58:             rest_y: f32::from_bits(words[5]),
59:         })
60:     }
61: }
62:

64: mod tests {
65:     use super::*;
66: 
67:     #[test]
68:     fn transport_words_round_trip() {
69:         let item = SupplyItem {
70:             id: 0xDEAD_BEEF_0042_1177,
71:             kind: SupplyKind::Ration,
72:             position: Position::new(-12.25, 830.5),
73:             rest_y: 0.8,
74:         };
75:         assert_eq!(SupplyItem::from_words(&item.to_words()), Some(item));
76:         assert_eq!(SupplyItem::from_words(&[0; 3]), None);
77:     }
78:

80:     fn reach_is_a_horizontal_disc() {

85:             rest_y: 0.0,
86:         };
87:         assert!(item.within_reach(10.5, 10.0, 0.6));
88:         assert!(!item.within_reach(11.0, 11.0, 0.6));
89:     }
90: }
````

````rust
132: impl VoxelGrid {
133:     pub fn new(width: usize, height: usize, depth: usize) -> Self {
134:         let size = width * height * depth;
135:         Self {
136:             width,
137:             height,
138:             depth,
139:             data: vec![VOXEL_AIR; size],
140:             light_data: vec![0; size],
141:             light_rgb: vec![[0; 3]; size],
142:             runtime_lights: Vec::new(),
143:             traversal_gates: Vec::new(),
144:             pit_hazards: Vec::new(),
145:             supply_items: Vec::new(),
146:             level_exits: Vec::new(),
147:             face_occlusion: vec![0; size],
148:         }
149:     }
150: 
151:     pub fn width(&self) -> usize {
152:         self.width
153:     }
154:     pub fn height(&self) -> usize {
155:         self.height
156:     }
157:     pub fn depth(&self) -> usize {
158:         self.depth
159:     }
160: 
161:     fn index(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> Option<usize> {
162:         if x < self.width && y < self.height && z < self.depth {
163:             Some(y * (self.width * self.depth) + z * self.width + x)
164:         } else {
165:             None
166:         }
167:     }
168: 
169:     pub fn set(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize, voxel_type: u8) {
170:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
171:             self.data[idx] = voxel_type;
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:     pub fn get(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> u8 {
176:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
177:             self.data[idx]
178:         } else {
179:             VOXEL_AIR
180:         }
181:     }
182: 
183: 
184:     pub fn set_light(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize, level: u8) {
185:         self.set_light_rgb(x, y, z, [level; 3]);
186:     }
187: 
188:     pub fn get_light(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> u8 {
189:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
190:             self.light_data[idx]
191:         } else {
192:             0
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196: 
197: 
198:     pub fn set_light_rgb(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize, rgb: [u8; 3]) {
199:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
200:             self.light_rgb[idx] = rgb;
201:             self.light_data[idx] = rgb[0].max(rgb[1]).max(rgb[2]);
202:         }
203:     }
204: 
205:     pub fn get_light_rgb(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> [u8; 3] {
206:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
207:             self.light_rgb[idx]
208:         } else {
209:             [0; 3]
210:         }
211:     }
212: 
213: 
214:     pub fn set_face_occlusion(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize, mask: u8) {
215:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
216:             self.face_occlusion[idx] = mask & FACE_OCCLUSION_MASK;
217:         }
218:     }
219: 
220:     pub fn get_face_occlusion(&self, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> u8 {
221:         if let Some(idx) = self.index(x, y, z) {
222:             self.face_occlusion[idx]
223:         } else {
224:             0
225:         }
226:     }
227: }
````

## File: src/domain/use_cases/generate_maze.rs
````rust
  1: use crate::domain::entities::grid::Grid;
  2: use rand::Rng;
  3: #[allow(unused_imports)]
  4: use rand::RngExt;
  5: 
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: pub trait MazeGenerator {
 12: 
 13:     fn generate<R: Rng + ?Sized>(&self, grid: &mut Grid, rng: &mut R);
 14: }
 15: 
 16: 
 17: 
 18: 
 19: pub struct GrowingTreeGenerator {
 20:     pub junction_density: f32,
 21: }
 22: 
 23: impl MazeGenerator for GrowingTreeGenerator {
 24:     fn generate<R: Rng + ?Sized>(&self, grid: &mut Grid, rng: &mut R) {
 25:         let width = grid.width();
 26:         let depth = grid.depth();
 27:         if width == 0 || depth == 0 {
 28:             return;
 29:         }
 30: 
 31: 
 32:         let start_x = rng.random_range(0..width);
 33:         let start_y = rng.random_range(0..depth);
 34: 
 35:         if let Some(cell) = grid.get_mut(start_x, start_y) {
 36:             cell.visited = true;
 37:         }
 38: 
 39:         let mut frontier = vec![(start_x, start_y)];
 40: 
 41:         while !frontier.is_empty() {
 42: 
 43:             let idx = rng.random_range(0..frontier.len());
 44:             let (cx, cy) = frontier[idx];
 45: 
 46: 
 47: 
 48:             let neighbors: [(isize, isize, usize, usize); 4] = [
 49:                 (cx as isize, (cy as isize) - 1, 0, 2),
 50:                 ((cx as isize) + 1, cy as isize, 1, 3),
 51:                 (cx as isize, (cy as isize) + 1, 2, 0),
 52:                 ((cx as isize) - 1, cy as isize, 3, 1),
 53:             ];
 54: 
 55:             let mut unvisited = Vec::new();
 56:             for &(nx, ny, wall_here, wall_there) in &neighbors {
 57:                 if nx >= 0 && nx < width as isize && ny >= 0 && ny < depth as isize {
 58:                     let (nx_u, ny_u) = (nx as usize, ny as usize);
 59:                     if let Some(cell) = grid.get(nx_u, ny_u) {
 60:                         if !cell.visited {
 61:                             unvisited.push((nx_u, ny_u, wall_here, wall_there));
 62:                         }
 63:                     }
 64:                 }
 65:             }
 66: 
 67:             if unvisited.is_empty() {
 68:                 frontier.swap_remove(idx);
 69:             } else {
 70:                 let unvisited_idx = rng.random_range(0..unvisited.len());
 71:                 let (nx, ny, wall_here, wall_there) = unvisited[unvisited_idx];
 72: 
 73: 
 74:                 if let Some(cell) = grid.get_mut(cx, cy) {
 75:                     cell.walls[wall_here] = false;
 76:                 }
 77:                 if let Some(cell) = grid.get_mut(nx, ny) {
 78:                     cell.walls[wall_there] = false;
 79:                     cell.visited = true;
 80:                 }
 81: 
 82:                 frontier.push((nx, ny));
 83:             }
 84:         }
 85: 
 86: 
 87:         let base_openings = (width * depth) as f32 / 4.0;
 88:         let extra_openings = (base_openings * self.junction_density) as usize;
 89:         let mut actual_openings = 0;
 90:         let mut attempts = 0;
 91: 
 92:         while actual_openings < extra_openings && attempts < extra_openings * 3 {
 93:             attempts += 1;
 94:             let x = rng.random_range(0..width);
 95:             let y = rng.random_range(0..depth);
 96: 
 97: 
 98:             if let Some(cell) = grid.get(x, y) {
 99:                 if cell.zone == crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone::Blackout {
100:                     continue;
101:                 }
102:             }
103: 
104:             let dir = rng.random_range(0..4);
105: 
106:             if let Some(cell) = grid.get_mut(x, y) {
107:                 cell.walls[dir] = false;
108:             }
109: 
110:             let (nx, ny) = match dir {
111:                 0 => (x as isize, y as isize - 1),
112:                 1 => (x as isize + 1, y as isize),
113:                 2 => (x as isize, y as isize + 1),
114:                 3 => (x as isize - 1, y as isize),
115:                 _ => unreachable!(),
116:             };
117: 
118:             if nx >= 0 && nx < width as isize && ny >= 0 && ny < depth as isize {
119:                 let (nx, ny) = (nx as usize, ny as usize);
120:                 let opposite_dir = (dir + 2) % 4;
121:                 if let Some(n_cell) = grid.get_mut(nx, ny) {
122:                     n_cell.walls[opposite_dir] = false;
123:                 }
124:             }
125: 
126:             actual_openings += 1;
127:         }
128:     }
129: }
130: 
131: #[cfg(test)]
132: mod tests {
133:     use super::*;
134:     use crate::domain::entities::grid::Grid;
135:     use rand::SeedableRng;
136:     use rand::rngs::StdRng;
137: 
138:     #[test]
139:     fn test_generate_maze_visits_all_cells() {
140:         let mut grid = Grid::new(10, 10);
141:         let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(42);
142: 
143:         let generator = GrowingTreeGenerator {
144:             junction_density: 1.0,
145:         };
146:         generator.generate(&mut grid, &mut rng);
147: 
148:         for y in 0..grid.depth() {
149:             for x in 0..grid.width() {
150:                 let cell = grid.get(x, y).unwrap();
151:                 assert!(cell.visited, "Cell at ({}, {}) was not visited", x, y);
152:             }
153:         }
154:     }
155: }
````

````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::grid::Grid;
 2: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 3:     VOXEL_AIR, VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_WALL, VoxelGrid,

 6: 
 7: 
 8: pub trait LevelBuilder {
 9:     fn build_voxels(&self, grid: &Grid) -> VoxelGrid;
10: }
11: 
12: 
13: 
14: pub struct Level0Builder {
15:     pub room_size: usize,
16:     pub wall_height: usize,
17: }
18: 
19: impl LevelBuilder for Level0Builder {
20:     fn build_voxels(&self, grid: &Grid) -> VoxelGrid {
21:         let rs = self.room_size;
22:         let wh = self.wall_height;
23: 
24: 
25:         let vw = grid.width() * rs;
26:         let vh = wh + 3;
27:         let vd = grid.depth() * rs;
28: 
29:         let mut voxels = VoxelGrid::new(vw, vh, vd);
30: 
31:         for gy in 0..grid.depth() {
32:             for gx in 0..grid.width() {
33:                 let cell = grid.get(gx, gy).unwrap();
34:                 let base_x = gx * rs;
35:                 let base_z = gy * rs;
36: 
37:                 for lx in 0..rs {
38:                     for lz in 0..rs {
39:                         let vx = base_x + lx;
40:                         let vz = base_z + lz;
41: 
42: 
43:                         voxels.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
44: 
45: 
46:                         let is_north_wall = lz == 0 && cell.walls[0];
47:                         let is_east_wall = lx == rs - 1 && cell.walls[1];
48:                         let is_south_wall = lz == rs - 1 && cell.walls[2];
49:                         let is_west_wall = lx == 0 && cell.walls[3];
50: 
51:                         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
52:                         let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
53:                             VOXEL_RED_WALL
54:                         } else {
55:                             VOXEL_WALL
56:                         };
57: 
58:                         if is_north_wall || is_east_wall || is_south_wall || is_west_wall {
59:                             for h in 1..=wh {
60:                                 voxels.set(vx, h, vz, wall_type);
61:                             }
62:                         }
63: 
64: 
65: 
66:                         let mut is_light = false;
67:                         if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Blackout {
68: 
69:                             let fixture1 = lx >= 4 && lx < 6 && lz >= 5 && lz < 11;
70:                             let fixture2 = lx >= 10 && lx < 12 && lz >= 5 && lz < 11;
71:                             if fixture1 || fixture2 {
72:                                 is_light = true;
73:                             }
74:                         }
75: 
76:                         if is_light {
77: 
78:                             voxels.set(vx, vh - 2, vz, VOXEL_AIR);
79:                             voxels.set(vx, vh - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
80:                         } else {
81:                             voxels.set(vx, vh - 2, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
82:                         }
83:                     }
84:                 }
85:             }
86:         }
87: 
88:         voxels
89:     }
90: }
````

````rust
 16: ) -> Option<(usize, usize, usize, u8)> {
 17:     let step_x = if dx > 0.0 { 1 } else { -1 };
 18:     let step_y = if dy > 0.0 { 1 } else { -1 };
 19:     let step_z = if dz > 0.0 { 1 } else { -1 };
 20: 
 21:     let mut t_max_x = if dx != 0.0 {
 22:         (x.floor() + if dx > 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 } - x) / dx
 23:     } else {
 24:         f32::INFINITY
 25:     };
 26:     let mut t_max_y = if dy != 0.0 {
 27:         (y.floor() + if dy > 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 } - y) / dy
 28:     } else {
 29:         f32::INFINITY
 30:     };
 31:     let mut t_max_z = if dz != 0.0 {
 32:         (z.floor() + if dz > 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 } - z) / dz
 33:     } else {
 34:         f32::INFINITY
 35:     };
 36: 
 37:     let t_delta_x = if dx != 0.0 {
 38:         (1.0 / dx).abs()
 39:     } else {
 40:         f32::INFINITY
 41:     };
 42:     let t_delta_y = if dy != 0.0 {
 43:         (1.0 / dy).abs()
 44:     } else {
 45:         f32::INFINITY
 46:     };
 47:     let t_delta_z = if dz != 0.0 {
 48:         (1.0 / dz).abs()
 49:     } else {
 50:         f32::INFINITY
 51:     };
 52: 
 53:     let mut ix = x as isize;
 54:     let mut iy = y as isize;
 55:     let mut iz = z as isize;
 56: 
 57:     for _ in 0..max_steps {
 58:         if t_max_x < t_max_y {
 59:             if t_max_x < t_max_z {
 60:                 ix += step_x;
 61:                 t_max_x += t_delta_x;
 62:             } else {
 63:                 iz += step_z;
 64:                 t_max_z += t_delta_z;
 65:             }
 66:         } else {
 67:             if t_max_y < t_max_z {
 68:                 iy += step_y;
 69:                 t_max_y += t_delta_y;
 70:             } else {
 71:                 iz += step_z;
 72:                 t_max_z += t_delta_z;
 73:             }
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         if ix < 0
 77:             || iy < 0
 78:             || iz < 0
 79:             || ix >= grid.width() as isize
 80:             || iy >= grid.height() as isize
 81:             || iz >= grid.depth() as isize
 82:         {
 83:             break;
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         let vx = ix as usize;
 87:         let vy = iy as usize;
 88:         let vz = iz as usize;
 89: 
 90:         let v = grid.get(vx, vy, vz);
 91:         if v != VOXEL_AIR {
 92:             return Some((vx, vy, vz, v));
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95:     None
 96: }
 97: 
 98: 
 99: pub fn bake_path_traced_lighting(grid: &mut VoxelGrid) {
100:     let w = grid.width();
101:     let h = grid.height();
102:     let d = grid.depth();
103: 
104:     let rays_per_voxel = 64;
105:     let max_bounces = 1;
106:     let max_steps = 30;
107: 
108:     let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(42);
109: 
110: 
111: 
112: 
113: 
114: 
115: 
116:     for z in 0..d {
117:         for y in 0..h {
118:             for x in 0..w {
119:                 let v = grid.get(x, y, z);
120:                 if v == VOXEL_AIR || v == VOXEL_LIGHT {
121:                     continue;
122:                 }
123: 
124: 
125: 
126: 
127: 
128:                 let mut total_light = 0.0;
129: 
130: 
131:                 let mut px = x as f32 + 0.5;
132:                 let mut py = y as f32 + 0.5;
133:                 let mut pz = z as f32 + 0.5;
134: 
135: 
136:                 if x > 0 && grid.get(x - 1, y, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
137:                     px -= 0.55;
138:                 } else if x < w - 1 && grid.get(x + 1, y, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
139:                     px += 0.55;
140:                 } else if y > 0 && grid.get(x, y - 1, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
141:                     py -= 0.55;
142:                 } else if y < h - 1 && grid.get(x, y + 1, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
143:                     py += 0.55;
144:                 } else if z > 0 && grid.get(x, y, z - 1) == VOXEL_AIR {
145:                     pz -= 0.55;
146:                 } else if z < d - 1 && grid.get(x, y, z + 1) == VOXEL_AIR {
147:                     pz += 0.55;
148:                 } else {
149:                     continue;
150:                 }
151: 
152:                 for _ in 0..rays_per_voxel {
153: 
154:                     let theta = rng.random::<f32>() * 2.0 * std::f32::consts::PI;
155:                     let phi = (rng.random::<f32>() * 2.0 - 1.0).acos();
156:                     let dx = phi.sin() * theta.cos();
157:                     let dy = phi.cos();
158:                     let dz = phi.sin() * theta.sin();
159: 
160:                     if let Some((_hx, _hy, _hz, hit_type)) =
161:                         cast_ray(grid, px, py, pz, dx, dy, dz, max_steps)
162:                     {
163:                         if hit_type == VOXEL_LIGHT {
164:                             total_light += 1.0;
165:                         } else if max_bounces > 0 {
166: 
167: 
168: 
169: 
170:                             total_light += 0.05;
171:                         }
172:                     }
173:                 }
174: 
175: 
176:                 let mut light_level = ((total_light / rays_per_voxel as f32) * 15.0 * 2.0) as u8;
177:                 if light_level > 15 {
178:                     light_level = 15;
179:                 }
180: 
181:                 grid.set_light(x, y, z, light_level);
182:             }
183:         }
184:     }
185: }
````

````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::position::Position;
 2: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
 3: 
 4: 
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: pub struct SimpleNoiseProvider;
 9: 
10: impl SimpleNoiseProvider {
11:     pub fn new() -> Self {
12:         Self
13:     }
14: 
15: 
16:     fn hash2d(seed: u32, x: i32, y: i32) -> f32 {
17: 
18:         let mut h = seed
19:             .wrapping_add(x as u32 ^ 0x9E3779B9)
20:             .wrapping_add(y as u32 ^ 0x85EBCA6B);
21:         h ^= h >> 16;
22:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0x85EBCA6B);
23:         h ^= h >> 13;
24:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2AE35);
25:         h ^= h >> 16;
26: 
27: 
28:         ((h as f32) / (std::u32::MAX as f32)) * 2.0 - 1.0
29:     }
30: 
31: 
32:     fn lerp(a: f32, b: f32, t: f32) -> f32 {
33:         a + t * (b - a)
34:     }
35: 
36: 
37:     fn smoothstep(t: f32) -> f32 {
38:         t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
39:     }
40: }
41: 
42: impl NoiseProvider for SimpleNoiseProvider {
43:     fn evaluate_2d(&self, seed: u32, position: Position) -> f32 {
44: 
45:         let freq = 0.05;
46:         let x = position.x * freq;
47:         let y = position.z * freq;
48: 
49:         let x0 = x.floor() as i32;
50:         let x1 = x0 + 1;
51:         let y0 = y.floor() as i32;
52:         let y1 = y0 + 1;
53: 
54:         let tx = x - (x0 as f32);
55:         let ty = y - (y0 as f32);
56: 
57:         let u = Self::smoothstep(tx);
58:         let v = Self::smoothstep(ty);
59: 
60:         let v00 = Self::hash2d(seed, x0, y0);
61:         let v10 = Self::hash2d(seed, x1, y0);
62:         let v01 = Self::hash2d(seed, x0, y1);
63:         let v11 = Self::hash2d(seed, x1, y1);
64: 
65:         let nx0 = Self::lerp(v00, v10, u);
66:         let nx1 = Self::lerp(v01, v11, u);
67: 
68:         Self::lerp(nx0, nx1, v)
69:     }
70: }
71: 
72: #[cfg(test)]
73: mod tests {
74:     use super::*;
75: 
76:     #[test]
77:     fn test_noise_determinism() {
78:         let provider = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
79:         let pos = Position::new(42.5, -17.2);
80: 
81:         let val1 = provider.evaluate_2d(123, pos);
82:         let val2 = provider.evaluate_2d(123, pos);
83:         let val3 = provider.evaluate_2d(999, pos);
84: 
85:         assert_eq!(val1, val2);
86:         assert_ne!(val1, val3);
87:     }
88: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/anomalies/determinism.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind;
 2: 
 3: pub(crate) const SNAP: f32 = 0.4;
 4: 
 5: pub(crate) fn snap(value: f32) -> f32 {
 6:     (value / SNAP).round() * SNAP
 7: }
 8: 
 9: pub(crate) fn mix64(mut value: u64) -> u64 {
10:     value ^= value >> 30;
11:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
12:     value ^= value >> 27;
13:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
14:     value ^ (value >> 31)
15: }
16: 
17: pub(crate) fn hash(seed: u32, salt: u64, x: i64, z: i64) -> u64 {
18:     mix64(
19:         seed as u64
20:             ^ salt
21:             ^ (x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
22:             ^ (z as u64).rotate_left(31),
23:     )
24: }
25: 
26: pub(crate) fn unit(hash: u64) -> f32 {
27:     (hash >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
28: }
29: 
30: pub(crate) fn stable_id(seed: u32, kind: AnomalyKind, anchor_x: i64, anchor_z: i64) -> u64 {
31:     hash(
32:         seed,
33:         0xA110_4A1E_0000_0000 | kind as u64,
34:         anchor_x,
35:         anchor_z,
36:     )
37: }
````

````rust
 11: const LIGHT_PERIOD: f32 = 2.8;

 13: 
 14: 
 15: const GENERATION_TILE_UNITS: f32 = 10.0;
 16: 
 17: struct SampleContext<'a> {
 18:     instance: &'a AnomalyInstance,
 19:     noise: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
 20:     seed: u32,
 21:     config: &'a GeneratorConfig,
 22:     reality: &'a RealitySnapshot,
 23:     world_x: f32,

 25:     local_x: f32,
 26:     local_z: f32,
 27:     boundary: f32,

 32: 
 33: /// Sample one immutable macro anomaly or stable archway anchor.
 34: ///
 35: /// Corridors have already won composition priority before this function is
 36: /// called, so every family may assume its protected bearing route is the only
 37: /// remaining cross-cutting circulation concern. Blackout expanses delegate
 38: /// their substrate to the ordinary Level 0 fabric sampler before applying the
 39: /// anomaly profile.
 40: pub(crate) fn sample_anomaly(
 41:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 42:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 43:     seed: u32,
 44:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 45:     reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 46:     world_x: f32,
 47:     world_z: f32,
 48: ) -> ColumnPlan {
 49:     let (local_x, local_z) = instance.local_coords(world_x, world_z);
 50:     let boundary = instance.boundary_distance(world_x, world_z);
 51:     let seam_x = world_x.rem_euclid(GENERATION_TILE_UNITS);
 52:     let seam_z = world_z.rem_euclid(GENERATION_TILE_UNITS);
 53:     let context = SampleContext {
 54:         instance,
 55:         noise,
 56:         seed,
 57:         config,
 58:         reality,
 59:         world_x,
 60:         world_z,
 61:         local_x,
 62:         local_z,
 63:         boundary,
 64:         perimeter: boundary <= PLAN_WALL_T,
 65:         skeleton: local_z.abs() <= instance.skeleton_half_width,
 66:         away_from_seam: seam_x > PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 67:             && seam_x < GENERATION_TILE_UNITS - PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 68:             && seam_z > PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 69:             && seam_z < GENERATION_TILE_UNITS - PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0,
 70:     };
 71: 
 72:     match instance.kind {
 73:         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => sample_pillar_expanse(&context),
 74:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => sample_blackout_expanse(&context),
 75:         AnomalyKind::PitLattice => sample_pit_lattice(&context),
 76:         AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => sample_archway_anchor(&context),
 77:         AnomalyKind::RedRoom => unreachable!("red rooms have a dedicated geometry sampler"),
 78:     }
 79: }
 80: 
 81: /// Dehydration multiplies mutable-infill probability: tier 3 nearly
 82: /// doubles how much anomalous mass a re-dealt space grows.
 83: fn delirium_gain(reality: &RealitySnapshot) -> f32 {
 84:     1.0 + 0.3 * reality.delirium() as f32
 85: }

 87: fn anomaly_hash(instance: &AnomalyInstance, epoch: u32, salt: u64, x: i64, z: i64) -> f32 {
 88:     let mut hash = instance.id
 89:         ^ salt
 90:         ^ (epoch as u64).rotate_left(19)
 91:         ^ (x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
 92:         ^ (z as u64).rotate_left(37);
 93:     hash ^= hash >> 30;
 94:     hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
 95:     hash ^= hash >> 27;
 96:     hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
 97:     hash ^= hash >> 31;
 98:     (hash >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
 99: }

101: fn remap_epoch(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> Option<u32> {
102:     let state = context.instance.state(context.reality)?;
103:     (state.epoch > 0
104:         && context.boundary > context.instance.entry_band
105:         && state.point_is_in_wake(
106:             context.world_x,
107:             context.world_z,
108:             context.config.anomalies.remap_distance,
109:         ))
110:     .then_some(state.epoch)
111: }

113: fn sample_pillar_expanse(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
114:     let instance = context.instance;
115:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
116:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
117:     let lattice = instance.pillar_lattice.expect("pillar instance lattice");
118:     let cell_x = ((local_x - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.bay_x).floor() as i64;
119:     let cell_z = ((local_z - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.bay_z).floor() as i64;
120:     let mut within_x = (local_x - lattice.phase_x).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
121:     let within_z = (local_z - lattice.phase_z).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_z);
122:     let mut side = instance.pillar_size(cell_x, cell_z).unwrap_or(1.2);
123: 
124:     // Distortion grows only after the entry has taught the player a regular
125:     // grid. The route and entry band therefore remain a reliable baseline.
126:     let budget = ((context.boundary - instance.entry_band) / (instance.entry_band.max(8.0) * 2.5))
127:         .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
128:     let immutable_zone = context.skeleton || budget <= 0.0;
129:     let mut dropped = false;
130:     if !immutable_zone {
131:         dropped = anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D0, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.10 * budget;
132:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D1, cell_z, 0) < 0.30 * budget {
133:             within_x = (within_x + lattice.bay_x * 0.5).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
134:         }
135:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D2, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.08 * budget {
136:             side += 0.4;
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     // A committed wake may change relationships between bays, but never at a
141:     // stable content-tile seam where resident reality cohorts meet.
142:     let wake_epoch = (!immutable_zone && context.away_from_seam)
143:         .then(|| remap_epoch(context))
144:         .flatten();
145:     if let Some(epoch) = wake_epoch {
146:         if anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F4, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.25 {
147:             side += 0.4;
148:         }
149:         if anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F5, cell_z, cell_x) < 0.35 {
150:             within_x = (within_x + 0.4).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
151:         }
152:     }
153: 
154:     let dx = within_x.min(lattice.bay_x - within_x);
155:     let dz = within_z.min(lattice.bay_z - within_z);
156:     let mut solid = context.perimeter || (!dropped && dx < side * 0.5 && dz < side * 0.5);
157:     if !solid && let Some(epoch) = wake_epoch {
158:         let edge_x = within_x < PLAN_WALL_T || lattice.bay_x - within_x < PLAN_WALL_T;
159:         let edge_z = within_z < PLAN_WALL_T || lattice.bay_z - within_z < PLAN_WALL_T;
160:         let threshold = (0.12
161:             * context.config.anomalies.remap_intensity
162:             * delirium_gain(context.reality))
163:         .clamp(0.0, 0.48);
164:         solid = (edge_x && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F1, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold)
165:             || (edge_z && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F2, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold);
166:     }
167:     if context.skeleton {
168:         solid = false;
169:     }
170: 
171:     let lane_light =
172:         local_z.abs() < 0.45 && (local_x - 2.4 + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9 && tuning.lights > 0.0;
173:     let field_light = (local_x - 2.4 + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9
174:         && (local_z + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9
175:         && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11A7, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.62 * tuning.lights;
176:     let ceiling_units = if !immutable_zone
177:         && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D3, cell_x / 2, cell_z / 2) < 0.35 * budget
178:     {
179:         4.0
180:     } else {
181:         4.2
182:     };
183:     ColumnPlan {
184:         light: !solid && (lane_light || field_light),
185:         solid,
186:         ceiling_units,
187:         floor_material: EnvironmentProfile::pillar_expanse().floor_voxel(),
188:         ..ColumnPlan::open(ceiling_units)
189:     }
190: }

192: fn sample_blackout_expanse(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
193:     let instance = context.instance;
194:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
195:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
196: 
197: 
198: 
199: 
200: 
201:     let mut plan = BackroomsLevel::column_plan_in_reality(
202:         context.noise,
203:         context.seed ^ instance.id as u32,
204:         tuning,
205:         context.reality,
206:         context.world_x,
207:         context.world_z,
208:     );
209:     let depth = instance.normalized_depth(context.world_x, context.world_z);
210:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::blackout(depth);
211:     plan.wall_material = profile.wall_voxel();
212:     plan.light_material = profile.light_voxel();
213: 
214: 
215: 
216:     if depth <= 0.22 {
217:         let cell_x = (context.world_x / LIGHT_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
218:         let cell_z = (context.world_z / LIGHT_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
219:         let keep = 1.0 - depth / 0.22;
220:         plan.light = plan.light && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0xFADE, cell_x, cell_z) < keep;
221:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_LIGHT;
222:     } else {
223:         plan.light = false;
224:     }
225:     plan.red_light = false;
226:     plan.ceiling_units = if depth > 0.68 {
227:         2.6
228:     } else if depth > 0.35 {
229:         3.0
230:     } else {
231:         3.4
232:     };
233: 
234:     if profile.floor == FloorState::RecessedFluid && !plan.solid && !context.skeleton {
235:         let cell = 7.2;
236:         let basin_x = (local_x / cell).floor() as i64;
237:         let basin_z = (local_z / cell).floor() as i64;
238:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0xF10D, basin_x, basin_z) < 0.22
239:             && local_x.rem_euclid(cell) > 1.2
240:             && local_z.rem_euclid(cell) > 1.2
241:         {
242:             plan.floor_material = VOXEL_FLUID;
243:         }
244:     }
245: 
246:     plan.solid |= context.perimeter;
247:     if context.skeleton {
248:         plan.solid = false;
249:         plan.light = local_x.rem_euclid(28.0) < 0.45 && tuning.lights > 0.0;
250:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_GLIMMER;
251:         return plan;
252:     }
253: 
254: 
255: 
256: 
257: 
258:     let decoys = (context.config.anomalies.blackout_decoys
259:         + 0.03 * context.reality.delirium() as f32)
260:         .clamp(0.0, 0.95);
261:     let off_lane = (local_z.abs() - (instance.skeleton_half_width + 7.2)).abs() < 0.45;
262:     if off_lane
263:         && depth > 0.3
264:         && local_x.rem_euclid(28.0) < 0.45
265:         && tuning.lights > 0.0
266:         && anomaly_hash(
267:             instance,
268:             0,
269:             0xDEC0,
270:             (local_x / 28.0).floor() as i64,
271:             local_z.is_sign_negative() as i64,
272:         ) < decoys
273:     {
274:         plan.light = true;
275:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_GLIMMER;
276:     }
277: 
278:     if context.away_from_seam
279:         && let Some(epoch) = remap_epoch(context)
280:     {
281:         let cell = 7.2;
282:         let cell_x = (local_x / cell).floor() as i64;
283:         let cell_z = (local_z / cell).floor() as i64;
284:         let within_x = local_x.rem_euclid(cell);
285:         let within_z = local_z.rem_euclid(cell);
286:         let edge = within_x < PLAN_WALL_T || within_z < PLAN_WALL_T;
287:         let threshold = (0.20
288:             * context.config.anomalies.remap_intensity
289:             * delirium_gain(context.reality))
290:         .clamp(0.0, 0.65);
291:         if edge && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0xB1AC, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold {
292:             plan.solid = true;
293:             plan.light = false;
294:         }
295:     }
296: 
297: 
298: 
299: 
300: 
301: 
302: 
303: 
304:     if depth > 0.25 && !context.skeleton && tuning.walls > 0.0 {
305:         const PARTITION_CELL: f32 = 9.6;
306:         let cell_x = (local_x / PARTITION_CELL).floor() as i64;
307:         let cell_z = (local_z / PARTITION_CELL).floor() as i64;
308:         let anchor = instance.world_coords(
309:             (cell_x as f32 + 0.5) * PARTITION_CELL,
310:             (cell_z as f32 + 0.5) * PARTITION_CELL,
311:         );
312:         let epoch = context.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(anchor.x, anchor.z);
313:         let within_x = local_x.rem_euclid(PARTITION_CELL);
314:         let within_z = local_z.rem_euclid(PARTITION_CELL);
315:         for (in_band, along, wall_salt, door_salt) in [
316:             (within_x < PLAN_WALL_T, within_z, 0xB1D0u64, 0xB1D1u64),
317:             (within_z < PLAN_WALL_T, within_x, 0xB1D2u64, 0xB1D3u64),
318:         ] {
319:             if !in_band {
320:                 continue;
321:             }
322:             if anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, wall_salt, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.5 {
323:                 let gap = anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, door_salt, cell_x, cell_z);
324:                 let gap_pos = 0.8 + (PARTITION_CELL - 3.2) * gap;
325:                 if along < gap_pos || along >= gap_pos + 1.6 {
326:                     plan.solid = true;
327:                     plan.light = false;
328:                 }
329:             }
330:         }
331:     }
332:     plan

335: fn sample_pit_lattice(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
336:     let lattice = context.instance.pit_lattice.expect("pit instance lattice");
337:     let within_x = (context.local_x - lattice.phase_x).rem_euclid(lattice.spacing_x);
338:     let within_z = (context.local_z - lattice.phase_z).rem_euclid(lattice.spacing_z);
339:     let dx = within_x.min(lattice.spacing_x - within_x);
340:     let dz = within_z.min(lattice.spacing_z - within_z);
341:     let pit = !context.skeleton
342:         && context.boundary > lattice.side
343:         && dx < lattice.side * 0.5
344:         && dz < lattice.side * 0.5;
345:     ColumnPlan {
346:         floor: !pit,
347:         solid: context.perimeter,
348:         light: !context.perimeter
349:             && context.local_x.rem_euclid(3.2) < 0.45
350:             && context.local_z.rem_euclid(3.2) < 0.45
351:             && context.config.tuning.lights > 0.0,
352:         ..ColumnPlan::open(3.8)
353:     }
354: }
355: 
356: /// Stable pale arch rooms never inspect `RealitySnapshot`, which keeps them a
357: /// fixed landmark against every mutable anomaly family.
358: ///
359: /// A `Transition` room is a *graph connector*: its `ArchBehavior` decides
360: /// what its far half (local `z > 0`) belongs to. The seam is expressed only
361: /// through legal architectural vocabulary — ceiling regime, floor finish,
362: /// lintel height, fixture rhythm — never through impossible collision or a
363: /// repainted wall, so the crossing is felt before it is understood.
364: fn sample_archway_anchor(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
365:     let instance = context.instance;
366:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
367:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
368:     let arch = instance.arch.expect("arch instance profile");
369:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::archway_room();
370:     let half_x = instance.footprint.half_x;
371:     let half_z = instance.footprint.half_z;
372: 
373: 
374:     let far_side = local_z > 0.0;
375:     let (ceiling_units, floor_material) = match arch.behavior {
376:         ArchBehavior::CultureSeam if far_side => {
377:             (3.0, EnvironmentProfile::pillar_expanse().floor_voxel())
378:         }
379:         ArchBehavior::ScaleBreach if far_side => (4.4, profile.floor_voxel()),
380:         _ => (3.6, profile.floor_voxel()),
381:     };
382:     let mut plan = ColumnPlan {
383:         wall_material: profile.wall_voxel(),
384:         floor_material,
385:         ..ColumnPlan::open(ceiling_units)
386:     };
387: 
388:     let bay_index = ((local_x + half_x) / arch.bay).floor() as i64;
389:     let along = (local_x + half_x).rem_euclid(arch.bay);
390: 
391: 
392: 
393:     let effective_opening = match arch.behavior {
394:         ArchBehavior::ScaleBreach if far_side => arch.opening * 1.5,
395:         _ => arch.opening,
396:     };
397:     let head_drop = match arch.behavior {
398:         ArchBehavior::CultureSeam if far_side => 0.4,
399:         _ => 0.0,
400:     };
401:     let across_opening = (along - arch.bay * 0.5).abs() < effective_opening * 0.5;
402:     let blind = bay_index.rem_euclid(arch.blind_every as i64) == arch.blind_every as i64 - 1;
403:     let arch_head = {
404:         let t = ((along - arch.bay * 0.5).abs() / (effective_opening * 0.5)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
405:         (((arch.spring_units - head_drop) + 0.6 * (1.0 - t)) / 0.2).round() * 0.2
406:     };
407: 
408:     if context.perimeter {
409:         plan.solid = tuning.walls > 0.0;
410:         let on_long_wall = half_z - local_z.abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T;
411:         match arch.layout {
412:             ArchLayout::Transition => {
413:                 if on_long_wall && across_opening && !blind {
414:                     plan.solid = false;
415:                     plan.lintel_from_units = (tuning.walls > 0.0).then_some(arch_head);
416:                 }
417:             }
418:             ArchLayout::DeadEnd => {
419:                 let on_entrance_wall = half_x - local_x.abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T && local_x < 0.0;
420:                 if on_entrance_wall && local_z.abs() < 1.0 {
421:                     plan.solid = false;
422:                     plan.lintel_from_units = (tuning.walls > 0.0).then_some(
423:                         ((arch.spring_units + 0.6 * (1.0 - local_z.abs())) / 0.2).round() * 0.2,
424:                     );
425:                 }
426:             }
427:         }
428:         return plan;
429:     }
430: 
431:     if arch.layout == ArchLayout::DeadEnd {
432:         let arcade_plane = half_z - 1.2 - PLAN_WALL_T;
433:         let in_arcade = (local_z.abs() - arcade_plane).abs() < PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5;
434:         let in_alcove = local_z.abs() > arcade_plane;
435:         if in_arcade && tuning.walls > 0.0 {
436:             if across_opening && !blind {
437:                 plan.lintel_from_units = Some(arch_head);
438:             } else {
439:                 plan.solid = true;
440:             }
441:         } else if in_alcove {
442:             plan.ceiling_units = 3.0;
443:             if ((local_x * 2.5).sin() * (local_z * 1.7).cos()).abs() < 0.3 {
444:                 plan.floor_material = VOXEL_FLUID;
445:             }
446:         }
447:     }
448: 
449:     plan.light = local_z.abs() < 0.45
450:         && (local_x + half_x - arch.bay * 0.5).rem_euclid(arch.bay * 2.0) < 0.45
451:         && tuning.lights > 0.0;
452:     let _ = context.boundary;
453:     plan
454: }
````

````rust
 18: fn weighted_family(config: &GeneratorConfig, sample: f32) -> Option<AnomalyKind> {
 19:     let tuning = config.anomalies;
 20:     let weights = [
 21:         (AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse, tuning.pillar_expanses.max(0.0)),
 22:         (AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse, tuning.blackouts.max(0.0)),
 23:         (AnomalyKind::PitLattice, tuning.pit_lattices.max(0.0)),
 24:         (AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom, tuning.archways.max(0.0)),
 25:     ];
 26:     let total: f32 = weights.iter().map(|(_, weight)| weight).sum();
 27:     if total <= 0.0 {
 28:         return None;
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     let mut cursor = sample * total;
 32:     for (kind, weight) in weights {
 33:         if cursor < weight {
 34:             return Some(kind);
 35:         }
 36:         cursor -= weight;
 37:     }
 38:     Some(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse)
 39: }

 41: fn remap_gates(instance: &AnomalyInstance) -> Vec<TraversalGate> {
 42:     let (step, first, last) = match instance.kind {
 43:         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => {
 44:             let bay = instance.pillar_lattice.map_or(4.0, |lattice| lattice.bay_x);
 45:             (
 46:                 bay * 4.0,
 47:                 -instance.footprint.half_x + instance.entry_band,
 48:                 instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band,
 49:             )
 50:         }
 51:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => (
 52:             22.0,
 53:             -instance.footprint.half_x + instance.entry_band,
 54:             instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band,
 55:         ),
 56:         _ => return Vec::new(),
 57:     };
 58: 
 59:     let mut gates = Vec::new();
 60:     let mut local_x = snap((first / step).ceil() * step);
 61:     let world_bounds = instance.footprint.bounds();
 62:     let axis = instance.basis.local_axis_in_world(Axis2::X);
 63:     while local_x <= last {
 64:         let at = instance.world_coords(local_x, 0.0);
 65:         let (plane, span_min, span_max) = match axis {
 66:             Axis2::X => (at.x, world_bounds.min_z, world_bounds.max_z),
 67:             Axis2::Z => (at.z, world_bounds.min_x, world_bounds.max_x),
 68:         };
 69:         let gate_index = (local_x / step).round() as i64;
 70:         gates.push(TraversalGate {
 71:             id: mix64(instance.id ^ (gate_index as u64).rotate_left(23) ^ 0x6A7E),
 72:             instance_id: instance.id,
 73:             anomaly_kind: instance.kind,
 74:             kind: TraversalGateKind::Remap,
 75:             axis,
 76:             plane,
 77:             span_min,
 78:             span_max,
 79:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
 80:             affected_bounds: world_bounds,
 81:         });
 82:         local_x += step;
 83:     }
 84:     gates
 85: }

208: fn forced_instance(
209:     seed: u32,
210:     query: WorldBounds,

219:     if kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom {

236:     let instance = macro_instance(seed, anchor_x, anchor_z, kind, config);

239:         .bounds()
240:         .intersects(query)
241:         .then_some(instance)
242: }
243: 
244: pub(crate) fn plan_macro_anomalies(
245:     seed: u32,
246:     query: WorldBounds,
247:     protected_point: Position,
248:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
249:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
250: ) -> Vec<AnomalyInstance> {
251:     let mut instances: Vec<_> = forced_instance(seed, query, protected_point, config)
252:         .into_iter()
253:         .collect();
254:     if config.anomalies.frequency <= 0.0 {
255:         return instances;
256:     }
257: 
258:     let expanded = query.expanded(MAX_QUERY_MARGIN);
259:     let anchor_x_min = (expanded.min_x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
260:     let anchor_x_max = (expanded.max_x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
261:     let anchor_z_min = (expanded.min_z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
262:     let anchor_z_max = (expanded.max_z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
263:     let base_chance = (0.20 * config.anomalies.frequency.clamp(0.0, 4.0)).min(0.75);
264: 
265:     for anchor_z in anchor_z_min..=anchor_z_max {
266:         for anchor_x in anchor_x_min..=anchor_x_max {
267: 
268: 
269: 
270: 
271: 
272: 
273:             let pressure = sample_fields(
274:                 noise,
275:                 seed,
276:                 (anchor_x as f32 + 0.5) * MACRO_CELL,
277:                 (anchor_z as f32 + 0.5) * MACRO_CELL,
278:             )
279:             .anomaly_pressure;
280:             let chance = base_chance * (0.40 + 1.20 * pressure);
281:             let candidate = hash(seed, 0xCAAD_1DA7, anchor_x, anchor_z);
282:             if unit(candidate) >= chance {
283:                 continue;
284:             }
285:             let Some(kind) = weighted_family(config, unit(candidate.rotate_left(21))) else {
286:                 continue;
287:             };
288:             let instance = macro_instance(seed, anchor_x, anchor_z, kind, config);
289:             if !instance.footprint.bounds().intersects(query) {
290:                 continue;
291:             }
292: 
293: 
294:             if instance
295:                 .footprint
296:                 .bounds()
297:                 .expanded(48.0)
298:                 .contains(protected_point.x, protected_point.z)
299:             {
300:                 continue;
301:             }
302:             instances.push(instance);
303:         }
304:     }
305:     instances
306: }
````

````rust
61: fn exposed_air_cell_below(

63:     emitter: VoxelCoord,
64:     expected_material: u8,

66:     if emitter.y == 0 || grid.get(emitter.x, emitter.y, emitter.z) != expected_material {

71:         y: emitter.y - 1,
72:         ..emitter
73:     };

75: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/bake_voxel_lighting/project_onto_solid_receivers.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_AIR, VoxelGrid};
 2: 
 3: use super::exposed_emissive_faces::emission_rgb;
 4: use super::propagate_through_air::{AirPropagation, UNREACHABLE};
 5: use super::settings::VoxelLightingSettings;
 6: use super::voxel_neighborhood::{for_each_face_neighbor, for_each_voxel};
 7: use super::world_space_attenuation::{accumulate_attenuated, pack_emission, pack_rgb};
 8: 
 9: 
10: 
11: 
12: pub(crate) fn project_onto_solid_receivers(
13:     grid: &mut VoxelGrid,
14:     propagated: &AirPropagation,
15:     settings: VoxelLightingSettings,
16: ) {
17:     for_each_voxel(propagated.dimensions, |coord| {
18:         let voxel_type = grid.get(coord.x, coord.y, coord.z);
19:         if voxel_type == VOXEL_AIR {
20:             return;
21:         }
22: 
23:         if let Some(rgb) = emission_rgb(voxel_type) {
24:             grid.set_light_rgb(coord.x, coord.y, coord.z, pack_emission(rgb));
25:             return;
26:         }
27: 
28:         let mut irradiance = [0.0; 3];
29:         for emission in &propagated.emissions {
30:             let mut nearest_air_steps = UNREACHABLE;
31:             for_each_face_neighbor(coord, propagated.dimensions, |neighbor| {
32:                 if grid.get(neighbor.x, neighbor.y, neighbor.z) != VOXEL_AIR {
33:                     return;
34:                 }
35:                 nearest_air_steps = nearest_air_steps
36:                     .min(emission.distance_steps[propagated.dimensions.index(neighbor)]);
37:             });
38:             if nearest_air_steps != UNREACHABLE {
39:                 accumulate_attenuated(
40:                     &mut irradiance,
41:                     emission.profile,
42:                     nearest_air_steps,
43:                     1.0,
44:                     settings,
45:                 );
46:             }
47:         }
48:         grid.set_light_rgb(coord.x, coord.y, coord.z, pack_rgb(irradiance));
49:     });
50: }
````
