````rust
  8: 
  9: pub(crate) fn sample_red_room(
 10:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 11:     mut column: ColumnPlan,
 12:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 13:     reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 14:     world_x: f32,
 15:     world_z: f32,
 16: ) -> ColumnPlan {
 17:     let (local_x, local_z) = instance.local_coords(world_x, world_z);
 18:     let half_x = instance.footprint.half_x;
 19:     let half_z = instance.footprint.half_z;
 20:     let loop_width = 2.0f32.min(half_x * 0.35).min(half_z * 0.35).max(1.2);
 21:     let boundary = instance.boundary_distance(world_x, world_z);
 22: 
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26:     let contamination = (1.0 - boundary / (loop_width * 2.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 27:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::red_room(contamination);
 28:     if boundary > PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05 {
 29:         if contamination > 0.15 {
 30:             column.floor_material = profile.floor_voxel();
 31:         }
 32:         if contamination > 0.33 {
 33:             column.ceiling_units = (column.ceiling_units - 0.2).max(2.6);
 34:         }
 35:         if contamination > 0.66 {
 36:             column.ceiling_units = (column.ceiling_units - 0.4).max(2.4);
 37:         }
 38:     }
 39:     column.red_light = true;
 40: 
 41:     let Some(state) = instance.state(reality) else {
 42:         return column;
 43:     };
 44:     if state.phase == RedRoomPhase::Outside {
 45:         return column;
 46:     }
 47: 
 48: 
 49: 
 50:     let in_core = local_x.abs() < half_x - loop_width && local_z.abs() < half_z - loop_width;
 51:     column.solid = boundary <= PLAN_WALL_T || in_core;
 52:     column.lintel_from_units = None;
 53:     column.floor_material = VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET;
 54:     column.ceiling_units = column.ceiling_units.min(2.8);
 55:     if column.solid {
 56:         column.light = false;
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     if state.phase == RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen {
 60:         open_single_escape(
 61:             instance,
 62:             state.epoch,
 63:             config.anomalies.red_escape_bias,
 64:             local_x,
 65:             local_z,
 66:             &mut column,
 67:         );
 68:     }
 69:     column
 70: }
 71: 
 72: 
 73: 
 74: 
 75: fn open_single_escape(
 76:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 77:     epoch: u32,
 78:     bias: f32,
 79:     local_x: f32,
 80:     local_z: f32,
 81:     column: &mut ColumnPlan,
 82: ) {
 83:     let width = bias.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 2.4;
 84:     if width <= 0.0 {
 85:         return;
 86:     }
 87:     let Some(threshold) = instance.gates.first() else {
 88:         return;
 89:     };
 90:     let side_sign = if stable_bit(instance.id, epoch) {
 91:         1.0
 92:     } else {
 93:         -1.0
 94:     };
 95:     let (side_coordinate, side_extent, along) = match threshold.axis {
 96:         Axis2::Z => (local_x, instance.footprint.half_x, local_z),
 97:         Axis2::X => (local_z, instance.footprint.half_z, local_x),
 98:     };
 99:     let on_selected_wall = (side_coordinate - side_sign * side_extent).abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
100:     if on_selected_wall && along.abs() < width {
101:         column.solid = false;
102:     }
103: }
104: 
105: fn stable_bit(instance_id: u64, epoch: u32) -> bool {
106:     let mut value = instance_id ^ (epoch as u64).rotate_left(29) ^ 0xE5CA_9E5C_A9E5_CA9E;
107:     value ^= value >> 30;
108:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
109:     value ^= value >> 27;
110:     value & 1 == 1
111: }
````

````rust
 10: const REGION_SIZE: f32 = 80.0;
 11: const THRESHOLD_DEPTH: f32 = 2.8;
 12: const LOOP_GATE_DEPTH: f32 = 6.0;
 13: 
 14: fn clamp_inward(desired: f32, far_inner_plane: f32, direction: AxisDirection) -> f32 {
 15:     match direction {
 16:         AxisDirection::Positive => desired.min(far_inner_plane),
 17:         AxisDirection::Negative => desired.max(far_inner_plane),
 18:     }
 19: }
 20: 
 21: fn red_room_instance(
 22:     seed: u32,
 23:     region_origin: Position,
 24:     assembly: &AssemblyInstance,
 25: ) -> Option<AnomalyInstance> {
 26:     let entrance = *assembly.entrances.first()?;
 27:     let bounds = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 28:     let center = Position::new((bounds.0 + bounds.2) * 0.5, (bounds.1 + bounds.3) * 0.5);
 29:     let region_x = (region_origin.x / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64;
 30:     let region_z = (region_origin.z / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64;
 31:     let id = mix64(
 32:         stable_id(seed, AnomalyKind::RedRoom, region_x, region_z)
 33:             ^ (assembly.id as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9),
 34:     );
 35:     let footprint = OrientedFootprint {
 36:         center,
 37:         half_x: (bounds.2 - bounds.0) * 0.5,
 38:         half_z: (bounds.3 - bounds.1) * 0.5,
 39:         basis: OrthoBasis {
 40:             turn: QuarterTurn::Zero,
 41:         },
 42:     };
 43:     let axis = if entrance.through_x_wall {
 44:         Axis2::Z
 45:     } else {
 46:         Axis2::X
 47:     };
 48:     let (edge_coordinate, center_coordinate, half_depth) = match axis {
 49:         Axis2::X => (entrance.center.x, center.x, footprint.half_x),
 50:         Axis2::Z => (entrance.center.z, center.z, footprint.half_z),
 51:     };
 52:     let forward = if center_coordinate >= edge_coordinate {
 53:         AxisDirection::Positive
 54:     } else {
 55:         AxisDirection::Negative
 56:     };
 57: 
 58: 
 59: 
 60:     let threshold_plane = edge_coordinate + forward.sign() * THRESHOLD_DEPTH;
 61:     let (span_min, span_max) = if axis == Axis2::Z {
 62:         (
 63:             entrance.center.x - entrance.width * 0.5,
 64:             entrance.center.x + entrance.width * 0.5,
 65:         )
 66:     } else {
 67:         (
 68:             entrance.center.z - entrance.width * 0.5,
 69:             entrance.center.z + entrance.width * 0.5,
 70:         )
 71:     };
 72:     let affected_bounds = footprint.bounds();
 73:     let threshold_gate = TraversalGate {
 74:         id: mix64(id ^ 0x6A7E_0ED0),
 75:         instance_id: id,
 76:         anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::RedRoom,
 77:         kind: TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold,
 78:         axis,
 79:         plane: threshold_plane,
 80:         span_min,
 81:         span_max,
 82:         forward,
 83:         affected_bounds,
 84:     };
 85: 
 86: 
 87: 
 88: 
 89:     let far_inner_plane = center_coordinate + forward.sign() * (half_depth - SNAP).max(0.0);
 90:     let loop_plane = clamp_inward(
 91:         threshold_plane + forward.sign() * LOOP_GATE_DEPTH,
 92:         far_inner_plane,
 93:         forward,
 94:     );
 95:     let loop_gate = TraversalGate {
 96:         id: mix64(id ^ 0x9B4C_1A2F),
 97:         instance_id: id,
 98:         anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::RedRoom,
 99:         kind: TraversalGateKind::RedLoop,
100:         axis,
101:         plane: loop_plane,
102:         span_min,
103:         span_max,
104: 
105: 
106:         forward,
107:         affected_bounds,
108:     };
109: 
110:     Some(AnomalyInstance {
111:         id,
112:         kind: AnomalyKind::RedRoom,
113:         footprint,
114:         basis: footprint.basis,
115:         macro_anchor: (region_x, region_z),
116:         pillar_lattice: None,
117:         pit_lattice: None,
118:         arch: None,
119:         gates: vec![threshold_gate, loop_gate],
120:         skeleton_half_width: 1.0,
121:         entry_band: THRESHOLD_DEPTH,
122:     })
123: }
124: 
125: pub(crate) fn plan_red_rooms(
126:     seed: u32,
127:     region_origin: Position,
128:     assemblies: &[AssemblyInstance],
129:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
130: ) -> Vec<AnomalyInstance> {
131:     let forced = config.anomalies.forced_kind == Some(AnomalyKind::RedRoom);
132:     let organic_enabled = config.anomalies.frequency > 0.0 && config.anomalies.red_rooms > 0.0;
133:     if !forced && !organic_enabled {
134:         return Vec::new();
135:     }
136: 
137:     assemblies
138:         .iter()
139:         .filter(|assembly| assembly.corruption.red_room)
140:         .filter_map(|assembly| red_room_instance(seed, region_origin, assembly))
141:         .collect()
142: }
````

````rust
 87:             .plan_at(recursive)
 88:             .map(|plan| (recursive, plan))

 97:     pub(crate) fn project_gate(&self, mut gate: TraversalGate) -> TraversalGate {
 98:         let offset = self.address.translation_world();
 99:         match gate.axis {
100:             Axis2::X => {
101:                 gate.plane -= offset.x;
102:                 gate.span_min -= offset.z;
103:                 gate.span_max -= offset.z;
104:             }
105:             Axis2::Z => {
106:                 gate.plane -= offset.z;
107:                 gate.span_min -= offset.x;
108:                 gate.span_max -= offset.x;
109:             }
110:         }
111:         gate.affected_bounds = self.project_bounds(gate.affected_bounds);
112:         gate
113:     }

139:         let max = self

146: impl RecursiveLevelAddress {
147: 
148: 
149:     pub(crate) fn derive(world_seed: u32, instance_id: AnomalyId) -> Self {
150:         let root = mix64(
151:             ADDRESS_DOMAIN ^ instance_id ^ (world_seed as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15),
152:         );
153:         let seed_hash = mix64(root ^ 0x5EED_5EED_A11C_0DE5);
154:         let derived_seed = (seed_hash as u32) ^ ((seed_hash >> 32) as u32);
155:         let translation_regions = (
156:             translation_component(root, 0x5841_5849_5300_0001),
157:             translation_component(root, 0x5A41_5849_5300_0002),
158:         );
159: 
160:         Self {
161:             instance_id,
162:             derived_seed,
163:             translation_regions,
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167: 
168: 
169:     pub(crate) fn from_reality(
170:         world_seed: u32,
171:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
172:     ) -> Option<(Self, &AnomalyStateStamp)> {
173:         let state = active_red_room(reality)?;
174:         Some((Self::derive(world_seed, state.instance_id), state))
175:     }
176: 
177:     pub(crate) fn derived_seed(self) -> u32 {
178:         self.derived_seed
179:     }
180: 
181:     pub(crate) fn translation_regions(self) -> (i64, i64) {
182:         self.translation_regions
183:     }
184: 
185: 
186: 
187:     pub(crate) fn to_recursive_region(self, source_region: (i64, i64)) -> (i64, i64) {
188:         (
189:             source_region.0.saturating_add(self.translation_regions.0),
190:             source_region.1.saturating_add(self.translation_regions.1),
191:         )
192:     }
193: 
194:     pub(crate) fn to_source_region(self, recursive_region: (i64, i64)) -> (i64, i64) {
195:         (
196:             recursive_region
197:                 .0
198:                 .saturating_sub(self.translation_regions.0),
199:             recursive_region
200:                 .1
201:                 .saturating_sub(self.translation_regions.1),
202:         )
203:     }
204: 
205: 
206: 
207: 
208:     pub(crate) fn to_recursive_world(self, source: Position) -> Position {
209:         let (region, local) = split_world_position(source);
210:         let recursive = self.to_recursive_region(region);
211:         join_world_position(recursive, local)
212:     }
213: 
214:     pub(crate) fn to_source_world(self, recursive: Position) -> Position {
215:         let (region, local) = split_world_position(recursive);
216:         let source = self.to_source_region(region);
217:         join_world_position(source, local)
218:     }
219: 
220:     pub(crate) fn translation_world(self) -> Position {
221:         let translation = self.translation_regions();
222:         Position::new(
223:             translation.0 as f32 * REGION_SIZE,
224:             translation.1 as f32 * REGION_SIZE,
225:         )
226:     }
227: 
228: 
229: 
230: 
231: 
232:     pub(crate) fn recursive_config(self, mut base: GeneratorConfig) -> GeneratorConfig {
233:         base.level = LEVEL_BACKROOMS;
234:         base.anomalies.forced_kind = None;
235:         base
236:     }
237: }
238: 
239: 
240: 
241: 
242: 
243: pub(crate) fn active_red_room(reality: &RealitySnapshot) -> Option<&AnomalyStateStamp> {
244:     reality
245:         .stamps()
246:         .iter()
247:         .filter(|state| state.phase != RedRoomPhase::Outside)
248:         .max_by_key(|state| {
249:             (
250:                 state.epoch,
251:                 state.phase,
252:                 state.loop_count,
253:                 state.last_gate_id,
254:                 state.instance_id,
255:             )
256:         })
257: }
258: 
259: fn translation_component(root: u64, axis_domain: u64) -> i64 {
260:     let hash = mix64(root ^ axis_domain);
261:     let magnitude = MIN_TRANSLATION_REGIONS + (hash % TRANSLATION_REGION_SPAN) as i64;
262:     if hash & (1 << 63) == 0 {
263:         magnitude
264:     } else {
265:         -magnitude
266:     }
267: }
268: 
269: fn split_world_position(position: Position) -> ((i64, i64), (f32, f32)) {
270:     let region = (
271:         (position.x / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64,
272:         (position.z / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64,
273:     );
274:     let local = (
275:         position.x - region.0 as f32 * REGION_SIZE,
276:         position.z - region.1 as f32 * REGION_SIZE,
277:     );
278:     (region, local)
279: }
280: 
281: fn join_world_position(region: (i64, i64), local: (f32, f32)) -> Position {
282:     Position::new(
283:         region.0 as f32 * REGION_SIZE + local.0,
284:         region.1 as f32 * REGION_SIZE + local.1,
285:     )
286: }
287: 
288: fn mix64(mut value: u64) -> u64 {
289:     value ^= value >> 30;
290:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
291:     value ^= value >> 27;
292:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
293:     value ^ (value >> 31)
294: }
````

````rust
  1: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::*;

  7: 
  8: 
  9: fn spine_z_at(path: &[Position], x: f32) -> f32 {
 10:     for seg in path.windows(2) {
 11:         let (a, b) = (seg[0], seg[1]);
 12:         if a.z == b.z && (x >= a.x.min(b.x)) && (x <= a.x.max(b.x)) {
 13:             return a.z;
 14:         }
 15:     }
 16:     path[0].z
 17: }
 18: 
 19: pub(super) fn build_corridors(
 20:     seed: u32,
 21:     rx: i64,
 22:     rz: i64,
 23:     genome: &ArchitectGenome,
 24:     origin: Position,
 25:     size: f32,
 26: ) -> Vec<CirculationSpine> {
 27:     let h = |k: i64| hash01(seed, &[0xC0 + k, rx, rz]);
 28:     let (x0, x1) = (origin.x, origin.x + size);
 29:     let (z0, z1) = (origin.z, origin.z + size);
 30:     let west_z = v_edge_portal_z(seed, rx, rz);
 31:     let east_z = v_edge_portal_z(seed, rx + 1, rz);
 32: 
 33: 
 34: 
 35:     let main_w = snap_width(4.8 + 2.4 * h(1));
 36:     let sec_w = snap_width(3.6 + 1.4 * hash01(seed, &[0xC1, rx, rz]));
 37: 
 38:     let mut spines = Vec::new();
 39:     let mut id = 0u32;
 40:     let mut push = |kind: SpaceProgram, path: Vec<Position>, width: f32, id: &mut u32| {
 41:         spines_push(&mut spines, kind, path, width, id);
 42:     };
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46:     let bend_x = snap(x0 + size * (0.35 + 0.30 * h(2)));
 47:     let main_path: Vec<Position> = match genome.circulation {
 48:         CirculationStyle::MeanderingSpine => {
 49:             let mid_z = snap(z0 + size * (0.30 + 0.40 * h(3)));
 50:             let bend2_x = snap(x0 + size * (0.60 + 0.25 * h(4)));
 51:             vec![
 52:                 Position::new(x0, west_z),
 53:                 Position::new(bend_x, west_z),
 54:                 Position::new(bend_x, mid_z),
 55:                 Position::new(bend2_x, mid_z),
 56:                 Position::new(bend2_x, east_z),
 57:                 Position::new(x1, east_z),
 58:             ]
 59:         }
 60:         _ => vec![
 61:             Position::new(x0, west_z),
 62:             Position::new(bend_x, west_z),
 63:             Position::new(bend_x, east_z),
 64:             Position::new(x1, east_z),
 65:         ],
 66:     };
 67:     let main_z_at = main_path.clone();
 68:     push(SpaceProgram::MainCorridor, main_path, main_w, &mut id);
 69: 
 70: 
 71: 
 72: 
 73:     let branch_count = match genome.circulation {
 74:         CirculationStyle::StraightSpine if h(11) < 0.45 => 0,
 75:         CirculationStyle::MeanderingSpine if h(11) < 0.20 => 0,
 76:         _ if h(11) < 0.28 => 0,
 77:         _ if h(11) < 0.82 => 1,
 78:         _ => 2,
 79:     };
 80:     for k in 0..branch_count {
 81:         let sx = snap(x0 + size * (0.18 + 0.64 * h(12 + k)));
 82:         let sz = spine_z_at(&main_z_at, sx);
 83:         let len = snap(12.0 + 14.0 * h(22 + k));
 84:         let dir = if h(32 + k) < 0.5 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
 85:         let end = (sz + dir * len).clamp(z0 + EDGE_MARGIN, z1 - EDGE_MARGIN);
 86:         if (end - sz).abs() >= 8.0 {
 87:             push(
 88:                 SpaceProgram::SecondaryHall,
 89:                 vec![Position::new(sx, sz), Position::new(sx, snap(end))],
 90:                 sec_w,
 91:                 &mut id,
 92:             );
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95:     spines
 96: }
 97: 
 98: fn spines_push(
 99:     spines: &mut Vec<CirculationSpine>,
100:     kind: SpaceProgram,
101:     path: Vec<Position>,
102:     width: f32,
103:     id: &mut u32,
104: ) {
105:     spines.push(CirculationSpine {
106:         id: *id,
107:         spine_kind: kind,
108:         path,
109:         width,
110:     });
111:     *id += 1;
112: }
````

````rust
 16: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
 17: pub(super) fn corrupt(
 18:     seed: u32,
 19:     rx: i64,
 20:     rz: i64,
 21:     dominant: &ArchitectGenome,
 22:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 23:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 24:     assemblies: &mut Vec<AssemblyInstance>,
 25:     taken: &mut Vec<(f32, f32, f32, f32)>,
 26:     spines: &[CirculationSpine],
 27: ) {
 28:     if assemblies.is_empty() {
 29:         return;
 30:     }
 31:     let h = |k: i64| hash01(seed, &[0xC0DE + k, rx, rz]);
 32: 
 33:     if h(1) < 0.6 {
 34:         let src = pick_index(h(2), assemblies.len());
 35:         let shift = snap(12.0 + 12.0 * h(3));
 36:         if let Some(dup) = duplicate_suite_candidate(assemblies, taken, spines, rx, rz, src, shift)
 37:         {
 38:             taken.push(dup.footprint.bounds());
 39:             assemblies.push(dup);
 40:         }
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     if h(6) < 0.6 {
 44:         let k = pick_index(h(7), assemblies.len());
 45:         abandon_assembly(&mut assemblies[k]);
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     apply_renovation_history(dominant.renovation_history, assemblies, h(8), h(9));
 49: 
 50: 
 51: 
 52:     let sp = spawn_point(seed);
 53:     let forced_in_spawn_region = config.anomalies.forced_kind == Some(AnomalyKind::RedRoom)
 54:         && rx == region_index(sp.x)
 55:         && rz == region_index(sp.z);
 56:     let red_room_realized = forced_in_spawn_region
 57:         && force_red_room_in_spawn_region(dominant, rx, rz, assemblies, taken, spines);
 58:     if !red_room_realized {
 59:         let red_room_scale = config.anomalies.frequency * config.anomalies.red_rooms;
 60:         realize_red_room_event(seed, noise, rx, rz, red_room_scale, assemblies);
 61:     }
 62: }

 69: fn duplicate_suite_candidate(
 70:     assemblies: &[AssemblyInstance],
 71:     taken: &[(f32, f32, f32, f32)],
 72:     spines: &[CirculationSpine],
 73:     rx: i64,
 74:     rz: i64,
 75:     src: usize,
 76:     shift: f32,
 77: ) -> Option<AssemblyInstance> {
 78: 
 79: 
 80: 
 81:     let skew = 0.0;
 82:     let mut dup = assemblies[src].clone();
 83:     let translate = |poly: &mut Polygon2| {
 84:         for v in &mut poly.vertices {
 85:             v.0 += shift;
 86:             v.1 += skew;
 87:         }
 88:     };
 89:     translate(&mut dup.footprint);
 90:     for s in &mut dup.spaces {
 91:         translate(&mut s.footprint);
 92:     }
 93:     for c in &mut dup.ceiling_zones {
 94:         translate(&mut c.area);
 95:     }
 96:     for f in &mut dup.fixtures {
 97:         f.at.x += shift;
 98:         f.at.z += skew;
 99:     }
100:     for e in &mut dup.entrances {
101:         e.center.x += shift;
102:         e.center.z += skew;
103:     }
104:     dup.id = assemblies.len() as u32 + 1000;
105:     dup.corruption.misalignment = (shift, skew);
106: 
107:     let b = dup.footprint.bounds();
108:     let inside = b.0 > rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE + EDGE_MARGIN
109:         && b.2 < (rx + 1) as f32 * REGION_SIZE - EDGE_MARGIN
110:         && b.1 > rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE + EDGE_MARGIN
111:         && b.3 < (rz + 1) as f32 * REGION_SIZE - EDGE_MARGIN;
112: 
113: 
114:     let reachable = dup.entrances.iter().any(|e| {
115:         spines
116:             .iter()
117:             .any(|s| s.distance(e.center.x, e.center.z) <= s.width * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05)
118:     });
119:     (inside && reachable && !taken.iter().any(|t| aabb_overlap(*t, b, 0.4))).then_some(dup)
120: }

138: fn apply_renovation_history(
139:     history: RenovationStyle,
140:     assemblies: &mut [AssemblyInstance],
141:     pick1: f32,
142:     pick2: f32,
143: ) {
144:     match history {
145:         RenovationStyle::Untouched => {}
146:         RenovationStyle::PartialRefit => {
147:             let k = pick_index(pick1, assemblies.len());
148:             overlay_renovation(&mut assemblies[k]);
149:         }
150:         RenovationStyle::LayeredRefits => {
151:             let k1 = pick_index(pick1, assemblies.len());
152:             overlay_renovation(&mut assemblies[k1]);
153:             if assemblies.len() > 1 {
154: 
155: 
156:                 let k2 = (k1 + 1 + pick_index(pick2, assemblies.len() - 1)) % assemblies.len();
157:                 overlay_renovation(&mut assemblies[k2]);
158:             }
159:         }
160:     }
161: }

173: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
174: fn force_red_room_in_spawn_region(
175:     dominant: &ArchitectGenome,
176:     rx: i64,
177:     rz: i64,
178:     assemblies: &mut Vec<AssemblyInstance>,
179:     taken: &mut Vec<(f32, f32, f32, f32)>,
180:     spines: &[CirculationSpine],
181: ) -> bool {
182:     if let Some(a) = assemblies
183:         .iter_mut()
184:         .find(|a| !a.entrances.is_empty() && !a.corruption.abandoned)
185:     {
186:         a.corruption.red_room = true;
187:         return true;
188:     }
189:     let Some(spine) = spines
190:         .iter()
191:         .find(|s| s.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor)
192:     else {
193:         return false;
194:     };
195:     let Some(seg) = spine.path.windows(2).find(|seg| seg[0].z == seg[1].z) else {
196:         return false;
197:     };
198:     let lx0 = seg[0].x.min(seg[1].x);
199:     let lz = seg[0].z;
200:     let origin = Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE);
201:     let Some(mut a) = place_suite(
202:         9999,
203:         SpaceProgram::PrivateOffice,
204:         dominant,
205:         0.5,
206:         0.5,
207:         lx0 + 12.0,
208:         lz,
209:         spine.width * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T,
210:         1.0,
211:         origin,
212:         REGION_SIZE,
213:         taken,
214:         spines,
215:     ) else {
216:         return false;
217:     };
218:     a.corruption.red_room = true;
219:     taken.push(a.footprint.bounds());
220:     assemblies.push(a);
221:     true
222: }

234:     rx: i64,
235:     rz: i64,
236:     red_room_scale: f32,

475:         assert!(assemblies[0].corruption.red_room);
476:         assert_eq!(assemblies.len(), 1, "an existing assembly was reused, not duplicated");
477:     }
478: 
479:     #[test]
480:     fn forced_red_room_places_a_new_room_when_nothing_qualifies() {
481:         let genome = test_genome();
482:         let mut assemblies: Vec<AssemblyInstance> = vec![];
483:         let mut taken = vec![];
484:         let spines = [corridor_spine()];
485:         let realized =
486:             force_red_room_in_spawn_region(&genome, 0, 0, &mut assemblies, &mut taken, &spines);
487:         assert!(realized, "with a main corridor present, a room must be placeable");
488:         assert_eq!(assemblies.len(), 1);
489:         assert!(assemblies[0].corruption.red_room);
490:     }
491: 
492:     #[test]
493:     fn red_room_event_marks_one_eligible_assembly_deterministically() {
494:         let assemblies = vec![
495:             minimal_assembly(0, 0.0, 20.0),
496:             minimal_assembly(1, 20.0, 20.0),
497:             minimal_assembly(2, 40.0, 20.0),
498:         ];
499: 
500: 
501:         let mut fired = false;
502:         for rx in 0..64 {
503:             let mut trial = assemblies.clone();
504:             realize_red_room_event(42, &ZeroNoise, rx, 0, 4.0, &mut trial);
505:             let marked = trial.iter().filter(|a| a.corruption.red_room).count();
506:             if marked > 0 {
507:                 assert_eq!(marked, 1, "exactly one assembly should be realized per event");
508:                 fired = true;
509:             }
510:         }
511:         assert!(fired, "no red room event fired across 64 region samples at scale 4.0");
512:     }
````

## File: src/use_cases/region_plan/debug.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind;
 2: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::*;
 3: 
 4: 
 5: 
 6: 
 7: pub fn debug_region_ascii(plan: &RegionPlan, step: f32) -> String {
 8:     let n = (plan.size_world / step) as usize;
 9:     let mut out = String::with_capacity((n + 1) * n);
10:     for iz in 0..n {
11:         for ix in 0..n {
12:             let x = plan.origin_world.x + (ix as f32 + 0.5) * step;
13:             let z = plan.origin_world.z + (iz as f32 + 0.5) * step;
14:             let mut ch = '.';
15:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
16:                 if a.footprint.contains(x, z) {
17:                     ch = match a.program {
18:                         SpaceProgram::OpenOffice => 'o',
19:                         SpaceProgram::PrivateOffice => 'p',
20:                         SpaceProgram::ConferenceRoom => 'c',
21:                         SpaceProgram::BreakRoom => 'b',
22:                         SpaceProgram::Storage => 's',
23:                         SpaceProgram::ServerRoom => 'v',
24:                         SpaceProgram::WaitingArea => 'w',
25:                         SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => 'x',
26:                         SpaceProgram::Atrium => 'A',
27:                         SpaceProgram::Stair => 'S',
28:                         _ => 'r',
29:                     };
30:                 }
31:             }
32:             for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
33:                 if anomaly.contains(x, z) {
34:                     ch = match anomaly.kind {
35:                         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => 'P',
36:                         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => 'B',
37:                         AnomalyKind::PitLattice => 'H',
38:                         AnomalyKind::RedRoom => 'R',
39:                         AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => 'M',
40:                     };
41:                 }
42:             }
43:             for s in &plan.corridors {
44:                 if s.distance(x, z) <= s.width * 0.5 {
45:                     ch = '=';
46:                 }
47:             }
48:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
49:                 for e in &a.entrances {
50:                     if (x - e.center.x).abs() < e.width * 0.5 && (z - e.center.z).abs() < step {
51:                         ch = '+';
52:                     }
53:                 }
54:             }
55:             out.push(ch);
56:         }
57:         out.push('\n');
58:     }
59:     out
60: }
````

````rust
 10: 
 11: pub fn derive_genome(
 12:     seed: u32,
 13:     rx: i64,
 14:     rz: i64,
 15:     salt: i64,
 16:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 17: ) -> ArchitectGenome {
 18:     let h = |k: i64| hash01(seed, &[0x6E0 + salt, rx, rz, k]);
 19: 
 20:     let culture = noise.evaluate_2d(
 21:         seed ^ 0xA11C_0DE ^ (salt as u32),
 22:         Position::new(
 23:             (rx as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE * 0.15,
 24:             (rz as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE * 0.15,
 25:         ),
 26:     );
 27:     let circulation = match ((culture * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 0.999) * 4.0) as u32 {
 28:         0 => CirculationStyle::StraightSpine,
 29:         1 => CirculationStyle::MeanderingSpine,
 30:         2 => CirculationStyle::PairedBranches,
 31:         _ => CirculationStyle::TreeWithCulDeSacs,
 32:     };
 33: 
 34:     let structural_system = *[
 35:         StructuralSystem::RegularGrid,
 36:         StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams,
 37:         StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid,
 38:         StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell,
 39:     ]
 40:     .get(pick_index(h(1), 4))
 41:     .unwrap();
 42:     let renovation_history = *[
 43:         RenovationStyle::Untouched,
 44:         RenovationStyle::PartialRefit,
 45:         RenovationStyle::LayeredRefits,
 46:     ]
 47:     .get(pick_index(h(5), 3))
 48:     .unwrap();
 49: 
 50: 
 51: 
 52: 
 53: 
 54: 
 55: 
 56:     let spans_wide = matches!(
 57:         structural_system,
 58:         StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell | StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams
 59:     );
 60:     let (min_lo, min_span, max_lo, max_span) = if spans_wide {
 61:         (16.0, 6.0, 24.0, 10.0)
 62:     } else {
 63:         (12.0, 4.0, 18.0, 6.0)
 64:     };
 65: 
 66: 
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71: 
 72:     let ceiling_language = match structural_system {
 73:         StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams => match h(3) {
 74:             v if v < 0.55 => CeilingLanguage::Coffered,
 75:             v if v < 0.85 => CeilingLanguage::ExposedSoffit,
 76:             _ => CeilingLanguage::FlatTiles,
 77:         },
 78:         StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell => match h(3) {
 79:             v if v < 0.70 => CeilingLanguage::FlatTiles,
 80:             v if v < 0.90 => CeilingLanguage::ExposedSoffit,
 81:             _ => CeilingLanguage::Coffered,
 82:         },
 83:         StructuralSystem::RegularGrid | StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid => *[
 84:             CeilingLanguage::FlatTiles,
 85:             CeilingLanguage::Coffered,
 86:             CeilingLanguage::ExposedSoffit,
 87:         ]
 88:         .get(pick_index(h(3), 3))
 89:         .unwrap(),
 90:     };
 91: 
 92: 
 93: 
 94: 
 95:     let symmetry_bias = match structural_system {
 96:         StructuralSystem::RegularGrid | StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell => 0.25,
 97:         StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid => -0.20,
 98:         StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams => 0.0,
 99:     };
100: 
101: 
102: 
103: 
104: 
105: 
106: 
107:     let refit_bias = match renovation_history {
108:         RenovationStyle::Untouched => 0.0,
109:         RenovationStyle::PartialRefit => 0.12,
110:         RenovationStyle::LayeredRefits => 0.25,
111:     };
112:     let threshold_language = match (h(2) + refit_bias).min(0.999) {
113:         v if v < 0.10 => ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel,
114:         v if v < 0.55 => ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal,
115:         _ => ThresholdLanguage::WidePortal,
116:     };
117: 
118:     let lighting_language = *[
119:         LightingLanguage::GridPanels,
120:         LightingLanguage::GridPanels,
121:         LightingLanguage::StripsAlongCirculation,
122:         LightingLanguage::SparsePendants,
123:     ]
124:     .get(pick_index(h(4), 4))
125:     .unwrap();
126: 
127:     ArchitectGenome {
128:         circulation,
129:         structural_system,
130:         room_proportions: ProportionRules {
131: 
132: 
133: 
134: 
135:             min_side: min_lo + min_span * h(6),
136:             max_side: max_lo + max_span * h(7),
137:             elongation: h(8),
138:         },
139:         threshold_language,
140:         ceiling_language,
141:         lighting_language,
142:         furnishing_density: (0.3 + 0.7 * h(9) + refit_bias).min(1.0),
143:         renovation_history,
144:         tolerance_for_symmetry: (h(10) + symmetry_bias).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
145:     }
146: }
````

````rust
 79: 
 80: pub fn generate_region_plan(
 81:     seed: u32,
 82:     region_origin: Position,
 83:     region_size: f32,
 84:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 85:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 86: ) -> RegionPlan {
 87:     let rx = region_index(region_origin.x + 0.1);
 88:     let rz = region_index(region_origin.z + 0.1);
 89:     let h = |k: i64| hash01(seed, &[0xA0 + k, rx, rz]);
 90: 
 91:     let dominant = derive_genome(seed, rx, rz, 0, noise);
 92:     let renovator = derive_genome(seed, rx, rz, 1, noise);
 93:     let mut architects = vec![dominant.clone(), renovator];
 94: 
 95: 
 96: 
 97:     let fields = crate::use_cases::world_topology::sample_fields(
 98:         noise,
 99:         seed,
100:         (rx as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE,
101:         (rz as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE,
102:     );
103:     if h(0) < 0.10 + 0.55 * fields.style_blend {
104:         architects.push(derive_genome(seed, rx, rz, 2, noise));
105:     }
106: 
107:     let corridors = build_corridors(seed, rx, rz, &dominant, region_origin, region_size);
108: 
109: 
110: 
111: 
112: 
113:     let mut assemblies: Vec<AssemblyInstance> = Vec::new();
114:     let mut taken: Vec<(f32, f32, f32, f32)> = Vec::new();
115:     let mut id = 0u32;
116:     let legs: Vec<(f32, f32, f32, f32)> = corridors
117:         .iter()
118:         .filter(|s| s.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor)
119:         .flat_map(|s| {
120:             let w = s.width;
121:             s.path
122:                 .windows(2)
123:                 .filter(|seg| seg[0].z == seg[1].z)
124:                 .map(move |seg| (seg[0].x.min(seg[1].x), seg[0].x.max(seg[1].x), seg[0].z, w))
125:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
126:         })
127:         .filter(|(a, b, _, _)| b - a >= 14.0)
128:         .collect();
129: 
130:     for (li, &(lx0, lx1, lz, lw)) in legs.iter().enumerate() {
131:         let mut cursor = lx0 + 4.0;
132:         let mut side = if h(40 + li as i64) < 0.5 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
133:         while cursor < lx1 - 12.0 {
134:             let aseed = hash01(seed, &[0x5EA, rx, rz, id as i64]);
135:             let threshold_seed = hash01(seed, &[0x7A11, rx, rz, id as i64]);
136: 
137: 
138:             if hash01(seed, &[0x5E8, rx, rz, id as i64]) < 0.62 {
139:                 let program = SUITE_PROGRAMS[pick_index(aseed, SUITE_PROGRAMS.len())];
140:                 if let Some(a) = place_suite(
141:                     id,
142:                     program,
143:                     &dominant,
144:                     aseed,
145:                     threshold_seed,
146:                     cursor,
147:                     lz,
148:                     lw * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T,
149:                     side,
150:                     region_origin,
151:                     region_size,
152:                     &taken,
153:                     &corridors,
154:                 ) {
155:                     let b = a.footprint.bounds();
156:                     cursor += (b.2 - b.0) + 8.0 + 8.0 * threshold_seed;
157:                     taken.push(b);
158:                     assemblies.push(a);
159:                 } else {
160:                     cursor += 8.0 + 8.0 * threshold_seed;
161:                 }
162:             } else {
163:                 cursor += 8.0 + 8.0 * threshold_seed;
164:             }
165:             side = -side;
166:             id += 1;
167:         }
168:     }
169: 
170: 
171:     corrupt(
172:         seed,
173:         rx,
174:         rz,
175:         &dominant,
176:         config,
177:         noise,
178:         &mut assemblies,
179:         &mut taken,
180:         &corridors,
181:     );
182: 
183: 
184: 
185: 
186: 
187: 
188: 
189:     if let Some(link) =
190:         crate::use_cases::world_topology::vertical_link_for_region(seed, noise, rx, rz)
191:         && crate::use_cases::vertical_circulation::link_wants_geometry(&link)
192:         && let Some(stair) = crate::use_cases::vertical_circulation::place_stairwell(
193:             id + 2000,
194:             &link,
195:             &legs,
196:             region_origin,
197:             region_size,
198:             EDGE_MARGIN,
199:             PLAN_WALL_T,
200:             &taken,
201:             |cx, cz, clearance| {
202:                 corridors
203:                     .iter()
204:                     .all(|s| s.distance(cx, cz) >= s.width * 0.5 + clearance)
205:             },
206:         )
207:     {
208:         taken.push(stair.footprint.bounds());
209:         assemblies.push(stair);
210:     }
211: 
212: 
213: 
214: 
215:     let anomalies = plan_anomalies_for_region(
216:         seed,
217:         region_origin,
218:         region_size,
219:         &assemblies,
220:         spawn_point(seed),
221:         config,
222:         noise,
223:     );
224: 
225:     RegionPlan {
226:         origin_world: region_origin,
227:         size_world: region_size,
228:         architects,
229:         assemblies,
230:         corridors,
231:         anomalies,
232:     }
233: }
````

````rust
 24: fn ceiling_height_for(program: SpaceProgram, aseed: f32) -> f32 {
 25:     match program {
 26:         SpaceProgram::Atrium => 4.8 + 0.6 * aseed,
 27: 
 28:         SpaceProgram::ServerRoom | SpaceProgram::Mechanical => 2.6 + 0.2 * aseed,
 29:         SpaceProgram::Storage | SpaceProgram::RestroomCore => 3.0 + 0.3 * aseed,
 30:         SpaceProgram::OpenOffice | SpaceProgram::ConferenceRoom => 3.5 + 0.7 * aseed,
 31:         _ => 3.2 + 0.5 * aseed,
 32:     }

 35: fn structure_for(genome: &ArchitectGenome, aseed: f32) -> StructuralSystemInstance {
 36:     let bay = snap(4.4 + 1.6 * aseed);
 37:     let (bay_x, bay_z) = match genome.structural_system {
 38:         StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams => (bay * 1.5, bay),
 39:         _ => (bay, bay),
 40:     };
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45:     let tol = genome.tolerance_for_symmetry.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 46:     let phase = (
 47:         snap(aseed * 4.0 * (1.0 - tol)),
 48:         snap(aseed * 8.0 % 4.0 * (1.0 - tol)),
 49:     );
 50:     StructuralSystemInstance {
 51:         system: genome.structural_system,
 52:         bay_x,
 53:         bay_z,
 54:         phase,
 55:         column_side: 0.4,

 58: 
 59: 
 60: fn fixtures_for(
 61:     genome: &ArchitectGenome,
 62:     footprint: &Polygon2,
 63:     lit: bool,
 64:     aseed: f32,
 65: ) -> Vec<Fixture> {
 66:     let (x0, z0, x1, z1) = footprint.bounds();
 67:     let mut out = Vec::new();
 68:     match genome.lighting_language {
 69:         LightingLanguage::GridPanels => {
 70:             let step = 2.4;
 71:             let mut z = z0 + 1.2;
 72:             while z < z1 - 0.8 {
 73:                 let mut x = x0 + 1.2;
 74:                 while x < x1 - 0.8 {
 75:                     out.push(Fixture {
 76:                         at: Position::new(snap(x), snap(z)),
 77:                         half_x: 0.4,
 78:                         half_z: 0.4,
 79:                         lit,
 80:                     });
 81:                     x += step;
 82:                 }
 83:                 z += step;
 84:             }
 85:         }
 86:         LightingLanguage::StripsAlongCirculation => {
 87: 
 88:             let long_x = (x1 - x0) >= (z1 - z0);
 89:             let (cx, cz) = ((x0 + x1) * 0.5, (z0 + z1) * 0.5);
 90:             let step = 3.2;
 91:             if long_x {
 92:                 let mut x = x0 + 1.6;
 93:                 while x < x1 - 1.2 {
 94:                     out.push(Fixture {
 95:                         at: Position::new(snap(x), snap(cz)),
 96:                         half_x: 1.0,
 97:                         half_z: 0.25,
 98:                         lit,
 99:                     });
100:                     x += step;
101:                 }
102:             } else {
103:                 let mut z = z0 + 1.6;
104:                 while z < z1 - 1.2 {
105:                     out.push(Fixture {
106:                         at: Position::new(snap(cx), snap(z)),
107:                         half_x: 0.25,
108:                         half_z: 1.0,
109:                         lit,
110:                     });
111:                     z += step;
112:                 }
113:             }
114:         }
115:         LightingLanguage::SparsePendants => {
116:             let n = 1 + (aseed * 2.0) as i32;
117: 
118: 
119: 
120: 
121:             let tol = genome.tolerance_for_symmetry.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
122:             let (cx, cz) = ((x0 + x1) * 0.5, (z0 + z1) * 0.5);
123:             let long_x = (x1 - x0) >= (z1 - z0);
124:             for k in 0..n {
125:                 let jx = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (0.3 + 0.4 * ((k as f32 * 0.618 + aseed) % 1.0));
126:                 let jz = z0 + (z1 - z0) * (0.3 + 0.4 * ((k as f32 * 0.382 + aseed * 2.0) % 1.0));
127:                 let centered = if n > 1 {
128:                     k as f32 / (n - 1) as f32 - 0.5
129:                 } else {
130:                     0.0
131:                 };
132:                 let (sx, sz) = if long_x {
133:                     (cx + centered * (x1 - x0) * 0.6, cz)
134:                 } else {
135:                     (cx, cz + centered * (z1 - z0) * 0.6)
136:                 };
137:                 let fx = jx + (sx - jx) * tol;
138:                 let fz = jz + (sz - jz) * tol;
139:                 out.push(Fixture {
140:                     at: Position::new(snap(fx), snap(fz)),
141:                     half_x: 0.3,
142:                     half_z: 0.3,
143:                     lit,
144:                 });
145:             }
146:         }
147:     }
148:     out
149: }
150: 
151: 
152: 
153: 
154: 
155: 
156: 
157: fn spaces_for(
158:     program: SpaceProgram,
159:     footprint: &Polygon2,
160:     genome: &ArchitectGenome,
161:     aseed: f32,
162: ) -> Vec<Space> {
163:     if !matches!(
164:         program,
165:         SpaceProgram::PrivateOffice | SpaceProgram::OpenOffice | SpaceProgram::ConferenceRoom
166:     ) {
167:         return Vec::new();
168:     }
169:     let (x0, z0, x1, z1) = footprint.bounds();
170:     let long_x = (x1 - x0) >= (z1 - z0);
171:     let span = if long_x { x1 - x0 } else { z1 - z0 };
172:     let want = genome.room_proportions.min_side.max(12.0);
173:     let n = ((span / want) as usize).clamp(1, 2);
174:     let split_threshold = (1.0 - genome.furnishing_density).clamp(0.05, 0.95);
175:     let n = if aseed > split_threshold { n } else { 1 };
176:     if n <= 1 {
177:         return Vec::new();
178:     }
179:     let mut out = Vec::new();
180:     for k in 0..n {
181:         let (a, b) = (
182:             snap(k as f32 / n as f32 * span),
183:             snap((k + 1) as f32 / n as f32 * span),
184:         );
185:         let rect = if long_x {
186:             Polygon2::rect(x0 + a, z0, b - a, z1 - z0)
187:         } else {
188:             Polygon2::rect(x0, z0 + a, x1 - x0, b - a)
189:         };
190:         out.push(Space {
191:             program,
192:             footprint: rect,
193:         });
194:     }
195:     out
196: }
197: 
198: pub(super) fn aabb_overlap(a: (f32, f32, f32, f32), b: (f32, f32, f32, f32), gap: f32) -> bool {
199:     a.0 < b.2 + gap && b.0 < a.2 + gap && a.1 < b.3 + gap && b.1 < a.3 + gap
200: }
201: 
202: 
203: 
204: 
205: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
206: pub(super) fn place_suite(
207:     id: u32,
208:     program: SpaceProgram,
209:     genome: &ArchitectGenome,
210:     aseed: f32,
211:     threshold_seed: f32,
212:     cursor_x: f32,
213:     corridor_z: f32,
214:     corridor_half: f32,
215:     side: f32,
216:     origin: Position,
217:     size: f32,
218:     taken: &[(f32, f32, f32, f32)],
219:     spines: &[CirculationSpine],
220: ) -> Option<AssemblyInstance> {
221:     let p = &genome.room_proportions;
222:     let w = snap((p.min_side + (p.max_side - p.min_side) * aseed).clamp(12.0, 24.0));
223:     let d = snap((w * (0.72 - 0.28 * p.elongation)).clamp(8.0, 18.0));
224: 
225:     let x0 = snap(cursor_x);
226:     let z_front = snap(if side > 0.0 {
227:         corridor_z + corridor_half
228:     } else {
229:         corridor_z - corridor_half - d
230:     });
231:     let footprint = Polygon2::rect(x0, z_front, w, d);
232:     let b = footprint.bounds();
233: 
234: 
235:     if b.0 < origin.x + EDGE_MARGIN
236:         || b.1 < origin.z + EDGE_MARGIN
237:         || b.2 > origin.x + size - EDGE_MARGIN
238:         || b.3 > origin.z + size - EDGE_MARGIN
239:     {
240:         return None;
241:     }
242:     if taken.iter().any(|t| aabb_overlap(*t, b, 0.8)) {
243:         return None;
244:     }
245: 
246: 
247:     let center = ((b.0 + b.2) * 0.5, (b.1 + b.3) * 0.5);
248:     for s in spines {
249:         if s.distance(center.0, center.1) < s.width * 0.5 + d.min(w) * 0.25 {
250:             return None;
251:         }
252:     }
253: 
254: 
255: 
256: 
257:     let threshold = match genome.threshold_language {
258:         ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel if threshold_seed < 0.14 => {
259:             ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel
260:         }
261:         ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal if threshold_seed < 0.08 => ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel,
262:         ThresholdLanguage::WidePortal if threshold_seed < 0.10 => ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel,
263:         ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal if threshold_seed < 0.62 => ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal,
264:         ThresholdLanguage::WidePortal if threshold_seed < 0.50 => ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal,
265:         ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel if threshold_seed < 0.50 => ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal,
266:         _ => ThresholdLanguage::WidePortal,
267:     };
268:     let front_z = if side > 0.0 { b.1 } else { b.3 };
269:     let (width, lintel) = match threshold {
270:         ThresholdLanguage::DoorWithLintel => (1.2, Some(2.2)),
271:         ThresholdLanguage::OpenPortal => (4.8, None),
272:         ThresholdLanguage::WidePortal => (3.6, Some(3.0)),
273:     };
274:     let edge = width * 0.5 + 0.8;
275:     let door_x = snap((b.0 + w * (0.25 + 0.5 * threshold_seed)).clamp(b.0 + edge, b.2 - edge));
276:     let entrances = vec![Opening {
277:         center: Position::new(door_x, front_z),
278:         width,
279:         through_x_wall: true,
280:         lintel_units: lintel,
281:     }];
282: 
283:     let ceiling = CeilingZone {
284:         area: footprint.clone(),
285:         language: genome.ceiling_language,
286:         height_units: ceiling_height_for(program, aseed),
287:     };
288:     Some(AssemblyInstance {
289:         id,
290:         program,
291:         spaces: spaces_for(program, &footprint, genome, aseed),
292:         structure: structure_for(genome, aseed),
293:         ceiling_zones: vec![ceiling],
294:         fixtures: fixtures_for(genome, &footprint, true, aseed),
295:         service_voids: Vec::new(),
296:         corruption: CorruptionProfile::default(),
297:         entrances,
298:         footprint,
299:     })
300: }
301:
````

````rust
  8: impl TestNoise {
  9:     fn hash2d(seed: u32, x: i32, y: i32) -> f32 {
 10:         let mut h = seed
 11:             .wrapping_add(x as u32 ^ 0x9E3779B9)
 12:             .wrapping_add(y as u32 ^ 0x85EBCA6B);
 13:         h ^= h >> 16;
 14:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0x85EBCA6B);
 15:         h ^= h >> 13;
 16:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2AE35);
 17:         h ^= h >> 16;
 18:         ((h as f32) / (std::u32::MAX as f32)) * 2.0 - 1.0
 19:     }
 20: 
 21:     fn lerp(a: f32, b: f32, t: f32) -> f32 {
 22:         a + t * (b - a)
 23:     }
 24: 
 25:     fn smoothstep(t: f32) -> f32 {
 26:         t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
 27:     }
 28: }
 29: 
 30: impl NoiseProvider for TestNoise {
 31:     fn evaluate_2d(&self, seed: u32, position: Position) -> f32 {
 32:         let freq = 0.05;
 33:         let x = position.x * freq;
 34:         let y = position.z * freq;
 35:         let x0 = x.floor() as i32;
 36:         let x1 = x0 + 1;
 37:         let y0 = y.floor() as i32;
 38:         let y1 = y0 + 1;
 39:         let tx = x - (x0 as f32);
 40:         let ty = y - (y0 as f32);
 41:         let u = Self::smoothstep(tx);
 42:         let v = Self::smoothstep(ty);
 43:         let v00 = Self::hash2d(seed, x0, y0);
 44:         let v10 = Self::hash2d(seed, x1, y0);
 45:         let v01 = Self::hash2d(seed, x0, y1);
 46:         let v11 = Self::hash2d(seed, x1, y1);
 47:         let nx0 = Self::lerp(v00, v10, u);
 48:         let nx1 = Self::lerp(v01, v11, u);
 49:         Self::lerp(nx0, nx1, v)
 50:     }
 51: }

372:         "a deep-beam designer chose flat tiles {deep_span_flat_rate:.2} of the time — \
373:          ceiling language is not tracking the structural system"
374:     );
375:     assert!(
376:         core_shell_flat_rate > 0.50,
377:         "a core-and-shell designer (no beams to show) chose flat tiles only \
378:          {core_shell_flat_rate:.2} of the time"
379:     );
380:     assert!(

382:         "flat-tile rate barely differs between structural systems \
383:          ({deep_span_flat_rate:.2} vs {core_shell_flat_rate:.2}) — \
384:          this would not reject independence"
````

````rust
 12: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
 13: struct OctreeRegion {
 14:     origin: [u32; 3],
 15:     size: u32,
 16:     depth: u32,
 17: }
 18: 
 19: impl OctreeRegion {
 20:     fn root(depth: u32) -> Self {
 21:         Self {
 22:             origin: [0; 3],
 23:             size: 1 << depth,
 24:             depth,
 25:         }
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     fn child(self, octant: u32) -> Self {
 29:         let size = self.size / 2;
 30:         Self {
 31:             origin: [
 32:                 self.origin[0] + (octant & 1) * size,
 33:                 self.origin[1] + ((octant >> 1) & 1) * size,
 34:                 self.origin[2] + ((octant >> 2) & 1) * size,
 35:             ],
 36:             size,
 37:             depth: self.depth - 1,
 38:         }
 39:     }
 40: }

 55:     /// Converts a dense VoxelGrid into an SVO of the specified depth.
 56:     pub fn execute(&self, grid: &VoxelGrid, depth: u32, world_size: f32) -> SparseVoxelOctree {
 57:         self.execute_internal::<true>(grid, depth, world_size)
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     /// Shared implementation kept generic over the pruning policy so tests can
 61:     /// compare the optimized traversal with the former exhaustive traversal.
 62:     fn execute_internal<const PRUNE_OUTSIDE: bool>(
 63:         &self,
 64:         grid: &VoxelGrid,
 65:         depth: u32,
 66:         world_size: f32,
 67:     ) -> SparseVoxelOctree {
 68:         let mut nodes = Vec::new();
 69: 
 70:         let root_node =
 71:             self.build_recursive::<PRUNE_OUTSIDE>(grid, &mut nodes, OctreeRegion::root(depth));
 72: 
 73:         // Push the root node to the end of the nodes array
 74:         let root_idx = nodes.len();
 75:         nodes.push(root_node);
 76: 
 77:         SparseVoxelOctree {
 78:             root: root_idx,
 79:             nodes,
 80:             depth,
 81:             world_size,
 82:         }
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     fn build_recursive<const PRUNE_OUTSIDE: bool>(
 86:         &self,
 87:         grid: &VoxelGrid,
 88:         nodes: &mut Vec<SvoNode>,
 89:         region: OctreeRegion,
 90:     ) -> SvoNode {
 91:         // Every coordinate sampled outside the dense grid is canonical air.
 92:         // Recursive cubes only extend in the positive direction, so when the
 93:         // cube's minimum lies past any grid dimension the former exhaustive
 94: 
 95: 
 96: 
 97:         if PRUNE_OUTSIDE && self.region_is_outside_grid(grid, region.origin) {
 98:             return AIR_LEAF;
 99:         }
100: 
101:         if region.depth == 0 {
102:             let [x, y, z] = region.origin;
103:             let (v_type, color, ll, fo) = self.get_voxel_attrs(grid, x, y, z);
104:             return SvoNode::Leaf {
105:                 voxel_type: v_type,
106:                 color,
107:                 light_rgb: ll,
108:                 face_occlusion: fo,
109:             };
110:         }
111: 
112:         let mut children = [AIR_LEAF; 8];
113: 
114:         for octant_idx in 0..8 {
115:             children[octant_idx as usize] =
116:                 self.build_recursive::<PRUNE_OUTSIDE>(grid, nodes, region.child(octant_idx));
117:         }
118: 
119: 
120:         let mut uniform = true;
121:         let mut first_val = None;
122:         for child in &children {
123:             match child {
124:                 SvoNode::Internal { .. } => {
125:                     uniform = false;
126:                     break;
127:                 }
128:                 SvoNode::Leaf {
129:                     voxel_type,
130:                     color,
131:                     light_rgb,
132:                     face_occlusion,
133:                 } => {
134:                     if let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
135:                         if vt != *voxel_type
136:                             || col != *color
137:                             || ll != *light_rgb
138:                             || fo != *face_occlusion
139:                         {
140:                             uniform = false;
141:                             break;
142:                         }
143:                     } else {
144:                         first_val = Some((*voxel_type, *color, *light_rgb, *face_occlusion));
145:                     }
146:                 }
147:             }
148:         }
149: 
150:         if uniform && let Some((vt, col, ll, fo)) = first_val {
151:             return SvoNode::Leaf {
152:                 voxel_type: vt,
153:                 color: col,
154:                 light_rgb: ll,
155:                 face_occlusion: fo,
156:             };
157:         }
158: 
159: 
160:         let child_base_index = nodes.len() as u32;
161:         let mut child_mask = 0;
162: 
163:         for octant_idx in 0..8 {
164:             let child = children[octant_idx as usize];
165:             match child {
166:                 SvoNode::Leaf { voxel_type, .. } => {
167:                     if voxel_type != 0 {
168:                         child_mask |= 1 << octant_idx;
169:                     }
170:                 }
171:                 SvoNode::Internal { .. } => {
172:                     child_mask |= 1 << octant_idx;
173:                 }
174:             }
175:             nodes.push(child);
176:         }
177: 
178:         SvoNode::Internal {
179:             child_base_index,
180:             child_mask,
181:         }
182:     }
183: 
184:     fn region_is_outside_grid(&self, grid: &VoxelGrid, origin: [u32; 3]) -> bool {
185:         origin[0] as usize >= grid.width()
186:             || origin[1] as usize >= grid.height()
187:             || origin[2] as usize >= grid.depth()
188:     }
189: 
190:     fn get_voxel_attrs(&self, grid: &VoxelGrid, x: u32, y: u32, z: u32) -> (u8, u32, [u8; 3], u8) {
191:         if x >= grid.width() as u32 || y >= grid.height() as u32 || z >= grid.depth() as u32 {
192:             return (0, 0, [0; 3], 0);
193:         }
194: 
195:         let v_id = grid.get(x as usize, y as usize, z as usize);
196:         if v_id == VOXEL_AIR {
197:             return (0, 0, [0; 3], 0);
198:         }
199: 
200:         let ll = grid.get_light_rgb(x as usize, y as usize, z as usize);
201:         let fo = grid.get_face_occlusion(x as usize, y as usize, z as usize);
202:         let base_color = self.palette.color(v_id);
203: 
204:         (v_id, base_color, ll, fo)
205:     }
206: }
````

````rust
203:     /// Applies a user-selected scene voxel size after checking every
204:     /// invariant relied upon by chunk generation and GPU traversal.
205:     ///
206:     /// The override must be finite, positive, tile this profile's chunk edge
207: 
208: 
209: 
210:     pub fn try_with_voxel_size(mut self, voxel_size: f32) -> Result<Self, VoxelSizeError> {
211:         if !voxel_size.is_finite() {
212:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::NotFinite);
213:         }
214:         if voxel_size <= 0.0 {
215:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::NotPositive);
216:         }
217: 
218:         let ratio = f64::from(self.chunk_size) / f64::from(voxel_size);
219:         let axis_voxels = ratio.round();
220:         let reconstructed_chunk = axis_voxels * f64::from(voxel_size);
221:         let seam_tolerance = f64::from(self.chunk_size).abs().mul_add(1.0e-6, 1.0e-6);
222:         if axis_voxels < 1.0
223:             || !ratio.is_finite()
224:             || (reconstructed_chunk - f64::from(self.chunk_size)).abs() > seam_tolerance
225:         {
226:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::DoesNotTileChunk {
227:                 chunk_size: self.chunk_size,
228:                 voxel_size,
229:             });
230:         }
231: 
232:         let axis_voxels = axis_voxels as u32;
233:         if axis_voxels % PROGRESSIVE_LOD_DIVISOR != 0 {
234:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::DoesNotTileProgressiveLod {
235:                 fine_axis_voxels: axis_voxels,
236:                 divisor: PROGRESSIVE_LOD_DIVISOR,
237:             });
238:         }
239:         let required_depth = axis_voxels
240:             .checked_next_power_of_two()
241:             .map(u32::trailing_zeros)
242:             .unwrap_or(u32::BITS);
243:         if required_depth > MAX_SUPPORTED_SVO_DEPTH {
244:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::SvoDepthExceedsLimit {
245:                 required: required_depth,
246:                 maximum: MAX_SUPPORTED_SVO_DEPTH,
247:             });
248:         }
249: 
250: 
251: 
252: 
253:         let allocated_axis = u64::from(axis_voxels) + 2;
254:         let required_columns = allocated_axis * allocated_axis;
255:         if required_columns > MAX_DENSE_CHUNK_COLUMNS {
256:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::DenseChunkBudgetExceeded {
257:                 required_columns,
258:                 maximum_columns: MAX_DENSE_CHUNK_COLUMNS,
259:             });
260:         }
261: 
262:         let height_voxels =
263:             (MAX_GENERATED_HEIGHT_WORLD_UNITS / f64::from(voxel_size)).ceil() as u64 + 2;
264:         let required_voxels = required_columns
265:             .checked_mul(height_voxels)
266:             .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);
267:         if required_voxels > MAX_DENSE_CHUNK_VOXELS {
268:             return Err(VoxelSizeError::DenseVoxelBudgetExceeded {
269:                 required_voxels,
270:                 maximum_voxels: MAX_DENSE_CHUNK_VOXELS,
271:             });
272:         }
273: 
274:         self.voxel_scale = voxel_size;
275:         Ok(self)
276:     }
277: 
278: 
279: 
280: 
281: 
282:     pub fn at_lod(mut self, lod: u8) -> Self {
283:         self.voxel_scale *= (1u32 << lod.min(4)) as f32;
284:         self
285:     }
286: 
287:     pub fn svo_depth(&self) -> u32 {
288:         let voxels = (self.chunk_size / self.voxel_scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
289:         voxels.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros()
290:     }
291: 
292:     pub fn svo_world_size(&self) -> f32 {
293:         let size = 1 << self.svo_depth();
294:         size as f32 * self.voxel_scale
295:     }
296: }
297: 
298: pub struct GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase<'a> {
299:     noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
300:     telemetry: &'a dyn TelemetryPort,
301: }
302: 
303: impl<'a> GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase<'a> {
304:     /// Constructs the use case with silent telemetry (tests, wasm default).
305:     pub fn new(noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider) -> Self {
306:         Self {
307:             noise_provider,
308:             telemetry: &NULL_TELEMETRY,
309:         }
310:     }
311: 
312: 
313: 
314: 
315:     pub fn with_telemetry(
316:         noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
317:         telemetry: &'a dyn TelemetryPort,
318:     ) -> Self {
319:         Self {
320:             noise_provider,
321:             telemetry,
322:         }
323:     }
324: 
325:     pub fn execute(&self, chunk_pos: Position, seed: u32, config: GeneratorConfig) -> VoxelGrid {
326:         self.execute_with_reality(chunk_pos, seed, config, &RealitySnapshot::default())
327:     }
328: 
329: 
330: 
331: 
332:     pub fn execute_with_reality(
333:         &self,
334:         chunk_pos: Position,
335:         seed: u32,
336:         config: GeneratorConfig,
337:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
338:     ) -> VoxelGrid {
339: 
340: 
341: 
342: 
343:         if config.level == 0 || config.level == 1 || config.level == 34 {
344:             use crate::use_cases::grassland_level::GrasslandLevel;
345:             use crate::use_cases::level_generator::LevelGenerator;
346:             use crate::use_cases::level_one::HabitableLevel;
347:             use crate::use_cases::level_zero::BackroomsLevel;
348: 
349:             let start_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros();
350:             let generator: &dyn LevelGenerator = match config.level {
351:                 0 => &BackroomsLevel,
352:                 1 => &HabitableLevel,
353:                 _ => &GrasslandLevel,
354:             };
355:             let mut grid = generator.generate_with_reality(
356:                 chunk_pos,
357:                 seed,
358:                 config,
359:                 self.noise_provider,
360:                 reality,
361:             );
362:             let lighting =
363:                 crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(
364:                     config.voxel_scale,
365:                 )
366:                 .expect("GeneratorConfig voxel_scale must be finite and greater than zero");
367:             crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::bake_voxel_lighting(&mut grid, lighting);
368: 
369:             let elapsed_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros().saturating_sub(start_micros);
370:             self.telemetry.log(&format!(
371:                 "[TELEMETRY] level {} chunk generated. Duration={}us, Grid={}x{}x{}",
372:                 config.level,
373:                 elapsed_micros,
374:                 grid.width(),
375:                 grid.height(),
376:                 grid.depth()
377:             ));
378:             return grid;
379:         }
380: 
381:         legacy_blueprint::generate_legacy_blueprint(
382:             self.noise_provider,
383:             self.telemetry,
384:             chunk_pos,
385:             seed,
386:             config,
387:         )
388:     }
389: }

517:     #[test]
518:     fn coarse_chunk_generates_the_same_layout_smaller() {
519:         let noise = MockNoiseProvider { value: 0.0 };
520:         let generator = GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
521:         let fine = generator.execute(
522:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
523:             42,
524:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_level(crate::use_cases::level_generator::LEVEL_LEGACY_OFFICES),
525:         );
526:         let coarse = generator.execute(
527:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
528:             42,
529:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_level(crate::use_cases::level_generator::LEVEL_LEGACY_OFFICES).at_lod(1),
530:         );
531:         assert_eq!(coarse.width() * 2, fine.width());
532:         assert_eq!(coarse.depth() * 2, fine.depth());
533: 
534: 
535: 
536: 
537:         let wall = crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_WALL;
538:         let mut wall_match = 0usize;
539:         let mut wall_total = 0usize;
540:         for z in 0..coarse.depth() {
541:             for x in 0..coarse.width() {
542:                 if coarse.get(x, 1, z) != wall {
543:                     continue;
544:                 }
545:                 wall_total += 1;
546:                 let (fx, fz) = (x * 2, z * 2);
547:                 let mut near = false;
548:                 for dz in -1i32..=2 {
549:                     for dx in -1i32..=2 {
550:                         let (sx, sz) = (fx as i32 + dx, fz as i32 + dz);
551:                         if sx >= 0
552:                             && sz >= 0
553:                             && (sx as usize) < fine.width()
554:                             && (sz as usize) < fine.depth()
555:                             && fine.get(sx as usize, 1, sz as usize) == wall
556:                         {
557:                             near = true;
558:                         }
559:                     }
560:                 }
561:                 if near {
562:                     wall_match += 1;
563:                 }
564:             }
565:         }
566:         assert!(wall_total > 0, "coarse chunk must still contain walls");
567:         assert!(
568:             wall_match * 10 >= wall_total * 9,
569:             "coarse walls should lie within one fine voxel of fine walls: {wall_match}/{wall_total}"
570:         );
571:     }

710:     #[test]
711:     fn test_microbiome_zones_generation_and_contiguous() {
712:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
713:         use crate::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
714: 
715:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
716:         let config = GeneratorConfig::high_spec().with_level(crate::use_cases::level_generator::LEVEL_LEGACY_OFFICES);
717:         let chunk_size = config.chunk_size;
718:         let mut zones = std::collections::HashSet::new();
719: 
720:         let seed = 42;
721:         let mut grid_zones = vec![MicrobiomeZone::Standard; 100];
722: 
723:         for cz in 0..10 {
724:             for cx in 0..10 {
725:                 let wx = 10.0 * chunk_size + (cx as f32) * 5.0;
726:                 let wz = 10.0 * chunk_size + (cz as f32) * 5.0;
727:                 let n = noise.evaluate_2d(
728:                     seed ^ 0x2b8f_a43c,
729:                     crate::domain::entities::position::Position::new(wx * 0.05, wz * 0.05),
730:                 );
731: 
732:                 let zone = if n < -0.7 {
733:                     MicrobiomeZone::Blackout
734:                 } else if n < -0.4 {
735:                     MicrobiomeZone::Holes
736:                 } else if n > 0.85 - (config.tuning.atria as f32 * 0.1) {
737:                     MicrobiomeZone::Atrium
738:                 } else if n > 0.6 {
739:                     MicrobiomeZone::PillarField
740:                 } else if n > 0.4 {
741:                     MicrobiomeZone::Arch
742:                 } else if n > 0.2 && n < 0.25 {
743:                     MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom
744:                 } else {
745:                     MicrobiomeZone::Standard
746:                 };
747: 
748:                 zones.insert(zone);
749:                 grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx] = zone;
750:             }
751:         }
752: 
753:         assert!(zones.len() >= 2, "Expected at least 2 distinct zones");
754: 
755:         let mut same_neighbor_count = 0;
756:         let mut total_neighbors = 0;
757:         for cz in 1..9 {
758:             for cx in 1..9 {
759:                 let z = grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx];
760:                 total_neighbors += 4;
761:                 if grid_zones[(cz - 1) * 10 + cx] == z {
762:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
763:                 }
764:                 if grid_zones[(cz + 1) * 10 + cx] == z {
765:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
766:                 }
767:                 if grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx - 1] == z {
768:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
769:                 }
770:                 if grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx + 1] == z {
771:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
772:                 }
773:             }
774:         }
775: 
776:         assert!(
777:             same_neighbor_count as f32 / total_neighbors as f32 > 0.6,
778:             "Expected zones to be highly contiguous"
779:         );
780:     }

838:     #[test]
839:     fn test_blackout_zone_connectivity() {
840:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
841:         use crate::domain::entities::grid::Grid;
842:         use crate::domain::use_cases::generate_maze::{GrowingTreeGenerator, MazeGenerator};
843:         use rand::SeedableRng;
844:         use rand::rngs::StdRng;
845: 
846:         let mut grid = Grid::new(20, 20);
847:         for y in 0..20 {
848:             for x in 0..20 {
849:                 if let Some(cell) = grid.get_mut(x, y) {
850:                     if x < 10 {
851:                         cell.zone = MicrobiomeZone::Blackout;
852:                     } else {
853:                         cell.zone = MicrobiomeZone::Standard;
854:                     }
855:                 }
856:             }
857:         }
858: 
859:         let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(42);
860:         let maze_gen = GrowingTreeGenerator {
861:             junction_density: 3.0,
862:         };
863:         maze_gen.generate(&mut grid, &mut rng);
864: 
865:         let mut blackout_openings = 0;
866:         let mut standard_openings = 0;
867: 
868:         for y in 0..20 {
869:             for x in 0..20 {
870:                 if let Some(cell) = grid.get(x, y) {
871:                     let open_count = cell.walls.iter().filter(|&&w| !w).count();
872:                     if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Blackout {
873:                         blackout_openings += open_count;
874:                     } else {
875:                         standard_openings += open_count;
876:                     }
877:                 }
878:             }
879:         }
880: 
881:         assert!(
882:             blackout_openings < standard_openings,
````

````rust
  2:     VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_TREE, VOXEL_WATER, VoxelGrid,

  8: 
  9: 
 10: const GRID_HEIGHT_UNITS: f32 = 5.8;
 11: 
 12: const TREE_PERIOD: f32 = 9.0;
 13: 
 14: const GLOW_PERIOD: f32 = 3.2;
 15: 
 16: pub struct GrasslandLevel;
 17: 
 18: impl GrasslandLevel {
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22:     fn hash(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, cx: i64, cz: i64) -> f32 {
 23:         let v = noise.evaluate_2d(
 24:             seed ^ salt,
 25:             Position::new(cx as f32 * 20.0, cz as f32 * 20.0),
 26:         );
 27:         (v * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 0.999)
 28:     }
 29: }
 30: 
 31: impl LevelGenerator for GrasslandLevel {
 32:     fn generate_with_reality(
 33:         &self,
 34:         chunk_pos: Position,
 35:         seed: u32,
 36:         config: GeneratorConfig,
 37:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 38:         _reality: &crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot,
 39:     ) -> VoxelGrid {
 40:         let s = config.voxel_scale;
 41:         let width = (config.chunk_size / s).round() as usize;
 42:         let depth = (config.chunk_size / s).round() as usize;
 43:         let height = (GRID_HEIGHT_UNITS / s) as usize;
 44:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(width, height, depth);
 45:         let sky_y = height - 1;
 46: 
 47:         for z in 0..depth {
 48:             for x in 0..width {
 49:                 let wx = chunk_pos.x + (x as f32 + 0.5) * s;
 50:                 let wz = chunk_pos.z + (z as f32 + 0.5) * s;
 51: 
 52: 
 53:                 let lake = noise.evaluate_2d(seed ^ 0x1A5E, Position::new(wx * 0.7, wz * 0.7));
 54:                 let ground = if lake > 0.62 {
 55:                     VOXEL_WATER
 56:                 } else {
 57:                     VOXEL_GRASS
 58:                 };
 59:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, ground);
 60: 
 61: 
 62:                 grid.set(x, sky_y, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 63: 
 64: 
 65: 
 66:                 let gx = wx.rem_euclid(GLOW_PERIOD);
 67:                 let gz = wz.rem_euclid(GLOW_PERIOD);
 68:                 if ground == VOXEL_GRASS && gx < s && gz < s {
 69:                     grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 70:                 }
 71: 
 72: 
 73:                 let cell_x = (wx / TREE_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
 74:                 let cell_z = (wz / TREE_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
 75:                 if Self::hash(noise, seed, 0x7EE5, cell_x, cell_z) > 0.6 && ground == VOXEL_GRASS {
 76: 
 77:                     let jx =
 78:                         Self::hash(noise, seed, 0x7EE6, cell_x, cell_z) * (TREE_PERIOD - 2.0) + 1.0;
 79:                     let jz =
 80:                         Self::hash(noise, seed, 0x7EE7, cell_x, cell_z) * (TREE_PERIOD - 2.0) + 1.0;
 81:                     let tx = cell_x as f32 * TREE_PERIOD + jx;
 82:                     let tz = cell_z as f32 * TREE_PERIOD + jz;
 83:                     let dx = wx - tx;
 84:                     let dz = wz - tz;
 85:                     let d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
 86: 
 87:                     let trunk_top = (2.2 / s) as usize;
 88:                     let canopy_top = (3.6 / s) as usize;
 89:                     if d2 < (0.25f32).powi(2) {
 90:                         for y in 1..trunk_top.min(height - 2) {
 91:                             grid.set(x, y, z, VOXEL_TREE);
 92:                         }
 93:                     }
 94:                     if d2 < (1.6f32).powi(2) {
 95:                         for y in trunk_top..canopy_top.min(height - 2) {
 96:                             grid.set(x, y, z, VOXEL_GRASS);
 97:                         }
 98:                     }
 99:                 }
100:             }
101:         }
102: 
103:         grid
104:     }
105: }
````

````rust
 13: #[derive(Debug)]
 14: pub(crate) struct InfiniteRegionWindow {
 15:     min_region_x: i64,
 16:     min_region_z: i64,
 17:     max_region_x: i64,
 18:     max_region_z: i64,
 19:     plans: Vec<RegionPlan>,
 20: }
 21: 
 22: impl InfiniteRegionWindow {
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26: 
 27:     pub(crate) fn covering(
 28:         area: WorldBounds,
 29:         halo: f32,
 30:         seed: u32,
 31:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 32:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 33:     ) -> Self {
 34:         assert!(
 35:             halo.is_finite() && halo >= 0.0,
 36:             "region-window halo must be a finite, non-negative world distance"
 37:         );
 38:         let area = area.expanded(halo);
 39:         assert!(
 40:             [area.min_x, area.min_z, area.max_x, area.max_z]
 41:                 .into_iter()
 42:                 .all(f32::is_finite),
 43:             "an infinite-region window requires finite world bounds"
 44:         );
 45: 
 46:         let min_region_x = region_index(area.min_x);
 47:         let min_region_z = region_index(area.min_z);
 48:         let max_region_x = region_index(area.max_x);
 49:         let max_region_z = region_index(area.max_z);
 50:         let width = region_count(min_region_x, max_region_x);
 51:         let height = region_count(min_region_z, max_region_z);
 52:         let capacity = width
 53:             .checked_mul(height)
 54:             .expect("requested region window is too large to address");
 55:         let mut plans = Vec::with_capacity(capacity);
 56: 
 57:         for region_z in min_region_z..=max_region_z {
 58:             for region_x in min_region_x..=max_region_x {
 59:                 plans.push(generate_region_plan(
 60:                     seed,
 61:                     region_origin(region_x, region_z),
 62:                     REGION_SIZE,
 63:                     config,
 64:                     noise,
 65:                 ));
 66:             }
 67:         }
 68: 
 69:         Self {
 70:             min_region_x,
 71:             min_region_z,
 72:             max_region_x,
 73:             max_region_z,
 74:             plans,
 75:         }
 76:     }
 77: 
 78: 
 79:     pub(crate) fn around_chunk(
 80:         chunk_origin: Position,
 81:         chunk_size: f32,
 82:         halo: f32,
 83:         seed: u32,
 84:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 85:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 86:     ) -> Self {
 87:         assert!(
 88:             chunk_size.is_finite() && chunk_size >= 0.0,
 89:             "chunk size must be a finite, non-negative world distance"
 90:         );
 91:         Self::covering(
 92:             WorldBounds::new(
 93:                 chunk_origin.x,
 94:                 chunk_origin.z,
 95:                 chunk_origin.x + chunk_size,
 96:                 chunk_origin.z + chunk_size,
 97:             ),
 98:             halo,
 99:             seed,
100:             config,
101:             noise,
102:         )
103:     }
104: 
105: 
106: 
107:     pub(crate) fn plan_at(&self, world: Position) -> Option<&RegionPlan> {
108:         self.plan_for_region(region_index(world.x), region_index(world.z))
109:     }
110: 
111:     pub(crate) fn plan_for_region(&self, region_x: i64, region_z: i64) -> Option<&RegionPlan> {
112:         if region_x < self.min_region_x
113:             || region_x > self.max_region_x
114:             || region_z < self.min_region_z
115:             || region_z > self.max_region_z
116:         {
117:             return None;
118:         }
119: 
120:         let width = region_count(self.min_region_x, self.max_region_x);
121:         let local_x = usize::try_from(region_x - self.min_region_x).ok()?;
122:         let local_z = usize::try_from(region_z - self.min_region_z).ok()?;
123:         self.plans
124:             .get(local_z.saturating_mul(width).saturating_add(local_x))
125:     }
126: 
127:     #[cfg(test)]
128:     pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
129:         self.plans.len()
130:     }
131: 
132:     #[cfg(test)]
133:     pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
134:         self.plans.is_empty()
135:     }
136: 
137: 
138:     pub(crate) fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = ((i64, i64), &RegionPlan)> {
139:         let width = region_count(self.min_region_x, self.max_region_x);
140:         self.plans.iter().enumerate().map(move |(index, plan)| {
141:             let local_z = index / width;
142:             let local_x = index % width;
143:             (
144:                 (
145:                     self.min_region_x + local_x as i64,
146:                     self.min_region_z + local_z as i64,
147:                 ),
148:                 plan,
149:             )
150:         })
151:     }
152: }
153: 
154: fn region_count(first: i64, last: i64) -> usize {
155:     let count = last
156:         .checked_sub(first)
157:         .and_then(|distance| distance.checked_add(1))
158:         .expect("requested region window exceeds integer address space");
159:     usize::try_from(count).expect("requested region window exceeds platform address space")
160: }
161: 
162: fn region_origin(region_x: i64, region_z: i64) -> Position {
163:     Position::new(region_x as f32 * REGION_SIZE, region_z as f32 * REGION_SIZE)
164: }
165:
````
