161:                 } else if x == 9 {
162:                     data[z * width + x] = 5;
163:                 } else if x == 8 {
164:                     data[z * width + x] = 6;
165:                 }
166:             }
167:         }
168:         Self { width, depth, data }
169:     }
170: }
171: 
172: 
173: 
174: pub(crate) fn generate_legacy_blueprint(
175:     noise_provider: &dyn NoiseProvider,
176:     telemetry: &dyn TelemetryPort,
177:     chunk_pos: Position,
178:     seed: u32,
179:     config: GeneratorConfig,
180: ) -> VoxelGrid {
181:     let start_micros = telemetry.now_micros();
182: 
183:     let width = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
184:     let depth = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
185: 
186: 
187: 
188: 
189: 
190:     let cell_border = |c: usize| (c as f32 * 5.0 / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
191:     let cell_w = ((config.chunk_size / 5.0).round() as usize).max(1);
192:     let cell_d = cell_w;
193: 
194:     let mut abstract_grid = Grid::new(cell_w, cell_d);
195: 
196: 
197:     let mut max_chunk_height_units = 3.0_f32;
198:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
199:         for cx in 0..cell_w {
200:             let wx = chunk_pos.x * config.chunk_size + (cx as f32) * 5.0;
201:             let wz = chunk_pos.z * config.chunk_size + (cz as f32) * 5.0;
202: 
203: 
204:             let n = noise_provider.evaluate_2d(
205:                 seed ^ 0x2b8f_a43c,
206:                 crate::domain::entities::position::Position::new(wx * 0.05, wz * 0.05),
207:             );
208: 
209:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
210:             let mut zone = MicrobiomeZone::Standard;
211: 
212:             if n < -0.7 {
213:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Blackout;
214:             } else if n < -0.4 {
215:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Holes;
216:             } else if n > 0.85 - (config.tuning.atria as f32 * 0.1) {
217:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Atrium;
218:             } else if n > 0.6 {
219:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::PillarField;
220:             } else if n > 0.4 {
221:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::Arch;
222:             } else if n > 0.2 && n < 0.25 {
223:                 zone = MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom;
224:             }
225: 
226:             if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz) {
227:                 cell.zone = zone;
228:             }
229: 
230:             let cell_h = match zone {
231:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
232:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
233:                 _ => 4.0,
234:             };
235:             if cell_h > max_chunk_height_units {
236:                 max_chunk_height_units = cell_h;
237:             }
238:         }
239:     }
240: 
241:     let height = (max_chunk_height_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize + 2;
242: 
243:     telemetry.log(&format!(
244:             "[INFO] Entering GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::execute. Args: chunk_pos={:?}, seed={}, chunk_size={} (Voxel dimensions: {}x{}x{})",
245:             chunk_pos, seed, config.chunk_size, width, height, depth
246:         ));
247: 
248:     let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(width, height, depth);
249: 
250: 
251:     if chunk_pos.x.abs() < 1.0 && chunk_pos.z.abs() < 1.0 {
252:         for z in 0..depth {
253:             for x in 0..width {
254:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_FLOOR);
255:                 grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_CEILING);
256: 
257: 
258:                 if x > 0 && z > 0 && x % 20 == 0 && z % 20 == 0 {
259:                     grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
260:                 }
261:             }
262:         }
263:         let lighting =
264:             crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(
265:                 config.voxel_scale,
266:             )
267:             .expect("GeneratorConfig voxel_scale must be finite and greater than zero");
268:         crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::bake_voxel_lighting(&mut grid, lighting);
269:         return grid;
270:     }
271: 
272: 
273: 
274: 
275:     let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
276:         (seed as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64),
277:     );
278: 
279: 
280: 
281: 
282:     let mut detail_rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
283:         (seed as u64)
284:             ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64)
285:             ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64)
286:             ^ 0xD57A_11ED,
287:     );
288: 
289:     let maze_gen = GrowingTreeGenerator {
290:         junction_density: config.tuning.junction_density,
291:     };
292:     maze_gen.generate(&mut abstract_grid, &mut rng);
293: 
294: 
295:     let mut rooms = Vec::new();
296:     let mut room_grid = vec![None; cell_w * cell_d];
297: 
298: 
299:     let num_room_attempts = 15;
300:     for _ in 0..num_room_attempts {
301:         let cx = rng.random_range(0..cell_w);
302:         let cz = rng.random_range(0..cell_d);
303:         let rw = rng.random_range(1..=3);
304:         let rd = rng.random_range(1..=3);
305: 
306:         if cx + rw <= cell_w && cz + rd <= cell_d {
307:             let mut overlap = false;
308:             for i in 0..rw {
309:                 for j in 0..rd {
310:                     if room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i].is_some() {
311:                         overlap = true;
312:                     }
313:                 }
314:             }
315:             if !overlap {
316:                 let room_id = rooms.len();
317:                 for i in 0..rw {
318:                     for j in 0..rd {
319:                         room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i] = Some(room_id);
320:                         if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx + i, cz + j) {
321:                             if j > 0 {
322:                                 cell.walls[0] = false;
323:                             }
324:                             if i < rw - 1 {
325:                                 cell.walls[1] = false;
326:                             }
327:                             if j < rd - 1 {
328:                                 cell.walls[2] = false;
329:                             }
330:                             if i > 0 {
331:                                 cell.walls[3] = false;
332:                             }
333:                         }
334:                     }
335:                 }
336:                 rooms.push(Room {
337:                     name: "Organic",
338:                     x0: cell_border(cx),
339:                     x1: cell_border(cx + rw) - 1,
340:                     z0: cell_border(cz),
341:                     z1: cell_border(cz + rd) - 1,
342:                 });
343:             }
344:         }
345:     }
346: 
347: 
348:     let mut non_room_indices = Vec::new();
349:     for i in 0..(cell_w * cell_d) {
350:         if room_grid[i].is_none() {
351:             non_room_indices.push(i);
352:         }
353:     }
354: 
355:     let target_corridors = (non_room_indices.len() as f32 * 0.20) as usize;
356:     let mut corridor_count = 0;
357: 
358:     use rand::seq::SliceRandom;
359:     non_room_indices.shuffle(&mut rng);
360: 
361:     for &idx in &non_room_indices {
362:         if corridor_count >= target_corridors {
363:             break;
364:         }
365:         let cx = idx % cell_w;
366:         let cz = idx / cell_w;
367:         if abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor {
368:             continue;
369:         }
370: 
371:         abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
372:         corridor_count += 1;
373: 
374: 
375:         let mut current_cz = cz;
376:         while current_cz > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[0] {
377:             current_cz -= 1;
378:             if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
379:                 || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
380:             {
381:                 break;
382:             }
383:             abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
384:             corridor_count += 1;
385:         }
386: 
387:         let mut current_cz = cz;
388:         while current_cz < cell_d - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[2] {
389:             current_cz += 1;
390:             if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
391:                 || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
392:             {
393:                 break;
394:             }
395:             abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
396:             corridor_count += 1;
397:         }
398: 
399:         let mut current_cx = cx;
400:         while current_cx > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[3] {
401:             current_cx -= 1;
402:             if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
403:                 || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
404:             {
405:                 break;
406:             }
407:             abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
408:             corridor_count += 1;
409:         }
410: 
411:         let mut current_cx = cx;
412:         while current_cx < cell_w - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[1] {
413:             current_cx += 1;
414:             if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
415:                 || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
416:             {
417:                 break;
418:             }
419:             abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
420:             corridor_count += 1;
421:         }
422:     }
423: 
424: 
425:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
426:         for cx in 0..cell_w {
427:             let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap();
428:             let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
429:             let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
430:             let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
431:             let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
432: 
433:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
434:             let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
435:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
436:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
437:                 _ => 4.0,
438:             };
439:             let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
440:             let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
441: 
442:             let wall_type = VOXEL_WALL;
443: 
444: 
445:             for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
446:                 for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
447:                     grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
448: 
449:                     if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Holes {
450:                         if vx > v_x0 + 5 && vx < v_x1 - 5 && vz > v_z0 + 5 && vz < v_z1 - 5 {
451:                             if detail_rng.random_bool(0.05) {
452:                                 grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_AIR);
453:                             }
454:                         }
455:                     }
456: 
457:                     if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Atrium {
458: 
459:                         grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
460:                         if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Blackout && (vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0) {
461:                             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
462:                                 grid.set(
463:                                     vx,
464:                                     wall_max_y - 1,
465:                                     vz,
466:                                     crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
467:                                 );
468:                             } else {
469:                                 grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
470:                             }
471:                         }
472:                         for y in (wall_max_y + 1)..height {
473:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
474:                         }
475:                     } else {
476: 
477:                         grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
478:                         if vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0 {
479:                             grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
480:                         }
481:                     }
482:                 }
483:             }
484: 
485:             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
486:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
487:                     grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z0, wall_type);
488:                     grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z0, wall_type);
489:                     grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z1, wall_type);
490:                     grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z1, wall_type);
491:                     if detail_rng.random_bool(0.3) {
492:                         grid.set((v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2, y, (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2, wall_type);
493:                     }
494:                 }
495:                 continue;
496:             }
497: 
498: 
499:             if cz < cell_d - 1 {
500:                 let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx] == room_grid[(cz + 1) * cell_w + cx]
501:                     && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
502: 
503:                 if !same_room {
504:                     let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
505:                     let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
506:                         1.2
507:                     } else if width_choice < 85 {
508:                         2.0
509:                     } else {
510:                         3.5
511:                     };
512:                     let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
513: 
514: 
515:                     let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
516:                     let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
517:                     let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
518:                         rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
519:                     } else {
520:                         50
521:                     };
522:                     let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
523:                     let hole_x0 = v_x0 + offset;
524:                     let hole_x1 = hole_x0 + hole_w;
525: 
526:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
527:                         let in_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x1;
528:                         if cell.walls[2] || !in_hole {
529:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
530:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
531:                             }
532:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
533:                             let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
534:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
535:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
536:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
537:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
538:                             }
539:                         } else {
540:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
541:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
542:                             }
543:                         }
544:                     }
545:                 }
546:             } else if cz == cell_d - 1 {
547: 
548:                 let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
549:                 let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
550:                 for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
551:                     let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
552:                     if !is_hole {
553:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
554:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
555:                         }
556:                     } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
557:                         let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
558:                         let arch_top = door_max_y;
559:                         let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
560:                         for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
561:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
562:                         }
563:                     } else {
564:                         for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
565:                             grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
566:                         }
567:                     }
568:                 }
569:             }
570: 
571: 
572:             if cx < cell_w - 1 {
573:                 let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx] == room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx + 1]
574:                     && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
575: 
576:                 if !same_room {
577:                     let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
578:                     let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
579:                         1.2
580:                     } else if width_choice < 85 {
581:                         2.0
582:                     } else {
583:                         3.5
584:                     };
585:                     let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
586: 
587:                     let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
588:                     let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
589:                     let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
590:                         rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
591:                     } else {
592:                         50
593:                     };
594:                     let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
595:                     let hole_z0 = v_z0 + offset;
596:                     let hole_z1 = hole_z0 + hole_w;
597: 
598:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
599:                         let in_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z1;
600:                         if cell.walls[1] || !in_hole {
601:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
602:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
603:                             }
604:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
605:                             let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
606:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
607:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
608:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
609:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
610:                             }
611:                         } else {
612:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
613:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
614:                             }
615:                         }
616:                     }
617:                 }
618:             } else if cx == cell_w - 1 {
619:                 let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
620:                 let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
621:                 for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
622:                     let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
623:                     if !is_hole {
624:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
625:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
626:                         }
627:                     } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
628:                         let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
629:                         let arch_top = door_max_y;
630:                         let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
631:                         for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
632:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
633:                         }
634:                     } else {
635:                         for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
636:                             grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
637:                         }
638:                     }
639:                 }
640:             }
641: 
642: 
643:             let mut is_ns_hall = false;
644:             let mut is_ew_hall = false;
645:             if cell.is_corridor {
646:                 let mut ns_run = 1;
647:                 if !cell.walls[0] && cz > 0 && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz - 1).unwrap().is_corridor {
648:                     ns_run += 1;
649:                 }
650:                 if !cell.walls[2]
651:                     && cz < cell_d - 1
652:                     && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz + 1).unwrap().is_corridor
653:                 {
654:                     ns_run += 1;
655:                 }
656: 
657:                 let mut ew_run = 1;
658:                 if !cell.walls[1]
659:                     && cx < cell_w - 1
660:                     && abstract_grid.get(cx + 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
661:                 {
662:                     ew_run += 1;
663:                 }
664:                 if !cell.walls[3] && cx > 0 && abstract_grid.get(cx - 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor {
665:                     ew_run += 1;
666:                 }
667: 
668:                 if ns_run >= 2 {
669:                     is_ns_hall = true;
670:                 }
671:                 if ew_run >= 2 {
672:                     is_ew_hall = true;
673:                 }
674:             }
675: 
676:             if is_ns_hall && !is_ew_hall {
677:                 let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
678:                 for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
679:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
680:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
681:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
682:                         }
683:                     }
684:                 }
685:                 for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
686:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
687:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
688:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
689:                         }
690:                     }
691:                 }
692:             } else if is_ew_hall && !is_ns_hall {
693:                 let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
694:                 for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
695:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
696:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
697:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
698:                         }
699:                     }
700:                 }
701:                 for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
702:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
703:                         for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
704:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
705:                         }
706:                     }
707:                 }
708:             } else if is_ns_hall && is_ew_hall {
709:                 let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
710:                 let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
711:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
712:                     for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
713:                         for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
714:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
715:                         }
716:                     }
717:                     for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
718:                         for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
719:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
720:                         }
721:                     }
722:                     for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
723:                         for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
724:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
725:                         }
726:                     }
727:                     for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
728:                         for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
729:                             grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
730:                         }
731:                     }
732:                 }
733:             }
734:         }
735:     }
736: 
737: 
738:     for cz in 0..cell_d {
739:         let cell = abstract_grid.get(0, cz).unwrap();
740:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
741:         let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
742:             MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
743:             MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
744:             _ => 4.0,
745:         };
746:         let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
747:         let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
748:         let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
749:             VOXEL_RED_WALL
750:         } else {
751:             VOXEL_WALL
752:         };
753: 
754:         if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
755:             continue;
756:         }
757: 
758:         let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
759:         let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
760:         let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
761:         let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
762:         for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
763:             let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
764:             if !is_hole {
765:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
766:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
767:                 }
768:             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
769:                 let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
770:                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
771:                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
772:                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
773:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
774:                 }
775:             } else {
776:                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
777:                     grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
778:                 }
779:             }
780:         }
781:     }
782:     for cx in 0..cell_w {
783:         let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, 0).unwrap();
784:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
785:         let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
786:             MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
787:             MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
788:             _ => 4.0,
789:         };
790:         let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
791:         let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
792:         let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
793:             VOXEL_RED_WALL
794:         } else {
795:             VOXEL_WALL
796:         };
797: 
798:         if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
799:             continue;
800:         }
801: 
802:         let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
803:         let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
804:         let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
805:         let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
806:         for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
807:             let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
808:             if !is_hole {
809:                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
810:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
811:                 }
812:             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
813:                 let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
814:                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
815:                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
816:                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
817:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
818:                 }
819:             } else {
820:                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
821:                     grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
822:                 }
823:             }
824:         }
825:     }
826: 
827: 
828:     let stamps = vec![
829:         RoomStamp::cubicles(),
830:         RoomStamp::showroom(),
831:         RoomStamp::waiting(),
832:         RoomStamp::storage(),
833:         RoomStamp::lounge(),
834:         RoomStamp::server_room(),
835:         RoomStamp::cafeteria(),
836:         RoomStamp::maintenance(),
837:     ];
838: 
839:     for room in &rooms {
840:         let mut possible_stamps = Vec::new();
841:         for stamp in &stamps {
842:             let max_stamps_w = (room.x1 - room.x0) / stamp.width.max(1);
843:             let max_stamps_d = (room.z1 - room.z0) / stamp.depth.max(1);
844:             if max_stamps_w > 0 && max_stamps_d > 0 {
845:                 possible_stamps.push(stamp);
846:             }
847:         }
848: 
849: 
850: 
851:         let stamp_roll = rng.random_range(0..usize::MAX);
852:         let stairs_roll = rng.random_bool(0.15 * (config.tuning.stairs_density as f64));
853:         if !possible_stamps.is_empty() {
854:             let mut stamp = possible_stamps[stamp_roll % possible_stamps.len()];
855: 
856: 
857:             let stairway = RoomStamp::stairway();
858:             if stairs_roll {
859:                 stamp = &stairway;
860:             }
861: 
862:             let spacing = (6.0 * (config.voxel_scale / 0.1)) as usize;
863:             let mut start_x = room.x0 + spacing;
864:             while start_x + stamp.width <= room.x1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
865:                 let mut start_z = room.z0 + spacing;
866:                 while start_z + stamp.depth <= room.z1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
867:                     if validate_stamp_placement(&grid, room, stamp, start_x, start_z) {
868:                         place_stamp(&mut grid, stamp, start_x, start_z);
869:                     }
870:                     start_z += stamp.depth + spacing;
871:                 }
872:                 start_x += stamp.width + spacing;
873:             }
874:         }
875: 
876: 
877:         let cx = (room.x0 + room.x1) / 2;
878:         let is_strip = rng.random_bool(0.3);
879:         let mut z = room.z0 + 8;
880: 
881:         while z <= room.z1.saturating_sub(8) {
882:             if is_strip {
883:                 for offset in 0..4 {
884:                     if z + offset <= room.z1 {
885:                         grid.set(cx, height - 1, z + offset, VOXEL_LIGHT);
886:                     }
887:                 }
888:             } else {
889:                 grid.set(cx, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
890:             }
891:             z += 12;
892:         }
893:     }
894: 
895: 
896:     for cz in (8..depth).step_by(16) {
897:         for cx in (8..width).step_by(16) {
898:             if grid.get(cx, height - 1, cz) == VOXEL_CEILING && grid.get(cx, 1, cz) == VOXEL_AIR {
899:                 grid.set(cx, height - 1, cz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
900:             }
901:         }
902:     }
903: 
904: 
905: 
906: 
907:     let lighting =
908:         crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(
909:             config.voxel_scale,
910:         )
911:         .expect("GeneratorConfig voxel_scale must be finite and greater than zero");
912:     crate::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::bake_voxel_lighting(&mut grid, lighting);
913: 
914:     let elapsed_micros = telemetry.now_micros().saturating_sub(start_micros);
915:     telemetry.log(&format!(
916:         "[TELEMETRY] execute completed. Duration={}us, OutputVoxelGridSize={}x{}x{}",
917:         elapsed_micros,
918:         grid.width(),
919:         grid.height(),
920:         grid.depth()
921:     ));
922: 
923:     grid
924: }
925: 
926: fn validate_stamp_placement(
927:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
928:     room: &Room,
929:     stamp: &RoomStamp,
930:     start_x: usize,
931:     start_z: usize,
932: ) -> bool {
933:     if start_x < room.x0
934:         || start_x + stamp.width > room.x1
935:         || start_z < room.z0
936:         || start_z + stamp.depth > room.z1
937:     {
938:         return false;
939:     }
940: 
941:     for lz in 0..stamp.depth {
942:         for lx in 0..stamp.width {
943:             let vx = start_x + lx;
944:             let vz = start_z + lz;
945:             if stamp.data[lz * stamp.width + lx] > 0 {
946:                 if grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_AIR && grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_FLOOR {
947:                     return false;
948:                 }
949:             }
950:         }
951:     }
952: 
953:     true
954: }
955: 
956: fn place_stamp(grid: &mut VoxelGrid, stamp: &RoomStamp, start_x: usize, start_z: usize) {
957:     let max_y = grid.height() - 2;
958:     for sz in 0..stamp.depth {
959:         for sx in 0..stamp.width {
960:             let val = stamp.data[sz * stamp.width + sx];
961:             let vx = start_x + sx;
962:             let vz = start_z + sz;
963:             if val == 1 {
964:                 for y in 1..=3 {
965:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
966:                 }
967:             } else if val == 2 {
968:                 for y in 1..=max_y {
969:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
970:                 }
971:             } else if val == 3 {
972:                 for y in 1..=1 {
973:                     grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
974:                 }
975:             } else if val == 4 {
976: 
977:                 grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
978:                 grid.set(vx, 2, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
979:             } else if val == 5 {
980: 
981:                 grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
982:             } else if val == 6 {
983: 
984:             }
985:         }
986:     }
987: }

 48:     id: u32,

 56:     corridor_clearance: impl Fn(f32, f32, f32) -> bool,
 57: ) -> Option<AssemblyInstance> {

 59:     let (lx0, lx1, lz, lw) = legs.iter().copied().min_by(|a, b| {
 60:         let da = (link.anchor.z - a.2).abs();
 61:         let db = (link.anchor.z - b.2).abs();
 62:         da.total_cmp(&db)

 65:         return None;

 72:         lz + corridor_half
 73:     } else {

 75:     });

 79:     if b.0 < origin.x + edge_margin
 80:         || b.1 < origin.z + edge_margin
 81:         || b.2 > origin.x + size - edge_margin
 82:         || b.3 > origin.z + size - edge_margin
 83:     {
 84:         return None;

148: pub(crate) fn apply_stair_profile(
149:     assembly: &AssemblyInstance,
150:     kind: VerticalLinkKind,
151:     plan: &mut ColumnPlan,
152:     _wx: f32,
153:     wz: f32,
154: ) {
155:     let Some(entrance) = assembly.entrances.first() else {
156:         return;
157:     };
158:     let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
159: 
160: 
161:     let depth_in = if entrance.through_x_wall {
162:         if (entrance.center.z - b.1).abs() < (entrance.center.z - b.3).abs() {
163:             wz - b.1
164:         } else {
165:             b.3 - wz
166:         }
167:     } else {
168: 
169: 
170:         return;
171:     };
172: 
173:     let target = match kind {
174:         VerticalLinkKind::EndlessAscent => ASCENT_MAX_UNITS,
175:         _ => LANDING_UNITS,
176:     };
177:     let treads = ((depth_in - VESTIBULE_DEPTH) / TREAD_RUN).floor().max(0.0);
178:     let raw = treads * TREAD_RISE;
179:     plan.floor_units = raw.min(target);
180: 
181: 
182:     plan.floor_units = plan
183:         .floor_units
184:         .min(plan.ceiling_units - MIN_HEADROOM_UNITS)
185:         .max(0.0);
186: 
187: 
188: 
189:     if plan.floor_units > 0.0 {
190:         plan.light = false;
191:     }
192: }

257:             0.0,
258:             "vestibule must stay walkable from the corridor"
259:         );
260:         let deep = profile_at(VerticalLinkKind::EndlessAscent, STAIR_DEPTH - 0.2);
261:         assert!(
262:             deep.floor_units > LANDING_UNITS,
263:             "endless ascent stops at an ordinary landing"
264:         );
265:         assert!(!deep.light, "the top of an endless flight must be unlit");
266:     }
267: }

 22: pub(crate) fn mix(mut h: u32) -> u32 {
 23:     h ^= h >> 16;
 24:     h = h.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA6B);
 25:     h ^= h >> 13;
 26:     h = h.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2_AE35);
 27:     h ^= h >> 16;
 28:     h
 29: }
 30: 
 31: 
 32: pub(crate) fn hash01(seed: u32, keys: &[i64]) -> f32 {
 33:     let mut h = mix(seed ^ 0x9E37_79B9);
 34:     for &k in keys {
 35:         h = mix(h ^ (k as u32)).wrapping_add(mix((k >> 32) as u32));
 36:     }
 37:     (mix(h) >> 8) as f32 / (1u32 << 24) as f32
 38: }

 48: pub fn primary_portal_z(seed: u32, edge_x: i64, row_z: i64) -> f32 {
 49:     let f = 0.30 + 0.40 * hash01(seed, &[0x0E1, edge_x, row_z]);
 50:     snap((row_z as f32 + f) * REGION_SIZE)
 51: }

 61:         edge_x,

 77: fn field(
 78:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 79:     seed: u32,
 80:     salt: u32,
 81:     wx: f32,
 82:     wz: f32,
 83:     wavelengths: [f32; 3],
 84:     weights: [f32; 3],
 85: ) -> f32 {
 86:     let mut sum = 0.0;
 87:     let mut norm = 0.0;
 88:     for (octave, (&wavelength, &weight)) in wavelengths.iter().zip(weights.iter()).enumerate() {
 89:         let s = 20.0 / wavelength;
 90:         sum += weight
 91:             * noise.evaluate_2d(
 92:                 seed ^ salt.wrapping_add((octave as u32).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9)),
 93:                 Position::new(wx * s, wz * s),
 94:             );
 95:         norm += weight;
 96:     }
 97: 
 98: 
 99:     ((sum / norm) * 0.8 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
100: }

179: const RED_ROOM_SEPARATION_CELLS: i64 = 1;
180: 
181: 
182: const RED_ROOM_BASE_CHANCE: f32 = 0.32;
183: 
184: 
185: 
186: fn red_room_candidate(
187:     seed: u32,
188:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
189:     cell: MacroCellId,
190:     red_room_scale: f32,
191: ) -> Option<f32> {
192:     if red_room_scale <= 0.0 {
193:         return None;
194:     }
195:     let center = cell.center();
196:     let pressure = sample_fields(noise, seed, center.x, center.z).redroom_pressure;
197:     let score = unit(hash(seed, 0x8ED8_0011, cell.x, cell.z));
198: 
199:     let chance = (RED_ROOM_BASE_CHANCE * red_room_scale).min(0.85) * (0.35 + 0.65 * pressure);
200:     (score < chance).then_some(score)
201: }

207: 
208: pub fn red_room_event_for_cell(
209:     seed: u32,
210:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
211:     cell: MacroCellId,
212:     red_room_scale: f32,
213: ) -> Option<RedRoomEvent> {
214:     let mine = red_room_candidate(seed, noise, cell, red_room_scale)?;
215:     for dz in -RED_ROOM_SEPARATION_CELLS..=RED_ROOM_SEPARATION_CELLS {
216:         for dx in -RED_ROOM_SEPARATION_CELLS..=RED_ROOM_SEPARATION_CELLS {
217:             if dx == 0 && dz == 0 {
218:                 continue;
219:             }
220:             let rival_cell = MacroCellId::new(cell.x + dx, cell.z + dz);
221:             if let Some(rival) = red_room_candidate(seed, noise, rival_cell, red_room_scale) {
222:                 let rival_wins = (rival, rival_cell.x, rival_cell.z) < (mine, cell.x, cell.z);
223:                 if rival_wins {
224:                     return None;
225:                 }
226:             }
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     let pick = hash(seed, 0x8ED8_0022, cell.x, cell.z);
231:     let region = (
232:         cell.x * REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL + (pick & 1) as i64,
233:         cell.z * REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL + ((pick >> 1) & 1) as i64,
234:     );
235:     Some(RedRoomEvent {
236:         id: hash(seed, 0x8ED8_0033, cell.x, cell.z),
237:         region,
238:         score: mine,
239:     })
240: }

269: pub fn vertical_link_for_region(
270:     seed: u32,
271:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
272:     region_x: i64,
273:     region_z: i64,
274: ) -> Option<VerticalLink> {
275:     let center_x = (region_x as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE;
276:     let center_z = (region_z as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE;
277:     let pressure = sample_fields(noise, seed, center_x, center_z).vertical_pressure;
278:     let gate = unit(hash(seed, 0x57A1_0001, region_x, region_z));
279:     if gate >= 0.06 + 0.30 * pressure * pressure {
280:         return None;
281:     }
282: 
283:     let kind_roll = unit(hash(seed, 0x57A1_0002, region_x, region_z));
284:     let (kind, to_elevation) = if kind_roll < 0.55 {
285:         (VerticalLinkKind::OrdinaryStair, 1)
286:     } else if kind_roll < 0.75 && pressure > 0.55 {
287:         (VerticalLinkKind::EndlessAscent, 1)
288:     } else if kind_roll < 0.90 && pressure > 0.55 {
289:         (VerticalLinkKind::EndlessDescent, -1)
290:     } else if kind_roll < 0.97 {
291:         (VerticalLinkKind::OrdinaryStair, 1)
292:     } else {
293:         (VerticalLinkKind::ServiceShaft, -1)
294:     };
295: 
296: 
297: 
298: 
299:     let ax = unit(hash(seed, 0x57A1_0003, region_x, region_z));
300:     let az = unit(hash(seed, 0x57A1_0004, region_x, region_z));
301:     Some(VerticalLink {
302:         id: hash(seed, 0x57A1_0005, region_x, region_z),
303:         kind,
304:         region: (region_x, region_z),
305:         anchor: Position::new(
306:             snap((region_x as f32 + 0.3 + 0.4 * ax) * REGION_SIZE),
307:             snap((region_z as f32 + 0.3 + 0.4 * az) * REGION_SIZE),
308:         ),
309:         from_elevation: 0,
310:         to_elevation,
311:     })
312: }

318: fn classify_region(
319:     seed: u32,
320:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
321:     region: (i64, i64),
322:     red_room_event: Option<&RedRoomEvent>,
323:     vertical: Option<&VerticalLink>,
324: ) -> PlaceKind {
325:     if red_room_event.is_some_and(|event| event.region == region) {
326:         return PlaceKind::RedRoomEncounter;
327:     }
328:     if vertical.is_some() {
329:         return PlaceKind::Stairwell;
330:     }
331:     let center_x = (region.0 as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE;
332:     let center_z = (region.1 as f32 + 0.5) * REGION_SIZE;
333:     let fields = sample_fields(noise, seed, center_x, center_z);
334:     if fields.openness > 0.66 {
335:         if fields.vertical_pressure > 0.60 {
336:             PlaceKind::Atrium
337:         } else {
338:             PlaceKind::OpenPlate
339:         }
340:     } else {
341:         PlaceKind::Warren
342:     }
343: }

352: pub fn plan_macro_cell(
353:     seed: u32,
354:     cell: MacroCellId,
355:     red_room_scale: f32,
356:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
357: ) -> MacroCell {
358:     let center = cell.center();
359:     let fields = sample_fields(noise, seed, center.x, center.z);
360:     let red_room_event = red_room_event_for_cell(seed, noise, cell, red_room_scale);
361: 
362:     let region_x0 = cell.x * REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL;
363:     let region_z0 = cell.z * REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL;
364: 
365:     let mut nodes = Vec::with_capacity((REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL * REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL) as usize);
366:     let mut vertical_links = Vec::new();
367:     for dz in 0..REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL {
368:         for dx in 0..REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL {
369:             let region = (region_x0 + dx, region_z0 + dz);
370:             let vertical = vertical_link_for_region(seed, noise, region.0, region.1);
371:             nodes.push(WorldNode {
372:                 id: hash(seed, 0x40DE_0001, region.0, region.1),
373:                 region,
374:                 kind: classify_region(
375:                     seed,
376:                     noise,
377:                     region,
378:                     red_room_event.as_ref(),
379:                     vertical.as_ref(),
380:                 ),
381:                 elevation: 0,
382:             });
383:             vertical_links.extend(vertical);
384:         }
385:     }
386: 
387: 
388: 
389: 
390:     let mut portals = Vec::new();
391:     for dz in 0..REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL {
392:         for edge in 0..=REGIONS_PER_MACRO_CELL {
393:             portals.push(portal(seed, region_x0 + edge, region_z0 + dz));
394:         }
395:     }
396: 
397:     MacroCell {
398:         id: cell,
399:         fields,
400:         nodes,
401:         portals,
402:         vertical_links,
403:         red_room_event,
404:     }
405: }

656:                     let x0 = rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE;
657:                     let z0 = rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE;
658:                     assert!(link.anchor.x > x0 + 8.0 && link.anchor.x < x0 + REGION_SIZE - 8.0);
659:                     assert!(link.anchor.z > z0 + 8.0 && link.anchor.z < z0 + REGION_SIZE - 8.0);
660:                 }
661:             }
662:         }
663:         let ratio = links as f32 / regions as f32;
664:         assert!(
665:             (0.05..=0.35).contains(&ratio),
666:             "vertical links in {:.0}% of regions",
667:             ratio * 100.0
668:         );
669:     }
670: }

  1: use std::fs;

  8: use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::std_telemetry::StdTelemetry;

 10: use vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase;

 15: fn main() {
 16:     let port = 3000;
 17:     let listener = TcpListener::bind(format!("0.0.0.0:{}", port)).unwrap();
 18:     println!("--- Backrooms Engine Running ---");
 19:     println!("Server listening on http://localhost:{}", port);
 20:     println!("Open the above URL in your browser to view the Voxel Rendering.");
 21: 
 22:     for stream in listener.incoming() {
 23:         match stream {
 24:             Ok(stream) => {
 25:                 thread::spawn(move || {
 26:                     handle_client(stream);
 27:                 });
 28:             }
 29:             Err(e) => {
 30:                 eprintln!("Failed to accept connection: {}", e);
 31:             }
 32:         }
 33:     }
 34: }
 35: 
 36: fn handle_client(mut stream: TcpStream) {
 37:     let mut buffer = [0; 1024];
 38:     if let Ok(bytes_read) = stream.read(&mut buffer) {
 39:         if bytes_read == 0 {
 40:             return;
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         let request = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer[..bytes_read]);
 44:         let request_line = request.lines().next().unwrap_or("");
 45: 
 46:         if request_line.starts_with("GET /maze") {
 47: 
 48:             let parts: Vec<&str> = request_line.split_whitespace().collect();
 49:             let url = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"/maze");
 50: 
 51:             let mut chunk_x = 0.0;
 52:             let mut chunk_z = 0.0;
 53:             let mut spec = "high";
 54: 
 55:             if let Some(query_idx) = url.find('?') {
 56:                 let query = &url[query_idx + 1..];
 57:                 for param in query.split('&') {
 58:                     let key_val: Vec<&str> = param.split('=').collect();
 59:                     if key_val.len() == 2 {
 60:                         match key_val[0] {
 61:                             "x" => chunk_x = key_val[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
 62:                             "z" => chunk_z = key_val[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
 63:                             "spec" => spec = key_val[1],
 64:                             _ => {}
 65:                         }
 66:                     }
 67:                 }
 68:             }
 69: 
 70:             let config = if spec == "low" {
 71:                 vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 72:             } else {
 73:                 vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 74:             };
 75: 
 76:             let noise_provider = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 77:             let telemetry = StdTelemetry;
 78:             let generator =
 79:                 GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::with_telemetry(&noise_provider, &telemetry);
 80: 
 81:             let chunk = generator.execute(Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z), 42, config);
 82: 
 83: 
 84:             let json = WebRendererAdapter::to_json(&chunk, config.voxel_scale);
 85: 
 86:             let response = format!(
 87:                 "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{}",
 88:                 json.len(),
 89:                 json
 90:             );
 91:             let _ = stream.write_all(response.as_bytes());
 92:         } else if request_line.starts_with("GET /octree") {
 93: 
 94:             let parts: Vec<&str> = request_line.split_whitespace().collect();
 95:             let url = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"/octree");
 96: 
 97:             let mut chunk_x = 0.0;
 98:             let mut chunk_z = 0.0;
 99:             let mut spec = "high";
100: 
101:             if let Some(query_idx) = url.find('?') {
102:                 let query = &url[query_idx + 1..];
103:                 for param in query.split('&') {
104:                     let key_val: Vec<&str> = param.split('=').collect();
105:                     if key_val.len() == 2 {
106:                         match key_val[0] {
107:                             "x" => chunk_x = key_val[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
108:                             "z" => chunk_z = key_val[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
109:                             "spec" => spec = key_val[1],
110:                             _ => {}
111:                         }
112:                     }
113:                 }
114:             }
115: 
116:             let config = if spec == "low" {
117:                 vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
118:             } else {
119:                 vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
120:             };
121: 
122:             let noise_provider = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
123:             let telemetry = StdTelemetry;
124:             let generator =
125:                 GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::with_telemetry(&noise_provider, &telemetry);
126: 
127: 
128:             let chunk = generator.execute(Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z), 42, config);
129: 
130: 
131:             let depth = config.svo_depth();
132:             let world_size = config.svo_world_size();
133:             let binary = WebRendererAdapter::to_octree_binary(
134:                 &chunk,
135:                 depth,
136:                 world_size,
137:                 config.voxel_scale,
138:                 config.chunk_size,
139:             );
140: 
141:             let header = format!(
142:                 "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n",
143:                 binary.len()
144:             );
145:             let mut response = Vec::with_capacity(header.len() + binary.len());
146:             response.extend_from_slice(header.as_bytes());
147:             response.extend_from_slice(&binary);
148:             let _ = stream.write_all(&response);
149:         } else if request_line.starts_with("GET ") {
150: 
151:             let parts: Vec<&str> = request_line.split_whitespace().collect();
152:             let url = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"/");
153:             let path = url.split('?').next().unwrap_or("/");
154:             serve_static(&mut stream, path);
155:         } else {
156:             let error = "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\n";
157:             let _ = stream.write_all(error.as_bytes());
158:         }
159:     }
160: }
161: 
162: 
163: 
164: 
165: fn serve_static(stream: &mut TcpStream, url_path: &str) {
166:     let relative = match url_path {
167:         "/" | "/index.html" => "index.html",
168:         other => other.trim_start_matches('/'),
169:     };
170: 
171: 
172:     if relative.split('/').any(|seg| seg == "..") || relative.contains('\\') {
173:         let _ = stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\r\n\r\n");
174:         return;
175:     }
176: 
177:     let file_path = format!("static/{}", relative);
178:     match fs::read(&file_path) {
179:         Ok(body) => {
180:             let mime = match file_path.rsplit('.').next() {
181:                 Some("html") => "text/html; charset=utf-8",
182:                 Some("js") | Some("mjs") => "text/javascript",
183:                 Some("wasm") => "application/wasm",
184:                 Some("css") => "text/css",
185:                 Some("json") => "application/json",
186:                 Some("png") => "image/png",
187:                 _ => "application/octet-stream",
188:             };
189:             let header = format!(
190:                 "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: {}\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n",
191:                 mime,
192:                 body.len()
193:             );
194:             let mut response = Vec::with_capacity(header.len() + body.len());
195:             response.extend_from_slice(header.as_bytes());
196:             response.extend_from_slice(&body);
197:             let _ = stream.write_all(&response);
198:         }
199:         Err(_) => {
200:             let _ = stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nFile not found.");
201:         }
202:     }
203: }

  30:         /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
  31:            Field-terminal shell. The interface reads like research-grade
  32:            DOS-era survival instrumentation from a cutting-edge dimensional
  33:            experiment: sparse text channels, thin 1px rules, square
  34:            geometry, explicit units, no chrome. Quiet during calm
  35:            exploration; present only when the body or the situation makes a
  36:            signal relevant. No scanlines, no phosphor, no glow by default.
  37:            ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  38:         :root {
  39:             --ink: #ffffff;        /* primary readable signal: plain white */
  40:             --quiet: #b4b4b4;      /* dormant structure: neutral grey */
  41:             --route: #d7bd70;      /* viable route / architectural direction */
  42:             --system: #7caeaa;     /* stable technical signal */
  43:             --hazard: #d45a4c;     /* danger only */
  44:             --critical: #f0dfcf;   /* urgent focus */
  45:             --panel: rgba(7, 10, 8, 0.44);
  46:             --panel-solid: rgba(7, 10, 8, 0.9);
  47:             --hairline: rgba(127, 139, 130, 0.4);
  48:             /* Bytesized is an 8px-grid pixel face; render it at 16px
  49:                multiples so the grid stays crisp. Fallbacks keep the
  50:                terminal legible when the font is unreachable offline. */
  51:             --mono: "Bytesized", "Consolas", "Menlo", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace;
  52:             /* Dense reading surfaces (the settings menu) use a normal
  53:                monospace, not the pixel face. */
  54:             --ui: "Consolas", "Menlo", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace;
  55:             --fs: clamp(16px, 0.9vw + 12px, 24px);

  91:             content: "";
  92:             position: absolute;
  93:             width: 7px;
  94:             height: 7px;
  95:             pointer-events: none;
  96:         }
  97:         .bracket::before {
  98:             top: -1px; left: -1px;
  99:             border-top: 1px solid var(--quiet);
 100:             border-left: 1px solid var(--quiet);
 101:         }
 102:         .bracket::after {
 103:             bottom: -1px; right: -1px;
 104:             border-bottom: 1px solid var(--quiet);
 105:             border-right: 1px solid var(--quiet);
 106:         }
 107: 
 108:         /* Center mark: a single restrained fixation point. */
 109:         #reticle {
 110:             position: absolute;
 111:             left: 50%;
 112:             top: 50%;
 113:             width: 3px;
 114:             height: 3px;
 115:             margin: -2px 0 0 -2px;
 116:             border: 1px solid var(--quiet);
 117:             opacity: 0.55;
 118:             pointer-events: none;
 119:         }
 120: 
 121:         /* ---- Body trace: heart glyph, pulse figure, supply ticks --------- */
 122:         #body-trace {
 123:             position: absolute;
 124:             left: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
 125:             bottom: calc(34px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
 126:             display: flex;
 127:             align-items: center;
 128:             gap: 8px;
 129:             pointer-events: none;
 130:             --beat-period: 1030ms;
 131:             --beat-amp: 0.12;
 132:         }
 133:         #pulse-glyph {
 134:             width: 15px;
 135:             height: 15px;
 136:             display: block;
 137:             stroke: var(--quiet);
 138:             fill: none;
 139:             stroke-width: 1.2;
 140:             transform-origin: 50% 55%;
 141:             animation: beat var(--beat-period) steps(1, end) infinite;
 142:             opacity: 0.8;
 143:         }
 144:         /* The beat is a stepped contraction, not a bouncy tween: brief
 145:            systole, long diastole. Amplitude follows the body's strain. */
 146:         @keyframes beat {
 147:             0%   { transform: scale(calc(1 + 0.22 * var(--beat-amp))); opacity: 1; }
 148:             12%  { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
 149:             100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
 150:         }
 151:         #hud-bpm {
 152:             font-size: var(--fs);
 153:             letter-spacing: 0.08em;
 154:             color: var(--quiet);
 155:             min-width: 3ch;
 156:         }
 157:         #hud-bpm:not(:empty)::after {
 158:             content: " bpm";
 159:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 160:             color: var(--quiet);
 161:         }
 162:         #body-trace[data-signal="active"] #pulse-glyph { stroke: var(--ink); }
 163:         #body-trace[data-signal="active"] #hud-bpm { color: var(--ink); }
 164:         #body-trace[data-signal="strained"] #pulse-glyph { stroke: var(--route); }
 165:         #body-trace[data-signal="strained"] #hud-bpm { color: var(--route); }
 166:         #body-trace[data-signal="critical"] #pulse-glyph {
 167:             stroke: var(--hazard);
 168:             /* The only sanctioned glow: a temporary critical-state cue. */
 169:             filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(212, 90, 76, 0.6));
 170:         }
 171:         #body-trace[data-signal="critical"] #hud-bpm { color: var(--hazard); }
 172: 
 173:         /* Carried supplies: discrete ticks, not meters. */
 174:         #supply-rack {
 175:             display: flex;
 176:             flex-direction: column;
 177:             gap: 2px;
 178:             font-size: 14px;
 179:             line-height: 1;
 180:             letter-spacing: 2px;
 181:         }
 182:         #supply-water { color: var(--system); }
 183:         #supply-ration { color: var(--quiet); }
 184:         #supply-water:not(:empty)::before { content: "aw "; color: var(--quiet); letter-spacing: 0; }
 185:         #supply-ration:not(:empty)::before { content: "rn "; color: var(--quiet); letter-spacing: 0; }
 186: 
 187:         /* Steps: a recovered record along the lower edge. */
 188:         #hud-steps-wrap {
 189:             position: absolute;
 190:             left: calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
 191:             bottom: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
 192:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 193:             letter-spacing: 0.12em;
 194:             color: var(--quiet);
 195:             pointer-events: none;
 196:         }
 197:         #hud-steps { color: var(--ink); }
 198:         #hud-steps-wrap .unit { margin-left: 5px; }
 199: 
 200:         /* ---- Route anchor: near the center mark, only when real -------- */
 201:         #route-anchor {
 202:             display: none;
 203:             position: absolute;
 204:             left: 50%;
 205:             bottom: 22%;
 206:             transform: translateX(-50%);
 207:             text-align: center;
 208:             pointer-events: none;
 209:             padding: 3px 10px 4px;
 210:             border-left: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 211:         }
 212:         #route-target {
 213:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 214:             letter-spacing: 0.2em;
 215:             color: var(--quiet);
 216:         }
 217:         #route-bearing {
 218:             font-size: var(--fs);
 219:             letter-spacing: 0.14em;
 220:             color: var(--route);
 221:             margin-top: 1px;
 222:         }
 223:         #route-range {
 224:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 225:             letter-spacing: 0.12em;
 226:             color: var(--ink);
 227:             margin-top: 1px;
 228:         }
 229: 
 230:         /* Top-right locality readout: which stratum the wanderer is in. */
 231:         #hud-section {
 232:             position: absolute;
 233:             top: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
 234:             right: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
 235:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 236:             letter-spacing: 0.16em;
 237:             text-align: right;
 238:             color: var(--quiet);
 239:             pointer-events: none;
 240:         }
 241: 
 242:         /* ---- Death: signal interruption, not a jump scare --------------- */
 243:         #death-overlay {
 244:             position: absolute;
 245:             inset: 0;
 246:             display: flex;
 247:             flex-direction: column;
 248:             align-items: center;
 249:             justify-content: center;
 250:             gap: 10px;
 251:             background: rgba(4, 3, 2, 0.88);
 252:             opacity: 0;
 253:             pointer-events: none;
 254:             transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
 255:             z-index: 5;
 256:             letter-spacing: 0.4em;
 257:             text-align: center;
 258:         }
 259:         #death-overlay .rule { width: 120px; height: 1px; background: var(--hairline); }
 260:         #death-overlay .headline {
 261:             font-size: clamp(14px, 2.4vw, 24px);
 262:             color: var(--critical);
 263:         }
 264:         #death-overlay .sub {
 265:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 266:             letter-spacing: 0.24em;
 267:             color: var(--quiet);
 268:         }
 269:         #death-overlay.shown { opacity: 1; }
 270: 
 271:         /* ---- Diagnostic aperture (F3 / Settings > Debug) ---------------- */
 272:         #diagnostics {
 273:             display: none;
 274:             position: absolute;
 275:             top: calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
 276:             left: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
 277:             width: min(620px, calc(100vw - 24px));
 278:             max-height: 72vh;
 279:             overflow-y: auto;
 280:             background: rgba(7, 10, 8, 0.78);
 281:             border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 282:             border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 283:             padding: 8px 12px 10px;
 284:             pointer-events: none;
 285:             z-index: 6;
 286:         }
 287:         .diag-section { margin: 0 0 8px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 1px solid var(--hairline); }
 288:         .diag-section h4 {
 289:             margin: 0 0 3px;
 290:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 291:             font-weight: normal;
 292:             letter-spacing: 0.28em;
 293:             color: var(--system);
 294:         }
 295:         .diag-section pre {
 296:             margin: 0;
 297:             font-family: var(--mono);
 298:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 299:             line-height: 1.5;
 300:             white-space: pre-wrap;
 301:             color: var(--ink);
 302:         }
 303:         #diag-engine pre b { color: var(--critical); font-weight: normal; }
 304: 
 305:         /* Small screens: clear both thumb zones — the locality label
 306:            tightens and the aperture narrows. */
 307:         @media (max-width: 700px) {
 308:             #hud-section { letter-spacing: 0.08em; max-width: 55vw; }
 309:             #body-trace { bottom: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
 310:             #hud-steps-wrap { bottom: calc(36px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
 311:             #route-anchor { bottom: 30%; }
 312:             #overlay h1 { font-size: 28px !important; }
 313:         }
 314: 
 315:         /* ---- Entry overlay ---------------------------------------------- */
 316:         #overlay {
 317:             position: absolute;
 318:             inset: 0;
 319:             display: flex;
 320:             flex-direction: column;
 321:             align-items: center;
 322:             justify-content: center;
 323:             background: rgba(2, 3, 2, 0.82);
 324:             cursor: pointer;
 325:             text-align: center;
 326:             z-index: 10;
 327:         }
 328:         #overlay h1 {
 329:             font-size: 34px;
 330:             font-weight: normal;
 331:             letter-spacing: 0.55em;
 332:             text-indent: 0.55em;
 333:             color: var(--ink);
 334:             margin: 0 0 6px;
 335:             padding: 10px 26px;
 336:             position: relative;
 337:         }
 338:         #overlay h1::before, #overlay h1::after {
 339:             content: "";
 340:             position: absolute;
 341:             width: 10px;
 342:             height: 10px;
 343:         }
 344:         #overlay h1::before { top: 0; left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--quiet); border-left: 1px solid var(--quiet); }
 345:         #overlay h1::after { bottom: 0; right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--quiet); border-right: 1px solid var(--quiet); }
 346:         #overlay p { font-size: var(--fs); color: var(--quiet); padding: 0 16px; line-height: 1.7; }
 347:         #play-msg { display: none; margin-bottom: 22px; color: var(--ink); }
 348:         #play-msg .alt { color: var(--quiet); }
 349: 
 350:         button {
 351:             font-family: var(--mono);
 352:             border-radius: 0;
 353:         }
 354:         /* Touch hardware gets generous targets everywhere: the field
 355:            terminal is operated with thumbs on a phone. 44px is the floor. */
 356:         @media (pointer: coarse) {
 357:             .tab-btn { min-height: 52px; font-size: var(--fs-small); }
 358:             #settings-btn { min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; }
 359:             .setting-row select,
 360:             .setting-row input[type="text"],
 361:             .setting-row input[type="number"] { padding: 14px; min-height: 48px; }
 362:             .setting-row input[type="range"] { height: 44px; }
 363:             .setting-row input[type="checkbox"] {
 364:                 width: 28px;
 365:                 height: 28px;
 366:                 accent-color: var(--system);
 367:             }
 368:             .inline-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 48px; }
 369:             .menu-actions button { min-height: 52px; }
 370:             #touch-ui button { min-width: 64px; min-height: 64px; }
 371:         }
 372:         #settings-btn {
 373:             padding: 10px 22px;
 374:             background: transparent;
 375:             border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 376:             color: var(--ink);
 377:             cursor: pointer;
 378:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 379:             letter-spacing: 0.18em;
 380:             transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
 381:             min-height: 44px;
 382:         }
 383:         #settings-btn:hover { border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--critical); }
 384: 
 385:         /* ---- Settings: maintenance parameters --------------------------- */
 386:         #settings-menu,
 387:         #settings-menu * {
 388:             font-family: var(--ui);
 389:             font-size: var(--fs-ui);
 390:         }
 391:         /* Full-screen configuration surface on every device. Content sits
 392:            in a centered readable column; padding respects notches and home
 393:            indicators on phones. */
 394:         #settings-menu {
 395:             display: none;
 396:             position: fixed;
 397:             inset: 0;
 398:             background: var(--panel-solid);
 399:             border: none;
 400:             box-sizing: border-box;
 401:             padding:
 402:                 calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))
 403:                 calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px))
 404:                 calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))
 405:                 calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
 406:             overflow-y: auto;
 407:             z-index: 20;
 408:             color: var(--ink);
 409:             text-align: left;
 410:             cursor: default;
 411:             touch-action: pan-y;   /* the menu itself may scroll */
 412:         }
 413:         #settings-menu > * {
 414:             max-width: 760px;
 415:             margin-left: auto;
 416:             margin-right: auto;
 417:         }
 418:         #settings-menu h2 {
 419:             margin: 0 auto 12px;
 420:             color: var(--ink);
 421:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 422:             font-weight: normal;
 423:             letter-spacing: 0.34em;
 424:             border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 425:             padding-bottom: 9px;
 426:         }
 427: 
 428:         .tabs-bar {
 429:             display: flex;
 430:             border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 431:             margin-bottom: 14px;
 432:             gap: 2px;
 433:             overflow-x: auto;
 434:             -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
 435:         }
 436:         .tab-btn {
 437:             flex: 1;
 438:             padding: 9px 4px;
 439:             background: transparent;
 440:             border: none;
 441:             color: var(--quiet);
 442:             cursor: pointer;
 443:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 444:             letter-spacing: 0.08em;
 445:             text-align: center;
 446:             transition: color 0.15s;
 447:             border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
 448:             margin-bottom: -1px;
 449:             min-width: 64px;
 450:             min-height: 40px;
 451:         }
 452:         .tab-btn.active {
 453:             color: var(--critical);
 454:             border-bottom: 1px solid var(--route);
 455:         }
 456: 
 457:         .setting-row { margin-bottom: 14px; }
 458:         .setting-row label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--quiet); }
 459:         .setting-row .value { color: var(--critical); float: right; }
 460:         .setting-row select, .setting-row input[type="text"], .setting-row input[type="number"] {
 461:             width: 100%;
 462:             padding: 10px;
 463:             background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
 464:             border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 465:             border-radius: 0;
 466:             color: var(--ink);
 467:             font-family: var(--mono);
 468:             box-sizing: border-box;
 469:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 470:             outline: none;
 471:         }
 472:         .setting-row select:focus, .setting-row input[type="text"]:focus,
 473:         .setting-row input[type="number"]:focus {
 474:             border-color: var(--system);
 475:         }
 476:         .setting-row input[type="range"] {
 477:             width: 100%;
 478:             accent-color: var(--system);
 479:             height: 28px;
 480:             background: transparent;
 481:             cursor: pointer;
 482:         }
 483:         .settings-group {
 484:             margin: 12px 0 16px;
 485:             padding: 10px 12px 1px;
 486:             border-left: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 487:         }
 488:         .settings-group h3 {
 489:             margin: 0 0 10px;
 490:             color: var(--system);
 491:             font-size: 14px;
 492:             font-weight: normal;
 493:             letter-spacing: 0.26em;
 494:             text-transform: uppercase;
 495:         }
 496: 
 497:         /* Checkboxes: square state indicators, not pill toggles. */
 498:         .setting-row.inline-switch {
 499:             display: flex;
 500:             justify-content: space-between;
 501:             align-items: center;
 502:             margin-bottom: 13px;
 503:             min-height: 28px;
 504:         }
 505:         .setting-row.inline-switch label {
 506:             display: inline;
 507:             margin-bottom: 0;
 508:         }
 509:         .setting-row.inline-switch input[type="checkbox"] {
 510:             appearance: none;
 511:             width: 30px;
 512:             height: 18px;
 513:             margin: 0;
 514:             background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
 515:             border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 516:             position: relative;
 517:             outline: none;
 518:             cursor: pointer;
 519:             flex-shrink: 0;
 520:         }
 521:         .setting-row.inline-switch input[type="checkbox"]::before {
 522:             content: "";
 523:             position: absolute;
 524:             inset: 3px;
 525:             right: 15px;
 526:             background: var(--quiet);
 527:             opacity: 0.35;
 528:             transition: none;
 529:         }
 530:         .setting-row.inline-switch input[type="checkbox"]:checked::before {
 531:             inset: 3px;
 532:             left: 15px;
 533:             right: 3px;
 534:             background: var(--system);
 535:             opacity: 1;
 536:         }
 537:         .setting-row.inline-switch input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible {
 538:             border-color: var(--system);
 539:         }
 540: 
 541:         .hint { font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--quiet); margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.5; }
 542: 
 543:         .settings-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; }
 544:         .settings-actions button {
 545:             flex: 1;
 546:             padding: 12px 8px;
 547:             background: transparent;
 548:             border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 549:             color: var(--ink);
 550:             cursor: pointer;
 551:             min-height: 44px;
 552:             font-size: var(--fs-small);
 553:             letter-spacing: 0.08em;
 554:             transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
 555:         }
 556:         .settings-actions button:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
 557:         #apply-settings-btn { border-color: var(--route); color: var(--route); }
 558:         #apply-settings-btn:hover { color: var(--critical); border-color: var(--critical); }
 559: 
 560:         /* ---- Touch chrome ----------------------------------------------- */
 561:         #touch-ui {
 562:             display: none;
 563:             position: absolute;
 564:             top: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
 565:             left: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
 566:             gap: 8px;
 567:             z-index: 5;
 568:         }
 569:         #touch-ui button {
 570:             width: 52px;
 571:             height: 52px;
 572:             font-size: 14px;
 573:             letter-spacing: 0.1em;
 574:             background: var(--panel);
 575:             color: var(--ink);
 576:             border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
 577:             font-family: var(--mono);
 578:             touch-action: none;
 579:         }
 580:         #btn-flare { color: var(--route); }
 581:         #btn-drink { color: var(--system); }
 582:         #touch-hint {
 583:             position: absolute;
 584:             bottom: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
 585:             width: 100%;
 586:             text-align: center;
 587:             font-size: 14px;
 588:             letter-spacing: 0.1em;
 589:             color: rgba(127, 139, 130, 0.6);
 590:             pointer-events: none;
 591:         }
 592:     </style>
 593: </head>
 594: <body>
 595:     <canvas id="view"></canvas>
 596: 
 597:     <div id="reticle"></div>
 598: 
 599: 
 600:     <div id="route-anchor" class="etch">
 601:         <div id="route-target">THRESHOLD / —</div>
 602:         <div id="route-bearing">VECTOR ---°</div>
 603:         <div id="route-range">RANGE — m</div>
 604:     </div>
 605: 
 606: 
 607:     <div id="body-trace" class="etch" data-signal="quiet">
 608:         <svg id="pulse-glyph" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
 609:             <path d="M8 14 L1.5 7.5 L1.5 4 L4.5 1.5 L8 4.5 L11.5 1.5 L14.5 4 L14.5 7.5 Z"/>
 610:         </svg>
 611:         <span id="hud-bpm"></span>
 612:         <div id="supply-rack"><span id="supply-water"></span><span id="supply-ration"></span></div>
 613:     </div>
 614:     <div id="hud-steps-wrap" class="etch"><span id="hud-steps">0</span><span class="unit">steps</span></div>
 615: 
 616:     <div id="hud-section" class="etch">&hellip;</div>
 617: 
 618:     <div id="death-overlay">
 619:         <div class="rule"></div>
 620:         <div class="headline">TELEMETRY LOST</div>
 621:         <div class="sub">subject reacquired at anchor point</div>
 622:         <div class="rule"></div>
 623:     </div>
 624: 
 625: 
 626: 
 627:     <div id="diagnostics">
 628:         <section class="diag-section" id="diag-engine">
 629:             <h4>ENGINE</h4>
 630:             <pre>renderer <b id="hud-renderer">—</b>   fps <b id="hud-fps">—</b>   frame <b id="hud-gpu">—</b>
 631: chunks <b id="hud-chunks">0</b>   svo nodes <b id="hud-nodes">0</b>   scale <b id="hud-scale">—</b></pre>
 632:         </section>
 633:         <div id="debug-overlay"></div>
 634:     </div>
 635: 
 636: 
 637:     <div id="touch-ui">
 638:         <button id="btn-menu" aria-label="Menu">MENU</button>
 639:         <button id="btn-flashlight" aria-label="Flashlight">LAMP</button>
 640:         <button id="btn-flare" aria-label="Drop flare">FLARE</button>
 641:         <button id="btn-drink" aria-label="Drink almond water">AW</button>
 642:         <button id="btn-eat" aria-label="Eat ration">MRE</button>
 643:         <div id="touch-hint">left: move &middot; right: look</div>
 644:     </div>
 645: 
 646:     <div id="overlay">
 647:         <h1>VACKROOMS</h1>
 648:         <p id="status-msg">Generating world in WebAssembly&hellip;</p>
 649:         <p id="play-msg">
 650:             Click to enter &mdash; WASD move &middot; mouse look &middot; F lamp &middot; G flare &middot; R drink &middot; T eat &middot; ESC release<br>
 651:             <span class="alt">Touch: tap to enter &mdash; left thumb move &middot; right thumb look</span>
 652:         </p>
 653:         <button id="settings-btn" style="display: none;">SETTINGS</button>
 654:     </div>
 655: 
 656:     <div id="settings-menu" class="bracket">
 657:         <h2>CONFIGURATION &mdash; FIELD TERMINAL</h2>
 658: 
 659:         <div class="tabs-bar">
 660:             <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="tab-controls">Controls</button>
 661:             <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="tab-graphics">Graphics</button>
 662:             <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="tab-optimizations">Optimize</button>
 663:             <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="tab-world">World</button>
 664:             <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="tab-cpu">CPU render</button>
 665:             <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="tab-debug">Debug</button>
 666:         </div>
 667: 
 668: 
 669:         <div id="tab-controls" class="tab-content">
 670:             <div class="setting-row">
 671:                 <label for="control-scheme">Control scheme</label>
 672:                 <select id="control-scheme">

 932:                     <option value="blackout">Blackout expanse</option>
