````html
 949: 
 950:     <script type="module">
 951:         import init, {
 952:             set_doom_controls,
 953:             set_mouse_sensitivity,
 954:             set_invert_y,
 955:             set_render_scale,
 956:             set_fov,
 957:             set_cpu_quality_preset,
 958:             set_cpu_scale,
 959:             set_cpu_lod_cutoff,
 960:             set_cpu_max_splat_radius,
 961:             set_cpu_virtual_depth,
 962:             set_cpu_mip_occupancy,
 963:             set_cpu_max_draw_distance,
 964:             set_cpu_shadows,
 965:             set_anomaly_debug,
 966:             set_assisted_consumption,
 967:             set_render_toggle,
 968:         } from './pkg/wasm_frontend.js';
 969: 
 970:         const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
 971:         const overlay = $('overlay');
 972:         const settingsMenu = $('settings-menu');
 973: 
 974:         // ---- Persistence -------------------------------------------------
 975:         // Live preferences (applied instantly, saved per device).
 976:         const PREFS_KEY = 'vackrooms_prefs';
 977:         // First-start switchboard: every load-reducing optimization on,
 978:         // every load-adding effect pass (deferred, AO, shadows) off. The
 979:         // default must run acceptably on weak hardware; enthusiasts opt up
 980:         // here and their choice persists per device.
 981:         const defaultRenderToggles = {
 982:             hiz: true,
 983:             f2b: true,
 984:             skip: true,
 985:             mips: true,
 986:             beam_occlusion: true,
 987:             deferred: false,
 988:             ao: false,
 989:             shadows: false,
 990:             cells: true,
 991:             budget: true,
 992:             cull: true,
 993:             dither: true,
 994:             bake: false,
 995:         };
 996:         const CPU_PRESETS = Object.freeze({
 997:             performance: Object.freeze({ id: 0, scale: 0.5, lod: 1.5, splatRadius: 14.0, virtualDepth: 4, mipOccupancy: 0.35, distance: 72, shadows: 'off' }),
 998:             balanced: Object.freeze({ id: 1, scale: 1.0, lod: 1.0, splatRadius: 8.0, virtualDepth: 5, mipOccupancy: 0.25, distance: 96, shadows: 'off' }),
 999:             quality: Object.freeze({ id: 2, scale: 1.5, lod: 0.65, splatRadius: 4.0, virtualDepth: 6, mipOccupancy: 0.12, distance: 128, shadows: 'hero' }),
1000:             maximum: Object.freeze({ id: 3, scale: 2.0, lod: 0.35, splatRadius: 2.0, virtualDepth: 8, mipOccupancy: 0.05, distance: 160, shadows: 'full' }),
1001:         });
1002:         // Mirrors the Rust-side safety ceiling (MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS in
1003:         // wasm_frontend/src/application/generation_worker_policy.rs) — not
1004:         // a target. The engine itself clamps further to whatever hardware
1005:         // actually reports, so this only guards malformed input.
1006:         const MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS = 32;
1007:         const normalizeGenerationWorkers = (value) => {
1008:             const text = String(value ?? 'auto');
1009:             if (text === 'auto' || text === '0') return text;
1010:             const requested = Number(text);
1011:             return Number.isInteger(requested) && requested > 0
1012:                 ? String(Math.min(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS, requested))
1013:                 : 'auto';
1014:         };
1015:         const clampFinite = (value, min, max, fallback) => {
1016:             const number = Number(value);
1017:             return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, number)) : fallback;
1018:         };
1019:         const copyCpuPreset = (target, name) => {
1020:             const preset = CPU_PRESETS[name];
1021:             if (!preset) return false;
1022:             target.cpuPreset = name;
1023:             target.cpuScale = preset.scale;
1024:             target.cpuLod = preset.lod;
1025:             target.cpuSplat = preset.splatRadius;
1026:             target.cpuVirtualDepth = preset.virtualDepth;
1027:             target.cpuMipOccupancy = preset.mipOccupancy;
1028:             target.cpuDist = preset.distance;
1029:             target.cpuShadows = preset.shadows;
1030:             return true;
1031:         };
1032:         const sanitizeCpuPrefs = (target) => {
1033:             if (target.cpuPreset !== 'custom' && copyCpuPreset(target, target.cpuPreset)) return;
1034:             target.cpuPreset = 'custom';
1035:             target.cpuScale = clampFinite(target.cpuScale, 0.25, 2.0, 1.0);
1036:             target.cpuLod = clampFinite(target.cpuLod, 0.25, 2.0, 1.0);
1037:             target.cpuSplat = clampFinite(target.cpuSplat, 1.0, 16.0, 8.0);
1038:             target.cpuVirtualDepth = Math.round(clampFinite(target.cpuVirtualDepth, 3, 8, 5));
1039:             target.cpuMipOccupancy = clampFinite(target.cpuMipOccupancy, 0, 0.5, 0.25);
1040:             target.cpuDist = Math.round(clampFinite(target.cpuDist, 16, 256, 96) / 8) * 8;
1041:             target.cpuShadows = ['off', 'hero', 'full'].includes(target.cpuShadows)
1042:                 ? target.cpuShadows
1043:                 : 'off';
1044:         };
1045:         const defaults = {
1046:             scheme: 'modern',
1047:             sensitivity: 1.0,
1048:             invertY: false,
1049:             assistConsume: false,
1050:             scale: 0,
1051:             fov: 75,
1052:             generationWorkers: 'auto',
1053:             cpuPreset: 'balanced',
1054:             cpuScale: 1.0,
1055:             cpuLod: 1.0,
1056:             cpuSplat: 8.0,
1057:             cpuVirtualDepth: 5,
1058:             cpuMipOccupancy: 0.25,
1059:             cpuDist: 96.0,
1060:             cpuShadows: 'off',
1061:             anomalyDebug: false,
1062:             renderToggles: { ...defaultRenderToggles },
1063:         };
1064:         let savedPrefs = {};
1065:         try { savedPrefs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PREFS_KEY) || '{}') || {}; } catch (_) {}
1066:         let prefs = { ...defaults, ...savedPrefs };
1067:         prefs.generationWorkers = normalizeGenerationWorkers(prefs.generationWorkers);
1068:         const owns = (object, key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key);
1069:         // Preferences written by the former UI had scalar CPU controls but
1070:         // no preset name. Preserve those values as a custom profile.
1071:         if (!owns(savedPrefs, 'cpuPreset') && [
1072:             'cpuScale', 'cpuLod', 'cpuSplat', 'cpuDist', 'cpuShadows',
1073:         ].some((key) => owns(savedPrefs, key))) {
1074:             prefs.cpuPreset = 'custom';
1075:         }
1076:         sanitizeCpuPrefs(prefs);
1077:         // Preferences are shallow-merged above. Rebuild the nested catalog
1078:         // from the known names so new switches default on and stale/corrupt
1079:         // keys can never point at a non-existent settings control.
1080:         const savedRenderToggles = prefs.renderToggles || {};
1081:         prefs.renderToggles = Object.fromEntries(
1082:             Object.entries(defaultRenderToggles).map(([name, fallback]) => [
1083:                 name,
1084:                 typeof savedRenderToggles[name] === 'boolean'
1085:                     ? savedRenderToggles[name]
1086:                     : fallback,
1087:             ]),
1088:         );
1089:         // Migrate the old single-key scheme store.
1090:         const legacyScheme = localStorage.getItem('vackrooms_controls');
1091:         if (legacyScheme) { prefs.scheme = legacyScheme; localStorage.removeItem('vackrooms_controls'); }
1092: 
1093:         const savePrefs = () => localStorage.setItem(PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs));
1094: 
1095:         // World/graphics-profile settings travel in the URL so worlds stay
1096:         // shareable by link.
````

## File: static/webgpu-min.html
````html
 1: <!doctype html>
 2: <title>webgpu minimal probe</title>
 3: <canvas id="c" width="64" height="64"></canvas>
 4: <script type="module">
 5:   const log = (...a) => console.log('[probe]', ...a);
 6:   try {
 7:     log('navigator.gpu:', !!navigator.gpu);
 8:     if (!navigator.gpu) throw new Error('no navigator.gpu');
 9:     const adapter = await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter();
10:     log('adapter:', adapter ? 'ok' : 'null');
11:     if (!adapter) throw new Error('null adapter');
12:     const device = await adapter.requestDevice();
13:     log('device: ok');
14:     const ctx = document.getElementById('c').getContext('webgpu');
15:     log('getContext(webgpu):', ctx ? 'ok' : 'null');
16:     if (!ctx) throw new Error('null context');
17:     const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
18:     log('preferred format:', format);
19:     ctx.configure({ device, format, alphaMode: 'opaque' });
20:     log('configure: ok — showcase-style init SUCCEEDED');
21:   } catch (e) {
22:     log('FAILED:', e.message);
23:   }
24: </script>
````

````javascript
11: function errorMessage(error) {
12:   if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
13:   return String(error);
14: }
15: 
16: function reportFailure(message, error) {
17:   const description = errorMessage(error);
18:   console.error("[WORKER] generation failure:", description);
19:   try {
20:     if (message?.type === "gen") {
21:       postMessage({
22:         type: "failed",
23:         requestId: message.requestId,
24:         ox: message.ox,
25:         oz: message.oz,
26:         level: message.level,
27:         lod: message.lod,
28:         artifacts: message.artifacts,
29:         reality: new Uint32Array(message.reality),
30:         message: description,
31:       });
32:     } else {
33:       postMessage({ type: "fatal", message: description });
34:     }
35:   } catch (reportError) {
36: 
37: 
38:     console.error("[WORKER] could not report generation failure:", reportError);
39:   }
40: }
41: 
42: async function processMessage(message) {
43:   await ensureWasm();
44:   if (message.type === "init") {
45:     worker_init(message.query, message.seed >>> 0);
46:     return;
47:   }
48:   if (message.type !== "gen") return;
49: 
50:   const t0 = performance.now();
51:   const reality = new Uint32Array(message.reality);
52:   const bytes = worker_generate(
53:     message.requestId >>> 0,
54:     message.ox,
55:     message.oz,
56:     message.level,
57:     message.lod,
58:     message.artifacts >>> 0,
59:     reality
60:   );
61:   const ms = performance.now() - t0;
62:   console.debug(
63:     `[WORKER] chunk (${message.ox}, ${message.oz}) lod ${message.lod} generated in ${ms.toFixed(1)} ms`
64:   );
65:   postMessage(
66:     {
67:       type: "done",
68:       requestId: message.requestId,
69:       ox: message.ox,
70:       oz: message.oz,
71:       level: message.level,
72:       lod: message.lod,
73:       artifacts: message.artifacts,
74:       reality,
75:       ms,
76:       buf: bytes.buffer,
77:     },
78:     [bytes.buffer]
79:   );
80: }
81: 
82: onmessage = (event) => {
83:   const message = event.data;
84: 
85: 
86:   queue = queue
87:     .then(() => processMessage(message))
88:     .catch((error) => reportFailure(message, error));
89: };
````

````rust
 15: 
 16: const SEED: u32 = 42;
 17: 
 18: struct Scene {
 19:     atlas: Vec<u32>,
 20:     chunks: Vec<ChunkDraw>,
 21:     frame: FrameParams,
 22:     collision_boxes: Vec<Aabb>,
 23: }

 28: 
 29: fn load_scene(radius: i32, voxel_scale: f32) -> Scene {
 30:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 31:     config.voxel_scale = voxel_scale;
 32:     let spawn = spawn_point(SEED);
 33:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
 34:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
 35:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), SEED, config);
 36: 
 37:     let mut payloads = Vec::new();
 38:     for dz in -radius..=radius {
 39:         for dx in -radius..=radius {
 40:             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
 41:             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
 42:             payloads.push((x, z, source.load(x, z, 0, 0)));
 43:         }
 44:     }
 45:     let max_rows = payloads
 46:         .iter()
 47:         .map(|(_, _, payload)| payload_rows(payload))
 48:         .max()
 49:         .expect("neighborhood is never empty");
 50:     let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
 51:     pool.ensure_layout(payloads.len(), max_rows);
 52: 
 53:     let mut atlas = Vec::new();
 54:     let mut chunks = Vec::new();
 55:     let mut unique_lights = HashMap::new();
 56:     let mut collision_boxes = Vec::new();
 57:     for (x, z, payload) in &payloads {
 58:         let slot = pool.assign(chunk_key(*x, *z)).expect("atlas sized for all");
 59:         let offset = slot * pool.slot_nodes();
 60:         atlas.extend(pool.rebased_block(slot, payload));
 61:         chunks.push(ChunkDraw {
 62:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
 63:             root_index: (offset + payload.root as usize) as i32,
 64:             world_size: payload.world_size,
 65:             voxel_size: payload.voxel_size,
 66:             svo_depth: payload.svo_depth,
 67:         });
 68:         for light in &payload.lights {
 69:             unique_lights.entry(light.id).or_insert(*light);
 70:         }
 71:         collision_boxes.extend(payload.collision.iter().copied());
 72:     }
 73:     let frame = FrameParams {
 74:         camera_pos: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
 75:         yaw: -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2,
 76:         scene_lights: unique_lights.into_values().collect(),
 77:         ..FrameParams::default()
 78:     };
 79:     Scene {
 80:         atlas,
 81:         chunks,
 82:         frame,
 83:         collision_boxes,
 84:     }
 85: }

 88: 
 89: fn ray_fan(frame: &FrameParams) -> Vec<[f32; 3]> {
 90:     let yaw = frame.yaw;
 91:     let forward = [yaw.sin(), 0.0, -yaw.cos()];
 92:     let right = [-forward[2], 0.0, forward[0]];
 93:     let up = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0];
 94:     let fov_tan = 0.767_327f32;
 95:     let mut rays = Vec::with_capacity(32 * 18);
 96:     for row in 0..18 {
 97:         for column in 0..32 {
 98:             let u = (column as f32 / 31.0 * 2.0 - 1.0) * fov_tan * (32.0 / 18.0);
 99:             let v = (1.0 - row as f32 / 17.0 * 2.0) * fov_tan;
100:             let direction = [
101:                 right[0] * u + up[0] * v + forward[0],
102:                 right[1] * u + up[1] * v + forward[1],
103:                 right[2] * u + up[2] * v + forward[2],
104:             ];
105:             let length = (direction[0] * direction[0]
106:                 + direction[1] * direction[1]
107:                 + direction[2] * direction[2])
108:                 .sqrt()
109:                 .max(1e-8);
110:             rays.push([
111:                 direction[0] / length,
112:                 direction[1] / length,
113:                 direction[2] / length,
114:             ]);
115:         }
116:     }
117:     rays
118: }
119:

121:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("trace_svo_by_chunk_count");
122:     for radius in [0i32, 1, 2, 3] {
123:         let scene = load_scene(radius, 0.2);
124:         let rays = ray_fan(&scene.frame);
125:         let chunk_count = scene.chunks.len();
126:         group.bench_with_input(
127:             BenchmarkId::new("chunks", chunk_count),
128:             &(scene, rays),
129:             |b, (scene, rays)| {
130:                 b.iter(|| {
131:                     for direction in rays {
132:                         black_box(trace_svo(
133:                             &scene.atlas,
134:                             &scene.chunks,
135:                             scene.frame.camera_pos,
136:                             *direction,
137:                             300.0,
138:                             true,
139:                         ));
140:                     }
141:                 });
142:             },
143:         );
144:     }
145:     group.finish();
146: }
147:

149:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("trace_svo_by_voxel_size");
150:     for voxel_scale in [0.4f32, 0.2, 0.1] {
151:         let scene = load_scene(1, voxel_scale);
152:         let rays = ray_fan(&scene.frame);
153:         group.bench_with_input(
154:             BenchmarkId::new("voxel_scale", voxel_scale),
155:             &(scene, rays),
156:             |b, (scene, rays)| {
157:                 b.iter(|| {
158:                     for direction in rays {
159:                         black_box(trace_svo(
160:                             &scene.atlas,
161:                             &scene.chunks,
162:                             scene.frame.camera_pos,
163:                             *direction,
164:                             300.0,
165:                             true,
166:                         ));
167:                     }
168:                 });
169:             },
170:         );
171:     }
172:     group.finish();
173: }

175: fn cpu_rasterizer_full_frame(c: &mut Criterion) {
176:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("cpu_rasterizer_full_frame");
177:     for radius in [0i32, 1, 2] {
178:         let scene = load_scene(radius, 0.2);
179:         let mut renderer = SoftwareRasterizer::new(384, 216);
180:         renderer.settings = CpuQualityPreset::Balanced.settings();
181:         renderer.upload_atlas(&scene.atlas);
182:         let chunk_count = scene.chunks.len();
183:         group.bench_with_input(
184:             BenchmarkId::new("chunks", chunk_count),
185:             &scene,
186:             |b, scene| {
187:                 b.iter(|| {
188:                     renderer.draw(&scene.frame, &scene.chunks);
189:                     black_box(renderer.framebuffer());
190:                 });
191:             },
192:         );
193:     }
194:     group.finish();
195: }
196: 
197: fn synthetic_collision_boxes(count: usize) -> Vec<Aabb> {
198:     (0..count)
199:         .map(|i| {
200:             let x = (i % 64) as f32 * 0.6;
201:             let z = (i / 64) as f32 * 0.6;
202:             Aabb::new([x, 0.0, z], [x + 0.5, 2.6, z + 0.5])
203:         })
204:         .collect()
205: }
206: 
207: fn collision_query(c: &mut Criterion) {
208:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("collision_query");
209:     for count in [100usize, 1_000, 10_000] {
210:         let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
211:         world.rebuild(&synthetic_collision_boxes(count));
212: 
213: 
214: 
215:         let probe = [19.2, 1.0, 19.2];
216:         group.bench_with_input(BenchmarkId::new("boxes", count), &world, |b, world| {
217:             b.iter(|| black_box(world.collides(black_box(probe))));
218:         });
219:     }
220: 
221: 
222:     let scene = load_scene(1, 0.2);
223:     let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
224:     world.rebuild(&scene.collision_boxes);
225:     let box_count = world.len();
226:     group.bench_with_input(
227:         BenchmarkId::new("boxes", format!("{box_count}_generated")),
228:         &(world, scene.frame.camera_pos),
229:         |b, (world, probe)| {
230:             b.iter(|| black_box(world.collides(black_box(*probe))));
231:         },
232:     );
233:     group.finish();
234: }
235: 
236: criterion_group! {
237:     name = benches;
238:     config = Criterion::default().sample_size(20);
239:     targets = trace_svo_by_chunk_count, trace_svo_by_voxel_size, cpu_rasterizer_full_frame, collision_query
240: }
241: criterion_main!(benches);
````

````rust
110: fn load_scene(seed: u32, radius: i32) -> Scene {
111:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
112:     let spawn = spawn_point(seed);
113:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
114:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
115:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), seed, config);
116: 
117:     let mut payloads = Vec::new();
118:     for dz in -radius..=radius {
119:         for dx in -radius..=radius {
120:             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
121:             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
122:             payloads.push((x, z, source.load(x, z, 0, 0)));
123:         }
124:     }
125:     let max_rows = payloads
126:         .iter()
127:         .map(|(_, _, payload)| payload_rows(payload))
128:         .max()
129:         .expect("spawn neighborhood is never empty");
130:     let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
131:     pool.ensure_layout(payloads.len(), max_rows);
132: 
133:     let mut atlas = Vec::new();
134:     let mut chunks = Vec::new();
135:     let mut voxel_size = config.voxel_scale;
136:     let mut unique_lights = HashMap::new();
137:     for (x, z, payload) in &payloads {
138:         let slot = pool.assign(chunk_key(*x, *z)).expect("atlas sized for all");
139:         let offset = slot * pool.slot_nodes();
140:         atlas.extend(pool.rebased_block(slot, payload));
141:         voxel_size = payload.voxel_size;
142:         chunks.push(ChunkDraw {
143:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
144:             root_index: (offset + payload.root as usize) as i32,
145:             world_size: payload.world_size,
146:             voxel_size: payload.voxel_size,
147:             svo_depth: payload.svo_depth,
148:         });
149:         for light in &payload.lights {
150:             if light.enabled {
151:                 unique_lights.entry(light.id).or_insert(*light);
152:             }
153:         }
154:     }
155:     Scene {
156:         atlas,
157:         chunks,
158:         lights: unique_lights.into_values().collect(),
159:         voxel_size,
160:     }
161: }

166: 
167: struct Ray {
168:     origin: [f32; 3],
169:     direction: [f32; 3],
170: }
171: 
172: 
173: 
174: 
175: 
176: 
177: fn trace_path(scene: &Scene, mut ray: Ray, bounces: u32, rng: &mut Pcg32) -> [f32; 3] {
178:     let mut radiance = [0.0f32; 3];
179:     let mut throughput = [1.0f32; 3];
180:     for bounce in 0..bounces {
181:         let Some(hit) = trace_svo(
182:             &scene.atlas,
183:             &scene.chunks,
184:             ray.origin,
185:             ray.direction,
186:             MAX_TRACE_DISTANCE,
187:             true,
188:         ) else {
189:             break;
190:         };
191:         let voxel = hit.voxel_type;
192:         let color = material_color_f32(voxel as u8);
193:         if is_emissive(voxel) {
194:             if bounce == 0 {
195:                 let strength = emission_strength(voxel).unwrap_or(1.0);
196:                 for axis in 0..3 {
197:                     radiance[axis] += throughput[axis] * color[axis] * strength;
198:                 }
199:             }
200:             break;
201:         }
202: 
203:         let hit_point = [
204:             ray.origin[0] + ray.direction[0] * hit.t,
205:             ray.origin[1] + ray.direction[1] * hit.t,
206:             ray.origin[2] + ray.direction[2] * hit.t,
207:         ];
208:         let normal = face_normal(hit_point, ray.direction, scene.voxel_size);
209:         let epsilon = scene.voxel_size * 0.05;
210:         let surface_point = [
211:             hit_point[0] + normal[0] * epsilon,
212:             hit_point[1] + normal[1] * epsilon,
213:             hit_point[2] + normal[2] * epsilon,
214:         ];
215: 
216: 
217:         let direct = sample_direct_light(scene, surface_point, normal, rng);
218:         for axis in 0..3 {
219:             radiance[axis] += throughput[axis] * color[axis] * direct[axis];
220:         }
221: 
222:         for axis in 0..3 {
223:             throughput[axis] *= color[axis];
224:         }
225: 
226:         if bounce >= 3 {
227:             let survive = throughput[0]
228:                 .max(throughput[1])
229:                 .max(throughput[2])
230:                 .clamp(0.05, 0.95);
231:             if rng.uniform() > survive {
232:                 break;
233:             }
234:             for axis in 0..3 {
235:                 throughput[axis] /= survive;
236:             }
237:         }
238:         ray = Ray {
239:             origin: surface_point,
240:             direction: cosine_hemisphere(normal, rng),
241:         };
242:     }
243:     radiance
244: }
245: 
246: 
247: 
248: 
249: fn sample_direct_light(
250:     scene: &Scene,
251:     surface_point: [f32; 3],
252:     normal: [f32; 3],
253:     rng: &mut Pcg32,
254: ) -> [f32; 3] {
255:     if scene.lights.is_empty() {
256:         return [0.0; 3];
257:     }
258:     let picked = (rng.uniform() * scene.lights.len() as f32) as usize;
259:     let light = &scene.lights[picked.min(scene.lights.len() - 1)];
260:     let half = [light.half_size[0].max(0.01), light.half_size[1].max(0.01)];
261:     let sample_point = [
262:         light.position[0] + (rng.uniform() * 2.0 - 1.0) * half[0],
263:         light.position[1],
264:         light.position[2] + (rng.uniform() * 2.0 - 1.0) * half[1],
265:     ];
266:     let to_light = [
267:         sample_point[0] - surface_point[0],
268:         sample_point[1] - surface_point[1],
269:         sample_point[2] - surface_point[2],
270:     ];
271:     let distance_sq = to_light[0] * to_light[0] + to_light[1] * to_light[1] + to_light[2] * to_light[2];
272:     let distance = distance_sq.sqrt().max(1e-4);
273:     let direction = [
274:         to_light[0] / distance,
275:         to_light[1] / distance,
276:         to_light[2] / distance,
277:     ];
278:     let cos_surface = direction[0] * normal[0] + direction[1] * normal[1] + direction[2] * normal[2];
279: 
280:     let cos_light = direction[1].max(0.0);
281:     if cos_surface <= 0.0 || cos_light <= 0.0 {
282:         return [0.0; 3];
283:     }
284: 
285: 
286:     if let Some(obstruction) = trace_svo(
287:         &scene.atlas,
288:         &scene.chunks,
289:         surface_point,
290:         direction,
291:         distance,
292:         true,
293:     ) {
294:         let reached_panel = is_emissive(obstruction.voxel_type)
295:             && obstruction.t > distance - scene.voxel_size * 4.0;
296:         if !reached_panel {
297:             return [0.0; 3];
298:         }
299:     }
300:     let area = 4.0 * half[0] * half[1];
301:     let pdf = 1.0 / (area * scene.lights.len() as f32);
302:     let geometry = cos_surface * cos_light / distance_sq;
303:     let scale = light.intensity * geometry / (std::f32::consts::PI * pdf);
304:     [
305:         light.color[0] * scale,
306:         light.color[1] * scale,
307:         light.color[2] * scale,
308:     ]
309: }
310: 
311: 
312: 
313: 
314: 
315: fn face_normal(point: [f32; 3], direction: [f32; 3], voxel_size: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
316:     let mut best_axis = 0;
317:     let mut best_distance = f32::MAX;
318:     for axis in 0..3 {
319:         let cell = point[axis] / voxel_size;
320:         let fractional = cell - cell.floor();
321:         let distance = fractional.min(1.0 - fractional);
322:         if distance < best_distance {
323:             best_distance = distance;
324:             best_axis = axis;
325:         }
326:     }
327:     let mut normal = [0.0f32; 3];
328:     normal[best_axis] = -direction[best_axis].signum();
329:     normal
330: }
331: 
332: fn cosine_hemisphere(normal: [f32; 3], rng: &mut Pcg32) -> [f32; 3] {
333: 
334: 
335:     let tangent = if normal[0].abs() < 0.9 {
336:         normalize(cross(normal, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]))
337:     } else {
338:         normalize(cross(normal, [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]))
339:     };
340:     let bitangent = cross(normal, tangent);
341:     let u1 = rng.uniform();
342:     let u2 = rng.uniform();
343:     let r = u1.sqrt();
344:     let phi = std::f32::consts::TAU * u2;
345:     let (x, y) = (r * phi.cos(), r * phi.sin());
346:     let z = (1.0 - u1).max(0.0).sqrt();
347:     normalize([
348:         tangent[0] * x + bitangent[0] * y + normal[0] * z,
349:         tangent[1] * x + bitangent[1] * y + normal[1] * z,
350:         tangent[2] * x + bitangent[2] * y + normal[2] * z,
351:     ])
352: }
353: 
354: 
355: 
356: 
357: 
358: struct Camera {
359:     position: [f32; 3],
360:     right: [f32; 3],
361:     up: [f32; 3],
362:     forward: [f32; 3],
363:     width: f32,
364:     height: f32,
365:     aspect: f32,
366: }
367: 
368: impl Camera {
369:     fn at_spawn(seed: u32, width: u32, height: u32) -> Self {
370:         let spawn = spawn_point(seed);
371:         let yaw = -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
372:         let forward = [yaw.sin(), 0.0, -yaw.cos()];
373:         let right = [-forward[2], 0.0, forward[0]];
374:         Self {
375:             position: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
376:             right,
377:             up: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],
378:             forward,
379:             width: width as f32,
380:             height: height as f32,
381:             aspect: width as f32 / height as f32,
382:         }
383:     }
384: 
385:     fn primary_ray(&self, column: f32, row: f32, rng: &mut Pcg32) -> Ray {
386:         let u = ((column + rng.uniform()) / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0) * FOV_TAN * self.aspect;
387:         let v = (1.0 - (row + rng.uniform()) / self.height * 2.0) * FOV_TAN;
388:         Ray {
389:             origin: self.position,
390:             direction: normalize([
391:                 self.right[0] * u + self.up[0] * v + self.forward[0],
392:                 self.right[1] * u + self.up[1] * v + self.forward[1],
393:                 self.right[2] * u + self.up[2] * v + self.forward[2],
394:             ]),
395:         }
396:     }
397: }

399: 
400: 
401: 
402: 
403: 
404: struct Pcg32 {
405:     state: u64,
406:     increment: u64,
407: }
408: 
409: impl Pcg32 {
410:     fn new(stream: u64, seed: u64) -> Self {
411:         let mut rng = Self {
412:             state: seed.wrapping_add(0x853c_49e6_748f_ea9b),
413:             increment: (stream << 1) | 1,
414:         };
415:         rng.next();
416:         rng.next();
417:         rng
418:     }
419: 
420:     fn next(&mut self) -> u32 {
421:         let old = self.state;
422:         self.state = old
423:             .wrapping_mul(6_364_136_223_846_793_005)
424:             .wrapping_add(self.increment);
425:         let xorshifted = (((old >> 18) ^ old) >> 27) as u32;
426:         let rotation = (old >> 59) as u32;
427:         xorshifted.rotate_right(rotation)
428:     }
429: 
430:     fn uniform(&mut self) -> f32 {
431:         (self.next() >> 8) as f32 / (1u32 << 24) as f32
432:     }
433: }
434: 
435: fn random_seed() -> u32 {
436:     use std::hash::{BuildHasher, Hasher};
437:     std::collections::hash_map::RandomState::new()
438:         .build_hasher()
439:         .finish() as u32
440: }
441: 
442: fn env_number(name: &str, fallback: u32) -> u32 {
443:     std::env::var(name)
444:         .ok()
445:         .and_then(|value| value.parse().ok())
446:         .unwrap_or(fallback)
447: }
448: 
449: fn parse_size() -> (u32, u32) {
450:     std::env::var("SIZE")
451:         .ok()
452:         .and_then(|value| {
453:             let (w, h) = value.split_once('x')?;
454:             Some((w.parse().ok()?, h.parse().ok()?))
455:         })
456:         .unwrap_or((640, 360))
457: }
458: 
459: fn cross(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
460:     [
461:         a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1],
462:         a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2],
463:         a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0],
464:     ]
465: }
466: 
467: fn normalize(v: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
468:     let length = (v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]).sqrt().max(1e-8);
469:     [v[0] / length, v[1] / length, v[2] / length]
470: }
````

````rust
171: fn snapshot_size() -> (u32, u32) {
172:     let requested = std::env::var("SNAPSHOT_SIZE").unwrap_or_default();
173:     let parsed = requested
174:         .split_once('x')
175:         .and_then(|(w, h)| Some((w.parse().ok()?, h.parse().ok()?)));
176:     let (width, height): (u32, u32) = parsed.unwrap_or((960, 540));
177: 
178: 
179:     assert!(
180:         (width * 4) % wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT == 0,
181:         "SNAPSHOT_SIZE width must be a multiple of 64 pixels"
182:     );
183:     (width.max(64), height.max(1))
184: }

186: fn create_vulkan_device() -> (wgpu::Device, wgpu::Queue) {
187:     let mut descriptor = wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle();
188:     descriptor.backends = wgpu::Backends::VULKAN;
189:     let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(descriptor);
190:     let adapter = pollster::block_on(instance.request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
191:         power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
192:         force_fallback_adapter: false,
193:         compatible_surface: None,
194:         apply_limit_buckets: false,
195:     }))
196:     .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
197:         panic!("no Vulkan adapter; install Mesa (Lavapipe) or expose a Vulkan GPU: {error}")
198:     });
199:     let info = adapter.get_info();
200:     eprintln!(
201:         "Vulkan adapter: {} ({}, {})",
202:         info.name, info.driver, info.driver_info
203:     );
204:     let limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
205:     let (device, queue) = pollster::block_on(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
206:         label: Some("vackrooms.vulkan-snapshot"),
207:         required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
208:         required_limits: limits,
209:         ..Default::default()
210:     }))
211:     .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("failed to create the Vulkan device: {error}"));
212:     (device, queue)
213: }

218: fn load_spawn_world(seed: u32) -> LoadedWorld {
219:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
220:     let spawn = spawn_point(seed);
221:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
222:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
223:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), seed, config);
224: 
225:     let mut payloads = Vec::new();
226:     for dz in -1..=1 {
227:         for dx in -1..=1 {
228:             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
229:             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
230:             payloads.push((x, z, source.load(x, z, 0, 0)));
231:         }
232:     }
233: 
234:     let max_rows = payloads
235:         .iter()
236:         .map(|(_, _, payload)| payload_rows(payload))
237:         .max()
238:         .expect("spawn neighborhood is never empty");
239:     let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
240:     pool.ensure_layout(payloads.len(), max_rows);
241: 
242:     let mut atlas = Vec::new();
243:     let mut chunks = Vec::new();
244:     let mut unique_lights = HashMap::new();
245:     for (x, z, payload) in &payloads {
246:         let key = chunk_key(*x, *z);
247:         let slot = pool.assign(key).expect("atlas sized for every chunk");
248:         let offset = slot * pool.slot_nodes();
249:         atlas.extend(pool.rebased_block(slot, payload));
250:         chunks.push(ChunkDraw {
251:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
252:             root_index: (offset + payload.root as usize) as i32,
253:             world_size: payload.world_size,
254:             voxel_size: payload.voxel_size,
255:             svo_depth: payload.svo_depth,
256:         });
257:         for light in &payload.lights {
258:             let quantized = [
259:                 (light.position[0] * 16.0) as i32,
260:                 (light.position[1] * 16.0) as i32,
261:                 (light.position[2] * 16.0) as i32,
262:             ];
263:             unique_lights.entry(quantized).or_insert(*light);
264:         }
265:     }
266: 
267:     let frame = FrameParams {
268:         camera_pos: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
269:         yaw: -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2,
270:         pitch: 0.0,
271:         scene_lights: unique_lights.into_values().collect(),
272:         environment: Environment::interior(),
273:         ..FrameParams::default()
274:     };
275: 
276:     LoadedWorld {
277:         payloads,
278:         chunks,
279:         atlas,
280:         frame,
281:     }
282: }
283: 
284: fn render_offscreen(
285:     device: &wgpu::Device,
286:     queue: &wgpu::Queue,
287:     width: u32,
288:     height: u32,
289:     with_depth: bool,
290:     draw: impl FnOnce(&mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, &wgpu::TextureView, Option<&wgpu::TextureView>),
291: ) -> Vec<u8> {
292:     let extent = wgpu::Extent3d {
293:         width,
294:         height,
295:         depth_or_array_layers: 1,
296:     };
297:     let color = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
298:         label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-color"),
299:         size: extent,
300:         mip_level_count: 1,
301:         sample_count: 1,
302:         dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
303:         format: TARGET_FORMAT,
304:         usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_SRC,
305:         view_formats: &[],
306:     });
307:     let color_view = color.create_view(&Default::default());
308:     let depth_view = with_depth.then(|| {
309:         device
310:             .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
311:                 label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-depth"),
312:                 size: extent,
313:                 mip_level_count: 1,
314:                 sample_count: 1,
315:                 dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
316:                 format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
317:                 usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
318:                 view_formats: &[],
319:             })
320:             .create_view(&Default::default())
321:     });
322: 
323:     let bytes_per_row = width * 4;
324:     let readback = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
325:         label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-readback"),
326:         size: u64::from(bytes_per_row * height),
327:         usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ,
328:         mapped_at_creation: false,
329:     });
330:     let mut encoder =
331:         device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor { label: None });
332:     draw(&mut encoder, &color_view, depth_view.as_ref());
333:     encoder.copy_texture_to_buffer(
334:         color.as_image_copy(),
335:         wgpu::TexelCopyBufferInfo {
336:             buffer: &readback,
337:             layout: wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
338:                 offset: 0,
339:                 bytes_per_row: Some(bytes_per_row),
340:                 rows_per_image: Some(height),
341:             },
342:         },
343:         extent,
344:     );
345:     queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
346: 
347:     let (mapped_tx, mapped_rx) = mpsc::channel();
348:     readback
349:         .slice(..)
350:         .map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read, move |result| {
351:             let _ = mapped_tx.send(result);
352:         });
353:     device
354:         .poll(wgpu::PollType::wait_indefinitely())
355:         .expect("device poll for snapshot readback");
356:     mapped_rx
357:         .recv()
358:         .expect("map_async callback")
359:         .expect("snapshot readback mapping");
360:     let pixels = readback
361:         .slice(..)
362:         .get_mapped_range()
363:         .expect("snapshot readback range")
364:         .to_vec();
365:     readback.unmap();
366:     pixels
367: }
368: 
369: fn write_png(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str, width: u32, height: u32, rgba: &[u8]) {
370:     let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.png"));
371:     let image = image::RgbaImage::from_raw(width, height, rgba.to_vec())
372:         .expect("snapshot buffer matches dimensions");
373:     image.save(&path).expect("write snapshot png");
374:     eprintln!("wrote {}", path.display());
375: }
````

````rust
 77: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
 78: 
 79:     pub(super) fn traverse_voxel_chunk(
 80:         &mut self,
 81:         cam: &Camera,
 82:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 83:         chunk: &ChunkDraw,
 84:         scene_lights: &[LightSource],
 85:         global_hero_id: Option<u64>,
 86:     ) {
 87:         let lighting = ChunkLighting::with_global_hero(scene_lights, global_hero_id);
 88:         self.traverse_voxel_node(cam, chunks, lighting, NodeVisit::root(chunk));
 89:     }

 92: 
 93:     fn traverse_voxel_node(
 94:         &mut self,
 95:         cam: &Camera,
 96:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 97:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
 98:         visit: NodeVisit,
 99:     ) {
100:         // These are absolute frame limits, checked before projection, atlas
101:         // decode, lighting, or a secondary visibility ray. In particular,
102:         // reaching the pixel-write cap must not leave an invisible tail of
103:         // expensive shading work in the recursion.
104:         if self.frame_work_budget.writes_exhausted(self.pixel_writes)
105:             || self.frame_work_budget.nodes_exhausted(self.visited_nodes)
106:         {
107:             self.budget_exhausted = true;
108:             return;
109:         }
110: 
111:         let Some(projected) = project_voxel_node(self, cam, visit) else {
112:             return;
113:         };
114: 
115:         // Preserve telemetry semantics: a projected malformed atlas node is
116:         // counted before its failed decode, just as the original traversal.
117:         self.visited_nodes += 1;
118:         let Some(kind) = self.resolve_node(visit) else {
119:             return;
120:         };
121: 
122:         let at_hard_cap = self.frame_work_budget.nodes_exhausted(self.visited_nodes);
123:         let outside_focus_reserve = self
124:             .frame_work_budget
125:             .outside_focus_reserve(self.visited_nodes)
126:             && !node_is_in_flashlight_focus(cam, &projected);
127:         if at_hard_cap || outside_focus_reserve {
128:             self.budget_exhausted = true;
129:             self.render_budget_fallback(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, kind);
130:             return;
131:         }
132: 
133:         match kind {
134:             NodeKind::Leaf { payload, exposure } => {
135:                 let visit = NodeVisit { exposure, ..visit };
136:                 self.render_leaf(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, payload)
137:             }
138:             NodeKind::Interior {
139:                 child_base,
140:                 child_mask,
141:             } => {
142:                 self.render_interior(
143:                     cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, child_base, child_mask,
144:                 );
145:             }
146:         }
147:     }
148: 
149:     fn resolve_node(&self, visit: NodeVisit) -> Option<NodeKind> {
150:         if let Some(payload) = visit.virtual_leaf {
151:             return Some(NodeKind::Leaf {
152:                 payload,
153:                 exposure: visit.exposure,
154:             });
155:         }
156: 
157:         let node = decode_node(&self.atlas, visit.node_idx)?;
158:         if node.is_leaf {
159:             let linear_albedo = self
160:                 .mips
161:                 .get(visit.node_idx)
162:                 .map_or([0.0; 3], |mip| mip.linear_albedo);
163:             Some(NodeKind::Leaf {
164:                 payload: LeafPayload {
165:                     voxel_type: node.voxel_type,
166:                     linear_albedo,
167:                     baked_rgb: node.baked_rgb,
168:                 },
169:                 exposure: node.exposure,
170:             })
171:         } else {
172:             Some(NodeKind::Interior {
173:                 child_base: node.child_base,
174:                 child_mask: node.child_mask,
175:             })
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     /// Safety-cap behavior: retain the current fidelity and stop descending.
180:     fn render_budget_fallback(
181:         &mut self,
182:         cam: &Camera,
183:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
184:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
185:         visit: NodeVisit,
186:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
187:         kind: NodeKind,
188:     ) {
189:         match kind {
190:             NodeKind::Leaf { payload, exposure } if payload.voxel_type != VOXEL_AIR => {
191:                 let visit = NodeVisit { exposure, ..visit };
192:                 self.draw_leaf_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected, payload);
193:             }
194:             NodeKind::Leaf { .. } => {}
195:             NodeKind::Interior { .. } => {
196:                 self.draw_mip_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected)
197:             }
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:     fn render_leaf(
202:         &mut self,
203:         cam: &Camera,
204:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
205:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
206:         visit: NodeVisit,
207:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
208:         payload: LeafPayload,
209:     ) {
210:         if payload.voxel_type == VOXEL_AIR {
211:             return;
212:         }
213:         self.max_virtual_depth_reached = self.max_virtual_depth_reached.max(visit.virtual_depth);
214: 
215:         let should_subdivide = should_subdivide_leaf(&self.settings, visit, projected);
216:         if should_subdivide {
217:             self.visit_children(
218:                 cam,
219:                 chunks,
220:                 lighting,
221:                 visit,
222:                 VoxelChildren::Virtual(payload),
223:                 visit.crowded_siblings,
224:             );
225:         } else {
226:             self.draw_leaf_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected, payload);
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     fn draw_leaf_splat(
231:         &mut self,
232:         cam: &Camera,
233:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
234:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
235:         visit: NodeVisit,
236:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
237:         payload: LeafPayload,
238:     ) {
239:         let half_px = projected.footprint.enclosing_radius().max(0.85);
240:         let emission_strength = emission_strength(payload.voxel_type);
241:         let emissive = emission_strength.is_some();
242:         let Some(surface_depth) = project_surface_depth(
243:             cam,
244:             projected.center,
245:             visit.size,
246:             payload.voxel_type,
247:             emissive,
248:             visit.exposure,
249:         ) else {
250:             return;
251:         };
252:         if self.settings.toggles.deferred_shading
253:             && !self.surface_splat_may_contribute(
254:                 projected.footprint.center[0],
255:                 projected.footprint.center[1],
256:                 half_px,
257:                 surface_depth,
258:                 emissive,
259:             )
260:         {
261:             return;
262:         }
263:         let hero_visibility = self.resolve_hero_light_visibility(
264:             chunks,
265:             projected.center,
266:             visit.size,
267:             emissive,
268:             surface_depth.representative_depth(),
269:             lighting.hero,
270:         );
271:         self.shade_predecoded_and_splat_with_frame_lighting(
272:             cam,
273:             chunks,
274:             frame_lighting(lighting.fixtures, hero_visibility),
275:             projected.center,
276:             visit.size,
277:             projected.footprint.center[0],
278:             projected.footprint.center[1],
279:             half_px,
280:             surface_depth,
281:             payload.linear_albedo,
282:             payload.baked_rgb.map(f32::from),
283:             emission_strength,
284:             payload.voxel_type,
285:             visit.exposure,
286:             visit.crowded_siblings,
287:         );
288:     }
289: 
290:     fn render_interior(
291:         &mut self,
292:         cam: &Camera,
293:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
294:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
295:         visit: NodeVisit,
296:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
297:         child_base: usize,
298:         child_mask: u32,
299:     ) {
300:         // OPTIMIZATION (LOD): a subtree fitting in roughly a pixel becomes
301:         // one prefiltered MIP splat instead of a full descendant walk.
302:         let contains_emissive = self
303:             .mips
304:             .get(visit.node_idx)
305:             .is_some_and(|mip| mip.emissive_coverage > 0.0);
306:         if should_draw_mip_splat(&self.settings, projected) && !contains_emissive {
307:             self.draw_mip_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected);
308:             return;
309:         }
310: 
311:         self.visit_children(
312:             cam,
313:             chunks,
314:             lighting,
315:             visit,
316:             VoxelChildren::Atlas {
317:                 base: child_base,
318:                 mask: child_mask,
319:             },
320:             child_mask.count_ones(),
321:         );
322:     }
323: 
324:     fn draw_mip_splat(
325:         &mut self,
326:         cam: &Camera,
327:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
328:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
329:         visit: NodeVisit,
330:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
331:     ) {
332:         let mip = self.mips.get(visit.node_idx).copied().unwrap_or_default();
333:         if mip.occupancy < self.settings.min_mip_occupancy {
334:             return;
335:         }
336:         let half_px = projected.footprint.enclosing_radius().max(0.85);
337:         let emissive = mip.emissive_coverage > 0.0;
338:         let mip_voxel_type = if emissive {
339:             vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_LIGHT as u32
340:         } else {
341:             mip.dominant_voxel_type
342:         };
343:         let Some(surface_depth) = project_surface_depth(
344:             cam,
345:             projected.center,
346:             visit.size,
347:             mip_voxel_type,
348:             emissive,
349:             mip.exposed_area,
350:         ) else {
351:             return;
352:         };
353:         if self.settings.toggles.deferred_shading
354:             && !self.surface_splat_may_contribute(
355:                 projected.footprint.center[0],
356:                 projected.footprint.center[1],
357:                 half_px,
358:                 surface_depth,
359:                 emissive,
360:             )
361:         {
362:             return;
363:         }
364:         let hero_visibility = self.resolve_hero_light_visibility(
365:             chunks,
366:             projected.center,
367:             visit.size,
368:             emissive,
369:             surface_depth.representative_depth(),
370:             lighting.hero,
371:         );
372:         self.shade_predecoded_and_splat_with_frame_lighting(
373:             cam,
374:             chunks,
375:             frame_lighting(lighting.fixtures, hero_visibility),
376:             projected.center,
377:             visit.size,
378:             projected.footprint.center[0],
379:             projected.footprint.center[1],
380:             half_px,
381:             surface_depth,
382:             if emissive {
383:                 mip.emitted_radiance_density
384:             } else {
385:                 mip.linear_albedo
386:             },
387:             mip.baked_rgb,
388:             emissive.then_some(1.0),
389:             mip_voxel_type,
390:             mip.exposed_area,
391:             visit.crowded_siblings,
392:         );
393:     }
394: 
395: 
396: 
397:     fn visit_children(
398:         &mut self,
399:         cam: &Camera,
400:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
401:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
402:         parent: NodeVisit,
403:         children: VoxelChildren,
404:         crowding: u32,
405:     ) {
406:         for child in voxel_child_visits(
407:             parent,
408:             children,
409:             crowding,
410:             cam.pos,
411:             self.settings.toggles.front_to_back,
412:         )
413:         .into_iter()
414:         .flatten()
415:         {
416:             self.traverse_voxel_node(cam, chunks, lighting, child);
417:         }
418:     }
419: }
420: 
421: fn frame_lighting(
422:     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
423:     hero_visibility: Option<HeroLightVisibility>,
424: ) -> FrameLighting<'_> {
425:     match hero_visibility {
426:         Some(hero) => {
427:             FrameLighting::with_hero_visibility(scene_lights, hero.light_id, hero.visibility)
428:         }
429:         None => FrameLighting::unshadowed(scene_lights),
430:     }
431: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/traverse_voxel_scene/project_voxel_node.rs
````rust
 1: use super::super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
 2: use super::super::SoftwareRasterizer;
 3: use super::super::project_aabb_footprint::{
 4:     NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH, ScreenFootprint, aabb_camera_depth_interval, project_screen_footprint,
 5: };
 6: use super::NodeVisit;
 7: 
 8: 
 9: pub(super) struct ProjectedVoxelNode {
10:     pub(super) center: [f32; 3],
11:     pub(super) relative_to_camera: [f32; 3],
12:     pub(super) camera_depth: f32,
13: 
14: 
15:     pub(super) footprint: ScreenFootprint,
16: }
17: 
18: 
19: pub(super) fn project_voxel_node(
20:     renderer: &SoftwareRasterizer,
21:     camera: &Camera,
22:     visit: NodeVisit,
23: ) -> Option<ProjectedVoxelNode> {
24:     let half_size = visit.size * 0.5;
25:     let center = [
26:         visit.min[0] + half_size,
27:         visit.min[1] + half_size,
28:         visit.min[2] + half_size,
29:     ];
30:     let relative_to_camera = [
31:         center[0] - camera.pos[0],
32:         center[1] - camera.pos[1],
33:         center[2] - camera.pos[2],
34:     ];
35:     let camera_depth = dot(relative_to_camera, camera.forward);
36:     let depth_interval = aabb_camera_depth_interval(camera, relative_to_camera, half_size);
37:     if depth_interval[1] <= NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH {
38:         return None;
39:     }
40: 
41:     let footprint = project_screen_footprint(camera, visit.min, visit.size, depth_interval[0])?;
42: 
43:     if footprint.outside_framebuffer(renderer.target.width(), renderer.target.height()) {
44:         return None;
45:     }
46: 
47: 
48: 
49:     if renderer.settings.toggles.hierarchical_z
50:         && renderer.target.coarse_rect_occludes(
51:             footprint.center,
52:             footprint.half_extent,
53:             footprint.nearest_depth.max(0.0),
54:         )
55:     {
56:         return None;
57:     }
58: 
59:     Some(ProjectedVoxelNode {
60:         center,
61:         relative_to_camera,
62:         camera_depth,
63:         footprint,
64:     })
65: }
66: 
67: 
68: 
69: pub(super) fn node_is_in_flashlight_focus(camera: &Camera, projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode) -> bool {
70:     if !camera.flashlight {
71:         return false;
72:     }
73:     let distance = projected.camera_depth.max(0.001);
74:     if distance >= 15.0 {
75:         return false;
76:     }
77:     let direction = projected
78:         .relative_to_camera
79:         .map(|component| component / distance);
80:     dot(direction, camera.forward) > 0.88
81: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/traverse_voxel_scene/visit_voxel_octants.rs
````rust
 1: use super::super::super::surface_geometry::exposure_for_octant;
 2: use super::{LeafPayload, NodeVisit};
 3: 
 4: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
 5: pub(super) enum VoxelChildren {
 6:     Atlas { base: usize, mask: u32 },
 7:     Virtual(LeafPayload),
 8: }
 9: 
10: impl VoxelChildren {
11:     fn occupied_mask(self) -> u32 {
12:         match self {
13:             Self::Atlas { mask, .. } => mask,
14:             Self::Virtual(_) => 0xFF,
15:         }
16:     }
17: 
18:     fn atlas_or_virtual_child(
19:         self,
20:         octant: u32,
21:         parent_virtual_depth: usize,
22:     ) -> (usize, Option<LeafPayload>, usize) {
23:         match self {
24:             Self::Atlas { base, .. } => (base + octant as usize, None, 0),
25:             Self::Virtual(payload) => (usize::MAX, Some(payload), parent_virtual_depth + 1),
26:         }
27:     }
28: }
29: 
30: 
31: 
32: 
33: pub(super) fn voxel_child_visits(
34:     parent: NodeVisit,
35:     children: VoxelChildren,
36:     crowded_siblings: u32,
37:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
38:     front_to_back: bool,
39: ) -> [Option<NodeVisit>; 8] {
40:     let half_size = parent.size * 0.5;
41:     let parent_center = [
42:         parent.min[0] + half_size,
43:         parent.min[1] + half_size,
44:         parent.min[2] + half_size,
45:     ];
46:     let camera_octant = (camera_position[0] >= parent_center[0]) as u32
47:         | (((camera_position[1] >= parent_center[1]) as u32) << 1)
48:         | (((camera_position[2] >= parent_center[2]) as u32) << 2);
49: 
50: 
51:     const NEAR_TO_FAR_XOR: [u32; 8] = [0, 1, 2, 4, 3, 5, 6, 7];
52:     let occupied_mask = children.occupied_mask();
53:     let mut visits = [None; 8];
54:     for (index, relative_octant) in NEAR_TO_FAR_XOR.into_iter().enumerate() {
55:         let octant = if front_to_back {
56:             camera_octant ^ relative_octant
57:         } else {
58:             index as u32
59:         };
60:         if occupied_mask & (1 << octant) == 0 {
61:             continue;
62:         }
63: 
64:         let min = [
65:             parent.min[0] + (octant & 1) as f32 * half_size,
66:             parent.min[1] + ((octant >> 1) & 1) as f32 * half_size,
67:             parent.min[2] + ((octant >> 2) & 1) as f32 * half_size,
68:         ];
69:         let (node_idx, virtual_leaf, virtual_depth) =
70:             children.atlas_or_virtual_child(octant, parent.virtual_depth);
71:         visits[index] = Some(NodeVisit {
72:             node_idx,
73:             min,
74:             size: half_size,
75:             crowded_siblings,
76:             virtual_leaf,
77:             virtual_depth,
78:             exposure: exposure_for_octant(parent.exposure, occupied_mask, octant),
79:         });
80:     }
81:     visits
82: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/draw_visible_flare_cores.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::application::ports::FrameParams;
 2: 
 3: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
 4: use super::SoftwareRasterizer;
 5: 
 6: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
 7:     pub(super) fn draw_visible_flare_cores(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, camera: &Camera) {
 8:         for light in frame.active_dynamic_lights() {
 9:             let Some(core) = project_flare_core(light.position, light.intensity, camera) else {
10:                 continue;
11:             };
12:             if core.depth > self.settings.max_draw_distance {
13:                 continue;
14:             }
15: 
16:             self.splat(
17:                 core.pixel[0],
18:                 core.pixel[1],
19:                 core.half_extent,
20:                 core.depth - 0.05,
21:                 core.color,
22:             );
23:         }
24:     }
25: }
26: 
27: struct ProjectedFlareCore {
28:     pixel: [f32; 2],
29:     half_extent: f32,
30:     depth: f32,
31:     color: [u8; 3],
32: }
33: 
34: fn project_flare_core(
35:     position: [f32; 3],
36:     intensity: f32,
37:     camera: &Camera,
38: ) -> Option<ProjectedFlareCore> {
39:     let relative = [
40:         position[0] - camera.pos[0],
41:         position[1] - camera.pos[1],
42:         position[2] - camera.pos[2],
43:     ];
44:     let depth = dot(relative, camera.forward);
45:     if depth <= 0.1 {
46:         return None;
47:     }
48: 
49:     let normalized_intensity = intensity.clamp(0.0, 1.6) / 1.6;
50:     Some(ProjectedFlareCore {
51:         pixel: [
52:             camera.half_w + dot(relative, camera.right) / depth * camera.focal_px,
53:             camera.half_h - dot(relative, camera.up) / depth * camera.focal_px,
54:         ],
55:         half_extent: (0.06 / depth * camera.focal_px).clamp(1.0, 6.0),
56:         depth,
57:         color: [
58:             (255.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
59:             (150.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
60:             (60.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
61:         ],
62:     })
63: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/frame_work_budget.rs
````rust
  1: use super::super::settings::CpuRenderSettings;
  2: 
  3: 
  4: 
  5: pub(super) const ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING: usize = 8_000_000;
  6: 
  7: 
  8: pub(super) const ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING: usize = 16_000_000;
  9: 
 10: const MINIMUM_NODE_VISITS: usize = 16_384;
 11: const MINIMUM_PIXEL_WRITES: usize = 4_096;
 12: const FOCUS_RESERVE_FRACTION: f64 = 0.90;
 13: 
 14: 
 15: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 16: pub(super) struct FrameWorkBudget {
 17:     node_visit_limit: usize,
 18:     soft_node_visit_limit: usize,
 19:     pixel_write_limit: usize,
 20: }
 21: 
 22: impl FrameWorkBudget {
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28:     pub(super) fn for_target(settings: &CpuRenderSettings, width: usize, height: usize) -> Self {
 29:         let settings = settings.validated();
 30:         let target_pixels = width.saturating_mul(height).max(1);
 31: 
 32:         let node_visit_limit = scaled_limit(
 33:             target_pixels,
 34:             node_visits_per_pixel(&settings),
 35:             MINIMUM_NODE_VISITS,
 36:             ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING,
 37:         );
 38:         let soft_node_visit_limit = ((node_visit_limit as f64 * FOCUS_RESERVE_FRACTION).floor()
 39:             as usize)
 40:             .max(1)
 41:             .min(node_visit_limit);
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46:         let one_full_coverage = target_pixels.min(ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING);
 47:         let pixel_write_limit = scaled_limit(
 48:             target_pixels,
 49:             pixel_writes_per_pixel(&settings),
 50:             MINIMUM_PIXEL_WRITES.max(one_full_coverage),
 51:             ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING,
 52:         );
 53: 
 54:         Self {
 55:             node_visit_limit,
 56:             soft_node_visit_limit,
 57:             pixel_write_limit,
 58:         }
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     pub(super) const fn node_visit_limit(self) -> usize {
 62:         self.node_visit_limit
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     pub(super) const fn soft_node_visit_limit(self) -> usize {
 66:         self.soft_node_visit_limit
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     pub(super) const fn pixel_write_limit(self) -> usize {
 70:         self.pixel_write_limit
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     pub(super) const fn nodes_exhausted(self, visited_nodes: usize) -> bool {
 74:         visited_nodes >= self.node_visit_limit
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     pub(super) const fn outside_focus_reserve(self, visited_nodes: usize) -> bool {
 78:         visited_nodes >= self.soft_node_visit_limit
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     pub(super) const fn writes_exhausted(self, pixel_writes: usize) -> bool {
 82:         pixel_writes >= self.pixel_write_limit
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     pub(super) const fn remaining_pixel_writes(self, pixel_writes: usize) -> usize {
 86:         self.pixel_write_limit.saturating_sub(pixel_writes)
 87:     }
 88: }
 89: 
 90: impl Default for FrameWorkBudget {
 91:     fn default() -> Self {
 92:         Self::for_target(&CpuRenderSettings::default(), 1, 1)
 93:     }
 94: }
 95: 
 96: fn scaled_limit(pixels: usize, density: f64, minimum: usize, ceiling: usize) -> usize {
 97:     let requested = (pixels as f64 * density).ceil();
 98:     if !requested.is_finite() || requested >= ceiling as f64 {
 99:         return ceiling;
100:     }
101:     (requested as usize).max(minimum).min(ceiling)
102: }
103: 
104: 
105: 
106: 
107: 
108: fn node_visits_per_pixel(settings: &CpuRenderSettings) -> f64 {
109:     0.35 + f64::from(settings.max_virtual_depth) * 0.08
110:         + 0.4 / f64::from(settings.max_splat_radius_px)
111:         + 0.15 / f64::from(settings.lod_cutoff_px)
112: }
113: 
114: 
115: 
116: 
117: fn pixel_writes_per_pixel(settings: &CpuRenderSettings) -> f64 {
118:     1.0 + f64::from(settings.max_virtual_depth) * 0.12
119:         + 1.0 / f64::from(settings.max_splat_radius_px).sqrt()
120:         + 0.2 / f64::from(settings.lod_cutoff_px)
121: }
````

````rust
  1: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
  2: 
  3: pub(super) const NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH: f32 = 0.01;
  4: 
  5: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  6: pub(super) struct ScreenFootprint {
  7:     pub(super) center: [f32; 2],
  8:     pub(super) half_extent: [f32; 2],
  9: 
 10:     pub(super) nearest_depth: f32,
 11: }
 12: 
 13: impl ScreenFootprint {
 14: 
 15: 
 16:     pub(super) fn enclosing_radius(self) -> f32 {
 17:         self.half_extent[0].max(self.half_extent[1])
 18:     }
 19: 
 20:     pub(super) fn outside_framebuffer(self, width: usize, height: usize) -> bool {
 21:         self.center[0] + self.half_extent[0] < 0.0
 22:             || self.center[0] - self.half_extent[0] >= width as f32
 23:             || self.center[1] + self.half_extent[1] < 0.0
 24:             || self.center[1] - self.half_extent[1] >= height as f32
 25:     }
 26: }
 27: 
 28: 
 29: 
 30: 
 31: pub(super) fn aabb_camera_depth_interval(
 32:     camera: &Camera,
 33:     center_relative_to_camera: [f32; 3],
 34:     half_size: f32,
 35: ) -> [f32; 2] {
 36:     let center_depth = dot(center_relative_to_camera, camera.forward);
 37:     let depth_radius =
 38:         half_size * (camera.forward[0].abs() + camera.forward[1].abs() + camera.forward[2].abs());
 39:     [center_depth - depth_radius, center_depth + depth_radius]
 40: }
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: pub(super) fn project_screen_footprint(
 45:     camera: &Camera,
 46:     min: [f32; 3],
 47:     size: f32,
 48:     nearest_depth: f32,
 49: ) -> Option<ScreenFootprint> {
 50:     if !size.is_finite()
 51:         || size <= 0.0
 52:         || !nearest_depth.is_finite()
 53:         || min.into_iter().any(|coordinate| !coordinate.is_finite())
 54:     {
 55:         return None;
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     let mut relative_corners = [[0.0; 3]; 8];
 59:     let mut depths = [0.0; 8];
 60:     for octant in 0..8usize {
 61:         let corner = [
 62:             min[0] + if octant & 1 != 0 { size } else { 0.0 },
 63:             min[1] + if octant & 2 != 0 { size } else { 0.0 },
 64:             min[2] + if octant & 4 != 0 { size } else { 0.0 },
 65:         ];
 66:         let relative = [
 67:             corner[0] - camera.pos[0],
 68:             corner[1] - camera.pos[1],
 69:             corner[2] - camera.pos[2],
 70:         ];
 71:         let depth = dot(relative, camera.forward);
 72:         if !depth.is_finite() || relative.into_iter().any(|component| !component.is_finite()) {
 73:             return None;
 74:         }
 75:         relative_corners[octant] = relative;
 76:         depths[octant] = depth;
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     let mut screen_min = [f32::INFINITY; 2];
 80:     let mut screen_max = [f32::NEG_INFINITY; 2];
 81:     let mut include_projection = |relative: [f32; 3], depth: f32| -> Option<()> {
 82:         let inverse_depth = 1.0 / depth;
 83:         let screen = [
 84:             camera.half_w + dot(relative, camera.right) * inverse_depth * camera.focal_px,
 85:             camera.half_h - dot(relative, camera.up) * inverse_depth * camera.focal_px,
 86:         ];
 87:         if screen.into_iter().any(|coordinate| !coordinate.is_finite()) {
 88:             return None;
 89:         }
 90:         for axis in 0..2 {
 91:             screen_min[axis] = screen_min[axis].min(screen[axis]);
 92:             screen_max[axis] = screen_max[axis].max(screen[axis]);
 93:         }
 94:         Some(())
 95:     };
 96: 
 97:     for octant in 0..8usize {
 98:         if depths[octant] >= NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH {
 99:             include_projection(relative_corners[octant], depths[octant])?;
100:         }
101:     }
102: 
103: 
104: 
105: 
106:     for axis_bit in [1usize, 2, 4] {
107:         for low in 0..8usize {
108:             if low & axis_bit != 0 {
109:                 continue;
110:             }
111:             let high = low | axis_bit;
112:             let low_depth = depths[low];
113:             let high_depth = depths[high];
114:             let crosses = (low_depth < NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH && high_depth > NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH)
115:                 || (high_depth < NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH && low_depth > NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH);
116:             if !crosses {
117:                 continue;
118:             }
119:             let t = (NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH - low_depth) / (high_depth - low_depth);
120:             let intersection = [
121:                 relative_corners[low][0]
122:                     + (relative_corners[high][0] - relative_corners[low][0]) * t,
123:                 relative_corners[low][1]
124:                     + (relative_corners[high][1] - relative_corners[low][1]) * t,
125:                 relative_corners[low][2]
126:                     + (relative_corners[high][2] - relative_corners[low][2]) * t,
127:             ];
128:             include_projection(intersection, NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH)?;
129:         }
130:     }
131: 
132:     if screen_min[0] == f32::INFINITY {
133:         return None;
134:     }
135: 
136:     let center = [
137:         (screen_min[0] + screen_max[0]) * 0.5,
138:         (screen_min[1] + screen_max[1]) * 0.5,
139:     ];
140:     let half_extent = [
141:         (screen_max[0] - screen_min[0]) * 0.5,
142:         (screen_max[1] - screen_min[1]) * 0.5,
143:     ];
144:     Some(ScreenFootprint {
145:         center,
146:         half_extent,
147:         nearest_depth: nearest_depth.max(NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH),
148:     })
149: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/render_cpu_frame.rs
````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, FrameParams};
  2: 
  3: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
  4: use super::SoftwareRasterizer;
  5: use super::frame_work_budget::FrameWorkBudget;
  6: use super::project_aabb_footprint::{
  7:     NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH, aabb_camera_depth_interval, project_screen_footprint,
  8: };
  9: use super::select_lights_for_chunk::select_lights_for_chunk;
 10: 
 11: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
 12:     pub(super) fn render_cpu_frame(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
 13:         self.environment = frame.environment;
 14:         self.frame_work_budget =
 15:             FrameWorkBudget::for_target(&self.settings, self.width(), self.height());
 16:         self.clear();
 17:         self.reset_frame_telemetry();
 18:         if self.atlas.is_empty() {
 19:             return;
 20:         }
 21: 
 22:         let camera = Camera::new(frame, self.width(), self.height(), &self.settings);
 23:         let ordered_chunks = chunks_in_draw_order(
 24:             chunks,
 25:             frame.camera_pos,
 26:             self.settings.toggles.front_to_back,
 27:         );
 28: 
 29: 
 30:         let mut chunk_scene_lights = std::mem::take(&mut self.chunk_light_scratch);
 31:         let global_hero_id = frame.active_scene_lights().first().map(|light| light.id);
 32: 
 33:         for chunk in ordered_chunks {
 34: 
 35: 
 36:             if self.frame_work_budget.writes_exhausted(self.pixel_writes)
 37:                 || self.frame_work_budget.nodes_exhausted(self.visited_nodes)
 38:             {
 39:                 self.budget_exhausted = true;
 40:                 break;
 41:             }
 42:             if self.settings.toggles.distance_cull
 43:                 && !chunk_can_contribute(
 44:                     chunk,
 45:                     &camera,
 46:                     self.width(),
 47:                     self.height(),
 48:                     self.settings.max_draw_distance,
 49:                 )
 50:             {
 51:                 continue;
 52:             }
 53:             select_lights_for_chunk(frame.active_scene_lights(), chunk, &mut chunk_scene_lights);
 54:             self.traverse_voxel_chunk(&camera, chunks, chunk, &chunk_scene_lights, global_hero_id);
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         self.chunk_light_scratch = chunk_scene_lights;
 58:         self.draw_visible_flare_cores(frame, &camera);
 59:         self.hero_light_visibility.advance_frame();
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     fn reset_frame_telemetry(&mut self) {
 63:         self.visited_nodes = 0;
 64:         self.budget_exhausted = false;
 65:         self.max_virtual_depth_reached = 0;
 66:         self.splat_count = 0;
 67:         self.pixel_writes = 0;
 68:     }
 69: }
 70: 
 71: 
 72: 
 73: fn chunks_in_draw_order(
 74:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 75:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
 76:     front_to_back: bool,
 77: ) -> Vec<&ChunkDraw> {
 78:     let mut ordered: Vec<_> = chunks.iter().collect();
 79:     if front_to_back {
 80:         ordered.sort_by(|a, b| {
 81:             chunk_distance_sq(a, camera_position).total_cmp(&chunk_distance_sq(b, camera_position))
 82:         });
 83:     }
 84:     ordered
 85: }
 86: 
 87: 
 88: fn chunk_can_contribute(
 89:     chunk: &ChunkDraw,
 90:     camera: &Camera,
 91:     width: usize,
 92:     height: usize,
 93:     max_draw_distance: f32,
 94: ) -> bool {
 95:     let half_size = chunk.world_size * 0.5;
 96:     let center = [
 97:         chunk.origin[0] + half_size,
 98:         chunk.origin[1] + half_size,
 99:         chunk.origin[2] + half_size,
100:     ];
101:     let radius = chunk.world_size * 0.5 * 3.0_f32.sqrt();
102:     let relative_to_camera = [
103:         center[0] - camera.pos[0],
104:         center[1] - camera.pos[1],
105:         center[2] - camera.pos[2],
106:     ];
107: 
108:     if dot(relative_to_camera, relative_to_camera).sqrt() - radius > max_draw_distance {
109:         return false;
110:     }
111:     let depth_interval = aabb_camera_depth_interval(camera, relative_to_camera, half_size);
112:     if depth_interval[1] <= NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH {
113:         return false;
114:     }
115: 
116:     project_screen_footprint(camera, chunk.origin, chunk.world_size, depth_interval[0])
117:         .is_some_and(|footprint| !footprint.outside_framebuffer(width, height))
118: }
119: 
120: fn chunk_distance_sq(chunk: &ChunkDraw, position: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
121:     let half = chunk.world_size * 0.5;
122:     let dx = chunk.origin[0] + half - position[0];
123:     let dz = chunk.origin[2] + half - position[2];
124:     dx * dx + dz * dz
125: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/resolve_hero_light_visibility.rs
````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, LightSource};
  2: 
  3: use super::super::camera::dot;
  4: use super::super::raycast::{ray_box_interval, svo_segment_is_occluded};
  5: use super::super::settings::CpuShadowMode;
  6: use super::super::shading::HeroLightVisibility;
  7: use super::SoftwareRasterizer;
  8: 
  9: const CACHE_ENTRIES: usize = 65_536;
 10: const RETRACE_PERIOD_FRAMES: usize = 4;
 11: const MAX_RECEIVER_DISTANCE: f32 = 24.0;
 12: const RECEIVER_EXIT_BIAS: f32 = 0.02;
 13: const EMITTER_ENDPOINT_BIAS: f32 = 0.02;
 14: 
 15: const SHADOW_PIXEL_BUDGET: usize = 1_500_000;
 16: 
 17: 
 18: pub(super) struct HeroLightVisibilityCache {
 19:     samples: Vec<CachedVisibility>,
 20:     frame_index: usize,
 21: }
 22: 
 23: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
 24: struct CachedVisibility {
 25:     query_key: u64,
 26:     visibility: f32,
 27:     valid: bool,
 28: }
 29: 
 30: impl HeroLightVisibilityCache {
 31:     pub(super) fn new() -> Self {
 32:         Self {
 33:             samples: vec![CachedVisibility::default(); CACHE_ENTRIES],
 34:             frame_index: 0,
 35:         }
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     pub(super) fn advance_frame(&mut self) {
 39:         self.frame_index = self.frame_index.wrapping_add(1);
 40:     }
 41: }
 42: 
 43: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
 44: 
 45: 
 46:     pub(super) fn resolve_hero_light_visibility(
 47:         &mut self,
 48:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 49:         center: [f32; 3],
 50:         receiver_world_size: f32,
 51:         is_emissive: bool,
 52:         receiver_distance: f32,
 53:         hero: Option<&LightSource>,
 54:     ) -> Option<HeroLightVisibility> {
 55:         let hero = hero?;
 56:         let affordable =
 57:             receiver_distance <= MAX_RECEIVER_DISTANCE && self.pixel_writes < SHADOW_PIXEL_BUDGET;
 58:         if self.settings.shadows != CpuShadowMode::Hero || is_emissive || !affordable {
 59:             return None;
 60:         }
 61: 
 62:         let query_key = hash_receiver_and_light(center, receiver_world_size, hero.id);
 63:         let cache_index = query_key as usize % self.hero_light_visibility.samples.len();
 64:         let should_trace = (query_key as usize + self.hero_light_visibility.frame_index)
 65:             .is_multiple_of(RETRACE_PERIOD_FRAMES);
 66:         let cached = self.hero_light_visibility.samples[cache_index];
 67:         if !should_trace && cached.valid && cached.query_key == query_key {
 68:             return Some(HeroLightVisibility {
 69:                 light_id: hero.id,
 70:                 visibility: cached.visibility,
 71:             });
 72:         }
 73: 
 74:         let visibility = trace_hero_fixture(
 75:             &self.atlas,
 76:             chunks,
 77:             center,
 78:             receiver_world_size,
 79:             hero.position,
 80:         );
 81:         self.hero_light_visibility.samples[cache_index] = CachedVisibility {
 82:             query_key,
 83:             visibility,
 84:             valid: true,
 85:         };
 86:         Some(HeroLightVisibility {
 87:             light_id: hero.id,
 88:             visibility,
 89:         })
 90:     }
 91: }
 92: 
 93: fn hash_receiver_and_light(center: [f32; 3], world_size: f32, light_id: u64) -> u64 {
 94:     let mut key = light_id ^ 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
 95:     for value in [center[0], center[1], center[2], world_size] {
 96:         let bits = if value == 0.0 { 0 } else { value.to_bits() };
 97:         key ^= u64::from(bits);
 98:         key = key.wrapping_mul(0x0000_0100_0000_01b3);
 99:     }
100:     key ^= key >> 33;
101:     key = key.wrapping_mul(0xff51_afd7_ed55_8ccd);
102:     key ^ (key >> 33)
103: }
104: 
105: fn trace_hero_fixture(
106:     atlas: &[u32],
107:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
108:     center: [f32; 3],
109:     receiver_world_size: f32,
110:     light_position: [f32; 3],
111: ) -> f32 {
112:     let to_light = [
113:         light_position[0] - center[0],
114:         light_position[1] - center[1],
115:         light_position[2] - center[2],
116:     ];
117:     let distance_to_light = dot(to_light, to_light).sqrt();
118:     if distance_to_light <= 0.001 {
119:         return 1.0;
120:     }
121: 
122:     let inverse_distance = 1.0 / distance_to_light;
123:     let direction = to_light.map(|component| component * inverse_distance);
124:     let receiver_half = receiver_world_size * 0.5;
125:     let receiver_min = center.map(|coordinate| coordinate - receiver_half);
126:     let receiver_max = center.map(|coordinate| coordinate + receiver_half);
127:     let Some(receiver_interval) = ray_box_interval(center, direction, receiver_min, receiver_max)
128:     else {
129:         return 1.0;
130:     };
131:     let origin_offset = receiver_interval.exit.max(0.0) + RECEIVER_EXIT_BIAS;
132:     let trace_length = distance_to_light - origin_offset - EMITTER_ENDPOINT_BIAS;
133:     if trace_length <= 0.0 {
134:         return 1.0;
135:     }
136:     let origin = [
137:         center[0] + direction[0] * origin_offset,
138:         center[1] + direction[1] * origin_offset,
139:         center[2] + direction[2] * origin_offset,
140:     ];
141:     if svo_segment_is_occluded(atlas, chunks, origin, direction, trace_length) {
142:         0.0
143:     } else {
144:         1.0
145:     }
146: }
147:
````
