````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, LightKind, LightSource};
  2: 
  3: pub(super) fn select_lights_for_chunk(
  4:     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
  5:     chunk: &ChunkDraw,
  6:     selected: &mut Vec<LightSource>,
  7: ) {
  8:     selected.clear();
  9:     selected.extend(
 10:         scene_lights
 11:             .iter()
 12:             .copied()
 13:             .filter(|light| light_can_reach_chunk(light, chunk)),
 14:     );
 15: }
 16: 
 17: fn light_can_reach_chunk(light: &LightSource, chunk: &ChunkDraw) -> bool {
 18:     if !light.enabled
 19:         || !light.radius.is_finite()
 20:         || light.radius <= 0.0
 21:         || light
 22:             .position
 23:             .iter()
 24:             .any(|coordinate| !coordinate.is_finite())
 25:     {
 26:         return false;
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     let emitter_half_size = match light.kind {
 30:         LightKind::Point => [0.0, 0.0],
 31:         LightKind::CeilingPanel | LightKind::Strip | LightKind::Emergency => {
 32:             if light
 33:                 .half_size
 34:                 .iter()
 35:                 .any(|half| !half.is_finite() || *half <= 0.0)
 36:             {
 37:                 return false;
 38:             }
 39:             light.half_size
 40:         }
 41:     };
 42: 
 43:     let chunk_max = chunk.origin.map(|minimum| minimum + chunk.world_size);
 44:     let dx = interval_distance(
 45:         light.position[0] - emitter_half_size[0],
 46:         light.position[0] + emitter_half_size[0],
 47:         chunk.origin[0],
 48:         chunk_max[0],
 49:     );
 50:     let dy = point_interval_distance(light.position[1], chunk.origin[1], chunk_max[1]);
 51:     let dz = interval_distance(
 52:         light.position[2] - emitter_half_size[1],
 53:         light.position[2] + emitter_half_size[1],
 54:         chunk.origin[2],
 55:         chunk_max[2],
 56:     );
 57:     dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= light.radius * light.radius
 58: }
 59: 
 60: fn interval_distance(a_min: f32, a_max: f32, b_min: f32, b_max: f32) -> f32 {
 61:     if a_max < b_min {
 62:         b_min - a_max
 63:     } else if b_max < a_min {
 64:         a_min - b_max
 65:     } else {
 66:         0.0
 67:     }
 68: }
 69: 
 70: fn point_interval_distance(point: f32, minimum: f32, maximum: f32) -> f32 {
 71:     if point < minimum {
 72:         minimum - point
 73:     } else if point > maximum {
 74:         point - maximum
 75:     } else {
 76:         0.0
 77:     }
 78: }
````

````rust
184:                     || (splat.equal_depth_wins && reciprocal_depth == stored)
185:                 {

196:                     pixel_writes += 1;

198:                         self.record_first_coverage(x, y);
199:                     }
200:                 }
201:             }
202:         }

204:         SplatWrite {
205:             pixel_writes,

246:     ) -> bool {
247:         let lower_tile = |value: f32, tiles: usize| {
248:             ((value.max(0.0) as usize) / COARSE_TILE).min(tiles.saturating_sub(1))
249:         };
250:

253:         let upper_tile = |value: f32, tiles: usize| {

255:                 .min(tiles.saturating_sub(1))
256:         };
257:         let x0 = lower_tile((center[0] - half_extent[0]).floor(), self.coarse_width);
258:         let x1 = upper_tile(center[0] + half_extent[0], self.coarse_width);
259:         let y0 = lower_tile((center[1] - half_extent[1]).floor(), self.coarse_height);
260:         let y1 = upper_tile(center[1] + half_extent[1], self.coarse_height);
261:         if !z_near.is_finite() || z_near <= 0.0 {
262:             return false;
263:         }

266:         for tile_y in y0..=y1 {

268:                 if reciprocal_near
269:                     >= self.coarse_reciprocal_depth[tile_y * self.coarse_width + tile_x]
270:                 {
271:                     return false;
272:                 }
273:             }
274:         }
275:         true
276:     }
````

````rust
 16: fn finite_clamp(value: f32, fallback: f32, limits: (f32, f32)) -> f32 {
 17:     if value.is_finite() {
 18:         value.clamp(limits.0, limits.1)
 19:     } else {
 20:         fallback
 21:     }
 22: }
 23: 
 24: impl CpuRenderSettings {
 25: 
 26:     pub fn validated(mut self) -> Self {
 27:         let fallback = Self::default();
 28:         self.internal_scale = finite_clamp(
 29:             self.internal_scale,
 30:             fallback.internal_scale,
 31:             CpuSettingsLimits::INTERNAL_SCALE,
 32:         );
 33:         self.lod_cutoff_px = finite_clamp(
 34:             self.lod_cutoff_px,
 35:             fallback.lod_cutoff_px,
 36:             CpuSettingsLimits::LOD_CUTOFF_PX,
 37:         );
 38:         self.max_splat_radius_px = finite_clamp(
 39:             self.max_splat_radius_px,
 40:             fallback.max_splat_radius_px,
 41:             CpuSettingsLimits::MAX_SPLAT_RADIUS_PX,
 42:         );
 43:         self.max_virtual_depth = self.max_virtual_depth.clamp(
 44:             CpuSettingsLimits::MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH.0,
 45:             CpuSettingsLimits::MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH.1,
 46:         );
 47:         self.min_split_size = finite_clamp(
 48:             self.min_split_size,
 49:             fallback.min_split_size,
 50:             CpuSettingsLimits::MIN_SPLIT_SIZE,
 51:         );
 52:         self.max_draw_distance = finite_clamp(
 53:             self.max_draw_distance,
 54:             fallback.max_draw_distance,
 55:             CpuSettingsLimits::MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE,
 56:         );
 57:         self.min_mip_occupancy = finite_clamp(
 58:             self.min_mip_occupancy,
 59:             fallback.min_mip_occupancy,
 60:             CpuSettingsLimits::MIN_MIP_OCCUPANCY,
 61:         );
 62:         self.fov_tan = finite_clamp(self.fov_tan, fallback.fov_tan, CpuSettingsLimits::FOV_TAN);
 63:         self
 64:     }
 65: 
 66: 
 67: 
 68:
````

````rust
 9: pub(super) fn ambient_irradiance(environment: &Environment) -> LinearRgb {

11:         OUTDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE
12:     } else {
13:         INDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE

22:     (1.0 - 0.055 * neighbors).clamp(0.62, 1.0)
23: }

25: pub(super) fn cached_fill_irradiance(
26:     surface: &SplatSurface,

30:         return [0.0; 3];
31:     }
32:     surface
33:         .baked_irradiance
34:         .map(|channel| (channel / 15.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * CACHED_DIFFUSE_FILL_GAIN)
````

````rust
 6: pub(super) fn dynamic_irradiance(
 7:     cam: &Camera,
 8:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
 9:     normal: [f32; 3],
10: ) -> LinearRgb {
11:     let mut sum = [0.0; 3];
12:     for light in &cam.dynamic_lights[..cam.dynamic_light_count] {
13:         let contribution = point_light_irradiance(
14:             surface_position,

17:             light.color,
18:             light.radius,
19:             light.intensity,
20:         );
21:         for channel in 0..3 {
22:             sum[channel] += contribution[channel];
23:         }
24:     }

26: }
````

````rust
 5: pub(crate) fn emission_strength(base_color: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
 6:     let near = |reference: [f32; 3]| {
 7:         base_color
 8:             .into_iter()
 9:             .zip(reference)
10:             .all(|(actual, expected)| (actual - expected).abs() <= 0.5)
11:     };
12:     if near([255.0, 248.0, 214.0]) {
13:         10.0
14:     } else if near([255.0, 68.0, 51.0]) {
15:         8.0
16:     } else if near([159.0, 196.0, 232.0]) {
17:         0.9
18:     } else {
19:         1.0
20:     }
21: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/shading/evaluate_fixture_irradiance.rs
````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::{LightKind, LightSource};
  2: use crate::application::rendering::{LinearRgb, finite_range_inverse_square_attenuation};
  3: 
  4: use super::super::camera::dot;
  5: use super::FrameLighting;
  6: use super::trace_direct_light_visibility::DirectLightVisibility;
  7: 
  8: const GAUSS_ABSCISSA: f32 = 0.577_350_26;
  9: const MINIMUM_LIGHT_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.2;
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: fn rectangle_can_contribute(
 15:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
 16:     normal: [f32; 3],
 17:     light: &LightSource,
 18: ) -> bool {
 19:     if !light.radius.is_finite() || light.radius <= 0.0 {
 20:         return false;
 21:     }
 22:     let center_delta = [
 23:         light.position[0] - surface_position[0],
 24:         light.position[1] - surface_position[1],
 25:         light.position[2] - surface_position[2],
 26:     ];
 27:     if center_delta
 28:         .into_iter()
 29:         .chain(normal)
 30:         .any(|component| !component.is_finite())
 31:     {
 32:         return false;
 33:     }
 34: 
 35: 
 36: 
 37:     if center_delta[1] <= 0.0 {
 38:         return false;
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     let sample_extent_x = GAUSS_ABSCISSA * light.half_size[0];
 42:     let sample_extent_z = GAUSS_ABSCISSA * light.half_size[1];
 43:     let nearest_x = (center_delta[0].abs() - sample_extent_x).max(0.0);
 44:     let nearest_z = (center_delta[2].abs() - sample_extent_z).max(0.0);
 45:     let nearest_squared =
 46:         nearest_x * nearest_x + center_delta[1] * center_delta[1] + nearest_z * nearest_z;
 47:     if nearest_squared >= light.radius * light.radius {
 48:         return false;
 49:     }
 50: 
 51: 
 52: 
 53:     let maximum_receiver_dot = dot(normal, center_delta)
 54:         + normal[0].abs() * sample_extent_x
 55:         + normal[2].abs() * sample_extent_z;
 56:     maximum_receiver_dot > 0.0
 57: }
 58: 
 59: fn sanitized_light_scale(color: LinearRgb, intensity: f32) -> LinearRgb {
 60:     if !intensity.is_finite() || intensity <= 0.0 {
 61:         return [0.0; 3];
 62:     }
 63:     color.map(|channel| {
 64:         if channel.is_finite() {
 65:             channel.max(0.0) * intensity
 66:         } else {
 67:             0.0
 68:         }
 69:     })
 70: }
 71: 
 72: fn normalized(vector: [f32; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
 73:     if vector.into_iter().any(|component| !component.is_finite()) {
 74:         return None;
 75:     }
 76:     let scale = vector
 77:         .into_iter()
 78:         .fold(0.0_f32, |largest, component| largest.max(component.abs()));
 79:     if scale == 0.0 {
 80:         return None;
 81:     }
 82:     let scaled = vector.map(|component| component / scale);
 83:     let length = dot(scaled, scaled).sqrt();
 84:     Some(scaled.map(|component| component / length))
 85: }
 86: 
 87: 
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91: pub(super) fn sample_geometry(
 92:     receiver_normal: [f32; 3],
 93:     surface_to_light: [f32; 3],
 94: ) -> Option<(f32, f32, f32)> {
 95:     let distance = dot(surface_to_light, surface_to_light).sqrt();
 96:     if !distance.is_finite() || distance <= 0.0 {
 97:         return None;
 98:     }
 99:     let inverse_distance = 1.0 / distance;
100:     let direction = surface_to_light.map(|component| component * inverse_distance);
101:     let receiver_cosine = dot(receiver_normal, direction).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
102: 
103: 
104:     let downward_emitter_cosine = direction[1].clamp(0.0, 1.0);
105:     Some((distance, receiver_cosine, downward_emitter_cosine))
106: }
107: 
108: pub(super) fn point_light_irradiance(
109:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
110:     normal: [f32; 3],
111:     light_position: [f32; 3],
112:     color: LinearRgb,
113:     range: f32,
114:     intensity: f32,
115: ) -> LinearRgb {
116:     let delta = [
117:         light_position[0] - surface_position[0],
118:         light_position[1] - surface_position[1],
119:         light_position[2] - surface_position[2],
120:     ];
121:     let distance_squared = dot(delta, delta);
122:     if !range.is_finite()
123:         || range <= 0.0
124:         || !distance_squared.is_finite()
125:         || distance_squared >= range * range
126:     {
127:         return [0.0; 3];
128:     }
129:     let Some(normal) = normalized(normal) else {
130:         return [0.0; 3];
131:     };
132:     let Some((distance, geometry, _)) = sample_geometry(normal, delta) else {
133:         return [0.0; 3];
134:     };
135:     let attenuation =
136:         finite_range_inverse_square_attenuation(distance, range, MINIMUM_LIGHT_DISTANCE);
137:     let scale = sanitized_light_scale(color, intensity);
138:     scale.map(|channel| channel * geometry * attenuation)
139: }
140: 
141: 
142: #[cfg(test)]
143: pub(super) fn rectangle_light_irradiance(
144:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
145:     normal: [f32; 3],
146:     light: &LightSource,
147: ) -> LinearRgb {
148:     rectangle_light_irradiance_with_visibility(
149:         surface_position,
150:         normal,
151:         light,
152:         DirectLightVisibility::unoccluded(),
153:     )
154: }
155: 
156: fn rectangle_light_irradiance_with_visibility(
157:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
158:     normal: [f32; 3],
159:     light: &LightSource,
160:     visibility: DirectLightVisibility<'_>,
161: ) -> LinearRgb {
162:     let [half_x, half_z] = light.half_size;
163:     if !half_x.is_finite() || !half_z.is_finite() || half_x <= 0.0 || half_z <= 0.0 {
164:         return [0.0; 3];
165:     }
166:     if !rectangle_can_contribute(surface_position, normal, light) {
167:         return [0.0; 3];
168:     }
169:     let mut integral = 0.0;
170:     for x in [-GAUSS_ABSCISSA, GAUSS_ABSCISSA] {
171:         for z in [-GAUSS_ABSCISSA, GAUSS_ABSCISSA] {
172:             let sample = [
173:                 light.position[0] + x * half_x,
174:                 light.position[1],
175:                 light.position[2] + z * half_z,
176:             ];
177:             let surface_to_light = [
178:                 sample[0] - surface_position[0],
179:                 sample[1] - surface_position[1],
180:                 sample[2] - surface_position[2],
181:             ];
182:             let Some((distance, receiver_cosine, emitter_cosine)) =
183:                 sample_geometry(normal, surface_to_light)
184:             else {
185:                 continue;
186:             };
187:             if receiver_cosine <= 0.0
188:                 || emitter_cosine <= 0.0
189:                 || !visibility.sample_is_visible(surface_position, normal, sample)
190:             {
191:                 continue;
192:             }
193:             integral += receiver_cosine
194:                 * emitter_cosine
195:                 * finite_range_inverse_square_attenuation(
196:                     distance,
197:                     light.radius,
198:                     MINIMUM_LIGHT_DISTANCE,
199:                 );
200:         }
201:     }
202:     let area = 4.0 * half_x * half_z;
203:     let scale = sanitized_light_scale(light.color, light.intensity);
204:     scale.map(|channel| channel * area * integral * 0.25)
205: }
206: 
207: fn scene_light_irradiance(
208:     light: &LightSource,
209:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
210:     normal: [f32; 3],
211:     visibility: DirectLightVisibility<'_>,
212: ) -> LinearRgb {
213:     if !light.enabled {
214:         return [0.0; 3];
215:     }
216:     match light.kind {
217:         LightKind::Point => {
218:             let contribution = point_light_irradiance(
219:                 surface_position,
220:                 normal,
221:                 light.position,
222:                 light.color,
223:                 light.radius,
224:                 light.intensity,
225:             );
226:             if contribution != [0.0; 3]
227:                 && !visibility.sample_is_visible(surface_position, normal, light.position)
228:             {
229:                 [0.0; 3]
230:             } else {
231:                 contribution
232:             }
233:         }
234:         LightKind::CeilingPanel | LightKind::Strip | LightKind::Emergency => {
235:             rectangle_light_irradiance_with_visibility(surface_position, normal, light, visibility)
236:         }
237:     }
238: }
239:

241: pub(super) fn fixture_irradiance(
242:     lighting: FrameLighting<'_>,

245: ) -> LinearRgb {
246:     fixture_irradiance_with_visibility(
247:         lighting,
248:         surface_position,
249:         normal,
250:         DirectLightVisibility::unoccluded(),
251:     )
252: }
253: 
254: pub(super) fn fixture_irradiance_with_visibility(
255:     lighting: FrameLighting<'_>,
256:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
257:     normal: [f32; 3],
258:     direct_visibility: DirectLightVisibility<'_>,
259: ) -> LinearRgb {
260:     let mut sum = [0.0; 3];
261:     for light in lighting.scene_lights {
262:         let visibility = lighting
263:             .hero_visibility
264:             .filter(|hero| hero.light_id == light.id)
265:             .map_or(1.0, |hero| hero.visibility.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
266:         let contribution =
267:             scene_light_irradiance(light, surface_position, normal, direct_visibility);
268:         for channel in 0..3 {
269:             sum[channel] += contribution[channel] * visibility;
270:         }
271:     }
272:     sum
273: }
````

````rust
 1: use crate::application::ports::Environment;
 2: use crate::application::rendering::{
 3:     LinearRgb, compose_fog, encode_display_color, fog_transmittance,
 4: };
 5: 
 6: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
 7: use super::SplatSurface;
 8: 
 9: pub(super) fn view_distance(
10:     cam: &Camera,
11:     surface: &SplatSurface,
12:     surface_position: [f32; 3],
13: ) -> f32 {
14:     let delta = [
15:         surface_position[0] - cam.pos[0],
16:         surface_position[1] - cam.pos[1],
17:         surface_position[2] - cam.pos[2],
18:     ];
19:     let distance = dot(delta, delta).sqrt();
20:     if distance.is_finite() {
21:         distance
22:     } else {
23:         surface.dist.max(0.0)
24:     }
25: }
26: 
27: pub(super) fn present_radiance(
28:     radiance: LinearRgb,
29:     distance: f32,
30:     environment: &Environment,
31: ) -> [u8; 3] {
32:     let transmittance = fog_transmittance(distance, environment.fog_start, environment.fog_density);
33:     let through_fog = compose_fog(radiance, environment.fog_color, transmittance);
34:     encode_display_color(through_fog)
35:         .map(|channel| (channel * 255.0).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8)
36: }
````

````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, Environment};
  2: use crate::application::rendering::{DIFFUSE_REFLECTANCE_INV_PI, LinearRgb};
  3: 
  4: use super::super::camera::Camera;
  5: use super::super::flashlight;
  6: use super::super::settings::{CpuRenderSettings, CpuShadowMode};
  7: use super::compose_environment_irradiance::{

  9: };

 11: use super::evaluate_emission::{emission_strength, emitted_radiance_with_strength};
 12: use super::evaluate_fixture_irradiance::fixture_irradiance_with_visibility;
 13: use super::present_radiance::{present_radiance, view_distance};
 14: use super::surface_reconstruction::{

 16: };
 17: use super::trace_direct_light_visibility::DirectLightVisibility;

 19: 
 20: 
 21: pub fn shade_with_frame_lighting(
 22:     cam: &Camera,
 23:     environment: &Environment,
 24:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
 25:     atlas: &[u32],
 26:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 27:     lighting: FrameLighting<'_>,
 28:     surface: &SplatSurface,
 29: ) -> [u8; 3] {
 30:     shade_predecoded_with_frame_lighting(
 31:         cam,
 32:         environment,
 33:         settings,
 34:         atlas,
 35:         chunks,
 36:         lighting,
 37:         surface,
 38:         decode_albedo(surface.base_color),
 39:         surface
 40:             .is_emissive
 41:             .then(|| emission_strength(surface.base_color)),
 42:     )
 43: }
 44: 
 45: /// Hot production path. Atlas upload already decoded authored sRGB and MIP
 46: /// filtering already averaged in linear space, so shading consumes the
 47: /// prepared albedo without repeating transfer-function powers per splat.
 48: pub(crate) fn shade_predecoded_with_frame_lighting(
 49:     cam: &Camera,
 50:     environment: &Environment,
 51:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
 52:     atlas: &[u32],
 53:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 54:     lighting: FrameLighting<'_>,
 55:     surface: &SplatSurface,
 56:     albedo: LinearRgb,
 57:     emission_strength: Option<f32>,
 58: ) -> [u8; 3] {
 59:     let camera_to_surface = [
 60:         surface.center[0] - cam.pos[0],
 61:         surface.center[1] - cam.pos[1],
 62:         surface.center[2] - cam.pos[2],
 63:     ];
 64:     let reconstructed_normal = representative_normal(surface, camera_to_surface);
 65:     let normal = reconstructed_normal.unwrap_or([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]);
 66:     let surface_position =
 67:         representative_surface_position(surface.center, surface.world_size, normal);
 68:     let distance = view_distance(cam, surface, surface_position);
 69: 
 70:     if let Some(emission) =
 71:         emitted_radiance_with_strength(surface, albedo, normal, emission_strength)
 72:     {
 73:         return present_radiance(emission, distance, environment);
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     let ambient_visibility = if settings.toggles.ambient_occlusion {
 77:         ambient_visibility(surface.crowded_siblings)
 78:     } else {
 79:         1.0
 80:     };
 81:     let mut irradiance =
 82:         ambient_irradiance(environment).map(|channel| channel * ambient_visibility);
 83: 
 84: 
 85: 
 86:     let cached = cached_fill_irradiance(surface, settings);
 87:     let direct_visibility = if settings.shadows == CpuShadowMode::Full {
 88:         DirectLightVisibility::trace_scene(atlas, chunks, surface.world_size)
 89:     } else {
 90:         DirectLightVisibility::unoccluded()
 91:     };
 92:     let fixtures =
 93:         fixture_irradiance_with_visibility(lighting, surface_position, normal, direct_visibility);
 94:     let dynamics = dynamic_irradiance(cam, surface_position, normal);
 95:     let flashlight = if cam.flashlight && reconstructed_normal.is_some() {
 96:         flashlight::beam_contribution(
 97:             cam,
 98:             atlas,
 99:             chunks,
100:             flashlight::BeamReceiver::surface_sample(
101:                 surface.center,
102:                 surface.world_size,
103:                 surface_position,
104:                 normal,
105:             ),
106:             settings.flashlight_visibility(),
107:         )
108:     } else {
109:         [0.0; 3]
110:     };
111: 
112:     for channel in 0..3 {
113:         irradiance[channel] +=
114:             cached[channel] + fixtures[channel] + dynamics[channel] + flashlight[channel];
115:     }
116:     let reflected = [
117:         albedo[0] * irradiance[0] * DIFFUSE_REFLECTANCE_INV_PI,
118:         albedo[1] * irradiance[1] * DIFFUSE_REFLECTANCE_INV_PI,
119:         albedo[2] * irradiance[2] * DIFFUSE_REFLECTANCE_INV_PI,
120:     ];
121:     present_radiance(reflected, distance, environment)
122: }
````

````rust
 1: use crate::application::ports::ChunkDraw;
 2: 
 3: use super::super::camera::dot;
 4: use super::super::raycast::svo_segment_is_occluded;
 5: 
 6: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
 7: pub(super) struct DirectLightVisibility<'a> {
 8:     atlas: &'a [u32],
 9:     chunks: &'a [ChunkDraw],
10:     receiver_world_size: f32,
11:     trace_scene: bool,
12: }
13: 
14: impl<'a> DirectLightVisibility<'a> {
15:     pub(super) fn unoccluded() -> Self {
16:         Self {
17:             atlas: &[],
18:             chunks: &[],
19:             receiver_world_size: 0.0,
20:             trace_scene: false,
21:         }
22:     }
23: 
24:     pub(super) fn trace_scene(
25:         atlas: &'a [u32],
26:         chunks: &'a [ChunkDraw],
27:         receiver_world_size: f32,
28:     ) -> Self {
29:         Self {
30:             atlas,
31:             chunks,
32:             receiver_world_size,
33:             trace_scene: true,
34:         }
35:     }
36: 
37:     pub(super) fn sample_is_visible(
38:         self,
39:         surface_position: [f32; 3],
40:         surface_normal: [f32; 3],
41:         sample_position: [f32; 3],
42:     ) -> bool {
43:         if !self.trace_scene {
44:             return true;
45:         }
46: 
47:         let bias = (self.receiver_world_size.abs() * 1.0e-3).max(1.0e-5);
48:         let origin = [
49:             surface_position[0] + surface_normal[0] * bias,
50:             surface_position[1] + surface_normal[1] * bias,
51:             surface_position[2] + surface_normal[2] * bias,
52:         ];
53:         let segment = [
54:             sample_position[0] - origin[0],
55:             sample_position[1] - origin[1],
56:             sample_position[2] - origin[2],
57:         ];
58:         let segment_length = dot(segment, segment).sqrt();
59:         if !segment_length.is_finite() || segment_length <= bias * 2.0 {
60:             return true;
61:         }
62:         let inverse_length = 1.0 / segment_length;
63:         let direction = segment.map(|component| component * inverse_length);
64:         let blocker_limit = segment_length - bias * 2.0;
65:         !svo_segment_is_occluded(self.atlas, self.chunks, origin, direction, blocker_limit)
66:     }
67: }
68:
````

````rust
  1: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
  2: use super::{SurfaceExposure, select_surface_normal};
  3: 
  4: 
  5: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  6: pub(crate) struct ProjectedSurfaceDepth {
  7:     representative_depth: f32,
  8: 
  9:     reciprocal_depth: [f32; 3],
 10: }
 11: 
 12: impl ProjectedSurfaceDepth {
 13: 
 14: 
 15:     pub(crate) fn constant(depth: f32) -> Self {
 16:         Self {
 17:             representative_depth: depth,
 18:             reciprocal_depth: [0.0, 0.0, depth.recip()],
 19:         }
 20:     }
 21: 
 22:     pub(crate) fn representative_depth(self) -> f32 {
 23:         self.representative_depth
 24:     }
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29:     pub(crate) fn reciprocal_at_pixel(self, pixel: [f32; 2]) -> Option<f32> {
 30:         let inverse_depth = self.reciprocal_depth[0].mul_add(
 31:             pixel[0],
 32:             self.reciprocal_depth[1].mul_add(pixel[1], self.reciprocal_depth[2]),
 33:         );
 34:         if !inverse_depth.is_finite() || inverse_depth <= 0.0 {
 35:             return None;
 36:         }
 37:         Some(inverse_depth)
 38:     }
 39: }
 40: 
 41: 
 42: pub(crate) fn project_surface_depth(
 43:     camera: &Camera,
 44:     center: [f32; 3],
 45:     world_size: f32,
 46:     voxel_type: u32,
 47:     is_emissive: bool,
 48:     exposure: SurfaceExposure,
 49: ) -> Option<ProjectedSurfaceDepth> {
 50:     let camera_to_surface = [
 51:         center[0] - camera.pos[0],
 52:         center[1] - camera.pos[1],
 53:         center[2] - camera.pos[2],
 54:     ];
 55:     let normal = select_surface_normal(voxel_type, is_emissive, exposure, camera_to_surface)?;
 56:     let position = representative_surface_position(center, world_size, normal);
 57:     let position_from_camera = [
 58:         position[0] - camera.pos[0],
 59:         position[1] - camera.pos[1],
 60:         position[2] - camera.pos[2],
 61:     ];
 62:     let representative_depth = dot(position_from_camera, camera.forward);
 63:     let plane_offset = dot(normal, position_from_camera);
 64:     if !representative_depth.is_finite()
 65:         || representative_depth <= 0.0
 66:         || !plane_offset.is_finite()
 67:         || plane_offset.abs() <= 1.0e-8
 68:         || !camera.focal_px.is_finite()
 69:         || camera.focal_px <= 0.0
 70:     {
 71:         return None;
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     let normal_right = dot(normal, camera.right);
 75:     let normal_up = dot(normal, camera.up);
 76:     let reciprocal_scale = (camera.focal_px * plane_offset).recip();
 77:     let reciprocal_depth = [
 78:         normal_right * reciprocal_scale,
 79:         -normal_up * reciprocal_scale,
 80:         dot(normal, camera.forward) / plane_offset
 81:             + (-normal_right * camera.half_w + normal_up * camera.half_h) * reciprocal_scale,
 82:     ];
 83:     if reciprocal_depth
 84:         .into_iter()
 85:         .any(|coefficient| !coefficient.is_finite())
 86:     {
 87:         return None;
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     Some(ProjectedSurfaceDepth {
 91:         representative_depth,
 92:         reciprocal_depth,
 93:     })
 94: }
 95: 
 96: 
 97: 
 98: pub(crate) fn representative_surface_position(
 99:     center: [f32; 3],
100:     world_size: f32,
101:     normal: [f32; 3],
102: ) -> [f32; 3] {
103:     let dominant = normal
104:         .into_iter()
105:         .fold(0.0_f32, |largest, component| largest.max(component.abs()));
106:     if !world_size.is_finite() || world_size <= 0.0 || dominant <= 1.0e-6 {
107:         return center;
108:     }
109:     let distance_to_boundary = world_size * 0.5 / dominant;
110:     [
111:         center[0] + normal[0] * distance_to_boundary,
112:         center[1] + normal[1] * distance_to_boundary,
113:         center[2] + normal[2] * distance_to_boundary,
114:     ]
115: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/surface_geometry/propagate_exposure_to_octant.rs
````rust
 1: use super::{SurfaceExposure, SurfaceFace};
 2: 
 3: 
 4: 
 5: 
 6: 
 7: 
 8: 
 9: 
10: pub(crate) fn exposure_for_octant(
11:     parent: SurfaceExposure,
12:     occupied_siblings: u32,
13:     octant: u32,
14: ) -> SurfaceExposure {
15:     debug_assert!(octant < 8);
16:     let mut result = SurfaceExposure::NONE;
17: 
18:     for face in SurfaceFace::ALL {
19:         let bit = face.axis_bit();
20:         let child_on_positive_side = octant & bit != 0;
21:         let child_on_parent_face = child_on_positive_side == face.is_positive();
22:         let area = if child_on_parent_face {
23:             parent.area(face)
24:         } else {
25:             let adjacent_octant = octant ^ bit;
26:             if occupied_siblings & (1 << adjacent_octant) == 0 {
27:                 255
28:             } else {
29:                 0
30:             }
31:         };
32:         result.set_area(face, area);
33:     }
34: 
35:     result
36: }
````

````rust
16:     }
17:     let voxel_type = u8::try_from(voxel_type).ok()?;
18:     match voxel_type {
19:         VOXEL_FLOOR | VOXEL_DRY_CARPET | VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET | VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET | VOXEL_GRASS
20:         | VOXEL_WATER | VOXEL_FLUID => Some(SurfaceFace::PositiveY),
21:         VOXEL_CEILING => Some(SurfaceFace::NegativeY),
22:         _ => None,
23:     }
24: }

38: ) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
39:     if exposure.is_empty()
40:         || camera_to_surface
41:             .into_iter()
42:             .any(|component| !component.is_finite())
43:     {
44:         return None;
45:     }
46: 
47:     if let Some(face) = material_face(voxel_type, is_emissive) {
48:         let normal = face.normal();
49:         let facing = -(normal[0] * camera_to_surface[0]
50:             + normal[1] * camera_to_surface[1]
51:             + normal[2] * camera_to_surface[2]);
52:         if exposure.contains(face) && facing > 1.0e-6 {
53:             return Some(face.normal());
54:         }
55:     }
56: 
57:     let mut best: Option<(f32, u8, SurfaceFace)> = None;
58:     for face in SurfaceFace::ALL {
59:         let area = exposure.area(face);
60:         if area == 0 {
61:             continue;
62:         }
63:         let normal = face.normal();
64:         let facing = -(normal[0] * camera_to_surface[0]
65:             + normal[1] * camera_to_surface[1]
66:             + normal[2] * camera_to_surface[2]);
67:         if facing <= 1.0e-6 {
68:             continue;
69:         }
70:         let candidate = (facing, area, face);
71:         let replace = best.is_none_or(|current| {
72:             candidate.0 > current.0 || (candidate.0 == current.0 && candidate.1 > current.1)
73:         });
74:         if replace {
75:             best = Some(candidate);
76:         }
77:     }
78:     best.map(|(_, _, face)| face.normal())
79: }
````

````rust
 12: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 13: pub enum SurfaceFace {
 14:     NegativeX = 0,
 15:     PositiveX = 1,
 16:     NegativeY = 2,
 17:     PositiveY = 3,
 18:     NegativeZ = 4,
 19:     PositiveZ = 5,
 20: }
 21: 
 22: impl SurfaceFace {
 23:     pub const ALL: [Self; 6] = [
 24:         Self::NegativeX,
 25:         Self::PositiveX,
 26:         Self::NegativeY,
 27:         Self::PositiveY,
 28:         Self::NegativeZ,
 29:         Self::PositiveZ,
 30:     ];
 31: 
 32:     pub const fn normal(self) -> [f32; 3] {
 33:         match self {
 34:             Self::NegativeX => [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
 35:             Self::PositiveX => [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
 36:             Self::NegativeY => [0.0, -1.0, 0.0],
 37:             Self::PositiveY => [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],
 38:             Self::NegativeZ => [0.0, 0.0, -1.0],
 39:             Self::PositiveZ => [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
 40:         }
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     pub const fn opposite(self) -> Self {
 44:         match self {
 45:             Self::NegativeX => Self::PositiveX,
 46:             Self::PositiveX => Self::NegativeX,
 47:             Self::NegativeY => Self::PositiveY,
 48:             Self::PositiveY => Self::NegativeY,
 49:             Self::NegativeZ => Self::PositiveZ,
 50:             Self::PositiveZ => Self::NegativeZ,
 51:         }
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     pub(super) const fn axis_bit(self) -> u32 {
 55:         match self {
 56:             Self::NegativeX | Self::PositiveX => 1,
 57:             Self::NegativeY | Self::PositiveY => 2,
 58:             Self::NegativeZ | Self::PositiveZ => 4,
 59:         }
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     pub(super) const fn is_positive(self) -> bool {
 63:         matches!(self, Self::PositiveX | Self::PositiveY | Self::PositiveZ)
 64:     }
 65: }
 66: 
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71: 
 72: 
 73: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
 74: pub struct SurfaceExposure {
 75:     area: [u8; 6],
 76: }
 77: 
 78: impl SurfaceExposure {
 79:     pub const NONE: Self = Self { area: [0; 6] };
 80:     pub const ALL_FACES: Self = Self { area: [255; 6] };
 81: 
 82:     pub const fn from_area(area: [u8; 6]) -> Self {
 83:         Self { area }
 84:     }
 85: 
 86: 
 87: 
 88:     pub const fn from_neighbor_occlusion(mask: u8) -> Self {
 89:         Self::from_area([
 90:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_X),
 91:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_X),
 92:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Y),
 93:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Y),
 94:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Z),
 95:             exposed_area(mask, FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Z),
 96:         ])
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     pub fn area(self, face: SurfaceFace) -> u8 {
100:         self.area[face as usize]
101:     }
102: 
103:     pub fn contains(self, face: SurfaceFace) -> bool {
104:         self.area(face) != 0
105:     }
106: 
107:     pub(super) fn set_area(&mut self, face: SurfaceFace, area: u8) {
108:         self.area[face as usize] = area;
109:     }
110: 
111:     pub(crate) fn add_saturating(&mut self, other: Self) {
112:         for face in SurfaceFace::ALL {
113:             let index = face as usize;
114:             self.area[index] = self.area[index].saturating_add(other.area[index]);
115:         }
116:     }
117: 
118:     pub(super) fn is_empty(self) -> bool {
119:         self.area == [0; 6]
120:     }
121: 
122: 
123: 
124:     pub(crate) fn scaled_to_parent(self) -> Self {
125:         Self::from_area(self.area.map(|area| ((u16::from(area) + 2) / 4) as u8))
126:     }
127: }
128: 
129: const fn exposed_area(mask: u8, neighbor_bit: u8) -> u8 {
130:     if mask & neighbor_bit == 0 { 255 } else { 0 }
131: }
````

````rust
 54: pub fn decode_node(atlas: &[u32], node_idx: usize) -> Option<DecodedNode> {
 55:     let t = node_idx * 4;
 56:     if t + 3 >= atlas.len() {
 57:         return None;
 58:     }
 59:     let is_leaf = atlas[t] == 1;
 60:     if is_leaf {
 61:         let packed_color = atlas[t + 2];
 62:         let packed_lighting = atlas[t + 3];
 63:         Some(DecodedNode {
 64:             is_leaf: true,
 65:             child_base: 0,
 66:             child_mask: 0,
 67:             voxel_type: atlas[t + 1],
 68:             color: [
 69:                 ((packed_color >> 16) & 0xFF) as f32,
 70:                 ((packed_color >> 8) & 0xFF) as f32,
 71:                 (packed_color & 0xFF) as f32,
 72:             ],
 73:             light: (packed_lighting & 0xFF) as f32,
 74:             baked_rgb: decode_baked_rgb(packed_lighting),
 75:             exposure: decode_surface_exposure(packed_lighting),
 76:         })
 77:     } else {
 78:         Some(DecodedNode {
 79:             is_leaf: false,
 80:             child_base: atlas[t + 1] as usize,
 81:             child_mask: atlas[t + 2],
 82:             voxel_type: 0,
 83:             color: [0.0; 3],
 84:             light: 0.0,
 85:             baked_rgb: [0; 3],
 86:             exposure: SurfaceExposure::NONE,
 87:         })
 88:     }
 89: }

 92: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq)]
 93: pub struct MipNode {
 94: 
 95: 
 96:     pub linear_albedo: [f32; 3],
 97: 
 98: 
 99:     pub baked_rgb: [f32; 3],
100: 
101:     pub occupancy: f32,
102: 
103:     pub dominant_voxel_type: u32,
104: 
105:     dominant_coverage: f32,
106: 
107:     pub emissive_coverage: f32,
108: 
109: 
110: 
111:     pub emitted_radiance_density: [f32; 3],
112: 
113:     pub exposed_area: SurfaceExposure,
114: }
115: 
116: fn decode_baked_rgb(packed_lighting: u32) -> [u8; 3] {
117:     [
118:         ((packed_lighting >> 16) & 0xF) as u8,
119:         ((packed_lighting >> 20) & 0xF) as u8,
120:         ((packed_lighting >> 24) & 0xF) as u8,
121:     ]
122: }
123: 
124: fn decode_surface_exposure(packed_lighting: u32) -> SurfaceExposure {
125:     SurfaceExposure::from_neighbor_occlusion(((packed_lighting >> 8) & 0x3F) as u8)
126: }

132: 
133: pub fn build_mips(atlas: &[u32]) -> Vec<MipNode> {
134:     let node_count = atlas.len() / 4;
135:     let mut mips = vec![MipNode::default(); node_count];
136:     let mut done = vec![false; node_count];
137:     for i in 0..node_count {
138:         compute_mip(atlas, i, &mut mips, &mut done, 0);
139:     }
140:     mips
141: }
142: 
143: 
144: 
145: 
146: 
147: pub(crate) fn rebuild_mips_in_node_range(
148:     atlas: &[u32],
149:     mips: &mut [MipNode],
150:     node_range: Range<usize>,
151:     done_scratch: &mut Vec<bool>,
152: ) -> bool {
153:     let node_count = atlas.len() / 4;
154:     if atlas.len() % 4 != 0
155:         || mips.len() != node_count
156:         || node_range.is_empty()
157:         || node_range.end > node_count
158:     {
159:         return false;
160:     }
161: 
162:     mips[node_range.clone()].fill(MipNode::default());
163:     done_scratch.clear();
164:     done_scratch.resize(node_range.len(), false);
165:     for node_index in node_range.clone() {
166:         compute_mip(atlas, node_index, mips, done_scratch, node_range.start);
167:     }
168:     true
169: }
170: 
171: fn compute_mip(atlas: &[u32], i: usize, mips: &mut [MipNode], done: &mut [bool], done_base: usize) {
172:     let Some(done_index) = i.checked_sub(done_base).filter(|&index| index < done.len()) else {
173:         return;
174:     };
175:     if done[done_index] {
176:         return;
177:     }
178: 
179: 
180:     done[done_index] = true;
181: 
182:     let t = i * 4;
183:     if atlas[t] == 1 {
184: 
185:         let voxel_type = atlas[t + 1];
186:         if voxel_type != VOXEL_AIR {
187:             let c = atlas[t + 2];
188:             let packed_lighting = atlas[t + 3];
189:             let linear_albedo = decode_packed_albedo(c);
190:             let strength = emission_strength(voxel_type);
191:             mips[i] = MipNode {
192:                 linear_albedo,
193:                 baked_rgb: decode_baked_rgb(packed_lighting).map(f32::from),
194:                 occupancy: 1.0,
195:                 dominant_voxel_type: voxel_type,
196:                 dominant_coverage: 1.0,
197:                 emissive_coverage: if strength.is_some() { 1.0 } else { 0.0 },
198:                 emitted_radiance_density: strength.map_or([0.0; 3], |scale| {
199:                     linear_albedo.map(|channel| channel * scale)
200:                 }),
201:                 exposed_area: decode_surface_exposure(packed_lighting),
202:             };
203:         }
204:     } else {
205:         let child_base = atlas[t + 1] as usize;
206:         let child_mask = atlas[t + 2];
207:         let mut acc = MipNode::default();
208:         for child in 0..8usize {
209:             if child_mask & (1 << child) == 0 {
210:                 continue;
211:             }
212:             let idx = child_base + child;
213:             if idx >= mips.len() {
214:                 continue;
215:             }
216:             compute_mip(atlas, idx, mips, done, done_base);
217:             let m = mips[idx];
218:             let w = m.occupancy / 8.0;
219:             acc.linear_albedo[0] += m.linear_albedo[0] * w;
220:             acc.linear_albedo[1] += m.linear_albedo[1] * w;
221:             acc.linear_albedo[2] += m.linear_albedo[2] * w;
222:             acc.baked_rgb[0] += m.baked_rgb[0] * w;
223:             acc.baked_rgb[1] += m.baked_rgb[1] * w;
224:             acc.baked_rgb[2] += m.baked_rgb[2] * w;
225:             acc.emissive_coverage += m.emissive_coverage / 8.0;
226:             acc.emitted_radiance_density[0] += m.emitted_radiance_density[0] / 8.0;
227:             acc.emitted_radiance_density[1] += m.emitted_radiance_density[1] / 8.0;
228:             acc.emitted_radiance_density[2] += m.emitted_radiance_density[2] / 8.0;
229:             acc.exposed_area
230:                 .add_saturating(m.exposed_area.scaled_to_parent());
231:             let dominant_coverage = m.dominant_coverage / 8.0;
232:             if dominant_coverage > acc.dominant_coverage {
233:                 acc.dominant_coverage = dominant_coverage;
234:                 acc.dominant_voxel_type = m.dominant_voxel_type;
235:             }
236:             acc.occupancy += w;
237:         }
238:         if acc.occupancy > 0.0 {
239:             let inv = 1.0 / acc.occupancy;
240:             acc.linear_albedo[0] *= inv;
241:             acc.linear_albedo[1] *= inv;
242:             acc.linear_albedo[2] *= inv;
243:             acc.baked_rgb[0] *= inv;
244:             acc.baked_rgb[1] *= inv;
245:             acc.baked_rgb[2] *= inv;
246:         }
247:         mips[i] = acc;
248:     }
249: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/decode_srgb_albedo.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::application::rendering::LinearRgb;
 2: 
 3: pub(crate) fn srgb_channel_to_linear(byte: f32) -> f32 {
 4:     let encoded = (byte / 255.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 5:     if encoded <= 0.040_45 {
 6:         encoded / 12.92
 7:     } else {
 8:         ((encoded + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
 9:     }
10: }
11: 
12: pub(crate) fn decode_albedo(bytes: [f32; 3]) -> LinearRgb {
13:     bytes.map(srgb_channel_to_linear)
14: }
15: 
16: pub(crate) fn decode_packed_albedo(packed: u32) -> LinearRgb {
17:     decode_albedo([
18:         ((packed >> 16) & 0xFF) as f32,
19:         ((packed >> 8) & 0xFF) as f32,
20:         (packed & 0xFF) as f32,
21:     ])
22: }
23: 
24: #[cfg(test)]
25: mod tests {
26:     use super::{decode_albedo, decode_packed_albedo, srgb_channel_to_linear};
27: 
28:     #[test]
29:     fn packed_and_unpacked_authored_colors_share_one_decode() {
30:         assert_eq!(
31:             decode_packed_albedo(0x80_FF_00),
32:             decode_albedo([128.0, 255.0, 0.0])
33:         );
34:         assert!((srgb_channel_to_linear(128.0) - 0.215_86).abs() < 1.0e-4);
35:     }
36: }
````

````rust
 32: fn smoothstep01(t: f32) -> f32 {
 33:     let t = t.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 34:     t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
 35: }

 39: pub fn cone_falloff(alignment: f32) -> f32 {
 40:     let inner_cos = INNER_DEG.to_radians().cos();
 41:     let outer_cos = OUTER_DEG.to_radians().cos();
 42:     if !alignment.is_finite() || alignment <= outer_cos {
 43:         return 0.0;
 44:     }
 45:     smoothstep01((alignment - outer_cos) / (inner_cos - outer_cos))
 46: }

 55: fn lamp_position(cam: &Camera) -> [f32; 3] {
 56:     [
 57:         cam.pos[0] + cam.forward[0] * LAMP_FORWARD,
 58:         cam.pos[1] + cam.forward[1] * LAMP_FORWARD - LAMP_DOWN,
 59:         cam.pos[2] + cam.forward[2] * LAMP_FORWARD,
 60:     ]

 63: fn normalized_direction(from: [f32; 3], to: [f32; 3]) -> Option<([f32; 3], f32)> {
 64:     let delta = [to[0] - from[0], to[1] - from[1], to[2] - from[2]];
 65:     let distance = dot(delta, delta).sqrt();
 66:     if !distance.is_finite() || distance <= 1.0e-4 {
 67:         return None;
 68:     }
 69:     Some((delta.map(|component| component / distance), distance))
 70: }

 76: pub struct BeamReceiver {

 86:         Self {

 92:     }

100:         normal: [f32; 3],
101:     ) -> Self {

106:             normal,
107:         }
108:     }
109: 
110:     fn bounds(self) -> ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]) {
111:         (
112:             self.center.map(|value| value - self.half_extent),

123: 
124: pub fn unoccluded_irradiance(cam: &Camera, receiver: BeamReceiver) -> [f32; 3] {
125:     let lamp = lamp_position(cam);
126:     let Some((lamp_to_receiver, distance)) = normalized_direction(lamp, receiver.sample_position)
127:     else {
128:         return [0.0; 3];
129:     };
130: 
131:     let cone = cone_falloff(dot(lamp_to_receiver, cam.forward));
132:     let facing = lambertian_receiver_cosine(receiver.normal, lamp_to_receiver.map(|v| -v));
133:     let attenuation =
134:         finite_range_inverse_square_attenuation(distance, RANGE_END, MINIMUM_DISTANCE);
135:     let scalar = INTENSITY * cone * facing * attenuation;
136:     TINT.map(|channel| channel * scalar)
137: }
138: 
139: fn occlusion_trace_length(lamp_to_receiver_face: f32) -> Option<f32> {
140:     let length = lamp_to_receiver_face - OCCLUSION_ORIGIN_BIAS - OCCLUSION_RECEIVER_BIAS;
141:     (length > 0.0).then_some(length)
142: }
143: 
144: 
145: fn segment_is_occluded(
146:     cam: &Camera,
147:     atlas: &[u32],
148:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
149:     receiver: BeamReceiver,
150: ) -> bool {
151:     let lamp = lamp_position(cam);
152:     let Some((direction, _)) = normalized_direction(lamp, receiver.sample_position) else {
153:         return false;
154:     };
155:     let (bounds_min, bounds_max) = receiver.bounds();
156:     let Some(interval) = ray_box_interval(lamp, direction, bounds_min, bounds_max) else {
157:         return false;
158:     };
159:     let receiver_face = interval.entry.max(0.0);
160:     let Some(max_trace) = occlusion_trace_length(receiver_face) else {
161:         return false;
162:     };
163:     let origin = [
164:         lamp[0] + direction[0] * OCCLUSION_ORIGIN_BIAS,
165:         lamp[1] + direction[1] * OCCLUSION_ORIGIN_BIAS,
166:         lamp[2] + direction[2] * OCCLUSION_ORIGIN_BIAS,
167:     ];
168:     svo_segment_is_occluded(atlas, chunks, origin, direction, max_trace)
169: }
170: 
171: 
172: 
173: pub fn beam_contribution(
174:     cam: &Camera,
175:     atlas: &[u32],
176:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
177:     receiver: BeamReceiver,
178:     visibility: CpuFlashlightVisibility,
179: ) -> [f32; 3] {
180:     let irradiance = unoccluded_irradiance(cam, receiver);
181:     if irradiance == [0.0; 3] {
182:         return irradiance;
183:     }
184:     if visibility == CpuFlashlightVisibility::TraceScene
185:         && segment_is_occluded(cam, atlas, chunks, receiver)
186:     {
187:         [0.0; 3]
188:     } else {
189:         irradiance
190:     }
191: }
````

````rust
 27: pub(super) fn ray_box_interval(
 28:     origin: [f32; 3],
 29:     direction: [f32; 3],
 30:     bounds_min: [f32; 3],
 31:     bounds_max: [f32; 3],
 32: ) -> Option<RayInterval> {
 33:     let mut entry = f32::NEG_INFINITY;
 34:     let mut exit = f32::INFINITY;
 35:     let mut has_direction = false;
 36: 
 37:     for axis in 0..3 {
 38:         let origin_axis = origin[axis];
 39:         let direction_axis = direction[axis];
 40:         if !origin_axis.is_finite()
 41:             || !direction_axis.is_finite()
 42:             || !bounds_min[axis].is_finite()
 43:             || !bounds_max[axis].is_finite()
 44:         {
 45:             return None;
 46:         }
 47: 
 48:         if direction_axis == 0.0 {
 49:             if origin_axis < bounds_min[axis] || origin_axis > bounds_max[axis] {
 50:                 return None;
 51:             }
 52:             continue;
 53:         }
 54: 
 55:         has_direction = true;
 56:         let first = (bounds_min[axis] - origin_axis) / direction_axis;
 57:         let second = (bounds_max[axis] - origin_axis) / direction_axis;
 58:         entry = entry.max(first.min(second));
 59:         exit = exit.min(first.max(second));
 60: 
 61:         if entry > exit {
 62:             return None;
 63:         }
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     has_direction.then_some(RayInterval { entry, exit })
 67: }

109: fn traversal_step_budget(world_size: f32, voxel_size: f32, svo_depth: u8) -> usize {
110:     let geometry_cells =
111:         if world_size.is_finite() && voxel_size.is_finite() && world_size > 0.0 && voxel_size > 0.0
112:         {
113:             (world_size / voxel_size).ceil().clamp(1.0, 1_048_576.0) as u64
114:         } else {
115:             1
116:         };
117:     let depth_cells = 1_u64
118:         .checked_shl(u32::from(svo_depth.min(20)))
119:         .unwrap_or(1_048_576);
120:     let cells_per_axis = geometry_cells.max(depth_cells);
121:     let levels = u64::from(svo_depth).saturating_add(1);
122:     let estimated = cells_per_axis
123:         .saturating_mul(3)
124:         .saturating_add(1)
125:         .saturating_mul(levels)
126:         .saturating_add(16);
127:     estimated.clamp(MIN_TRAVERSAL_STEPS as u64, MAX_TRAVERSAL_STEPS as u64) as usize
128: }

130: impl TraversalCursor {
131:     fn at_root(root: usize, world_size: f32) -> Self {
132:         Self {
133:             stack: [TraversalFrame {
134:                 node_idx: 0,
135:                 b_min: [0.0; 3],
136:                 b_max: [0.0; 3],
137:             }; 9],
138:             stack_ptr: 0,
139:             node: root,
140:             b_min: [0.0; 3],
141:             b_max: [world_size; 3],
142:         }
143:     }
144: 
145:     fn push(&mut self) {
146:         if self.stack_ptr < 8 {
147:             self.stack[self.stack_ptr] = TraversalFrame {
148:                 node_idx: self.node,
149:                 b_min: self.b_min,
150:                 b_max: self.b_max,
151:             };
152:             self.stack_ptr += 1;
153:         }
154:     }
155: 
156: 
157: 
158: 
159: 
160:     fn pop_exited(&mut self, p: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
161:         while p[0] < self.b_min[0]
162:             || p[0] > self.b_max[0]
163:             || p[1] < self.b_min[1]
164:             || p[1] > self.b_max[1]
165:             || p[2] < self.b_min[2]
166:             || p[2] > self.b_max[2]
167:         {
168:             if self.stack_ptr == 0 {
169:                 return false;
170:             }
171:             self.stack_ptr -= 1;
172:             let frame = self.stack[self.stack_ptr];
173:             self.node = frame.node_idx;
174:             self.b_min = frame.b_min;
175:             self.b_max = frame.b_max;
176:         }
177:         true
178:     }
179: }

187: fn skip_to_exit(
188:     ro: [f32; 3],
189:     rd: [f32; 3],
190:     b_min: [f32; 3],
191:     b_max: [f32; 3],
192: ) -> Option<(f32, [f32; 3])> {
193:     let exit_plane = |axis: usize| match rd[axis].total_cmp(&0.0) {
194:         std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => b_max[axis],
195:         std::cmp::Ordering::Less => b_min[axis],
196:         std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => ro[axis],
197:     };
198:     let axis_exit = |axis: usize| {
199:         if rd[axis] == 0.0 {
200:             f32::INFINITY
201:         } else {
202:             (exit_plane(axis) - ro[axis]) / rd[axis]
203:         }
204:     };
205:     let t_max_planes = [axis_exit(0), axis_exit(1), axis_exit(2)];
206:     let t_exit = t_max_planes[0].min(t_max_planes[1]).min(t_max_planes[2]);
207:     if !t_exit.is_finite() {
208:         return None;
209:     }
210:     let mut p = [
211:         ro[0] + t_exit * rd[0],
212:         ro[1] + t_exit * rd[1],
213:         ro[2] + t_exit * rd[2],
214:     ];
215:     for axis in 0..3 {
216:         let axis_t = t_max_planes[axis];
217:         if !axis_t.is_finite() {
218:             continue;
219:         }
220:         let tie_tolerance = f32::EPSILON * 4.0 * t_exit.abs().max(axis_t.abs()).max(1.0);
221:         if (t_exit - axis_t).abs() <= tie_tolerance {
222:             let plane = exit_plane(axis);
223:             p[axis] = if rd[axis] > 0.0 {
224:                 plane.next_up()
225:             } else {
226:                 plane.next_down()
227:             };
228:         }
229:     }
230:     Some((t_exit, p))
231: }

235: fn raymarch_svo_single(
236:     atlas: &[u32],
237:     ro: [f32; 3],
238:     rd: [f32; 3],
239:     chunk_root_idx: usize,
240:     t_entry: f32,
241:     max_t: f32,
242:     world_size: f32,
243:     voxel_size: f32,
244:     svo_depth: u8,
245: ) -> ChunkMarch {
246:     let mut t = t_entry;
247:     let mut p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
248:     let mut cursor = TraversalCursor::at_root(chunk_root_idx, world_size);
249: 
250:     let max_steps = traversal_step_budget(world_size, voxel_size, svo_depth);
251:     for _ in 0..max_steps {
252: 
253: 
254: 
255:         if t > max_t {
256:             return ChunkMarch::Clear;
257:         }
258:         let Some(node) = decode_node(atlas, cursor.node) else {
259:             return ChunkMarch::Indeterminate;
260:         };
261: 
262:         if node.is_leaf {
263:             if node.voxel_type != 0 {
264:                 return ChunkMarch::Hit(RayHit {
265:                     t,
266:                     voxel_type: node.voxel_type,
267:                 });
268:             }
269: 
270: 
271:             let Some(next) = skip_to_exit(ro, rd, cursor.b_min, cursor.b_max) else {
272:                 return ChunkMarch::Indeterminate;
273:             };
274:             (t, p) = next;
275:             if !cursor.pop_exited(p) {
276:                 return ChunkMarch::Clear;
277:             }
278:             continue;
279:         }
280: 
281:         let center = [
282:             (cursor.b_min[0] + cursor.b_max[0]) * 0.5,
283:             (cursor.b_min[1] + cursor.b_max[1]) * 0.5,
284:             (cursor.b_min[2] + cursor.b_max[2]) * 0.5,
285:         ];
286:         let ox = (p[0] >= center[0]) as usize;
287:         let oy = (p[1] >= center[1]) as usize;
288:         let oz = (p[2] >= center[2]) as usize;
289:         let child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
290: 
291: 
292: 
293: 
294: 
295: 
296: 
297: 
298: 
299:         let oct_min = [
300:             if ox == 1 { center[0] } else { cursor.b_min[0] },
301:             if oy == 1 { center[1] } else { cursor.b_min[1] },
302:             if oz == 1 { center[2] } else { cursor.b_min[2] },
303:         ];
304:         let oct_max = [
305:             if ox == 1 { cursor.b_max[0] } else { center[0] },
306:             if oy == 1 { cursor.b_max[1] } else { center[1] },
307:             if oz == 1 { cursor.b_max[2] } else { center[2] },
308:         ];
309: 
310:         if (node.child_mask & (1 << child_idx)) != 0 {
311: 
312:             cursor.push();
313:             cursor.b_min = oct_min;
314:             cursor.b_max = oct_max;
315:             cursor.node = node.child_base + child_idx;
316:         } else {
317: 
318:             let Some(next) = skip_to_exit(ro, rd, oct_min, oct_max) else {
319:                 return ChunkMarch::Indeterminate;
320:             };
321:             (t, p) = next;
322:             if !cursor.pop_exited(p) {
323:                 return ChunkMarch::Clear;
324:             }
325:         }
326:     }
327:     ChunkMarch::Indeterminate
328: }
````

````rust
 12: fn one_voxel_atlas(color: u32, light: u8) -> (Vec<u32>, u32) {
 13:     let mut svo = SparseVoxelOctree::new(2, 4.0);
 14:     svo.set(1, 1, 1, 1, color, [light; 3], 0);
 15:     let gpu = OctreeGpuSerializer::serialize_to_gpu_data(&svo);
 16:     (gpu.texel_data, svo.root as u32)
 17: }

 19: fn frame_at(pos: [f32; 3], yaw: f32) -> FrameParams {
 20:     FrameParams {
 21:         camera_pos: pos,
 22:         yaw,
 23:         pitch: 0.0,
 24:         flashlight: false,
 25:         ..FrameParams::default()
 26:     }
 27: }
 28: 
 29: fn center_pixel(r: &SoftwareRasterizer) -> [u8; 4] {
 30:     let idx = (r.height() / 2 * r.width() + r.width() / 2) * 4;
 31:     let fb = r.framebuffer();
 32:     [fb[idx], fb[idx + 1], fb[idx + 2], fb[idx + 3]]
 33: }
````

````rust
  1: use std::ops::Range;
  2: 
  3: use crate::application::atlas::ROW_TEXELS;
  4: 
  5: use super::atlas::{MipNode, rebuild_mips_in_node_range};
  6: 
  7: const WORDS_PER_NODE: usize = 4;
  8: const WORDS_PER_ROW: usize = ROW_TEXELS * WORDS_PER_NODE;
  9: 
 10: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 11: struct ValidatedRowUpdate {
 12:     word_range: Range<usize>,
 13:     node_range: Range<usize>,
 14: }
 15: 
 16: 
 17: pub(super) fn update_prepared_atlas_rows(
 18:     atlas: &mut [u32],
 19:     mips: &mut [MipNode],
 20:     mip_visit_scratch: &mut Vec<bool>,
 21:     first_row: u32,
 22:     texels: &[u32],
 23: ) -> bool {
 24:     let Some(update) = validate_row_update(atlas, mips, first_row, texels) else {
 25:         return false;
 26:     };
 27: 
 28:     atlas[update.word_range].copy_from_slice(texels);
 29:     let rebuilt = rebuild_mips_in_node_range(atlas, mips, update.node_range, mip_visit_scratch);
 30:     debug_assert!(rebuilt, "validated row range must always rebuild");
 31:     rebuilt
 32: }
 33: 
 34: 
 35: fn validate_row_update(
 36:     atlas: &[u32],
 37:     mips: &[MipNode],
 38:     first_row: u32,
 39:     texels: &[u32],
 40: ) -> Option<ValidatedRowUpdate> {
 41:     if atlas.is_empty()
 42:         || texels.is_empty()
 43:         || atlas.len() % WORDS_PER_ROW != 0
 44:         || texels.len() % WORDS_PER_ROW != 0
 45:         || mips.len().checked_mul(WORDS_PER_NODE)? != atlas.len()
 46:     {
 47:         return None;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     let first_row = usize::try_from(first_row).ok()?;
 51:     let word_start = first_row.checked_mul(WORDS_PER_ROW)?;
 52:     let word_end = word_start.checked_add(texels.len())?;
 53:     if word_end > atlas.len() {
 54:         return None;
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     let node_range = word_start / WORDS_PER_NODE..word_end / WORDS_PER_NODE;
 58:     validate_independent_node_block(texels, node_range.clone())?;
 59:     Some(ValidatedRowUpdate {
 60:         word_range: word_start..word_end,
 61:         node_range,
 62:     })
 63: }
 64: 
 65: 
 66: 
 67: 
 68: fn validate_independent_node_block(texels: &[u32], global_nodes: Range<usize>) -> Option<()> {
 69:     for node in texels.chunks_exact(WORDS_PER_NODE) {
 70:         match node[0] {
 71:             1 => {}
 72:             0 => {
 73:                 if node[2] & !0xff != 0 {
 74:                     return None;
 75:                 }
 76:                 let child_base = usize::try_from(node[1]).ok()?;
 77:                 let child_end = child_base.checked_add(8)?;
 78:                 if child_base < global_nodes.start || child_end > global_nodes.end {
 79:                     return None;
 80:                 }
 81:             }
 82:             _ => return None,
 83:         }
 84:     }
 85:     Some(())
 86: }

191:         let mut short_atlas = vec![1, 0, 0, 0];
192:         let mut short_mips = build_mips(&short_atlas);
193:         assert!(!update_prepared_atlas_rows(
194:             &mut short_atlas,
195:             &mut short_mips,
196:             &mut scratch,
197:             0,
198:             &slot,
199:         ));
200: 
201:         let mut atlas_without_prepared_mips = slot.clone();
202:         let unchanged = atlas_without_prepared_mips.clone();
203:         assert!(!update_prepared_atlas_rows(
204:             &mut atlas_without_prepared_mips,
205:             &mut [],
206:             &mut scratch,
207:             0,
208:             &slot,
209:         ));
210:         assert_eq!(atlas_without_prepared_mips, unchanged);
211: 
212:         let mut valid_atlas = slot.clone();
213:         let mut valid_mips = build_mips(&valid_atlas);
214:         assert!(!update_prepared_atlas_rows(
215:             &mut valid_atlas,
216:             &mut valid_mips,
217:             &mut scratch,
218:             0,
219:             &[],
220:         ));
221:     }
222: }
````

````rust
135: pub fn decode_chunk_payload(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<ChunkPayload> {
136:     let mut r = Reader { bytes, pos: 0 };
137:     if r.u32()? != MAGIC {
138:         return None;
139:     }
140:     let root = r.u32()?;
141:     let world_size = r.f32()?;
142:     let voxel_size = r.f32()?;
143:     let svo_depth = r.u8()?;
144: 
145:     let node_count = r.len(4)?;
146:     let mut nodes = Vec::with_capacity(node_count);
147:     for _ in 0..node_count {
148:         nodes.push(r.u32()?);
149:     }
150: 
151:     let vertex_count = r.len(10)?;
152:     let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(vertex_count);
153:     for _ in 0..vertex_count {
154:         vertices.push(PackedVertex {
155:             position: [r.u16()?, r.u16()?, r.u16()?],
156:             normal_axis: r.u8()?,
157:             material: r.u8()?,
158:             static_indirect: r.u8()?,
159:             ao: r.u8()?,
160:         });
161:     }
162:     let index_count = r.len(4)?;
163:     let mut indices = Vec::with_capacity(index_count);
164:     for _ in 0..index_count {
165:         indices.push(r.u32()?);
166:     }
167:     let bounds = r.aabb()?;
168:     let lod = r.u8()?;
169:     let voxel_scale = r.f32()?;
170:     let light_volume_dims = [r.u32()?, r.u32()?, r.u32()?];
171:     let _light_volume_padding = r.u8()?;
172:     let volume_len = r.len(1)?;
173:     let light_volume_bytes = r.slice(volume_len)?.to_vec();
174: 
175:     let light_count = r.len(51)?;
176:     let mut lights = Vec::with_capacity(light_count);
177:     for _ in 0..light_count {
178:         lights.push(LightSource {
179:             id: r.u64()?,
180:             position: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
181:             half_size: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
182:             color: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
183:             radius: r.f32()?,
184:             intensity: r.f32()?,
185:             kind: LightKind::from_u8(r.u8()?)?,
186:             flicker_mode: r.u8()?,
187:             enabled: r.u8()? != 0,
188:         });
189:     }
190: 
191:     let instance_count = r.len(13)?;
192:     let mut instances = Vec::with_capacity(instance_count);
193:     for _ in 0..instance_count {
194:         instances.push(PackedFaceInstance {
195:             position: [r.u16()?, r.u16()?, r.u16()?],
196:             extent_u: r.u8()?,
197:             extent_v: r.u8()?,
198:             normal_axis: r.u8()?,
199:             material: r.u8()?,
200:             baked_light: r.u8()?,
201:             ao: r.u8()?,
202:             flags: r.u8()?,
203:             reserved: [0; 3],
204:         });
205:     }
206:     let cell_count = r.len(11)?;
207:     let mut cells = Vec::with_capacity(cell_count);
208:     for _ in 0..cell_count {
209:         cells.push(FaceCellRange {
210:             cell: [r.u8()?, r.u8()?, r.u8()?],
211:             offset: r.u32()?,
212:             count: r.u32()?,
213:         });
214:     }
215:     let cell_size = r.f32()?;
216: 
217:     let collision_count = r.len(24)?;
218:     let mut collision = Vec::with_capacity(collision_count);
219:     for _ in 0..collision_count {
220:         collision.push(r.aabb()?);
221:     }
222: 
223:     let gate_count = r.len(TraversalGate::WORDS * 4)?;
224:     let mut traversal_gates = Vec::with_capacity(gate_count);
225:     for _ in 0..gate_count {
226:         let mut words = [0u32; TraversalGate::WORDS];
227:         for word in &mut words {
228:             *word = r.u32()?;
229:         }
230:         traversal_gates.push(TraversalGate::from_words(&words)?);
231:     }
232:     let hazard_count = r.len(PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS * 4)?;
233:     let mut pit_hazards = Vec::with_capacity(hazard_count);
234:     for _ in 0..hazard_count {
235:         let mut words = [0u32; PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS];
236:         for word in &mut words {
237:             *word = r.u32()?;
238:         }
239:         pit_hazards.push(PitHazard::from_transport_words(&words)?);
240:     }
241:     let supply_count = r.len(SupplyItem::WORDS * 4)?;
242:     let mut supply_items = Vec::with_capacity(supply_count);
243:     for _ in 0..supply_count {
244:         let mut words = [0u32; SupplyItem::WORDS];
245:         for word in &mut words {
246:             *word = r.u32()?;
247:         }
248:         supply_items.push(SupplyItem::from_words(&words)?);
249:     }
250:     let exit_count = r.len(LevelExit::WORDS * 4)?;
251:     let mut level_exits = Vec::with_capacity(exit_count);
252:     for _ in 0..exit_count {
253:         let mut words = [0u32; LevelExit::WORDS];
254:         for word in &mut words {
255:             *word = r.u32()?;
256:         }
257:         level_exits.push(LevelExit::from_words(&words)?);
258:     }
259: 
260:     Some(ChunkPayload {
261:         root,
262:         nodes,
263:         world_size,
264:         voxel_size,
265:         svo_depth,
266:         surface: SurfaceMeshPayload {
267:             vertices,
268:             indices,
269:             bounds,
270:             lod,
271:             faces: FaceInstanceSet {
272:                 instances,
273:                 cells,
274:                 cell_size,
275:             },
276:             voxel_scale,
277:             light_volume_bytes,
278:             light_volume_dims,
279:         },
280:         lights,
281:         collision,
282:         traversal_gates,
283:         pit_hazards,
284:         supply_items,
285:         level_exits,
286:     })
287: }

289: fn put_u16(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: u16) {
290:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
291: }
292: fn put_u32(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: u32) {
293:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
294: }
295: fn put_f32(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: f32) {
296:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
297: }
298: fn put_aabb(out: &mut Vec<u8>, aabb: &Aabb) {
299:     for c in aabb.min {
300:         put_f32(out, c);
301:     }
302:     for c in aabb.max {
303:         put_f32(out, c);
304:     }
305: }
306: 
307: struct Reader<'a> {
308:     bytes: &'a [u8],
309:     pos: usize,
310: }
311: 
312: impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
313:     fn slice(&mut self, n: usize) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
314:         let end = self.pos.checked_add(n)?;
315:         let s = self.bytes.get(self.pos..end)?;
316:         self.pos = end;
317:         Some(s)
318:     }
319:     fn u8(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
320:         Some(self.slice(1)?[0])
321:     }
322:     fn u16(&mut self) -> Option<u16> {
323:         Some(u16::from_le_bytes(self.slice(2)?.try_into().ok()?))
324:     }
325:     fn u32(&mut self) -> Option<u32> {
326:         Some(u32::from_le_bytes(self.slice(4)?.try_into().ok()?))
327:     }
328:     fn u64(&mut self) -> Option<u64> {
329:         Some(u64::from_le_bytes(self.slice(8)?.try_into().ok()?))
330:     }
331:     fn f32(&mut self) -> Option<f32> {
332:         Some(f32::from_le_bytes(self.slice(4)?.try_into().ok()?))
333:     }
334:     fn aabb(&mut self) -> Option<Aabb> {
335:         Some(Aabb::new(
336:             [self.f32()?, self.f32()?, self.f32()?],
337:             [self.f32()?, self.f32()?, self.f32()?],
338:         ))
339:     }
340: 
341: 
342: 
343:     fn len(&mut self, min_element_bytes: usize) -> Option<usize> {
344:         let n = self.u32()? as usize;
345:         let remaining = self.bytes.len().saturating_sub(self.pos);
346:         if n.saturating_mul(min_element_bytes.max(1)) > remaining {
347:             return None;
348:         }
349:         Some(n)
350:     }
351: }
````

````rust
 65: 
 66: 
 67:     for y in 1..halo_grid.height() {
 68:         for z in lateral_padding..halo_grid.depth() - lateral_padding {
 69:             for x in lateral_padding..halo_grid.width() - lateral_padding {
 70:                 let index = grid_index(halo_grid, x, y, z);
 71:                 if visited[index] || !is_exposed_underside(halo_grid, x, y, z) {
 72:                     continue;
 73:                 }
 74: 
 75:                 let component =
 76:                     collect_owned_rectangle(halo_grid, x, y, z, lateral_padding, &mut visited);
 77:                 let key = component_key(component, voxel_size, halo_world_origin);
 78:                 keyed_lights.push((
 79:                     key,
 80:                     light_from_component(component, key, voxel_size, halo_world_origin),
 81:                 ));
 82:             }
 83:         }
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     keyed_lights.sort_unstable_by_key(|(key, _)| *key);
 87:     keyed_lights.dedup_by(|(left, _), (right, _)| left == right);
 88:     keyed_lights.into_iter().map(|(_, light)| light).collect()
 89: }
 90: 
 91: fn valid_transform(voxel_size: f32, origin: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
 92:     voxel_size.is_finite() && voxel_size > 0.0 && origin.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
 93: }
 94: 
 95: fn is_exposed_underside(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> bool {
 96:     emission_profile(grid.get(x, y, z)).is_some() && grid.get(x, y - 1, z) == VOXEL_AIR
 97: }
 98: 
 99: 
100: 
101: 
102: fn collect_owned_rectangle(
103:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
104:     start_x: usize,
105:     y: usize,
106:     start_z: usize,
107:     lateral_padding: usize,
108:     visited: &mut [bool],
109: ) -> ComponentBounds {
110:     let material = grid.get(start_x, y, start_z);
111:     let owned_x_end = grid.width() - lateral_padding;
112:     let owned_z_end = grid.depth() - lateral_padding;
113: 
114:     let mut max_x_exclusive = start_x;
115:     while max_x_exclusive < owned_x_end
116:         && rectangle_cell_matches(grid, max_x_exclusive, y, start_z, material, visited)
117:     {
118:         max_x_exclusive += 1;
119:     }
120: 
121:     let mut max_z_exclusive = start_z + 1;
122:     while max_z_exclusive < owned_z_end
123:         && (start_x..max_x_exclusive)
124:             .all(|x| rectangle_cell_matches(grid, x, y, max_z_exclusive, material, visited))
125:     {
126:         max_z_exclusive += 1;
127:     }
128: 
129:     for z in start_z..max_z_exclusive {
130:         for x in start_x..max_x_exclusive {
131:             visited[grid_index(grid, x, y, z)] = true;
132:         }
133:     }
134: 
135:     ComponentBounds {
136:         material,
137:         y,
138:         min_x: start_x,
139:         max_x_exclusive,
140:         min_z: start_z,
141:         max_z_exclusive,
142:     }
143: }
144: 
145: fn rectangle_cell_matches(
146:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
147:     x: usize,
148:     y: usize,
149:     z: usize,
150:     material: u8,
151:     visited: &[bool],
152: ) -> bool {
153:     !visited[grid_index(grid, x, y, z)]
154:         && grid.get(x, y, z) == material
155:         && is_exposed_underside(grid, x, y, z)
156: }
157: 
158: fn grid_index(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> usize {
159:     y * grid.width() * grid.depth() + z * grid.width() + x
160: }
161: 
162: fn component_key(component: ComponentBounds, voxel_size: f32, origin: [f32; 3]) -> ComponentKey {
163:     let min_world = [
164:         origin[0] + component.min_x as f32 * voxel_size,
165:         origin[1] + component.y as f32 * voxel_size,
166:         origin[2] + component.min_z as f32 * voxel_size,
167:     ];
168:     let max_world = [
169:         origin[0] + component.max_x_exclusive as f32 * voxel_size,
170:         min_world[1],
171:         origin[2] + component.max_z_exclusive as f32 * voxel_size,
172:     ];
173:     ComponentKey {
174:         material: component.material,
175:         min_world_fixed: min_world.map(world_to_fixed),
176:         max_world_fixed: max_world.map(world_to_fixed),
177:     }
178: }
179: 
180: fn world_to_fixed(value: f32) -> i64 {
181:     (value * POSITION_FIXED_SCALE).round() as i64
182: }
183: 
184: fn light_from_component(
185:     component: ComponentBounds,
186:     key: ComponentKey,
187:     voxel_size: f32,
188:     origin: [f32; 3],
189: ) -> LightSource {
190:     let width = (component.max_x_exclusive - component.min_x) as f32 * voxel_size;
191:     let depth = (component.max_z_exclusive - component.min_z) as f32 * voxel_size;
192:     let profile = emission_profile(component.material)
193:         .expect("components are seeded only from emissive materials");
194:     let kind = if profile.kind == LightKind::Emergency {
195:         LightKind::Emergency
196:     } else if width > depth * 2.0 || depth > width * 2.0 {
197:         LightKind::Strip
198:     } else {
199:         LightKind::CeilingPanel
200:     };
201: 
202:     let id = stable_id(key);
203:     LightSource {
204:         id,
205:         position: [
206:             origin[0] + (component.min_x + component.max_x_exclusive) as f32 * voxel_size * 0.5,
207:             origin[1] + component.y as f32 * voxel_size,
208:             origin[2] + (component.min_z + component.max_z_exclusive) as f32 * voxel_size * 0.5,
209:         ],
210:         half_size: [width * 0.5, depth * 0.5],
211:         color: profile.linear_rgb,
212:         radius: DEFAULT_MAX_LIGHT_RANGE_WORLD_UNITS,
213:         intensity: profile.radiance,
214:         kind,
215:         flicker_mode: flicker_mode_for(component.material, id),
216:         enabled: true,
217:     }
218: }
219: 
220: 
221: 
222: 
223: 
224: 
225: fn flicker_mode_for(material: u8, id: u64) -> u8 {
226:     if material != VOXEL_LIGHT {
227:         return 0;
228:     }
229: 
230: 
231:     let mut h = id ^ (id >> 33);
232:     h = h.wrapping_mul(0xFF51_AFD7_ED55_8CCD);
233:     match (h >> 40) % 100 {
234:         0..=11 => 1,
235:         12..=15 => 2,
236:         _ => 0,
237:     }
238: }
239: 
240: fn emission_profile(material: u8) -> Option<EmissionProfile> {
241:     let kind = match material {
242:         VOXEL_LIGHT | VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => LightKind::CeilingPanel,
243:         VOXEL_GLIMMER => LightKind::Emergency,
244:         _ => return None,
245:     };
246:     Some(EmissionProfile {
247:         linear_rgb: material_color_f32(material).map(srgb_channel_to_linear),
248:         radiance: material_emission_strength(material)?,
249:         kind,
250:     })
251: }
252: 
253: fn srgb_channel_to_linear(channel: f32) -> f32 {
254:     if channel <= 0.04045 {
255:         channel / 12.92
256:     } else {
257:         ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
258:     }
259: }
260: 
261: 
262: 
263: 
264: fn stable_id(key: ComponentKey) -> u64 {
265:     const FNV_OFFSET: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
266:     const FNV_PRIME: u64 = 0x0000_0100_0000_01b3;
267: 
268:     let mut hash = FNV_OFFSET;
269:     for byte in std::iter::once(key.material).chain(
270:         key.min_world_fixed
271:             .into_iter()
272:             .chain(key.max_world_fixed)
273:             .flat_map(i64::to_le_bytes),
274:     ) {
275:         hash ^= u64::from(byte);
276:         hash = hash.wrapping_mul(FNV_PRIME);
277:     }
278:     hash
279: }
````

````rust
 10: pub const MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS: f32 = 2.5;
 11: 
 12: 
 13: pub const FACE_CELL_UNITS: f32 = 2.5;

 17: 
 18: pub fn build_face_instances(quads: &[MergedQuad], voxel_scale: f32) -> FaceInstanceSet {
 19:     let max_cells = ((MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS / voxel_scale).floor() as u32).max(1);
 20:     let mut instances = Vec::with_capacity(quads.len());
 21:     for quad in quads {
 22:         emit_capped(quad, voxel_scale, max_cells, &mut instances);
 23:     }
 24: 
 25: 
 26:     let cell_of = |inst: &PackedFaceInstance| -> [u8; 3] {
 27:         let mut cell = [0u8; 3];
 28:         for axis in 0..3 {
 29:             let world = inst.position[axis] as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE;
 30:             cell[axis] = (world / FACE_CELL_UNITS).floor().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
 31:         }
 32:         cell
 33:     };
 34:     instances.sort_by_key(|inst| {
 35:         let c = cell_of(inst);
 36:         (c[0], c[1], c[2])
 37:     });
 38: 
 39:     let mut cells: Vec<FaceCellRange> = Vec::new();
 40:     for (index, inst) in instances.iter().enumerate() {
 41:         let cell = cell_of(inst);
 42:         match cells.last_mut() {
 43:             Some(range) if range.cell == cell => range.count += 1,
 44:             _ => cells.push(FaceCellRange {
 45:                 cell,
 46:                 offset: index as u32,
 47:                 count: 1,
 48:             }),
 49:         }
 50:     }
 51: 
 52:     FaceInstanceSet {
 53:         instances,
 54:         cells,
 55:         cell_size: FACE_CELL_UNITS,
 56:     }
 57: }
````
