````rust
 62: struct FaceFrame {
 63: 
 64:     plane_axis: usize,
 65: 
 66:     plane: f32,
 67:     u_axis: usize,
 68:     v_axis: usize,
 69:     min_u: f32,
 70:     min_v: f32,
 71:     cells_u: u32,
 72:     cells_v: u32,
 73: }
 74: 
 75: fn face_frame(quad: &MergedQuad, s: f32) -> FaceFrame {
 76:     let cells = |len: f32| ((len / s).round() as u32).max(1);
 77:     match quad.dir {
 78: 
 79:         FaceDirection::Up | FaceDirection::Down => FaceFrame {
 80:             plane_axis: 1,
 81:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::Up {
 82:                 quad.y + s
 83:             } else {
 84:                 quad.y
 85:             },
 86:             u_axis: 0,
 87:             v_axis: 2,
 88:             min_u: quad.x,
 89:             min_v: quad.z,
 90:             cells_u: cells(quad.w),
 91:             cells_v: cells(quad.h),
 92:         },
 93: 
 94:         FaceDirection::North | FaceDirection::South => FaceFrame {
 95:             plane_axis: 2,
 96:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::South {
 97:                 quad.z + s
 98:             } else {
 99:                 quad.z
100:             },
101:             u_axis: 0,
102:             v_axis: 1,
103:             min_u: quad.x,
104:             min_v: quad.y,
105:             cells_u: cells(quad.w),
106:             cells_v: cells(quad.h),
107:         },
108: 
109:         FaceDirection::East | FaceDirection::West => FaceFrame {
110:             plane_axis: 0,
111:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::East {
112:                 quad.x + s
113:             } else {
114:                 quad.x
115:             },
116:             u_axis: 1,
117:             v_axis: 2,
118:             min_u: quad.y,
119:             min_v: quad.z,
120:             cells_u: cells(quad.h),
121:             cells_v: cells(quad.w),
122:         },
123:     }
124: }
125: 
126: fn emit_capped(quad: &MergedQuad, s: f32, max_cells: u32, out: &mut Vec<PackedFaceInstance>) {
127:     let frame = face_frame(quad, s);
128:     let material = quad.material;
129:     let flags = if vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::EMISSIVE_MATERIALS.contains(&material) {
130:         FACE_INSTANCE_FLAG_EMISSIVE
131:     } else {
132:         0
133:     };
134:     let normal_axis = normal_axis(quad.dir);
135: 
136:     let mut u_off = 0;
137:     while u_off < frame.cells_u {
138:         let piece_u = max_cells.min(frame.cells_u - u_off);
139:         let mut v_off = 0;
140:         while v_off < frame.cells_v {
141:             let piece_v = max_cells.min(frame.cells_v - v_off);
142:             let center_u = frame.min_u + (u_off as f32 + piece_u as f32 * 0.5) * s;
143:             let center_v = frame.min_v + (v_off as f32 + piece_v as f32 * 0.5) * s;
144:             let mut position = [0.0f32; 3];
145:             position[frame.plane_axis] = frame.plane;
146:             position[frame.u_axis] = center_u;
147:             position[frame.v_axis] = center_v;
148:             out.push(PackedFaceInstance {
149:                 position: position.map(pack_position),
150:                 extent_u: piece_u.min(u8::MAX as u32) as u8,
151:                 extent_v: piece_v.min(u8::MAX as u32) as u8,
152:                 normal_axis,
153:                 material,
154:                 baked_light: quad.light,
155:                 ao: quad.ao,
156:                 flags,
157:                 reserved: [0; 3],
158:             });
159:             v_off += piece_v;
160:         }
161:         u_off += piece_u;
162:     }
163: }
164: 
165: fn pack_position(value: f32) -> u16 {

167:         .round()
168:         .clamp(0.0, u16::MAX as f32) as u16
169: }

177:         FaceDirection::South => 3,

208:             .instances
````

````rust
 30:     pub fn key_event(&mut self, code: &str, pressed: bool) {
 31:         #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 32:         let doom = crate::DOOM_CONTROLS.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
 33: 
 34:         #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
 35:         let doom = false;
 36: 
 37:         if pressed && code == "KeyF" {
 38:             self.flashlight = !self.flashlight;
 39:         }
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44:         if code == "KeyG" {
 45:             if pressed && !self.flare_key_held && self.locked {
 46:                 self.flare_queued = true;
 47:             }
 48:             self.flare_key_held = pressed;
 49:         }
 50: 
 51: 
 52:         if code == "KeyR" {
 53:             if pressed && !self.drink_key_held && self.locked {
 54:                 self.drink_queued = true;
 55:             }
 56:             self.drink_key_held = pressed;
 57:         }
 58:         if code == "KeyT" {
 59:             if pressed && !self.eat_key_held && self.locked {
 60:                 self.eat_queued = true;
 61:             }
 62:             self.eat_key_held = pressed;
 63:         }
 64: 
 65:         if doom {
 66:             match code {
 67:                 "KeyW" | "ArrowUp" => self.intent.forward = pressed,
 68:                 "KeyS" | "ArrowDown" => self.intent.backward = pressed,
 69:                 "KeyQ" => self.intent.left = pressed,
 70:                 "KeyE" => self.intent.right = pressed,
 71:                 "KeyA" | "ArrowLeft" => self.intent.turn_left = pressed,
 72:                 "KeyD" | "ArrowRight" => self.intent.turn_right = pressed,
 73:                 _ => {}
 74:             }
 75:         } else {
 76:             match code {
 77:                 "KeyW" | "ArrowUp" => self.intent.forward = pressed,
 78:                 "KeyS" | "ArrowDown" => self.intent.backward = pressed,
 79:                 "KeyA" | "ArrowLeft" => self.intent.left = pressed,
 80:                 "KeyD" | "ArrowRight" => self.intent.right = pressed,
 81:                 "KeyQ" => self.intent.turn_left = pressed,
 82:                 "KeyE" => self.intent.turn_right = pressed,
 83:                 _ => {}
 84:             }
 85:         }
 86:     }

 89:     pub fn mouse_delta(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
 90:         if self.locked {
 91:             #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 92:             let (sens, invert) = {
 93:                 use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
 94:                 (
 95:                     f32::from_bits(crate::MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
 96:                     crate::INVERT_Y.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
 97:                 )
 98:             };
 99:             #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
100:             let (sens, invert) = (1.0f32, false);
101: 
102:             self.pending_dx += dx * sens;
103:             self.pending_dy += dy * sens * if invert { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
104:         }
105:     }
````

````rust
177: 
178: fn crop_lateral_halo(halo: &VoxelGrid, padding: usize) -> VoxelGrid {
179:     assert!(halo.width() > padding * 2 && halo.depth() > padding * 2);
180:     let mut inner = VoxelGrid::new(
181:         halo.width() - padding * 2,
182:         halo.height(),
183:         halo.depth() - padding * 2,
184:     );
185:     for z in 0..inner.depth() {
186:         for y in 0..inner.height() {
187:             for x in 0..inner.width() {
188:                 let hx = x + padding;
189:                 let hz = z + padding;
190:                 inner.set(x, y, z, halo.get(hx, y, hz));
191:                 inner.set_light_rgb(x, y, z, halo.get_light_rgb(hx, y, hz));
192:                 inner.set_face_occlusion(x, y, z, neighbor_occlusion_mask(halo, hx, y, hz));
193:             }
194:         }
195:     }
196:     inner
197: }
198: 
199: 
200: 
201: 
202: 
203: 
204: 
205: fn neighbor_occlusion_mask(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> u8 {
206:     if grid.get(x, y, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
207:         return 0;
208:     }
209: 
210:     let occupied = |x: isize, y: isize, z: isize| {
211:         x >= 0
212:             && y >= 0
213:             && z >= 0
214:             && (x as usize) < grid.width()
215:             && (y as usize) < grid.height()
216:             && (z as usize) < grid.depth()
217:             && grid.get(x as usize, y as usize, z as usize) != VOXEL_AIR
218:     };
219:     let x = x as isize;
220:     let y = y as isize;
221:     let z = z as isize;
222:     let mut mask = 0;
223:     if occupied(x + 1, y, z) {
224:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_X;
225:     }
226:     if occupied(x - 1, y, z) {
227:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_X;
228:     }
229:     if occupied(x, y + 1, z) {
230:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Y;
231:     }
232:     if occupied(x, y - 1, z) {
233:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Y;
234:     }
235:     if occupied(x, y, z + 1) {
236:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Z;
237:     }
238:     if occupied(x, y, z - 1) {
239:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Z;
240:     }
241:     mask
242: }
243: 
244: 
245: 
246: 
247: pub fn extract_collision_boxes(
248:     svo: &SparseVoxelOctree,
249:     origin_x: f32,
250:     origin_z: f32,
251:     voxel_scale: f32,
252: ) -> Vec<Aabb> {
253:     let mut boxes = Vec::new();
254:     let size = 1u32 << svo.depth;
255:     walk(
256:         svo,
257:         svo.root,
258:         0,
259:         0,
260:         0,
261:         size,
262:         origin_x,
263:         origin_z,
264:         voxel_scale,
265:         &mut boxes,
266:     );
267:     boxes
268: }
269: 
270: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
271: fn walk(
272:     svo: &SparseVoxelOctree,
273:     node_idx: usize,
274:     x: u32,
275:     y: u32,
276:     z: u32,
277:     size: u32,
278:     origin_x: f32,
279:     origin_z: f32,
280:     voxel_scale: f32,
281:     out: &mut Vec<Aabb>,
282: ) {
283:     match svo.nodes[node_idx] {
284:         SvoNode::Leaf { voxel_type, .. } => {
285:             if SOLID_TYPES.contains(&voxel_type) {
286:                 let min = [
287:                     origin_x + x as f32 * voxel_scale,
288:                     y as f32 * voxel_scale,
289:                     origin_z + z as f32 * voxel_scale,
290:                 ];
291:                 let extent = size as f32 * voxel_scale;
292:                 out.push(Aabb::new(
293:                     min,
294:                     [min[0] + extent, min[1] + extent, min[2] + extent],
295:                 ));
296:             }
297:         }
298:         SvoNode::Internal {
299:             child_base_index,
300:             child_mask,
301:         } => {
302:             let half = size / 2;
303:             for child in 0..8u32 {
304:                 if child_mask & (1 << child) != 0 {
305:                     walk(
306:                         svo,
307:                         child_base_index as usize + child as usize,
308:                         x + (child & 1) * half,
309:                         y + ((child >> 1) & 1) * half,
310:                         z + ((child >> 2) & 1) * half,
311:                         half,
312:                         origin_x,
313:                         origin_z,
314:                         voxel_scale,
315:                         out,
316:                     );
317:                 }
318:             }
319:         }
320:     }
321: }
````

````rust
 19: pub fn query_param<'a>(query: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
 20:     query
 21:         .trim_start_matches('?')
 22:         .split('&')
 23:         .find_map(|pair| match pair.split_once('=') {
 24:             Some((k, v)) if k == key => Some(v),
 25:             _ => None,
 26:         })
 27: }
 28: 
 29: /// True when the query holds exactly `key=1`.
 30: pub fn query_flag(query: &str, key: &str) -> bool {
 31:     query_param(query, key) == Some("1")
 32: }
 33: 
 34: /// Parses `window.location.search` (with or without the leading `?`).
 35: /// Unknown keys are ignored; malformed values fall back to defaults.
 36: pub fn parse_generation_params(query: &str, default_seed: u32) -> GenerationParams {
 37:     let mut params = GenerationParams {
 38:         seed: default_seed,
 39:         voxel_size: None,
 40:         tuning: LevelTuning::default(),
 41:         anomalies: AnomalyTuning::default(),
 42:     };
 43: 
 44:     for pair in query.trim_start_matches('?').split('&') {
 45:         let Some((key, value)) = pair.split_once('=') else {
 46:             continue;
 47:         };
 48:         let knob = |t: &mut f32| {
 49:             if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<f32>() {
 50:                 if v.is_finite() {
 51:                     *t = v.clamp(0.0, 4.0);
 52:                 }
 53:             }
 54:         };
 55:         let ranged = |t: &mut f32, min: f32, max: f32| {
 56:             if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<f32>() {
 57:                 if v.is_finite() {
 58:                     *t = v.clamp(min, max);
 59:                 }
 60:             }
 61:         };
 62:         match key {
 63:             "seed" => {
 64:                 params.seed = value.parse::<u32>().unwrap_or_else(|_| hash_seed(value));
 65:             }
 66:             "voxel_size" => {
 67:                 params.voxel_size = value.parse::<f32>().ok().filter(|v| v.is_finite());
 68:             }
 69:             "pillars" => knob(&mut params.tuning.pillars),
 70:             "walls" => knob(&mut params.tuning.walls),
 71:             "atria" => knob(&mut params.tuning.atria),
 72:             "lights" => knob(&mut params.tuning.lights),
 73:             // World provisioning: drink, food, and level-door frequency.
 74:             // 0 removes that class of content entirely.
 75:             "almond_water" => knob(&mut params.tuning.almond_water),
 76:             "rations" => knob(&mut params.tuning.rations),
 77:             "level_doors" => knob(&mut params.tuning.level_doors),
 78:             "anomalies" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.frequency),
 79:             "anomaly_size" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.size, 0.5, 2.0),
 80:             "pillar_expanses" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.pillar_expanses),
 81:             "blackouts" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.blackouts),
 82:             "red_rooms" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.red_rooms),
 83:             "pit_lattices" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.pit_lattices),
 84:             "remap_intensity" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.remap_intensity),
 85:             "remap_distance" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.remap_distance, 4.0, 64.0),
 86:             "anomaly_safe_radius" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.safe_radius, 4.0, 32.0),
 87:             // Gameplay tuning: the probability per closed-loop epoch that a
 88:             // red room hashes a single far-side escape breach. 0 seals every
 89:             // loop, 1 guarantees a breach; it is never the entrance.
 90:             "red_escape_bias" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.red_escape_bias, 0.0, 1.0),
 91:             "archways" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.archways),
 92:             // Deception: the fraction of blackout glimmers placed one
 93:             // segment off the recovery skeleton. The default is high on
 94:             // purpose — most glimmers lie.
 95:             "blackout_decoys" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.blackout_decoys, 0.0, 0.9),
 96:             // Debug: guarantee one anomaly of this family on the spawn's
 97: 
 98: 
 99:             "force_anomaly" => {
100:                 params.anomalies.forced_kind = match value {
101:                     "pillars" => Some(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse),
102:                     "blackout" => Some(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse),
103:                     "pits" => Some(AnomalyKind::PitLattice),
104:                     "archway" => Some(AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom),
105:                     "redroom" => Some(AnomalyKind::RedRoom),
106:                     _ => None,
107:                 };
108:             }
109:             _ => {}
110:         }
111:     }
112:     params
113: }

118: pub fn generator_setup_from_query(query: &str, default_seed: u32) -> (u32, GeneratorConfig) {
119:     generator_setup_for_quality(query, default_seed, quality_profile_from_query(query))
120: }
121: 
122: 
123: 
124: 
125: pub fn quality_profile_from_query(query: &str) -> QualityProfile {
126:     query_param(query, "spec")
127:         .and_then(QualityProfile::parse)
128:         .unwrap_or_default()
129: }
130: 
131: 
132: 
133: 
134: pub fn generator_setup_for_quality(
135:     query: &str,
136:     default_seed: u32,
137:     quality: QualityProfile,
138: ) -> (u32, GeneratorConfig) {
139:     let params = parse_generation_params(query, default_seed);
140:     let base = match quality {
141:         QualityProfile::Low => GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
142:         QualityProfile::High => GeneratorConfig::high_spec(),
143:     };
144:     let configured = base
145:         .with_tuning(params.tuning)
146:         .with_anomalies(params.anomalies);
147:     let configured = params
148:         .voxel_size
149:         .and_then(|voxel_size| configured.try_with_voxel_size(voxel_size).ok())
150:         .unwrap_or(configured);
151:     (params.seed, configured)
152: }
153: 
154: 
155: fn hash_seed(text: &str) -> u32 {
156:     let mut h: u32 = 0x811C_9DC5;
157:     for b in text.bytes() {
158:         h ^= b as u32;
159:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193);
160:     }
161:     h
162: }
````

````rust
 11: 
 12: pub struct SectionLocator {
 13:     seed: u32,

 19: 
 20: impl SectionLocator {
 21:     pub fn new(seed: u32, config: GeneratorConfig) -> Self {
 22:         Self {
 23:             seed,
 24:             config,
 25:             noise: SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
 26:             cached_region: None,
 27:             plan: None,
 28:         }
 29:     }
 30: 
 31: 
 32: 
 33:     pub fn describe(&mut self, level: u32, x: f32, z: f32) -> String {
 34:         if level == LEVEL_GRASSLAND {
 35:             return "LEVEL 34 · THE GRASSLAND".to_string();
 36:         }
 37:         if level == LEVEL_HABITABLE {
 38: 
 39: 
 40:             let sector =
 41:                 vackrooms::use_cases::level_one::Sector::at(self.seed, x, z).name();
 42:             return format!("LEVEL 1 · HABITABLE ZONE · {sector}");
 43:         }
 44:         let rx = (x / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64;
 45:         let rz = (z / REGION_SIZE).floor() as i64;
 46:         let zone = self.zone_name(rx, rz, x, z);
 47:         format!("LEVEL {level} · {zone} · REGION ({rx}, {rz})")
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     fn zone_name(&mut self, rx: i64, rz: i64, x: f32, z: f32) -> &'static str {
 51:         if self.cached_region != Some((rx, rz)) {
 52:             self.plan = Some(generate_region_plan(
 53:                 self.seed,
 54:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
 55:                 REGION_SIZE,
 56:                 &self.config,
 57:                 &self.noise,
 58:             ));
 59:             self.cached_region = Some((rx, rz));
 60:         }
 61:         let plan = self.plan.as_ref().expect("plan cached above");
 62: 
 63:         // Anomalies dominate: standing inside one matters more than which
 64:         // office footprint it swallowed.
 65:         for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 66:             if anomaly.footprint.contains(x, z) {
 67:                 return match anomaly.kind {
 68:                     AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => "PILLAR EXPANSE",
 69:                     AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => "BLACKOUT EXPANSE",
 70:                     AnomalyKind::PitLattice => "PIT LATTICE",
 71:                     AnomalyKind::RedRoom => "RED LOOP",
 72:                     AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => "ARCHWAY ANCHOR",
 73:                 };
 74:             }
 75:         }
 76:         for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 77:             if assembly.footprint.contains(x, z) {
 78:                 return program_name(assembly.program);
 79:             }
 80:         }
 81:         for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 82:             if corridor.distance(x, z) <= corridor.width * 0.5 {
 83:                 return program_name(corridor.spine_kind);
 84:             }
 85:         }
 86:         "OPEN FABRIC"
 87:     }
 88: }
 89: 
 90: fn program_name(program: SpaceProgram) -> &'static str {

 93:         SpaceProgram::Reception => "RECEPTION",
 94:         SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => "MAIN CORRIDOR",
 95:         SpaceProgram::SecondaryHall => "SECONDARY HALL",
 96:         SpaceProgram::OpenOffice => "OPEN OFFICE",
 97:         SpaceProgram::PrivateOffice => "PRIVATE OFFICE",
 98:         SpaceProgram::ConferenceRoom => "CONFERENCE ROOM",
 99:         SpaceProgram::WaitingArea => "WAITING AREA",
100:         SpaceProgram::BreakRoom => "BREAK ROOM",
101:         SpaceProgram::Storage => "STORAGE",
102:         SpaceProgram::ServerRoom => "SERVER ROOM",
103:         SpaceProgram::RestroomCore => "RESTROOM CORE",
104:         SpaceProgram::Stair => "STAIRWELL",
105:         SpaceProgram::Mechanical => "MECHANICAL",
106:         SpaceProgram::Atrium => "ATRIUM",
107:         SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "ABANDONED EXPANSION",
108:     }
109: }
````

````rust
 14: 
 15: 
 16: pub fn build_surface_mesh(
 17:     halo_grid: &VoxelGrid,
 18:     voxel_scale: f32,
 19:     lod: u8,
 20:     lateral_padding: usize,
 21: ) -> SurfaceMeshPayload {
 22:     build_surface_artifacts(
 23:         halo_grid,

 31: 
 32: 
 33: 
 34: pub fn build_surface_artifacts(
 35:     halo_grid: &VoxelGrid,
 36:     voxel_scale: f32,
 37:     lod: u8,
 38:     lateral_padding: usize,
 39:     artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds,
 40: ) -> SurfaceMeshPayload {
 41:     let mapper = VoxelMapper::new(voxel_scale, &DEFAULT_MATERIAL_PALETTE);
 42:     let quads = mapper.map_voxel_grid_with_padding(halo_grid, lateral_padding);
 43:     let width = halo_grid.width() - lateral_padding * 2;
 44:     let depth = halo_grid.depth() - lateral_padding * 2;
 45:     let bounds = Aabb::new(
 46:         [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
 47:         [
 48:             width as f32 * voxel_scale,
 49:             halo_grid.height() as f32 * voxel_scale,
 50:             depth as f32 * voxel_scale,
 51:         ],
 52:     );
 53:     let probe_grid = ProbeGrid::from_voxel_grid(
 54:         halo_grid,
 55:         DEFAULT_PROBE_WIDTH,
 56:         DEFAULT_PROBE_HEIGHT,
 57:         DEFAULT_PROBE_DEPTH,
 58:     );
 59:     let (pw, ph, pd) = probe_grid.dimensions();
 60:     let mut mesh = SurfaceMeshPayload {
 61:         vertices: Vec::with_capacity(if artifacts.indexed_surface_mesh() {
 62:             quads.len() * 4
 63:         } else {
 64:             0
 65:         }),
 66:         indices: Vec::with_capacity(if artifacts.indexed_surface_mesh() {
 67:             quads.len() * 6
 68:         } else {
 69:             0
 70:         }),
 71:         bounds,
 72:         lod,
 73:         faces: if artifacts.face_splats() {
 74:             crate::adapters::face_instances::build_face_instances(&quads, voxel_scale)
 75:         } else {
 76:             crate::application::ports::FaceInstanceSet::empty()
 77:         },
 78:         voxel_scale,
 79:         light_volume_bytes: probe_grid.as_bytes().to_vec(),
 80:         light_volume_dims: [pw as u32, ph as u32, pd as u32],
 81:     };
 82:     if artifacts.indexed_surface_mesh() {
 83:         for quad in &quads {
 84:             append_quad(&mut mesh, quad, voxel_scale);
 85:         }
 86:     }
 87:     mesh
 88: }
 89: 
 90: fn append_quad(mesh: &mut SurfaceMeshPayload, quad: &MergedQuad, voxel_scale: f32) {
 91:     let x0 = quad.x;
 92:     let x1 = quad.x + quad.w;
 93:     let y0 = quad.y;
 94:     let y1 = quad.y + quad.h;
 95:     let z0 = quad.z;
 96:     let z1_horizontal = quad.z + quad.h;
 97:     let z1_x_face = quad.z + quad.w;
 98: 
 99: 
100: 
101:     let points = match quad.dir {
102:         FaceDirection::Up => {
103:             let y = quad.y + voxel_scale;
104:             [
105:                 [x0, y, z0],
106:                 [x0, y, z1_horizontal],
107:                 [x1, y, z1_horizontal],
108:                 [x1, y, z0],
109:             ]
110:         }
111:         FaceDirection::Down => [
112:             [x0, y0, z0],
113:             [x1, y0, z0],
114:             [x1, y0, z1_horizontal],
115:             [x0, y0, z1_horizontal],
116:         ],
117:         FaceDirection::North => [
118:             [x0, y0, quad.z],
119:             [x0, y1, quad.z],
120:             [x1, y1, quad.z],
121:             [x1, y0, quad.z],
122:         ],
123:         FaceDirection::South => {
124:             let z = quad.z + voxel_scale;
125:             [[x0, y0, z], [x1, y0, z], [x1, y1, z], [x0, y1, z]]
126:         }
127:         FaceDirection::East => {
128:             let x = quad.x + voxel_scale;
129:             [
130:                 [x, y0, z0],
131:                 [x, y1, z0],
132:                 [x, y1, z1_x_face],
133:                 [x, y0, z1_x_face],
134:             ]
135:         }
136:         FaceDirection::West => [
137:             [quad.x, y0, z0],
138:             [quad.x, y0, z1_x_face],
139:             [quad.x, y1, z1_x_face],
140:             [quad.x, y1, z0],
141:         ],
142:     };
143: 
144:     let base = mesh.vertices.len() as u32;
145:     let normal_axis = normal_axis(quad.dir);
146:     let material = quad.material;
147:     for position in points {
148:         mesh.vertices.push(PackedVertex {
149:             position: position.map(pack_position),
150:             normal_axis,
151:             material,
152:             static_indirect: quad.light,
153:             ao: quad.ao,
154:         });
155:     }
156:     mesh.indices
157:         .extend_from_slice(&[base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3]);
158: }
159: 
160: fn pack_position(value: f32) -> u16 {
161:     (value * POSITION_FIXED_SCALE)
162:         .round()
163:         .clamp(0.0, u16::MAX as f32) as u16
164: }
165: 
166: fn normal_axis(dir: FaceDirection) -> u8 {
167:     match dir {
168:         FaceDirection::Up => 0,
169:         FaceDirection::Down => 1,
170:         FaceDirection::North => 2,
171:         FaceDirection::South => 3,
172:         FaceDirection::East => 4,
173:         FaceDirection::West => 5,
174:     }
175: }
176: 
177: #[cfg(test)]
178: mod tests {
179:     use super::*;
180:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_WALL;
181:

185:         grid.set(1, 0, 1, VOXEL_WALL);

187:         assert_eq!(mesh.vertices.len(), 24);
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/application/engine/noclip.rs
````rust
 1: use super::{
 2:     Engine, InputFrame, LEVEL_BACKROOMS, LEVEL_GRASSLAND, NOCLIP_CHANCE, NOCLIP_PUSH_SECONDS,
 3: };
 4: 
 5: impl Engine {
 6:     pub(super) fn rng_next01(&mut self) -> f32 {
 7:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
 8:         self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
 9:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
10:         (self.rng >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
11:     }
12: 
13: 
14: 
15:     pub(super) fn update_noclip(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
16:         self.noclip_cooldown = (self.noclip_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
17: 
18:         let i = input.intent;
19:         let pushing = input.locked && (i.forward || i.backward || i.left || i.right);
20:         let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
21:         let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
22:         let pinned = pushing && (dx * dx + dz * dz) < 0.002 * 0.002;
23: 
24:         if !pinned {
25:             self.push_seconds = 0.0;
26:             return;
27:         }
28:         self.push_seconds += dt;
29:         if self.push_seconds < NOCLIP_PUSH_SECONDS || self.noclip_cooldown > 0.0 {
30:             return;
31:         }
32:         self.noclip_cooldown = 1.0;
33:         if self.rng_next01() < NOCLIP_CHANCE {
34:             self.noclip();
35:         }
36:     }
37: 
38: 
39: 
40: 
41:     fn noclip(&mut self) {
42:         let (target, arrival) = if self.level == LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
43: 
44:             (LEVEL_GRASSLAND, None)
45:         } else {
46: 
47: 
48:             (LEVEL_BACKROOMS, Some(self.config.spawn))
49:         };
50:         self.switch_level(target, arrival);
51:     }
52: }
````

````rust
123:     fn run_fabric_drift_shift(&mut self, dt: f32) {
124:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);

130:         let min_cz = fabric_drift_cell_of(pz - near);
131:         let max_cz = fabric_drift_cell_of(pz + near);
132:         for cz in min_cz..=max_cz {

139:         let far2 = self.drift_far_radius() * self.drift_far_radius();
140:         let abandoned: Vec<(i64, i64)> = self
141:             .drift_near
142:             .iter()
143:             .copied()
144:             .filter(|&cell| Self::drift_cell_dist2(cell, px, pz) > far2)
145:             .collect();

151:         self.blackout_shift_cooldown = (self.blackout_shift_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
152:         let blackout_bounds = self
153:             .store
154:             .all_traversal_gates()
155:             .find(|gate| {
156:                 gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse
157:                     && gate.affected_bounds.contains(px, pz)
158:             })
159:             .map(|gate| gate.affected_bounds);
160:         let Some(bounds) = blackout_bounds else {
161:             self.blackout_shift_debug.0 = false;
162:             return;
163:         };
164:         self.blackout_shift_debug.0 = true;
165:         if self.blackout_shift_cooldown > 0.0 {
166:             return;
167:         }
168:         let forward = self.player.forward();
169: 
170: 
171: 
172:         let reach = self.drift_near_radius().max(3.0 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL);
173:         let mut shifted = Vec::new();
174:         for cz in fabric_drift_cell_of(pz - reach)..=fabric_drift_cell_of(pz + reach) {
175:             for cx in fabric_drift_cell_of(px - reach)..=fabric_drift_cell_of(px + reach) {
176:                 let cx_w = (cx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
177:                 let cz_w = (cz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL;
178: 
179: 
180: 
181: 
182: 
183:                 let inside = bounds.contains(cx_w, cz_w);
184:                 let behind = (cx_w - px) * forward[0] + (cz_w - pz) * forward[2] < -4.0;
185:                 let hidden = Self::is_hidden_from_player((cx, cz), px, pz);
186:                 if inside && behind && hidden {
187:                     shifted.push((cx, cz));
188:                 }
189:             }
190:         }
191:         self.blackout_shift_debug = (true, shifted.len(), self.blackout_shift_debug.2);
192:         if shifted.is_empty() {
193:             return;
194:         }
195:         self.blackout_shift_debug.2 += shifted.len();
196: 
197: 
198:         self.blackout_shift_cooldown =
199:             BLACKOUT_SHIFT_PERIOD_S / (1.0 + 2.0 * self.survival.mismanagement());
200:         for &(cx, cz) in &shifted {
201:             self.reality = self.reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, cz);
202:         }
203: 
204: 
205: 
206:         let cell_bounds: Vec<WorldBounds> = shifted
207:             .iter()
208:             .map(|&(cx, cz)| {
209:                 WorldBounds::new(
210:                     cx as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
211:                     cz as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
212:                     (cx + 1) as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
213:                     (cz + 1) as f32 * FABRIC_DRIFT_CELL,
214:                 )
215:             })
216:             .collect();
217:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
218:         let targets: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
219:             .store
220:             .iter_ordered()
221:             .filter(|chunk| {
222:                 let rect = WorldBounds::new(
223:                     chunk.origin.0,
224:                     chunk.origin.1,
225:                     chunk.origin.0 + cs,
226:                     chunk.origin.1 + cs,
227:                 );
228:                 cell_bounds.iter().any(|cell| cell.intersects(rect))
229:             })
230:             .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
231:             .collect();
232:         for key in targets {
233:             self.force_rebuild(key);
234:         }
235:     }
236: }
````

````rust
  6: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  7: pub struct CameraBasis {
  8:     pub right: [f32; 3],
  9:     pub up: [f32; 3],
 10:     pub forward: [f32; 3],
 11: }
 12: 
 13: 
 14: pub fn camera_basis(yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> CameraBasis {
 15:     let (sin_pitch, cos_pitch) = pitch.sin_cos();
 16:     let (sin_yaw, cos_yaw) = yaw.sin_cos();
 17:     CameraBasis {
 18:         right: [cos_yaw, 0.0, -sin_yaw],
 19:         up: [sin_pitch * sin_yaw, cos_pitch, sin_pitch * cos_yaw],
 20:         forward: [-cos_pitch * sin_yaw, sin_pitch, -cos_pitch * cos_yaw],
 21:     }
 22: }
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29: pub fn webgpu_view_projection(
 30:     frame: &FrameParams,
 31:     width: u32,
 32:     height: u32,
 33:     far: f32,
 34:     fov_tan: f32,
 35: ) -> [f32; 16] {
 36:     let basis = camera_basis(frame.yaw, frame.pitch);
 37:     let p = frame.camera_pos;
 38:     let dot = |a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]| a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
 39:     let view = [
 40:         basis.right[0],
 41:         basis.up[0],
 42:         -basis.forward[0],
 43:         0.0,
 44:         basis.right[1],
 45:         basis.up[1],
 46:         -basis.forward[1],
 47:         0.0,
 48:         basis.right[2],
 49:         basis.up[2],
 50:         -basis.forward[2],
 51:         0.0,
 52:         -dot(basis.right, p),
 53:         -dot(basis.up, p),
 54:         dot(basis.forward, p),
 55:         1.0,
 56:     ];
 57: 
 58:     let near = 0.03;
 59:     let far = far.max(near + 0.01);
 60:     let f = 1.0 / fov_tan.clamp(0.05, 4.0);
 61:     let aspect = width.max(1) as f32 / height.max(1) as f32;
 62:     let projection = [
 63:         f / aspect,
 64:         0.0,
 65:         0.0,
 66:         0.0,
 67:         0.0,
 68:         f,
 69:         0.0,
 70:         0.0,
 71:         0.0,
 72:         0.0,
 73:         far / (near - far),
 74:         -1.0,
 75:         0.0,
 76:         0.0,
 77:         (far * near) / (near - far),
 78:         0.0,
 79:     ];
 80:     multiply_column_major(&projection, &view)
 81: }
 82: 
 83: pub fn multiply_column_major(a: &[f32; 16], b: &[f32; 16]) -> [f32; 16] {
 84:     let mut result = [0.0; 16];
 85:     for column in 0..4 {
 86:         for row in 0..4 {
 87:             result[column * 4 + row] = a[row] * b[column * 4]
 88:                 + a[4 + row] * b[column * 4 + 1]
 89:                 + a[8 + row] * b[column * 4 + 2]
 90:                 + a[12 + row] * b[column * 4 + 3];
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93:     result
 94: }
````

````rust
 52: pub fn encode_display_color(radiance: LinearRgb) -> LinearRgb {
 53:     radiance.map(|channel| {
 54:         let linear = nonnegative_radiance(channel);
 55:         let mapped = if linear == f32::INFINITY {
 56:             1.0
 57:         } else {
 58:             linear / (1.0 + linear)
 59:         };
 60:         if mapped <= 0.003_130_8 {
 61:             mapped * 12.92
 62:         } else {
 63:             1.055 * mapped.powf(1.0 / 2.4) - 0.055
 64:         }
 65:     })
 66: }

 78: pub fn beer_lambert_transmittance(distance: f32, extinction: f32) -> f32 {
 79:     let Some(distance) = nonnegative(distance) else {
 80:         return 1.0;
 81:     };
 82:     let Some(extinction) = nonnegative(extinction) else {
 83:         return 1.0;
 84:     };
 85: 
 86:     if distance == 0.0 || extinction == 0.0 {
 87:         return 1.0;
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     (-extinction * distance).exp()
 91: }

104: pub fn fog_transmittance(view_distance: f32, fog_start: f32, extinction: f32) -> f32 {
105:     let (Some(view_distance), Some(fog_start)) =
106:         (nonnegative(view_distance), nonnegative(fog_start))
107:     else {
108:         return 1.0;
109:     };
110: 
111:     let fog_distance = if view_distance <= fog_start {
112:         0.0
113:     } else {
114:         view_distance - fog_start
115:     };
116:     beer_lambert_transmittance(fog_distance, extinction)
117: }

128: pub fn compose_fog(
129:     surface_radiance: LinearRgb,
130:     fog_radiance: LinearRgb,
131:     transmittance: f32,
132: ) -> LinearRgb {
133:     let surface = surface_radiance.map(nonnegative_radiance);
134:     let fog = fog_radiance.map(nonnegative_radiance);
135:     let transmittance = unit_interval_or_one(transmittance);
136: 
137:     if transmittance == 1.0 {
138:         return surface;
139:     }
140:     if transmittance == 0.0 {
141:         return fog;
142:     }
143: 
144:     let scattered = 1.0 - transmittance;
145:     [
146:         surface[0] * transmittance + fog[0] * scattered,
147:         surface[1] * transmittance + fog[1] * scattered,
148:         surface[2] * transmittance + fog[2] * scattered,
149:     ]
150: }

163: pub fn compact_support_window(distance: f32, range: f32) -> f32 {
164:     let Some(distance) = nonnegative(distance) else {
165:         return 0.0;
166:     };
167:     let Some(range) = positive(range) else {
168:         return 0.0;
169:     };
170: 
171:     if distance >= range || distance == f32::INFINITY {
172:         return 0.0;
173:     }
174:     if range == f32::INFINITY {
175:         return 1.0;
176:     }
177: 
178:     let ratio_squared = (distance / range).powi(2);
179:     let one_minus_fourth = 1.0 - ratio_squared * ratio_squared;
180:     one_minus_fourth * one_minus_fourth
181: }

194: pub fn finite_range_inverse_square_attenuation(
195:     distance: f32,
196:     range: f32,
197:     minimum_distance: f32,
198: ) -> f32 {
199:     let Some(distance) = nonnegative(distance) else {
200:         return 0.0;
201:     };
202:     let Some(minimum_distance) = positive(minimum_distance) else {
203:         return 0.0;
204:     };
205: 
206:     let window = compact_support_window(distance, range);
207:     if window == 0.0 {
208:         return 0.0;
209:     }
210: 
211:     let denominator = distance.max(minimum_distance).powi(2);
212:     if denominator == f32::INFINITY {
213:         0.0
214:     } else {
215:         window / denominator
216:     }
217: }

246: 
247: fn positive_cosine(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
248:     let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (normalize(a), normalize(b)) else {
249:         return 0.0;
250:     };
251:     (a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
252: }
253: 
254: 
255: fn normalize(vector: [f32; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
256:     if vector.iter().any(|component| !component.is_finite()) {
257:         return None;
258:     }
259: 
260:     let scale = vector
261:         .iter()
262:         .fold(0.0_f32, |largest, component| largest.max(component.abs()));
263:     if scale == 0.0 {
264:         return None;
265:     }
266: 
267:     let scaled = vector.map(|component| component / scale);
268:     let length = (scaled[0] * scaled[0] + scaled[1] * scaled[1] + scaled[2] * scaled[2]).sqrt();
269:     Some(scaled.map(|component| component / length))
270: }
271: 
272: fn nonnegative(value: f32) -> Option<f32> {
273:     if value.is_nan() {
274:         None
275:     } else {
276:         Some(value.max(0.0))
277:     }
278: }
279: 
280: fn positive(value: f32) -> Option<f32> {
281:     if value.is_nan() || value <= 0.0 {
282:         None
283:     } else {
284:         Some(value)
285:     }
286: }
287: 
288: fn nonnegative_radiance(value: f32) -> f32 {
289:     if value.is_nan() || value < 0.0 {
290:         0.0
291:     } else {
292:         value
293:     }
294: }
295: 
296: fn unit_interval_or_one(value: f32) -> f32 {
297:     if value.is_nan() {
298:         1.0
299:     } else {
300:         value.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
301:     }
302: }
````

````rust
 14: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 15: pub struct AtlasPool {

 21: 
 22: impl AtlasPool {
 23:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 24:         Self::default()
 25:     }
 26: 
 27: 
 28:     pub fn slot_nodes(&self) -> usize {
 29:         self.slot_rows * ROW_TEXELS
 30:     }
 31: 
 32: 
 33:     pub fn total_rows(&self) -> usize {
 34:         self.slot_rows * self.slots.len()
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:

 39: 
 40: 
 41:     pub fn ensure_layout(&mut self, num_slots: usize, rows: usize) -> bool {
 42:         let changed = rows > self.slot_rows || num_slots > self.slots.len();
 43:         if changed {
 44:             self.slot_rows = self.slot_rows.max(rows);
 45:             let len = self.slots.len().max(num_slots);
 46:             self.slots.clear();
 47:             self.slots.resize(len, None);
 48:         }
 49:         changed
 50:     }
 51: 
 52: 
 53: 
 54: 
 55:     pub fn assign(&mut self, key: ChunkKey) -> Option<usize> {
 56:         if let Some(i) = self.slots.iter().position(|s| *s == Some(key)) {
 57:             return Some(i);
 58:         }
 59:         let free = self.slots.iter().position(|s| s.is_none())?;
 60:         self.slots[free] = Some(key);
 61:         Some(free)
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     pub fn release(&mut self, key: ChunkKey) {
 65:         for slot in &mut self.slots {
 66:             if *slot == Some(key) {
 67:                 *slot = None;
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:     }
 71: 
 72: 
 73:     pub fn slot_first_row(&self, slot: usize) -> usize {
 74:         slot * self.slot_rows
 75:     }
 76: 
 77: 
 78:     pub fn node_offset_of(&self, key: ChunkKey) -> Option<usize> {
 79:         self.slots
 80:             .iter()
 81:             .position(|s| *s == Some(key))
 82:             .map(|i| i * self.slot_nodes())
 83:     }
 84: 
 85: 
 86:     pub fn fits(&self, payload: &ChunkPayload) -> bool {
 87:         payload.nodes.len() / 4 <= self.slot_nodes()
 88:     }
 89: 
 90: 
 91: 
 92:     pub fn rebased_block(&self, slot: usize, payload: &ChunkPayload) -> Vec<u32> {
 93:         let node_offset = (slot * self.slot_nodes()) as u32;
 94:         let mut block = Vec::with_capacity(self.slot_nodes() * 4);
 95:         block.extend_from_slice(&payload.nodes);
 96: 
 97: 
 98:         for i in 0..(payload.nodes.len() / 4) {
 99:             if block[i * 4] == 0 {
100:                 block[i * 4 + 1] += node_offset;
101:             }
102:         }
103:         while block.len() < self.slot_nodes() * 4 {
104:             block.extend_from_slice(&AIR_LEAF);
105:         }
106:         block
107:     }

111: 
112:     pub fn full_texels<'a>(
113:         &self,
114:         lookup: impl Fn(ChunkKey) -> Option<&'a ChunkPayload>,
115:     ) -> Vec<u32> {
116:         let mut texels = Vec::with_capacity(self.total_rows() * ROW_TEXELS * 4);
117:         for (slot, occupant) in self.slots.iter().enumerate() {
118:             match occupant.and_then(&lookup) {
119:                 Some(payload) => texels.extend_from_slice(&self.rebased_block(slot, payload)),
120:                 None => {
121:                     for _ in 0..self.slot_nodes() {
122:                         texels.extend_from_slice(&AIR_LEAF);
123:                     }
124:                 }
125:             }
126:         }
127:         texels
128:     }
129: }

132: pub fn payload_rows(payload: &ChunkPayload) -> usize {
133:     (payload.nodes.len() / 4).div_ceil(ROW_TEXELS)
134: }

159:     fn slots_are_stable_across_unrelated_evictions() {
160:         let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
161:         pool.ensure_layout(4, 2);
162:         let (a, b, c) = (
163:             chunk_key(0.0, 0.0),
164:             chunk_key(10.0, 0.0),
165:             chunk_key(20.0, 0.0),
166:         );
167:         let slot_a = pool.assign(a).unwrap();
168:         let slot_b = pool.assign(b).unwrap();
169:         pool.release(a);
170:         let slot_c = pool.assign(c).unwrap();
171: 
172:         assert_eq!(pool.node_offset_of(b), Some(slot_b * pool.slot_nodes()));
173:         assert_eq!(slot_c, slot_a);
174:     }

176:     #[test]
177:     fn rebased_block_shifts_internal_child_pointers_only() {
178:         let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
179:         pool.ensure_layout(2, 1);
180: 
181:         let mut p = payload(0, 2);
182: 
183:         p.nodes[0] = 0;
184:         p.nodes[1] = 8;
185:         p.nodes[4] = 1;
186:         p.nodes[5] = 42;
187: 
188:         let block = pool.rebased_block(1, &p);
189:         assert_eq!(block.len(), pool.slot_nodes() * 4);
190:         assert_eq!(block[1], 8 + pool.slot_nodes() as u32);
191:         assert_eq!(block[4], 1, "leaf type flag untouched");
192:         assert_eq!(block[5], 42, "leaf payload untouched");
193: 
194:         assert_eq!(&block[8..12], &AIR_LEAF);
195:     }
196: 
197:     #[test]
198:     fn growing_the_layout_invalidates_assignments() {
199:         let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
200:         assert!(pool.ensure_layout(2, 1));
201:         let key = chunk_key(0.0, 0.0);
202:         pool.assign(key).unwrap();
203:         assert!(!pool.ensure_layout(2, 1), "same layout is a no-op");
204:         assert!(pool.ensure_layout(2, 3), "bigger slots relayout");
205:         assert_eq!(pool.node_offset_of(key), None);
206:     }
207: 
208:     #[test]
209:     fn full_texels_covers_every_slot() {
210:         let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
211:         pool.ensure_layout(3, 1);
212:         let key = chunk_key(0.0, 0.0);
213:         let slot = pool.assign(key).unwrap();
214:         let p = payload(0, 4);
215:         let texels = pool.full_texels(|k| (k == key).then_some(&p));
216:         assert_eq!(texels.len(), 3 * pool.slot_nodes() * 4);
217: 
218:         let other_slot = (slot + 1) % 3;
219:         let base = other_slot * pool.slot_nodes() * 4;
220:         assert_eq!(&texels[base..base + 4], &AIR_LEAF);
221:     }
222: }
````

````rust
148: fn finite01(value: f32) -> f32 {
149:     if value.is_finite() {
150:         value.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
151:     } else {
152:         0.0
153:     }
154: }

156: 
157: fn smooth(edge0: f32, edge1: f32, x: f32) -> f32 {
158:     let t = ((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
159:     t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
160: }

165:     pub fn reset_strain(&mut self) {
166:         self.exertion = 0.0;
167:         self.fatigue = 0.0;
168:         self.bpm = BASELINE_BPM;
169:         self.target_bpm = BASELINE_BPM;
170:         self.still_seconds = 0.0;
171:     }

179: 
180:     pub fn advance(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32, moved_m: f32, context: BodyContext) {
181:         let dt = if dt_seconds.is_finite() {
182:             dt_seconds.clamp(0.0, 0.25)
183:         } else {
184:             0.0
185:         };
186:         let moved = if moved_m.is_finite() {
187: 
188:             moved_m.clamp(0.0, 2.0)
189:         } else {
190:             0.0
191:         };
192:         self.context = BodyContext {
193:             hydration: finite01(context.hydration),
194:             satiety: finite01(context.satiety),
195:             condition: finite01(context.condition),
196:             ambient_c: if context.ambient_c.is_finite() {
197:                 context.ambient_c.clamp(-50.0, 80.0)
198:             } else {
199:                 21.0
200:             },
201:         };
202:         if dt <= 0.0 {
203:             self.beat_event = false;
204:             return;
205:         }
206: 
207:         self.walked_m += moved as f64;
208: 
209: 
210:         let speed = moved / dt;
211:         let intensity = (speed / FULL_INTENSITY_SPEED_MPS).clamp(0.0, 1.5).powf(1.3);
212: 
213: 
214:         let c = self.context;
215:         let heat_stress = smooth(
216:             HEAT_STRESS_FLOOR_C,
217:             HEAT_STRESS_FLOOR_C + HEAT_STRESS_SPAN_C,
218:             c.ambient_c,
219:         );
220:         let dehydration = smooth(0.5, 0.0, c.hydration);
221:         let hunger = smooth(0.35, 0.0, c.satiety);
222:         let injury = smooth(0.6, 0.0, c.condition);
223: 
224: 
225: 
226:         let cost = (1.0 + 0.9 * heat_stress + 0.9 * dehydration + 0.5 * hunger + 0.6 * injury)
227:             .clamp(1.0, 3.0);
228: 
229:         let recovery_quality = (1.0
230:             - 0.45 * dehydration
231:             - 0.30 * hunger
232:             - 0.25 * self.fatigue
233:             - 0.25 * heat_stress)
234:             .clamp(0.25, 1.0);
235: 
236: 
237:         let target_exertion = (intensity * HEALTHY_WALK_EXERTION * cost).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
238:         if target_exertion > self.exertion {
239:             let blend = (dt / EXERTION_RISE_TAU_S).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
240:             self.exertion += (target_exertion - self.exertion) * blend;
241:         } else {
242:             let blend = (dt * recovery_quality / EXERTION_FALL_TAU_S).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
243:             self.exertion += (target_exertion - self.exertion) * blend;
244:         }
245:         self.exertion = finite01(self.exertion);
246: 
247: 
248:         let resting = intensity < 0.05;
249:         self.still_seconds = if resting {
250:             (self.still_seconds + dt).min(3600.0)
251:         } else {
252:             0.0
253:         };
254:         if self.exertion > FATIGUE_EXERTION_THRESHOLD {
255:             let over = (self.exertion - FATIGUE_EXERTION_THRESHOLD)
256:                 / (1.0 - FATIGUE_EXERTION_THRESHOLD);
257:             self.fatigue += over * FATIGUE_RISE_PER_S * dt;
258:         } else if resting && self.still_seconds >= FATIGUE_REST_DELAY_S {
259:             self.fatigue -= FATIGUE_RECOVERY_PER_S * recovery_quality * dt;
260:         }
261:         self.fatigue = finite01(self.fatigue);
262: 
263: 
264:         let deficit_stress = 0.5 * hunger + 0.5 * dehydration;
265:         let mut target = BASELINE_BPM
266:             + 78.0 * self.exertion
267:             + 26.0 * heat_stress.max(dehydration)
268:             + 10.0 * deficit_stress
269:             + 14.0 * self.fatigue
270:             + 24.0 * injury;
271:         target = target.clamp(MIN_BPM, MAX_BPM);
272:         self.target_bpm = target;
273:         let tau = if target > self.bpm {
274:             BPM_RISE_TAU_S
275:         } else {
276: 
277: 
278:             BPM_FALL_TAU_S / recovery_quality
279:         };
280:         let blend = (dt / tau).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
281:         self.bpm += (target - self.bpm) * blend;
282:         self.bpm = self.bpm.clamp(MIN_BPM, MAX_BPM);
283: 
284: 
285:         let next_phase = self.beat_phase + self.bpm / 60.0 * dt;
286:         self.beat_event = next_phase >= 1.0;
287:         self.beat_phase = next_phase.fract();
288:     }

370:             * self.condition_multiplier()
371:             * self.fatigue_multiplier();
372:         product.clamp(MOVEMENT_FLOOR, 1.0)
````

````rust
 15:     pub fn intersects(&self, other: &Aabb) -> bool {
 16:         self.max[0] > other.min[0]
 17:             && self.min[0] < other.max[0]
 18:             && self.max[1] > other.min[1]
 19:             && self.min[1] < other.max[1]
 20:             && self.max[2] > other.min[2]
 21:             && self.min[2] < other.max[2]
 22:     }
 23: }

 36:             eye_pos[1] - PLAYER_EYE_TO_FEET,

 38:         ],
 39:         [
 40:             eye_pos[0] + PLAYER_RADIUS,

 50: const MAX_CELLS_PER_BOX: usize = 256;

 58: #[derive(Debug)]
 59: pub struct CollisionWorld {
 60:     boxes: Vec<Aabb>,
 61:     occupied_cells: HashMap<SpatialCell, Vec<usize>>,
 62:     center_cells: HashMap<SpatialCell, Vec<usize>>,
 63:     fallback: Vec<usize>,
 64: }
 65: 
 66: impl CollisionWorld {
 67:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 68:         Self {
 69:             boxes: Vec::new(),
 70:             occupied_cells: HashMap::new(),
 71:             center_cells: HashMap::new(),
 72:             fallback: Vec::new(),
 73:         }
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     pub fn rebuild<'a, I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Aabb>>(&mut self, boxes: I) {
 77:         self.boxes.clear();
 78:         self.boxes.extend(boxes.into_iter().copied());
 79:         self.occupied_cells.clear();
 80:         self.center_cells.clear();
 81:         self.fallback.clear();
 82: 
 83:         for (index, aabb) in self.boxes.iter().enumerate() {
 84:             let Some((min_cell, max_cell)) = cells_for_bounds(aabb.min, aabb.max) else {
 85:                 self.fallback.push(index);
 86:                 continue;
 87:             };
 88:             let width = cell_count(min_cell.0, max_cell.0).unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
 89:             let depth = cell_count(min_cell.1, max_cell.1).unwrap_or(usize::MAX);
 90:             if width.saturating_mul(depth) > MAX_CELLS_PER_BOX {
 91:                 self.fallback.push(index);
 92:                 continue;
 93:             }
 94: 
 95:             for cell_z in min_cell.1..=max_cell.1 {
 96:                 for cell_x in min_cell.0..=max_cell.0 {
 97:                     self.occupied_cells
 98:                         .entry((cell_x, cell_z))
 99:                         .or_default()
100:                         .push(index);
101:                 }
102:             }
103: 
104:             let center_x = (aabb.min[0] + aabb.max[0]) * 0.5;
105:             let center_z = (aabb.min[2] + aabb.max[2]) * 0.5;
106:             self.center_cells
107:                 .entry(spatial_cell(center_x, center_z))
108:                 .or_default()
109:                 .push(index);
110:         }
111:     }
112: 
113:     pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
114:         self.boxes.len()
115:     }
116: 
117:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
118:         self.boxes.is_empty()
119:     }
120: 
121:     pub fn boxes(&self) -> &[Aabb] {
122:         &self.boxes
123:     }
124: 
125: 
126:     pub fn collides(&self, eye_pos: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
127:         self.intersects(&player_aabb(eye_pos))
128:     }
129: 
130: 
131: 
132:     pub fn count_centers_within_xz(&self, point: [f32; 3], radius: f32) -> usize {
133:         if !point[0].is_finite() || !point[2].is_finite() || !radius.is_finite() || radius < 0.0 {
134:             return 0;
135:         }
136:         let min = spatial_cell(point[0] - radius, point[2] - radius);
137:         let max = spatial_cell(point[0] + radius, point[2] + radius);
138:         let radius_squared = radius * radius;
139:         let mut count = 0;
140:         for cell_z in min.1..=max.1 {
141:             for cell_x in min.0..=max.0 {
142:                 let Some(indices) = self.center_cells.get(&(cell_x, cell_z)) else {
143:                     continue;
144:                 };
145:                 count += indices
146:                     .iter()
147:                     .filter(|&&index| center_within_xz(self.boxes[index], point, radius_squared))
148:                     .count();
149:             }
150:         }
151:         count
152:             + self
153:                 .fallback
154:                 .iter()
155:                 .filter(|&&index| center_within_xz(self.boxes[index], point, radius_squared))
156:                 .count()
157:     }
158: 
159:     fn intersects(&self, query: &Aabb) -> bool {
160:         let indexed_hit = cells_for_bounds(query.min, query.max).is_some_and(|(min, max)| {
161:             (min.1..=max.1).any(|cell_z| {
162:                 (min.0..=max.0).any(|cell_x| {
163:                     self.occupied_cells
164:                         .get(&(cell_x, cell_z))
165:                         .is_some_and(|indices| {
166:                             indices
167:                                 .iter()
168:                                 .any(|&index| query.intersects(&self.boxes[index]))
169:                         })
170:                 })
171:             })
172:         });
173:         indexed_hit
174:             || self
175:                 .fallback
176:                 .iter()
177:                 .any(|&index| query.intersects(&self.boxes[index]))
178:     }
179: }
180: 
181: impl Default for CollisionWorld {
182:     fn default() -> Self {
183:         Self::new()
184:     }
185: }
186: 
187: fn spatial_cell(x: f32, z: f32) -> SpatialCell {
188:     (
189:         (x / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE).floor() as i64,
190:         (z / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE).floor() as i64,
191:     )
192: }
193: 
194: fn cells_for_bounds(min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> Option<(SpatialCell, SpatialCell)> {
195:     if ![min[0], min[2], max[0], max[2]]
196:         .into_iter()
197:         .all(f32::is_finite)
198:         || max[0] < min[0]
199:         || max[2] < min[2]
200:     {
201:         return None;
202:     }
203:     Some((spatial_cell(min[0], min[2]), spatial_cell(max[0], max[2])))
204: }
205: 
206: fn cell_count(first: i64, last: i64) -> Option<usize> {
207:     last.checked_sub(first)
208:         .and_then(|distance| distance.checked_add(1))
209:         .and_then(|count| usize::try_from(count).ok())
210: }
211: 
212: fn center_within_xz(aabb: Aabb, point: [f32; 3], radius_squared: f32) -> bool {
213:     let center_x = (aabb.min[0] + aabb.max[0]) * 0.5;
214:     let center_z = (aabb.min[2] + aabb.max[2]) * 0.5;
215:     let dx = center_x - point[0];
216:     let dz = center_z - point[2];
217:     dx * dx + dz * dz <= radius_squared
218: }
````

````rust
 183: fn fixture_flicker_gain(id: u64, mode: u8, time: f32) -> f32 {
 184:     let phase = (id % 977) as f32 * 0.61;
 185:     match mode {
 186:         1 => {
 187:             let t = time * 47.0 + phase;
 188:             (0.86 + 0.10 * t.sin() * (t * 0.093).cos() + 0.04 * (time * 3.1 + phase).sin())
 189:                 .clamp(0.7, 1.0)
 190:         }
 191:         2 => {
 192: 
 193:             let step = (time * 9.0 + phase) as u64;
 194:             let mut h = id ^ step.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
 195:             h ^= h >> 31;
 196:             h = h.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
 197:             if (h >> 40) % 100 < 24 { 0.06 } else { 0.92 }
 198:         }
 199:         _ => 1.0,
 200:     }
 201: }

 306:         Self {

 354:     fn switch_level(&mut self, target: u32, arrival: Option<[f32; 3]>) {
 355:         self.level = target;
 356:         self.store.retain_keys(&[]);
 357: 
 358: 
 359: 
 360:         self.pending.clear();
 361:         self.completed_backlog.clear();
 362:         self.forced_reloads.clear();
 363: 
 364: 
 365:         self.pool = AtlasPool::new();
 366:         self.renderer.clear_surfaces();
 367:         self.world.rebuild([].iter());
 368:         self.draws.clear();
 369:         self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 370: 
 371:         self.flares.clear();
 372:         self.abandon_all_watched_drift_cells();
 373:         if let Some(arrival) = arrival {
 374:             self.player.relocate(arrival);
 375:         }
 376:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 377: 
 378:         self.invalidate_route();
 379: 
 380: 
 381:         self.door_cooldown = DOOR_COOLDOWN_S;
 382:     }

 420:     pub fn tick(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 421: 
 422:         let dt = dt_seconds.clamp(0.0, 0.1);
 423:         self.governor.update(dt_seconds * 1000.0);
 424:         self.time_seconds += dt as f64;
 425: 
 426:         let old_pos = self.player.position;
 427: 
 428: 
 429: 
 430:         let effort = self.body.movement_factor();
 431: 
 432: 
 433:         let mut walked_m = 0.0f32;
 434:         if input.locked {
 435:             self.player.apply_look(input.look_dx, input.look_dy);
 436:             self.player
 437:                 .step_with_effort(dt, &input.intent, &self.world, effort);
 438: 
 439: 
 440: 
 441: 
 442: 
 443: 
 444:             let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 445:             let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 446:             let step = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
 447: 
 448: 
 449:             if step < 1.0 {
 450:                 self.distance_m += step as f64;
 451:                 walked_m = step;
 452:             }
 453:         }
 454:         self.update_flares(dt, input);
 455:         self.update_anomalies(old_pos);
 456:         self.update_provisions(dt);
 457:         self.update_peripheral_shift(dt);
 458:         self.update_noclip(dt, input, old_pos);
 459: 
 460:         self.stream_chunks();
 461: 
 462:         let mut scene_lights = select_scene_lights(
 463:             self.store
 464:                 .iter_ordered()
 465:                 .flat_map(|chunk| chunk.payload.lights.iter()),
 466:             self.player.position,
 467:         );
 468: 
 469: 
 470: 
 471:         let flicker_time = self.time_seconds as f32;
 472:         for light in &mut scene_lights {
 473:             light.intensity *= fixture_flicker_gain(light.id, light.flicker_mode, flicker_time);
 474:         }
 475: 
 476: 
 477: 
 478: 
 479:         let instantaneous_c = thermal::ambient_celsius(
 480:             self.level,
 481:             self.player.position,
 482:             &scene_lights,
 483:             self.world
 484:                 .count_centers_within_xz(self.player.position, thermal::ENCLOSURE_RADIUS),
 485:         );
 486:         self.survival.advance_vitals(dt, instantaneous_c);
 487: 
 488: 
 489:         self.survival.consume(ConsumptionIntent {
 490:             drink: input.drink,
 491:             eat: input.eat,
 492:         });
 493: 
 494: 
 495:         let survival = self.survival.readout();
 496:         self.body.advance(
 497:             dt,
 498:             walked_m,
 499:             BodyContext {
 500:                 hydration: survival.vitals.hydration,
 501:                 satiety: survival.vitals.satiety,
 502:                 condition: survival.vitals.condition,
 503:                 ambient_c: survival.ambient_c,
 504:             },
 505:         );
 506:         self.update_route(dt);
 507:         if self.survival.succumb_if_dead() {
 508:             self.respawn_after_attrition();
 509:         }
 510: 
 511: 
 512: 
 513: 
 514: 
 515: 
 516: 
 517:         let tier = self.survival.advance_strain(dt);
 518:         if tier != self.reality.delirium() {
 519:             self.reality = self.reality.with_delirium(tier);
 520:         }
 521: 
 522:         let flare_lights = self
 523:             .flares
 524:             .lights(self.player.position, self.time_seconds as f32);
 525:         let frame = FrameParams {
 526:             camera_pos: self.player.position,
 527:             yaw: self.player.yaw,
 528:             pitch: self.player.pitch,
 529:             flashlight: input.flashlight,
 530:             dynamic_lights: flare_lights.lights,
 531:             dynamic_light_count: flare_lights.count,
 532:             scene_lights,
 533:             environment: self.environment(),
 534:             supply_sprites: self.collect_supply_sprites(),
 535:         };
 536:         self.renderer.draw(&frame, &self.draws);
 537:     }

 562:     fn chunk_dist2(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32) -> f32 {
 563:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 564:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 565:         let dx = (origin_x - px).max(px - (origin_x + cs)).max(0.0);
 566:         let dz = (origin_z - pz).max(pz - (origin_z + cs)).max(0.0);
 567:         dx * dx + dz * dz
 568:     }

 570:     fn update_anomalies(&mut self, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 571:         if self.level != LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 572:             self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 573:             return;
 574:         }
 575: 
 576:         let hazards: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
 577:         if let Some(hazard) = hazards
 578:             .iter()
 579:             .find(|h| h.contains(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]))
 580:         {
 581:             let authored = [
 582:                 hazard.recovery.x,
 583:                 self.player.position[1],
 584:                 hazard.recovery.z,
 585:             ];
 586:             let recovery = if self.world.collides(authored) {
 587:                 self.last_safe_position
 588:             } else {
 589:                 authored
 590:             };
 591:             self.player.relocate(recovery);
 592:             self.last_safe_position = recovery;
 593:             return;
 594:         }
 595: 
 596:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
 597:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
 598:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
 599:         for gate in gates {
 600:             let Some(direction) = gate.crossing(
 601:                 [old_pos[0], old_pos[2]],
 602:                 [self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]],
 603:             ) else {
 604:                 continue;
 605:             };
 606:             if gate.kind == TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold && direction != gate.forward {
 607:                 continue;
 608:             }
 609:             let next_reality = self.reality.with_advanced_gate(&gate, direction);
 610:             if next_reality == self.reality {
 611:                 continue;
 612:             }
 613:             self.reality = next_reality;
 614: 
 615: 
 616:             self.invalidate_route();
 617: 
 618:             if gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom {
 619: 
 620: 
 621: 
 622: 
 623:                 let targets: Vec<_> = self
 624:                     .store
 625:                     .iter_ordered()
 626:                     .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
 627:                     .collect();
 628:                 for key in targets {
 629: 
 630: 
 631: 
 632:                     self.force_rebuild(key);
 633:                 }
 634:             }
 635:         }
 636:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 637:     }

 642:     fn update_provisions(&mut self, dt: f32) {
 643:         self.door_cooldown = (self.door_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
 644:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 645: 
 646: 
 647: 
 648: 
 649:         let mut grabbed: Vec<_> = self
 650:             .store
 651:             .all_supply_items()
 652:             .filter(|item| {
 653:                 item.within_reach(px, pz, PICKUP_REACH) && !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id)
 654:             })
 655:             .copied()
 656:             .collect();
 657:         grabbed.sort_by_key(|item| item.id);
 658:         grabbed.dedup_by_key(|item| item.id);
 659:         for item in grabbed {
 660: 
 661: 
 662: 
 663: 
 664:             if !self.survival.try_pickup(item.kind) {
 665:                 continue;
 666:             }
 667:             self.reality = self.reality.with_supply_consumed(item.id);
 668: 
 669: 
 670:             let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 671:             let key = chunk_key(
 672:                 (item.position.x / cs).floor() * cs,
 673:                 (item.position.z / cs).floor() * cs,
 674:             );
 675:             self.force_rebuild(key);
 676:         }
 677: 
 678: 
 679:         if self.door_cooldown > 0.0 {
 680:             return;
 681:         }
 682:         let transit = self
 683:             .store
 684:             .all_level_exits()
 685:             .find(|exit| exit.contains(px, pz))
 686:             .copied();
 687:         if let Some(exit) = transit {
 688:             let arrival = [exit.arrival.x, self.player.position[1], exit.arrival.z];
 689:             self.switch_level(exit.target_level, Some(arrival));
 690:         }
 691:     }

 696:     pub fn collect_supply_sprites(&self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::SupplySprite> {
 697:         use crate::application::ports::{MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES, SupplySprite};
 698:         const LABEL_CULL: f32 = 14.0;
 699:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 700:         let mut near: Vec<(f32, SupplySprite)> = self
 701:             .store
 702:             .all_supply_items()
 703:             .filter(|item| !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id))
 704:             .filter_map(|item| {
 705:                 let dx = item.position.x - px;
 706:                 let dz = item.position.z - pz;
 707:                 let d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
 708:                 (d2 < LABEL_CULL * LABEL_CULL).then_some((
 709:                     d2,
 710:                     SupplySprite {
 711:                         position: [item.position.x, item.rest_y + 0.62, item.position.z],
 712:                         atlas_row: match item.kind {
 713:                             SupplyKind::AlmondWater => 0,
 714:                             SupplyKind::Ration => 1,
 715:                         },
 716:                     },
 717:                 ))
 718:             })
 719:             .collect();
 720:         near.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
 721: 
 722:         near.dedup_by(|a, b| a.1 == b.1);
 723:         near.truncate(MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES);
 724:         near.into_iter().map(|(_, sprite)| sprite).collect()
 725:     }

 781:     fn install_completed(
 782:         &mut self,
 783:         keep: &[ChunkKey],
 784:         loaded: &mut Vec<ChunkKey>,
 785:         changed: &mut bool,
 786:     ) {
 787: 
 788: 
 789: 
 790: 
 791:         for failed in self.source.poll_failed_requests() {
 792:             let key = chunk_key(failed.origin_x, failed.origin_z);
 793:             let is_current = self
 794:                 .pending
 795:                 .get(&key)
 796:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&failed));
 797:             if is_current {
 798:                 self.pending.remove(&key);
 799:             }
 800:         }
 801: 
 802:         let fresh = self.source.poll_completed();
 803:         self.completed_backlog.extend(fresh);
 804:         let mut budget = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST).max(1);
 805:         let mut deferred: Vec<CompletedChunk> = Vec::new();
 806:         for done in self.completed_backlog.drain(..).collect::<Vec<_>>() {
 807:             let install_cost = if done.request.lod == 0 {
 808:                 FINE_LOAD_COST
 809:             } else {
 810:                 1
 811:             };
 812:             if budget < install_cost {
 813:                 deferred.push(done);
 814:                 continue;
 815:             }
 816:             let req = &done.request;
 817:             let key = chunk_key(req.origin_x, req.origin_z);
 818: 
 819: 
 820: 
 821:             let is_current = self
 822:                 .pending
 823:                 .get(&key)
 824:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(req));
 825:             if !is_current {
 826:                 continue;
 827:             }
 828:             self.pending.remove(&key);
 829:             if req.level != self.level || !keep.contains(&key) {
 830:                 continue;
 831:             }
 832:             let is_forced = self.forced_reloads.contains(&key);
 833:             let improves = match self.store.get(key) {
 834:                 None => true,
 835: 
 836: 
 837: 
 838:                 Some(resident) if resident.is_in_reality(&req.reality) => req.lod < resident.lod,
 839:                 Some(_) => is_forced,
 840:             };
 841:             if !improves {
 842:                 continue;
 843:             }
 844:             if is_forced {
 845:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
 846:                 if done
 847:                     .payload
 848:                     .collision
 849:                     .iter()
 850:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
 851:                 {
 852: 
 853: 
 854: 
 855:                     self.pending.insert(key, req.clone());
 856:                     deferred.push(done);
 857:                     continue;
 858:                 }
 859:             }
 860:             budget -= install_cost;
 861:             self.store.insert(
 862:                 key,
 863:                 LoadedChunk::new(
 864:                     (req.origin_x, req.origin_z),
 865:                     req.lod,
 866:                     req.reality.clone(),
 867:                     done.payload,
 868:                 ),
 869:             );
 870:             if !loaded.contains(&key) {
 871:                 loaded.push(key);
 872:             }
 873:             *changed = true;
 874:             self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
 875:         }
 876:         self.completed_backlog = deferred;
 877: 
 878: 
 879:         self.pending
 880:             .retain(|key, request| keep.contains(key) && request.level == self.level);
 881:     }

 886:     fn issue_requests(&mut self, desired: &[(f32, f32)], desired_visual: &[(f32, f32)]) {
 887: 
 888: 
 889:         let max_pending = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick * 2).max(4);
 890: 
 891:         let forced: Vec<_> = self
 892:             .forced_reloads
 893:             .iter()
 894:             .filter_map(|&key| {
 895:                 self.store
 896:                     .get(key)
 897:                     .map(|chunk| (key, chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1, chunk.lod))
 898:             })
 899:             .collect();
 900:         for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
 901:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 902:                 break;
 903:             }
 904:             if !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 905:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, lod);
 906:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 907:                 self.source.request(request);
 908:             }
 909:         }
 910: 
 911:         for &(ox, oz) in desired_visual {
 912:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 913:                 break;
 914:             }
 915:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 916:             if !self.store.contains(key) && !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 917:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, COARSE_LOD);
 918:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 919:                 self.source.request(request);
 920:             }
 921:         }
 922: 
 923:         let fine_in_flight = self.pending.values().any(|request| request.lod == 0);
 924:         if fine_in_flight || self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 925:             return;
 926:         }
 927:         let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
 928:         let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
 929:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 930:             self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
 931:                 && !self.pending.contains_key(&key)
 932:                 && self.store.get(key).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
 933:         });
 934:         if let Some((ox, oz)) = target {
 935:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 936:             let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
 937:             let request = self.make_request_for(ox, oz, 0, resident_reality);
 938:             self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 939:             self.source.request(request);
 940:         }
 941:     }

 944: 
 945:

 947:

 950:

 959:     fn stream_chunks(&mut self) {
 960:         let surface_renderer = self.artifact_needs.needs_surface_extraction();
 961:         let desired = self
 962:             .policy
 963:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 964:         let desired_visual = self
 965:             .visual_policy
 966:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 967:         let keep: Vec<_> = desired_visual
 968:             .iter()
 969:             .map(|&(x, z)| chunk_key(x, z))
 970:             .collect();
 971: 
 972: 
 973:         let evicted: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
 974:             .store
 975:             .iter_ordered()
 976:             .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
 977:             .filter(|k| !keep.contains(k))
 978:             .collect();
 979:         let mut changed = self.store.retain_keys(&keep);
 980:         self.forced_reloads.retain(|key| keep.contains(key));
 981:         if surface_renderer {
 982:             if !evicted.is_empty() {
 983:                 self.renderer.remove_surfaces(&evicted);
 984:             }

1211:

1216:         self.pending.remove(&key);
1217:         self.forced_reloads.insert(key);

1556:     struct AsyncFakeSource {

1562:     impl ChunkSourcePort for AsyncFakeSource {
1563:         fn load(&self, _x: f32, _z: f32, _level: u32, _lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
1564:             unreachable!("async sources must never be block-loaded by the engine");
1565:         }
1566:         fn is_async(&self) -> bool {
1567:             true
1568:         }
1569:         fn request(&mut self, request: ChunkRequest) {
1570:             self.requests.borrow_mut().push(request);
1571:         }
1572:         fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk> {
1573:             self.ready.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
1574:         }
1575:         fn poll_failed_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
1576:             self.failed.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
1577:         }
1578:     }
1579: 
1580:     fn completed(request: ChunkRequest) -> crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk {
1581:         let payload = FlatChunkSource.load(
1582:             request.origin_x,
1583:             request.origin_z,
1584:             request.level,
1585:             request.lod,
1586:         );
1587:         crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk { request, payload }
1588:     }

1591:         request_id: u32,
1592:         origin_x: f32,
1593:         origin_z: f32,
1594:         level: u32,
1595:         lod: u8,
1596:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
1597:         ChunkRequest {
1598:             request_id,
1599:             origin_x,
1600:             origin_z,
1601:             level,
1602:             lod,
1603:             artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH,
1604:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
1605:         }
1606:     }

1608:     #[test]
1609:     fn async_source_streams_without_blocking_and_refines_monotonically() {
1610:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1611:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1612:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1613:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1614:             EngineConfig::default(),
1615:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1616:             Box::new(source),
1617:         );
1618:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1619: 
1620:         // First tick issues requests but installs nothing — the frame
1621:         // never waits for generation.
1622:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1623:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 0);
1624:         assert!(!engine.stats().ready);
1625:         assert!(!requests.borrow().is_empty());
1626:         assert!(
1627:             requests
1628:                 .borrow()
1629:                 .iter()
1630:                 .all(|request| request.artifacts == RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH),
1631:             "the renderer's selected artifacts must reach every chunk order"
1632:         );
1633: 
1634: 
1635:         for _ in 0..40 {
1636:             let fulfil: Vec<_> = requests.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect();
1637:             for req in fulfil {
1638:                 ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
1639:             }
1640:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1641:         }
1642:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1643:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
1644:         assert!(engine.stats().ready);
1645: 
1646: 
1647:         let before = requests.borrow().len();
1648:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1649:         assert_eq!(requests.borrow().len(), before);
1650:     }

1778:     #[test]
1779:     fn old_completion_cannot_clear_a_newer_request_for_the_same_chunk() {
1780:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1781:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1782:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1783:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1784:             EngineConfig::default(),
````
