````rust
1786:             Box::new(source),
1787:         );
1788:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1789:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1790: 
1791:         let current = requests.borrow()[0].clone();
1792:         let key = chunk_key(current.origin_x, current.origin_z);
1793:         let mut stale = current.clone();
1794:         stale.request_id = stale.request_id.wrapping_sub(1);
1795:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(stale));
1796:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1797: 
1798:         assert!(
1799:             engine
1800:                 .pending
1801:                 .get(&key)
1802:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&current)),
1803:             "a stale completion must leave the newer request pending"
1804:         );
1805:         assert!(engine.store.get(key).is_none());
1806: 
1807:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(current.clone()));
1808:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1809:         let installed = engine.store.get(key).expect("current completion installs");
1810:         assert!(installed.is_in_reality(&current.reality));
1811:     }

1813:     #[test]
1814:     fn failed_async_request_is_retried_but_stale_failure_cannot_cancel_retry() {
1815:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1816:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1817:         let failed = source.failed.clone();
1818:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1819:             EngineConfig::default(),
1820:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1821:             Box::new(source),
1822:         );
1823:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1824:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1825: 
1826:         let first = requests.borrow()[0].clone();
1827:         let key = chunk_key(first.origin_x, first.origin_z);
1828:         requests.borrow_mut().clear();
1829:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first.clone());
1830:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1831: 
1832:         let retry = engine
1833:             .pending
1834:             .get(&key)
1835:             .expect("a transport failure is retried on the same tick")
1836:             .clone();
1837:         assert_ne!(retry.request_id, first.request_id);
1838:         assert!(
1839:             requests
1840:                 .borrow()
1841:                 .iter()
1842:                 .any(|request| request.is_same_request(&retry))
1843:         );
1844: 
1845:         requests.borrow_mut().clear();
1846:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first);
1847:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1848:         assert!(
1849:             engine
1850:                 .pending
1851:                 .get(&key)
1852:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&retry)),
1853:             "a late failure for the old order must preserve its current retry"
1854:         );
1855:         assert!(requests.borrow().is_empty(), "no duplicate may be queued");
1856:     }
````

````rust
  7: const FLARE_CAP: usize = 12;

  9: const FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE: f32 = 40.0;

 11: const FLARE_LIGHT_RADIUS: f32 = 9.0;
 12: 
 13: const FLARE_DROP_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.9;
 14: 
 15: const FLARE_HEIGHT: f32 = 0.3;
 16: 
 17: const BURIED_PROBE_HEIGHT: f32 = 0.2;
 18: 
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 23: pub struct Flare {
 24:     pub position: [f32; 3],
 25:     pub age_seconds: f32,
 26: 
 27:     pub sequence: u64,
 28: }
 29: 
 30: impl Flare {
 31:     pub fn remaining_seconds(&self) -> f32 {
 32:         (FLARE_LIFETIME_S - self.age_seconds).max(0.0)
 33:     }
 34: }
 35: 
 36: 
 37: pub(crate) struct FlareLightSet {
 38:     pub(crate) lights: [DynamicLight; MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS],
 39:     pub(crate) count: u8,
 40: }
 41: 
 42: 
 43: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 44: pub(crate) struct FlareField {
 45:     active: Vec<Flare>,
 46:     sequence: u64,
 47: }
 48: 
 49: impl FlareField {
 50: 
 51:     pub(crate) fn advance(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32) {
 52:         for flare in &mut self.active {
 53:             flare.age_seconds += dt_seconds;
 54:         }
 55:         self.active
 56:             .retain(|flare| flare.age_seconds < FLARE_LIFETIME_S);
 57:     }
 58: 
 59: 
 60: 
 61:     pub(crate) fn drop_from(
 62:         &mut self,
 63:         eye: [f32; 3],
 64:         forward: [f32; 3],
 65:         collision: &CollisionWorld,
 66:     ) {
 67:         let ahead = [
 68:             eye[0] + forward[0] * FLARE_DROP_DISTANCE,
 69:             eye[1],
 70:             eye[2] + forward[2] * FLARE_DROP_DISTANCE,
 71:         ];
 72:         let spot = if collision.collides(ahead) {
 73:             eye
 74:         } else {
 75:             ahead
 76:         };
 77: 
 78:         if self.active.len() >= FLARE_CAP {
 79:             self.active.remove(0);
 80:         }
 81:         self.sequence += 1;
 82:         self.active.push(Flare {
 83:             position: [spot[0], FLARE_HEIGHT, spot[2]],
 84:             age_seconds: 0.0,
 85:             sequence: self.sequence,
 86:         });
 87:     }
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91: 
 92:     pub(crate) fn extinguish_buried(&mut self, boxes: &[Aabb]) {
 93:         self.active.retain(|flare| {
 94:             let probe = [
 95:                 flare.position[0],
 96:                 flare.position[1] + BURIED_PROBE_HEIGHT,
 97:                 flare.position[2],
 98:             ];
 99:             !boxes.iter().any(|bounds| point_in_aabb(probe, bounds))
100:         });
101:     }
102: 
103: 
104: 
105:     pub(crate) fn lights(&self, camera: [f32; 3], time_seconds: f32) -> FlareLightSet {
106:         let nearest = self.nearest(camera);
107:         let count = nearest.len() as u8;
108:         let mut lights = [DynamicLight::default(); MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS];
109: 
110:         for (slot, flare) in nearest.into_iter().enumerate() {
111:             let fade = (flare.remaining_seconds() / (FLARE_LIFETIME_S * 0.1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
112:             let phase = time_seconds * 13.0 + flare.sequence as f32 * 1.7;
113:             let flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * phase.sin() * (phase * 0.37).cos();
114:             lights[slot] = DynamicLight {
115:                 position: flare.position,
116:                 color: [1.0, 0.45, 0.18],
117:                 radius: FLARE_LIGHT_RADIUS,
118:                 intensity: 1.6 * fade * flicker,
119:             };
120:         }
121: 
122:         FlareLightSet { lights, count }
123:     }
124: 
125: 
126:     pub(crate) fn clear(&mut self) {
127:         self.active.clear();
128:     }
129: 
130:     pub(crate) fn active(&self) -> &[Flare] {
131:         &self.active
132:     }
133: 
134:     pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
135:         self.active.len()
136:     }
137: 
138:     fn nearest(&self, camera: [f32; 3]) -> Vec<&Flare> {
139:         let cull_distance_squared = FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE * FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE;
140:         let distance_squared = |flare: &Flare| {
141:             let dx = flare.position[0] - camera[0];
142:             let dz = flare.position[2] - camera[2];
143:             dx * dx + dz * dz
144:         };
145:         let mut nearest: Vec<_> = self
146:             .active
147:             .iter()
148:             .filter(|flare| distance_squared(flare) < cull_distance_squared)
149:             .collect();
150:         nearest.sort_by(|a, b| {
151:             distance_squared(a)
152:                 .total_cmp(&distance_squared(b))
153:                 .then_with(|| a.sequence.cmp(&b.sequence))
154:         });
155:         nearest.truncate(MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS);
156:         nearest
157:     }
158: }
159: 
160: fn point_in_aabb(point: [f32; 3], bounds: &Aabb) -> bool {
161:     point[0] >= bounds.min[0]
162:         && point[0] <= bounds.max[0]
163:         && point[1] >= bounds.min[1]
164:         && point[1] <= bounds.max[1]
165:         && point[2] >= bounds.min[2]
166:         && point[2] <= bounds.max[2]
167: }
````

````rust
  1: pub const MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS: u8 = 32;
  2: 
  3: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
  4: pub enum GenerationWorkerPreference {
  5: 
  6:     Auto,
  7: 
  8:     Disabled,
  9: 
 10:     Fixed(u8),
 11: }
 12: 
 13: impl Default for GenerationWorkerPreference {
 14:     fn default() -> Self {
 15:         Self::Auto
 16:     }
 17: }
 18: 
 19: impl GenerationWorkerPreference {
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23:     pub fn resolve(self, hardware_concurrency: f64) -> usize {
 24:         if self == Self::Disabled {
 25:             return 0;
 26:         }
 27: 
 28:         let reported_threads = if hardware_concurrency.is_finite() && hardware_concurrency >= 1.0 {
 29:             hardware_concurrency.floor().min(u32::MAX as f64) as u32
 30:         } else {
 31:             2
 32:         };
 33:         let auto_workers = reported_threads
 34:             .saturating_sub(1)
 35:             .clamp(1, u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8;
 36:         let fixed_worker_ceiling =
 37:             reported_threads.clamp(1, u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8;
 38:         match self {
 39:             Self::Auto => auto_workers,
 40:             Self::Fixed(requested) => requested.clamp(1, fixed_worker_ceiling),
 41:             Self::Disabled => 0,
 42:         }
 43:         .into()
 44:     }
 45: }
 46: 
 47: 
 48: 
 49: 
 50: pub fn parse_generation_worker_preference(query: &str) -> GenerationWorkerPreference {
 51:     let mut preference = GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto;
 52:     for (key, value) in query
 53:         .trim_start_matches('?')
 54:         .split('&')
 55:         .filter_map(|pair| pair.split_once('='))
 56:     {
 57:         if key != "workers" {
 58:             continue;
 59:         }
 60:         preference = match value {
 61:             "auto" => GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto,
 62:             "0" => GenerationWorkerPreference::Disabled,
 63:             _ => value
 64:                 .parse::<u32>()
 65:                 .ok()
 66:                 .filter(|requested| *requested > 0)
 67:                 .map(|requested| {
 68:                     GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(
 69:                         requested.min(u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8,
 70:                     )
 71:                 })
 72:                 .unwrap_or(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto),
 73:         };
 74:     }
 75:     preference
 76: }
 77:
````

````rust
 33: 
 34: 
 35:     let cross = fwd[0] * dir[1] - fwd[1] * dir[0];
 36:     let dot = fwd[0] * dir[0] + fwd[1] * dir[1];
 37:     let deg = cross.atan2(dot).to_degrees();
 38:     let wrapped = ((deg % 360.0) + 360.0) % 360.0;
 39:     (wrapped.round() as i64).rem_euclid(360) as u16
 40: }

 44: 
 45: pub fn select_route_target<'a>(
 46:     exits: impl Iterator<Item = &'a LevelExit>,
 47:     player: [f32; 2],
 48: ) -> Option<RouteTarget> {
 49:     exits
 50:         .map(|exit| {
 51:             let pos = [exit.center.x, exit.center.z];
 52:             (range_m(player, pos), exit.id, exit, pos)
 53:         })
 54:         .min_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0).then(a.1.cmp(&b.1)))
 55:         .map(|(_, _, exit, pos)| RouteTarget {
 56:             exit_id: exit.id,
 57:             target_level: exit.target_level,
 58:             position: pos,
 59:         })
 60: }

 67: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 68: pub struct AnomalyFocus {
 69:     pub kind: AnomalyKind,
 70:     pub instance_id: u64,
 71: 
 72:     pub range_m: f32,
 73: 
 74:     pub position: [f32; 2],
 75: 
 76:     pub priority: u8,
 77: }
 78: 
 79: fn kind_priority(kind: AnomalyKind) -> u8 {
 80: 
 81:     match kind {
 82:         AnomalyKind::RedRoom => 4,
 83:         AnomalyKind::PitLattice => 3,
 84:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => 2,
 85:         _ => 1,
 86:     }
 87: }
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91: 
 92: pub fn select_anomaly_focus<'a>(
 93:     gates: impl Iterator<Item = &'a TraversalGate>,
 94:     pits: impl Iterator<Item = &'a PitHazard>,
 95:     player: [f32; 2],
 96:     awareness_m: f32,
 97: ) -> Option<AnomalyFocus> {
 98:     let gate_candidates = gates.map(|gate| {
 99:         // The gate's reference point: the nearest point of its plane span.
100:         let (x, z) = match gate.axis {
101:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => {
102:                 (gate.plane, player[1].clamp(gate.span_min, gate.span_max))
103:             }
104:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => {
105:                 (player[0].clamp(gate.span_min, gate.span_max), gate.plane)
106:             }
107:         };
108:         AnomalyFocus {
109:             kind: gate.anomaly_kind,
110:             instance_id: gate.instance_id,
111:             range_m: range_m(player, [x, z]),
112:             position: [x, z],
113:             priority: kind_priority(gate.anomaly_kind),
114:         }
115:     });
116:     let pit_candidates = pits.map(|pit| AnomalyFocus {
117:         kind: AnomalyKind::PitLattice,
118:         instance_id: pit.instance_id,
119:         range_m: range_m(player, [pit.center.x, pit.center.z]),
120:         position: [pit.center.x, pit.center.z],
121:         priority: kind_priority(AnomalyKind::PitLattice),
122:     });
123:     gate_candidates
124:         .chain(pit_candidates)
125:         .filter(|focus| focus.range_m.is_finite() && focus.range_m <= awareness_m)
126:         .min_by(|a, b| {
127:             b.priority
128:                 .cmp(&a.priority)
129:                 .then(((a.range_m * 10.0) as i64).cmp(&((b.range_m * 10.0) as i64)))
130:                 .then(a.instance_id.cmp(&b.instance_id))
131:         })
132: }
133:
````

````rust
  1: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
  2: pub struct PerfGovernor {
  3:     ema_frame_ms: f32,
  4:     scale: f32,
  5:     cooldown_frames: u32,
  6: 
  7:     frames_since_raise: u32,
  8: 
  9: 
 10:     raise_lockout_frames: u32,
 11: }
 12: 
 13: impl PerfGovernor {
 14:     const SCALES: [f32; 4] = [0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 1.0];
 15: 
 16:     const RAISE_PROBE_FRAMES: u32 = 600;
 17: 
 18:     const RAISE_LOCKOUT_FRAMES: u32 = 3600;
 19: 
 20:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 21:         Self {
 22:             ema_frame_ms: 16.0,
 23:             scale: 0.8,
 24:             cooldown_frames: 0,
 25:             frames_since_raise: u32::MAX,
 26:             raise_lockout_frames: 0,
 27:         }
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     pub fn scale(&self) -> f32 {
 31:         self.scale
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     pub fn update(&mut self, frame_ms: f32) {
 35:         self.ema_frame_ms = self.ema_frame_ms * 0.95 + frame_ms.clamp(0.0, 100.0) * 0.05;
 36:         self.frames_since_raise = self.frames_since_raise.saturating_add(1);
 37:         self.raise_lockout_frames = self.raise_lockout_frames.saturating_sub(1);
 38:         if self.cooldown_frames > 0 {
 39:             self.cooldown_frames -= 1;
 40:             return;
 41:         }
 42:         let idx = Self::SCALES
 43:             .iter()
 44:             .position(|&s| s == self.scale)
 45:             .unwrap_or(2);
 46:         if self.ema_frame_ms > 33.0 && idx > 0 {
 47: 
 48: 
 49: 
 50:             if self.frames_since_raise < Self::RAISE_PROBE_FRAMES {
 51:                 self.raise_lockout_frames = Self::RAISE_LOCKOUT_FRAMES;
 52:             }
 53:             self.scale = Self::SCALES[idx - 1];
 54:             self.cooldown_frames = 120;
 55:         } else if self.ema_frame_ms < 17.5
 56:             && idx + 1 < Self::SCALES.len()
 57:             && self.raise_lockout_frames == 0
 58:         {
 59: 
 60: 
 61:             self.scale = Self::SCALES[idx + 1];
 62:             self.cooldown_frames = 240;
 63:             self.frames_since_raise = 0;
 64:         }
 65:     }
 66: }
````

````rust
  6: 
  7: const FRICTION: f32 = 8.0;
  8: 
  9: const MOUSE_SENSITIVITY: f32 = 0.002;
 10: 
 11: const PITCH_LIMIT: f32 = std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2 - 0.05;

 26: pub struct Player {

 30: 
 31:     vel_strafe: f32,
 32:     vel_forward: f32,
 33: }
 34: 
 35: impl Player {
 36:     pub fn new(position: [f32; 3]) -> Self {
 37:         Self {
 38:             position,
 39:             yaw: 0.0,
 40:             pitch: 0.0,
 41:             vel_strafe: 0.0,
 42:             vel_forward: 0.0,
 43:         }
 44:     }
 45: 
 46: 
 47: 
 48: 
 49: 
 50:     pub fn relocate(&mut self, position: [f32; 3]) {
 51:         self.position = position;
 52:         self.vel_strafe = 0.0;
 53:         self.vel_forward = 0.0;
 54:     }
 55: 
 56: 
 57:     pub fn apply_look(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
 58:         self.yaw -= dx * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY;
 59:         self.pitch = (self.pitch - dy * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY).clamp(-PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT);
 60:     }
 61: 
 62: 
 63:     pub fn forward(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
 64:         [-self.yaw.sin(), 0.0, -self.yaw.cos()]
 65:     }
 66: 
 67: 
 68:     pub fn right(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
 69:         [self.yaw.cos(), 0.0, -self.yaw.sin()]
 70:     }
 71: 
 72: 
 73: 
 74: 
 75:     pub fn step(&mut self, dt: f32, intent: &MoveIntent, world: &CollisionWorld) {
 76:         self.step_with_effort(dt, intent, world, 1.0);
 77:     }
 78: 
 79: 
 80: 
 81: 
 82: 
 83:     pub fn step_with_effort(
 84:         &mut self,
 85:         dt: f32,
 86:         intent: &MoveIntent,
 87:         world: &CollisionWorld,
 88:         effort: f32,
 89:     ) {
 90:         let effort = if effort.is_finite() {
 91:             effort.clamp(0.05, 1.0)
 92:         } else {
 93:             1.0
 94:         };
 95: 
 96:         self.vel_strafe -= self.vel_strafe * FRICTION * dt;
 97:         self.vel_forward -= self.vel_forward * FRICTION * dt;
 98: 
 99: 
100:         let turn_speed = 3.0;
101:         if intent.turn_left {
102:             self.yaw += turn_speed * dt;
103:         }
104:         if intent.turn_right {
105:             self.yaw -= turn_speed * dt;
106:         }
107: 
108:         let mut wish_forward = (intent.forward as i32 - intent.backward as i32) as f32;
109:         let mut wish_strafe = (intent.right as i32 - intent.left as i32) as f32;
110:         let len = (wish_forward * wish_forward + wish_strafe * wish_strafe).sqrt();
111:         if len > 0.0 {
112:             wish_forward /= len;
113:             wish_strafe /= len;
114:         }
115: 
116:         self.vel_forward += wish_forward * ACCELERATION * effort * dt;
117:         self.vel_strafe += wish_strafe * ACCELERATION * effort * dt;
118: 
119:         let fwd = self.forward();
120:         let rgt = self.right();
121:         let step_x = (fwd[0] * self.vel_forward + rgt[0] * self.vel_strafe) * dt;
122:         let step_z = (fwd[2] * self.vel_forward + rgt[2] * self.vel_strafe) * dt;
123: 
124:         let old = self.position;
125: 
126:         self.position[0] = old[0] + step_x;
127:         if world.collides(self.position) {
128:             self.position[0] = old[0];
129:         }
130: 
131:         self.position[2] = old[2] + step_z;
132:         if world.collides(self.position) {
133:             self.position[2] = old[2];
134:         }
135:     }
136: }
````

````rust
361: #[repr(transparent)]
362: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
363: pub struct RenderArtifactNeeds(u8);
364: 
365: impl RenderArtifactNeeds {
366:     const INDEXED_SURFACE_MESH_BIT: u8 = 1 << 0;
367:     const FACE_SPLATS_BIT: u8 = 1 << 1;
368:     const SVO_NODES_BIT: u8 = 1 << 2;
369:     const KNOWN_BITS: u8 =
370:         Self::INDEXED_SURFACE_MESH_BIT | Self::FACE_SPLATS_BIT | Self::SVO_NODES_BIT;
371: 
372:     pub const NONE: Self = Self(0);
373:     pub const SURFACE: Self = Self(Self::INDEXED_SURFACE_MESH_BIT);
374:     pub const SPLAT: Self = Self(Self::FACE_SPLATS_BIT);
375:     pub const RAYMARCH: Self = Self(Self::SVO_NODES_BIT);
376:     pub const CPU: Self = Self(Self::SVO_NODES_BIT);
377:     pub const ALL: Self = Self(Self::KNOWN_BITS);
378: 
379:     pub const fn from_bits(bits: u8) -> Option<Self> {
380:         if bits & !Self::KNOWN_BITS == 0 {
381:             Some(Self(bits))
382:         } else {
383:             None
384:         }
385:     }
386: 
387:     pub const fn bits(self) -> u8 {
388:         self.0
389:     }
390: 
391:     pub const fn indexed_surface_mesh(self) -> bool {
392:         self.0 & Self::INDEXED_SURFACE_MESH_BIT != 0
393:     }
394: 
395:     pub const fn face_splats(self) -> bool {
396:         self.0 & Self::FACE_SPLATS_BIT != 0
397:     }
398: 
399:     pub const fn svo_nodes(self) -> bool {
400:         self.0 & Self::SVO_NODES_BIT != 0
401:     }
402: 
403:     pub const fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self {
404:         Self(self.0 | other.0)
405:     }
406: 
407:     pub const fn needs_surface_extraction(self) -> bool {
408:         self.indexed_surface_mesh() || self.face_splats()
409:     }
410: }

620:             let needs = RenderArtifactNeeds::from_bits(bits).expect("known bit combination");
621:             assert_eq!(needs.bits(), bits);

623:             assert_eq!(needs.face_splats(), bits & 2 != 0);

632:         assert!(!RenderArtifactNeeds::SURFACE.face_splats());
633:         assert!(!RenderArtifactNeeds::SURFACE.svo_nodes());
634: 
635:         assert!(!RenderArtifactNeeds::SPLAT.indexed_surface_mesh());
636:         assert!(RenderArtifactNeeds::SPLAT.face_splats());
637:         assert!(!RenderArtifactNeeds::SPLAT.svo_nodes());
638: 
639:         assert_eq!(RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH, RenderArtifactNeeds::CPU);
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/application/prepare_frame_lighting.rs
````rust
  1: use std::collections::HashMap;
  2: 
  3: use crate::application::ports::LightSource;
  4: 
  5: 
  6: 
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: pub fn select_scene_lights<'a>(
 13:     lights: impl Iterator<Item = &'a LightSource>,
 14:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
 15: ) -> Vec<LightSource> {
 16:     let mut unique = HashMap::<u64, LightSource>::new();
 17:     for light in lights.copied() {
 18:         if light.enabled && valid(&light) {
 19:             unique.entry(light.id).or_insert(light);
 20:         }
 21:     }
 22: 
 23:     let mut ranked: Vec<(LightSource, f32)> = unique
 24:         .into_values()
 25:         .map(|light| {
 26:             let delta = [
 27:                 light.position[0] - camera_position[0],
 28:                 light.position[1] - camera_position[1],
 29:                 light.position[2] - camera_position[2],
 30:             ];
 31:             let distance_squared = delta.into_iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f32>();
 32:             let area = (4.0 * light.half_size[0] * light.half_size[1]).max(0.01);
 33:             let importance = light.intensity * area / (distance_squared + area);
 34:             (light, importance)
 35:         })
 36:         .collect();
 37:     ranked.sort_by(|(a, a_score), (b, b_score)| {
 38:         b_score.total_cmp(a_score).then_with(|| a.id.cmp(&b.id))
 39:     });
 40: 
 41:     ranked.into_iter().map(|(light, _)| light).collect()
 42: }
 43: 
 44: fn valid(light: &LightSource) -> bool {
 45:     light.position.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
 46:         && light.color.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
 47:         && light
 48:             .half_size
 49:             .into_iter()
 50:             .all(|v| v.is_finite() && v >= 0.0)
 51:         && light.radius.is_finite()
 52:         && light.radius > 0.0
 53:         && light.intensity.is_finite()
 54:         && light.intensity > 0.0
 55: }
 56:
````

````rust
74:                 Some(quality)
75:             );
76:             assert_eq!(value.parse(), Ok(quality));
77:         }
````

````rust
111: const TOGGLE_BITS: [(&str, u32); 13] = [
112:     ("hiz", 1 << 0),
113:     ("f2b", 1 << 1),
114:     ("mips", 1 << 2),
115:     ("beam_occlusion", 1 << 3),
116:     ("shadows", 1 << 4),
117:     ("cells", 1 << 5),
118:     ("budget", 1 << 6),

120:     ("dither", 1 << 8),

125: ];
126: 
127: impl RenderToggles {
128:     fn field_mut(&mut self, name: &str) -> Option<&mut bool> {
129:         Some(match name {
130:             "hiz" => &mut self.hierarchical_z,
131:             "f2b" => &mut self.front_to_back,
132:             "skip" => &mut self.empty_space_skip,
133:             "mips" => &mut self.mip_lod,
134:             "beam_occlusion" => &mut self.flashlight_occlusion,
135:             "deferred" => &mut self.deferred_shading,
136:             "ao" => &mut self.ambient_occlusion,
137:             "shadows" => &mut self.shadow_pass,
138:             "cells" => &mut self.cell_culling,
139:             "budget" => &mut self.face_budget,
140:             "cull" => &mut self.distance_cull,
141:             "dither" => &mut self.dither,
142:             "bake" => &mut self.baked_lighting,
143:             _ => return None,
144:         })
145:     }
146: 
147:     fn field(&self, name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
148:         let mut copy = *self;
149:         copy.field_mut(name).map(|b| *b)
150:     }
151: 
152: 
153: 
154:     pub fn set(&mut self, name: &str, enabled: bool) {
155:         if let Some(field) = self.field_mut(name) {
156:             *field = enabled;
157:         }
158:     }
159: 
160: 
161: 
162: 
163:     pub fn enabled(&self, name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
164:         self.field(name)
165:     }
166: 
167: 
168:     pub fn to_bits(self) -> u32 {
169:         let mut bits = 0;
170:         for (name, bit) in TOGGLE_BITS {
171:             if self.field(name).expect("table names match fields") {
172:                 bits |= bit;
173:             }
174:         }
175:         bits
176:     }
177: 
178: 
179:     pub fn from_bits(bits: u32) -> Self {
180:         let mut toggles = Self::default();
181:         for (name, bit) in TOGGLE_BITS {
182:             toggles.set(name, bits & bit != 0);
183:         }
184:         toggles
185:     }
186: }

191: pub fn parse_render_toggles(query: &str) -> RenderToggles {
192:     let mut toggles = RenderToggles::default();
193:     for pair in query.trim_start_matches('?').split('&') {
194:         let Some((key, value)) = pair.split_once('=') else {
195:             continue;
196:         };
197:         let Some(name) = key.strip_prefix("rt_") else {
198:             continue;
199:         };
200:         match value {
201:             "0" | "false" | "off" => toggles.set(name, false),
202:             "1" | "true" | "on" => toggles.set(name, true),
203:             _ => {}
204:         }
205:     }
206:     toggles
207: }
````

````rust
 33:     pub fn desired_origins(&self, player_x: f32, player_z: f32) -> Vec<(f32, f32)> {
 34:         let px = if player_x.is_finite() { player_x } else { 0.0 };
 35:         let pz = if player_z.is_finite() { player_z } else { 0.0 };
 36:         let base_x = (px / self.chunk_size).floor() * self.chunk_size;
 37:         let base_z = (pz / self.chunk_size).floor() * self.chunk_size;
 38: 
 39:         let mut origins = Vec::with_capacity(((2 * self.radius + 1).pow(2)) as usize);
 40:         for dz in -self.radius..=self.radius {
 41:             for dx in -self.radius..=self.radius {
 42:                 origins.push((
 43:                     base_x + dx as f32 * self.chunk_size,
 44:                     base_z + dz as f32 * self.chunk_size,
 45:                 ));
 46:             }
 47:         }
 48:         origins.sort_by(|a, b| {
 49:             let da = (a.0 + self.chunk_size * 0.5 - px).powi(2)
 50:                 + (a.1 + self.chunk_size * 0.5 - pz).powi(2);
 51:             let db = (b.0 + self.chunk_size * 0.5 - px).powi(2)
 52:                 + (b.1 + self.chunk_size * 0.5 - pz).powi(2);
 53:             da.total_cmp(&db)
 54:         });
 55:         origins
 56:     }
 57: }

 99: pub struct ChunkStore {

104: impl ChunkStore {
105:     pub fn new() -> Self {
106:         Self {
107:             chunks: HashMap::new(),
108:             order: Vec::new(),
109:         }
110:     }
111: 
112:     pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
113:         self.order.len()
114:     }
115: 
116:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
117:         self.order.is_empty()
118:     }
119:

122:     }

126:     }

130:             self.order.push(key);
131:         }
132:     }
133: 
134: 
135: 
136:     pub fn retain_keys(&mut self, keep: &[ChunkKey]) -> bool {
137:         let before = self.order.len();
138:         self.order.retain(|k| keep.contains(k));
139:         self.chunks.retain(|k, _| keep.contains(k));
140:         before != self.order.len()
141:     }
142: 
143: 
144:     pub fn iter_ordered(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &LoadedChunk> {
145:         self.order.iter().filter_map(|k| self.chunks.get(k))
146:     }

161:     }

166:     }
````

````rust
  1: use crate::application::ports::LightSource;
  2: 
  3: 
  4: 
  5: pub fn dark_baseline_c(level: u32) -> f32 {
  6:     match level {
  7:         0 => 24.0,
  8:         1 => 13.0,
  9:         _ => 21.0,
 10:     }
 11: }
 12: 
 13: 
 14: const MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C: f32 = 13.0;
 15: 
 16: const HEAT_PER_IRRADIANCE: f32 = 9.0;
 17: 
 18: const ENCLOSURE_GAIN: f32 = 0.6;
 19: 
 20: pub const ENCLOSURE_RADIUS: f32 = 6.0;
 21: 
 22: const ENCLOSURE_SATURATION: f32 = 36.0;
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26: 
 27: 
 28: 
 29: pub fn ambient_celsius(
 30:     level: u32,
 31:     player: [f32; 3],
 32:     lights: &[LightSource],
 33:     enclosing_collision_boxes: usize,
 34: ) -> f32 {
 35:     let mut irradiance = 0.0f32;
 36:     for light in lights {
 37:         let dx = light.position[0] - player[0];
 38:         let dy = light.position[1] - player[1];
 39:         let dz = light.position[2] - player[2];
 40:         let distance = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();
 41:         let range = light.radius.max(0.01);
 42:         let falloff = (1.0 - distance / range).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 43:         irradiance += light.intensity * falloff * falloff;
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     let enclosure = (enclosing_collision_boxes as f32 / ENCLOSURE_SATURATION).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 47: 
 48:     let heat = (irradiance * HEAT_PER_IRRADIANCE).min(MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C)
 49:         * (1.0 + ENCLOSURE_GAIN * enclosure);
 50:     dark_baseline_c(level) + heat.min(MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C * (1.0 + ENCLOSURE_GAIN))
 51: }
 52: 
 53: #[cfg(test)]
 54: mod tests {

 58: 
 59:     fn fixture(position: [f32; 3], intensity: f32) -> LightSource {
 60:         LightSource {
 61:             id: 1,

 64:             color: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],

 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     fn walls_around(count: usize) -> Vec<Aabb> {
 74:         (0..count)
 75:             .map(|i| {
 76:                 let angle = i as f32;
 77:                 Aabb::new(
 78:                     [angle.cos() * 2.0, 0.0, angle.sin() * 2.0],
 79:                     [angle.cos() * 2.0 + 0.4, 3.0, angle.sin() * 2.0 + 0.4],
 80:                 )
 81:             })
 82:             .collect()
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     fn nearby_wall_count(player: [f32; 3], walls: &[Aabb]) -> usize {
 86:         walls
 87:             .iter()
 88:             .filter(|wall| {
 89:                 let center_x = (wall.min[0] + wall.max[0]) * 0.5;
 90:                 let center_z = (wall.min[2] + wall.max[2]) * 0.5;
 91:                 let dx = center_x - player[0];
 92:                 let dz = center_z - player[2];
 93:                 dx * dx + dz * dz <= ENCLOSURE_RADIUS * ENCLOSURE_RADIUS
 94:             })
 95:             .count()
 96:     }
````

````rust
 63: fn parse_options() -> Options {

 65:         renderer: RendererKind::Surface,

 70:     for argument in std::env::args().skip(1) {
 71:         if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--renderer=") {
 72:             options.renderer = value
 73:                 .parse()
 74:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("unknown renderer {value:?}; use surface|splat|raymarch|cpu"));
 75:         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--preset=") {
 76:             options.toggles = match value {
 77:                 "compat" => compat_toggles(),
 78:                 "full" => RenderToggles::default(),
 79:                 other => panic!("unknown preset {other:?}; use compat|full"),
 80:             };
 81:         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--quality=") {
 82:             options.quality = value
 83:                 .parse()
 84:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("unknown quality {value:?}; use low|high"));
 85:         } else if let Some(value) = argument.strip_prefix("--seed=") {
 86:             options.seed = value

 88:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("seed must be a number, got {value:?}"));
 89:         } else {

 92:             );

255:                         .or_else(|_| state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Locked))
256:                         .is_ok();
257:                     state.window.set_cursor_visible(!grabbed);
258:                     state.input.captured = grabbed;
259:                 }
260:             }
261:             WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. } => {
262:                 let pressed = event.state == ElementState::Pressed;
263:                 match event.physical_key {
264:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyW | KeyCode::ArrowUp) => {
265:                         state.input.forward = pressed;
266:                     }
267:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyS | KeyCode::ArrowDown) => {
268:                         state.input.backward = pressed;
269:                     }
270:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyA | KeyCode::ArrowLeft) => {
271:                         state.input.left = pressed;
272:                     }
273:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyD | KeyCode::ArrowRight) => {
274:                         state.input.right = pressed;
275:                     }
276:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyF) if pressed => {
277:                         state.input.flashlight = !state.input.flashlight;
278:                     }
279:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyG) if pressed => {
280:                         state.input.drop_flare = true;
281:                     }
282:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyR) if pressed => {
283:                         state.input.drink = true;
284:                     }
285:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyT) if pressed => {
286:                         state.input.eat = true;
287:                     }
288:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F1) if pressed => {
289:                         state.show_config = !state.show_config;
290:                     }
291: 
292: 
293: 
294:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F5) if pressed => {
295:                         state.toggles.shadow_pass = !state.toggles.shadow_pass;
296:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
297:                     }
298:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F6) if pressed => {
299:                         state.toggles.ambient_occlusion = !state.toggles.ambient_occlusion;
300:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
301:                     }
302:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F7) if pressed => {
303:                         state.toggles.deferred_shading = !state.toggles.deferred_shading;
304:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
305:                     }
306:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F8) if pressed => {
307:                         state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion = !state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion;
308:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
309:                     }
310:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::Escape) if pressed => {
311:                         let _ = state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::None);
312:                         state.window.set_cursor_visible(true);
313:                         state.input.captured = false;
314:                     }
315:                     _ => {}
316:                 }

321:                 state.last_frame = now;
322: 
323: 
324:                 state.hud_frames += 1;
325:                 let elapsed = now - state.hud_window_start;
326:                 if elapsed.as_secs_f32() >= 1.0 {
327:                     state.fps = state.hud_frames as f32 / elapsed.as_secs_f32();
328:                     state.hud_frames = 0;
329:                     state.hud_window_start = now;
330:                     let (level, pos) = {
331:                         let player = state.engine.player();
332:                         (state.engine.level(), player.position)
333:                     };
334:                     state.section = state.locator.describe(level, pos[0], pos[2]);
335:                 }
336: 
337: 
338: 
339: 
340:                 let stats = state.engine.stats();
341:                 state.renderer.set_hud(HudSnapshot {
342:                     hydration: stats.hydration,
343:                     satiety: stats.satiety,
344:                     condition: stats.condition,
345:                     almond_bottles: stats.almond_bottles,
346:                     rations: stats.rations,
347:                     ready: stats.ready,
348:                     flashlight: state.input.flashlight,
349:                     fps: state.fps,
350:                     fine_chunks: stats.fine_chunks,
351:                     resident_chunks: stats.resident_chunks,
352:                     atlas_nodes: stats.atlas_nodes,
353:                     bpm: stats.body.bpm,
354:                     signal: stats.body.signal,

356:                     distance_m: stats.distance_m,
357:                     ambient_c: stats.ambient_c,
358:                     deaths: stats.deaths,
359:                     seed: state.seed,
360:                     show_config: state.show_config,
361:                     toggles: state.toggles,
362:                 });

376:             if state.input.captured {
377:                 state.input.look_dx += dx as f32;
378:                 state.input.look_dy += dy as f32;
379:             }
380:         }
381:     }
382: }

448: struct NativeRenderer {
449:     _instance: wgpu::Instance,
450:     surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
451:     device: wgpu::Device,
452:     queue: wgpu::Queue,
453:     config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
454:     frame_resources: FrameResources,
455:     strategy: Strategy,
456:     supply_labels: SupplyLabelPipeline,
457:     profile: RendererProfile,
458:     toggles: RenderToggles,
459:     depth_view: wgpu::TextureView,
460:     terminal: crate::terminal::FieldTerminal,
461:     hud_snapshot: HudSnapshot,
462: }
463: 
464: impl NativeRenderer {
465:     fn new(window: Arc<Window>, profile: RendererProfile, toggles: RenderToggles) -> Self {
466:         let mut descriptor =
467:             wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_with_display_handle(Box::new(window.clone()));
468:         descriptor.backends = wgpu::Backends::VULKAN;
469:         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(descriptor);
470:         let surface = instance
471:             .create_surface(window.clone())
472:             .expect("create window surface");
473:         let adapter = pollster::block_on(instance.request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
474:             power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
475:             force_fallback_adapter: false,
476:             compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
477:             apply_limit_buckets: false,
478:         }))
479:         .expect("no Vulkan adapter; install Mesa (Lavapipe works) or expose a Vulkan GPU");
480:         let info = adapter.get_info();
481:         eprintln!(
482:             "Vulkan adapter: {} ({}, {})",
483:             info.name, info.driver, info.driver_info
484:         );
485:         let limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
486:         let (device, queue) = pollster::block_on(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
487:             label: Some("vackrooms.native-play"),
488:             required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
489:             required_limits: limits,
490:             ..Default::default()
491:         }))
492:         .expect("create Vulkan device");
493: 
494:         // Mirror the browser context: the shaders encode display color
495:         // themselves, so present through a non-sRGB view of the swapchain.
496:         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
497:         let format = capabilities
498:             .formats
499:             .iter()
500:             .copied()
501:             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
502:             .expect("surface exposes a linear color format");
503:         let size = window.inner_size();
504:         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
505:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
506:             format,
507:             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
508:             width: size.width.max(1),
509:             height: size.height.max(1),
510:             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
511:             present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync,
512:             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
513:             view_formats: vec![],
514:         };
515:         surface.configure(&device, &config);
516: 
517:         let frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&device);
518:         let strategy = match profile {
519:             RendererProfile::Surface(settings) => {
520:                 Strategy::Surface(SurfacePipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
521:                     &device,
522:                     format,
523:                     frame_resources.layout(),
524:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
525:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
526:                         settings.shadow_map,
527:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
528:                     ),
529:                 ))
530:             }
531:             RendererProfile::Splat(settings) => {
532:                 Strategy::Splat(SplatPipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
533:                     &device,
534:                     format,
535:                     frame_resources.layout(),
536:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
537:                     settings.face_budget,
538:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
539:                         settings.shadow_map,
540:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
541:                     ),
542:                 ))
543:             }
544:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(settings) => {
545:                 let mut pipeline = RaymarchPipeline::new(
546:                     &device,
547:                     format,
548:                     frame_resources.layout(),
549:                     settings.maximum_resident_chunks as usize,
550:                 );
551:                 pipeline.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(
552:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
553:                     settings.optimizations.direct_light_visibility,
554:                     settings.area_light_visibility_samples,
555:                 ));
556:                 Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline)
557:             }
558:             RendererProfile::Cpu(_) => Strategy::Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline::new(
559:                 &device,
560:                 format,
561:                 config.width,
562:                 config.height,
563:             )),
564:         };
565:         let supply_labels = SupplyLabelPipeline::new(&device, format, frame_resources.layout());
566:         let depth_view = create_depth_view(&device, config.width, config.height);
567:         let terminal = crate::terminal::FieldTerminal::new(&device, &queue, format);
568:         Self {
569:             _instance: instance,
570:             surface,
571:             device,
572:             queue,
573:             config,
574:             frame_resources,
575:             strategy,
576:             supply_labels,
577:             profile,
578:             toggles,
579:             depth_view,
580:             terminal,
581:             hud_snapshot: HudSnapshot::default(),
582:         }
583:     }
584: 
585:     fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
586:         let width = width.max(1);
587:         let height = height.max(1);
588:         if width == self.config.width && height == self.config.height {
589:             return;
590:         }
591:         self.config.width = width;
592:         self.config.height = height;
593:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
594:         if let Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) = &mut self.strategy {
595:             pipeline.resize(&self.device, width, height);
596:         }
597:         self.depth_view = create_depth_view(&self.device, width, height);
598:     }
599: 
600:     fn trace_budget(&self) -> u32 {
601:         match self.profile {
602:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(profile) => profile.maximum_trace_steps,
603:             _ => 1,
604:         }
605:     }
606: 
607:     fn render(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
608:         let lights = collect_frame_lights(frame);
609:         let toggles = self.profile.apply_runtime_toggles(self.toggles);
610:         let common = self.profile.common();
611:         let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
612:             frame,
613:             self.config.width,
614:             self.config.height,
615:             camera_state::fov_tan(),
616:             common.maximum_draw_distance,
617:             self.trace_budget(),
618:             lights.len(),
619:             toggles,
620:         );
621:         self.frame_resources
622:             .write(&self.device, &self.queue, &uniforms, &lights);
623: 
624:         let surface_texture = match self.surface.get_current_texture() {
625:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture)
626:             | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => texture,
627:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost => {
628:                 self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
629:                 return;
630:             }
631:             _ => return,
632:         };
633:         let view = surface_texture.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
634:         let mut encoder = self
635:             .device
636:             .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
637:                 label: Some("vackrooms.native.frame"),
638:             });
639:         match &mut self.strategy {
640:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
641:                 &self.queue,
642:                 &mut encoder,
643:                 &view,
644:                 &self.depth_view,
645:                 &self.frame_resources,
646:                 frame,
647:                 toggles,
648:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
649:             ),
650:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
651:                 &self.queue,
652:                 &mut encoder,
653:                 &view,
654:                 &self.depth_view,
655:                 &self.frame_resources,
656:                 frame,
657:                 toggles,
658:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
659:             ),
660:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
661:                 &self.queue,
662:                 &mut encoder,
663:                 &view,
664:                 &self.frame_resources,
665:                 frame,
666:                 chunks,
667:                 toggles,
668:             ),
669:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => {
670:                 let mut settings = CpuRenderSettings::default();
671:                 settings.fov_tan = camera_state::fov_tan();
672:                 settings.toggles = toggles;
673:                 pipeline.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view, frame, chunks, settings);
674:             }
675:         }
676:         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
677:             self.supply_labels.draw(
678:                 &self.queue,
679:                 &mut encoder,
680:                 &view,
681:                 &self.depth_view,
682:                 &self.frame_resources,
683:                 frame,
684:             );
685:         }
686:         let renderer_label = self.profile.renderer().label();
687:         draw_field_terminal(
688:             &mut self.terminal,
689:             &self.hud_snapshot,
690:             renderer_label,
691:             self.config.width,
692:             self.config.height,
693:         );
694:         self.terminal.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view);
695:         self.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
696:         self.queue.present(surface_texture);
697:     }
698: }
699: 
700: 
701: fn create_depth_view(device: &wgpu::Device, width: u32, height: u32) -> wgpu::TextureView {
702:     device
703:         .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
704:             label: Some("vackrooms.native.depth"),
705:             size: wgpu::Extent3d {
706:                 width: width.max(1),
707:                 height: height.max(1),
708:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
709:             },
710:             mip_level_count: 1,
711:             sample_count: 1,
712:             dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
713:             format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
714:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
715:             view_formats: &[],
716:         })
717:         .create_view(&Default::default())
718: }
719: 
720: /// The engine owns its renderer as a boxed port while the event loop still
721: /// needs resize access, so the native renderer is shared the same way the
722: /// browser shares its canvas renderer.
723: #[derive(Clone)]
724: struct SharedNativeRenderer(std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<NativeRenderer>>);
725: 
726: impl SharedNativeRenderer {
727:     fn new(renderer: NativeRenderer) -> Self {
728:         Self(std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::RefCell::new(renderer)))
729:     }
730: 
731:     fn resize(&self, width: u32, height: u32) {
732:         self.0.borrow_mut().resize(width, height);
733:     }
734: 
735:     fn set_hud(&self, snapshot: HudSnapshot) {
736:         self.0.borrow_mut().hud_snapshot = snapshot;
737:     }
738: 
739:     /// Live effect-pass switches from the F5–F8 keys; per-frame parameters,
740:     /// no pipeline rebuild involved.
741:     fn set_toggles(&self, toggles: RenderToggles) {
742:         self.0.borrow_mut().toggles = toggles;
743:     }
744: }
745: 
746: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
747: // Field-terminal layout: the same channels as static/index.html, composed
748: // from the shared palette in `terminal`. All coordinates are window pixels.
749: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
750: 
751: fn draw_field_terminal(
752:     terminal: &mut crate::terminal::FieldTerminal,
753:     snapshot: &HudSnapshot,
754:     renderer_label: &str,
755:     width: u32,
756:     height: u32,
757: ) {
758:     use crate::terminal::{
759:         CRITICAL, HAZARD, INK, LOADING_PLATE, PANEL, QUIET, ROUTE, SYSTEM,
760:     };
761:     terminal.begin(width, height);
762:     let w = width.max(1) as f32;
763:     let h = height.max(1) as f32;
764:     let px = 16.0;
765:     let margin = 18.0;
766: 
767:     if !snapshot.ready {
768:         terminal.rect(0.0, 0.0, w, h, LOADING_PLATE);
769:         let line = "GENERATING WORLD IN WEBASSEMBLY'S ABSENCE...";
770:         let lw = terminal.measure(line, 24.0);
771:         terminal.text(line, (w - lw) * 0.5, h * 0.5, 24.0, INK);
772:         let seed_line = format!("SEED {}", snapshot.seed);
773:         let sw = terminal.measure(&seed_line, px);
774:         terminal.text(&seed_line, (w - sw) * 0.5, h * 0.5 + 28.0, px, QUIET);
775:         return;
776:     }
777: 
778:     // Top-left: renderer / frame channels, key in quiet, value in ink.
779:     let mut y = margin + px;
780:     let pen = terminal.text("renderer ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
781:     let pen = terminal.text(renderer_label, pen, y, px, INK);
782:     let pen = terminal.text("   fps ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
783:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0}", snapshot.fps), pen, y, px, INK);
784:     let pen = terminal.text("   frame ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
785:     terminal.text("Vulkan", pen, y, px, INK);
786:     y += terminal.line_height(px);
787:     let pen = terminal.text("chunks ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
788:     let pen = terminal.text(
789:         &format!("{}/{}", snapshot.fine_chunks, snapshot.resident_chunks),
790:         pen,
791:         y,
792:         px,
793:         INK,
794:     );
795:     let pen = terminal.text("   nodes ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
796:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{}", snapshot.atlas_nodes), pen, y, px, INK);
797:     let pen = terminal.text("   dist ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
798:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} m", snapshot.distance_m), pen, y, px, INK);
799:     let pen = terminal.text("   amb ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
800:     terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} C", snapshot.ambient_c), pen, y, px, INK);
801: 
802: 
803: 
804:     if !snapshot.section.is_empty() {
805:         let sw = terminal.measure(&snapshot.section, px);
806:         terminal.text(&snapshot.section, w - margin - sw, margin + px, px, QUIET);
807:     }
808: 
809: 
810:     let bar_w = 220.0;
811:     let bar_h = 12.0;
812:     let gap = 7.0;
813:     let bars_top = h - margin - 3.0 * (bar_h + gap) + gap;
814:     let signal_color = match snapshot.signal {
815:         PulseSignal::Quiet => QUIET,
816:         PulseSignal::Active => INK,
817:         PulseSignal::Strained => ROUTE,
818:         PulseSignal::Critical => HAZARD,
819:     };
820:     if snapshot.signal != PulseSignal::Quiet {
821:         terminal.text(
822:             &format!("{:.0} bpm", snapshot.bpm),
823:             margin,
824:             bars_top - 14.0,
825:             px,
826:             signal_color,
827:         );
828:     }
829:     let bars = [
830:         (snapshot.hydration, SYSTEM, "H2O"),
831:         (snapshot.satiety, ROUTE, "RAT"),
832:         (snapshot.condition, HAZARD, "BOD"),
833:     ];
834:     for (index, (value, color, tag)) in bars.iter().enumerate() {
835:         let by = bars_top + index as f32 * (bar_h + gap);
836:         terminal.text(tag, margin, by + bar_h - 1.0, 16.0, QUIET);
837:         let bx = margin + 46.0;
838:         terminal.rect(bx - 2.0, by - 2.0, bar_w + 4.0, bar_h + 4.0, PANEL);
839:         terminal.rect(bx, by, bar_w * value.clamp(0.0, 1.0), bar_h, *color);
840:     }
841: 
842: 
843:     let pip = 9.0;
844:     let pip_gap = 5.0;
845:     let pip_y = bars_top - 34.0;
846:     for index in 0..snapshot.almond_bottles.min(12) {
847:         terminal.rect(
848:             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
849:             pip_y,
850:             pip,
851:             pip,
852:             SYSTEM,
853:         );
854:     }
855:     for index in 0..snapshot.rations.min(12) {
856:         terminal.rect(
857:             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
858:             pip_y - pip - pip_gap,
859:             pip,
860:             pip,
861:             ROUTE,
862:         );
863:     }
864: 
865: 
866:     let mut right_y = h - margin;
867:     let hint = "F1 CONFIG";
868:     let hw = terminal.measure(hint, px);
869:     terminal.text(hint, w - margin - hw, right_y, px, QUIET);
870:     right_y -= terminal.line_height(px);
871:     if snapshot.flashlight {
872:         let torch = "TORCH ON";
873:         let tw = terminal.measure(torch, px);
874:         terminal.text(torch, w - margin - tw, right_y, px, ROUTE);
875:     }
876:     if snapshot.deaths > 0 {
877:         let text = format!("SUCCUMBED x{}", snapshot.deaths);
878:         let tw = terminal.measure(&text, px);
879:         terminal.text(&text, w - margin - tw, right_y - terminal.line_height(px), px, HAZARD);
880:     }
881: 
882: 
883:     terminal.rect(w * 0.5 - 2.0, h * 0.5 - 2.0, 4.0, 4.0, [0.9, 0.9, 0.85, 0.55]);
884: 
885: 
886: 
887:     if snapshot.show_config {
888:         let pw = 560.0_f32.min(w - 2.0 * margin);
889:         let ph = 330.0_f32.min(h - 2.0 * margin);
890:         let px0 = (w - pw) * 0.5;
891:         let py0 = (h - ph) * 0.5;
892:         terminal.rect(px0, py0, pw, ph, [0.027, 0.039, 0.031, 0.92]);
893:         let mut ly = py0 + 34.0;
894:         let lx = px0 + 24.0;
895:         terminal.text("CONFIGURATION - FIELD TERMINAL", lx, ly, px, CRITICAL);
896:         ly += terminal.line_height(px) * 1.5;
897:         let on_off = |on: bool| if on { "ON" } else { "OFF" };
898:         let rows: Vec<(String, [f32; 4])> = vec![
899:             (format!("RENDERER   {renderer_label}   (--renderer=surface|splat|raymarch|cpu)"), INK),
900:             (format!("SEED       {}   (--seed=N reproduces this world)", snapshot.seed), INK),
901:             (format!("F5 SHADOWS          {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.shadow_pass)), SYSTEM),
902:             (format!("F6 AMBIENT OCCL.    {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.ambient_occlusion)), SYSTEM),
903:             (format!("F7 DEFERRED SHADING {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.deferred_shading)), SYSTEM),
904:             (format!("F8 TORCH OCCLUSION  {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.flashlight_occlusion)), SYSTEM),
905:             ("WASD MOVE   MOUSE LOOK   F TORCH   G FLARE".to_owned(), QUIET),
906:             ("R DRINK     T EAT        ESC RELEASE MOUSE".to_owned(), QUIET),
907:         ];
908:         for (row, color) in rows {
909:             terminal.text(&row, lx, ly, px, color);
910:             ly += terminal.line_height(px) * 1.15;
911:         }
912:     }
913: }
914: 
915: impl RendererPort for SharedNativeRenderer {
916:     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
917:         self.0.borrow().profile.artifact_needs()
918:     }
919: 
920:     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
921:         self.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
922:     }
923: 
924:     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
925:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
926:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
927:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
928:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
929:             _ => {}
930:         }
931:     }
932: 
933:     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
934:         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
935:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
936:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
937:             _ => {}
938:         }
939:     }
940: 
941:     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
942:         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
943:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
944:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
945:             _ => {}
946:         }
947:     }
948: 
949:     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
950:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
951:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
952:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(&renderer.device, texels),
953:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(texels),
954:             _ => {}
955:         }
956:     }
957: 
958:     fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
959:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
960:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
961:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => {
962:                 pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(&renderer.queue, first_row, texels)
963:             }
964:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, texels),
965:             _ => false,
966:         }
967:     }
968: 
969:     fn upload_label_atlas(&mut self, rgba: &[u8], width: u32, height: u32) {
970:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
971:         renderer
972:             .supply_labels
973:             .upload_atlas(&renderer.device, &renderer.queue, rgba, width, height);
974:     }
975: 
976:     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
977:         self.0.borrow_mut().render(frame, chunks);
978:     }
979: }
````

````rust
297: 
298:     pub fn begin(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
299:         self.width = width.max(1) as f32;
300:         self.height = height.max(1) as f32;
301:         self.rects.clear();
302:         self.texts.clear();
303:     }
304: 
305:     pub fn rect(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, color: [f32; 4]) {
306:         let x0 = x / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
307:         let x1 = (x + w) / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
308:         let y0 = 1.0 - y / self.height * 2.0;
309:         let y1 = 1.0 - (y + h) / self.height * 2.0;
310:         for pos in [[x0, y0], [x0, y1], [x1, y1], [x0, y0], [x1, y1], [x1, y0]] {
311:             self.rects.push(RectVertex { pos, color });
312:         }
313:     }
314: 
315: 
316: 
317:     pub fn text(&mut self, text: &str, x: f32, y_baseline: f32, px: f32, color: [f32; 4]) -> f32 {
318:         let scale = px / RASTER_PX;
319:         let mut pen = x;
320:         for ch in text.chars() {
321:             if ch == ' ' {
322:                 pen += self.space_advance * scale;
323:                 continue;
324:             }
325:             let Some(glyph) = self.glyphs.get(&ch) else {
326:                 pen += self.space_advance * scale;
327:                 continue;
328:             };
329:             let gx = pen + glyph.bearing[0] * scale;
330:             let gy = y_baseline + glyph.bearing[1] * scale;
331:             let gw = glyph.size[0] * scale;
332:             let gh = glyph.size[1] * scale;
333:             let x0 = gx / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
334:             let x1 = (gx + gw) / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
335:             let y0 = 1.0 - gy / self.height * 2.0;
336:             let y1 = 1.0 - (gy + gh) / self.height * 2.0;
337:             let (u0, v0) = (glyph.uv_min[0], glyph.uv_min[1]);
338:             let (u1, v1) = (glyph.uv_max[0], glyph.uv_max[1]);
339:             let quad = [
340:                 ([x0, y0], [u0, v0]),
341:                 ([x0, y1], [u0, v1]),
342:                 ([x1, y1], [u1, v1]),
343:                 ([x0, y0], [u0, v0]),
344:                 ([x1, y1], [u1, v1]),
345:                 ([x1, y0], [u1, v0]),
346:             ];
347:             for (pos, uv) in quad {
348:                 self.texts.push(TextVertex { pos, uv, color });
349:             }
350:             pen += glyph.advance * scale;
351:         }
352:         pen
353:     }
354: 
355: 
356:     pub fn measure(&self, text: &str, px: f32) -> f32 {
357:         let scale = px / RASTER_PX;
358:         text.chars()
359:             .map(|ch| match self.glyphs.get(&ch) {
360:                 Some(glyph) => glyph.advance * scale,
361:                 None => self.space_advance * scale,
362:             })
363:             .sum()
364:     }
365: 
366:     pub fn line_height(&self, px: f32) -> f32 {
367:         self.line_height * (px / RASTER_PX)
368:     }
369: 
370:     pub fn draw(
371:         &mut self,
372:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
373:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
374:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
375:     ) {
376:         self.rects.truncate(RECT_CAPACITY);
377:         self.texts.truncate(TEXT_CAPACITY);
378:         if self.rects.is_empty() && self.texts.is_empty() {
379:             return;
380:         }
381:         if !self.rects.is_empty() {
382:             queue.write_buffer(&self.rect_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&self.rects));
383:         }
384:         if !self.texts.is_empty() {
385:             queue.write_buffer(&self.text_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&self.texts));
386:         }
387:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
388:             label: Some("native.terminal.pass"),
389:             color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
390:                 view: target,
391:                 depth_slice: None,
392:                 resolve_target: None,
393:                 ops: wgpu::Operations {
394:                     load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
395:                     store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
396:                 },
397:             })],
398:             depth_stencil_attachment: None,
399:             ..Default::default()
400:         });
401:         if !self.rects.is_empty() {
402:             pass.set_pipeline(&self.rect_pipeline);
403:             pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.rect_buffer.slice(..));
404:             pass.draw(0..self.rects.len() as u32, 0..1);
405:         }
406:         if !self.texts.is_empty() {
407:             pass.set_pipeline(&self.text_pipeline);
408:             pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.text_bind_group, &[]);
409:             pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.text_buffer.slice(..));
410:             pass.draw(0..self.texts.len() as u32, 0..1);
411:         }
412:     }
413: }
414: 
415: #[expect(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "one-shot pipeline builder")]
416: fn build_pipeline(
417:     device: &wgpu::Device,
418:     format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
419:     shader_source: &str,
420:     vertex_entry: &str,
421:     fragment_entry: &str,
422:     bind_layouts: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayout],
423:     stride: u64,
424:     attributes: &[wgpu::VertexAttribute],
425: ) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
426:     let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
427:         label: Some("native.terminal.shader"),
428:         source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(shader_source.into()),
429:     });
430:     let layout_refs: Vec<Option<&wgpu::BindGroupLayout>> =
431:         bind_layouts.iter().map(Some).collect();
432:     let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
433:         label: Some("native.terminal.pipeline-layout"),
434:         bind_group_layouts: &layout_refs,
435:         immediate_size: 0,
436:     });
437:     device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
438:         label: Some("native.terminal.pipeline"),
439:         layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
440:         vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
441:             module: &shader,
442:             entry_point: Some(vertex_entry),
443:             compilation_options: Default::default(),
444:             buffers: &[Some(wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
445:                 array_stride: stride,
446:                 step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
447:                 attributes,
448:             })],
449:         },
450:         primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
451:             topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
452:             cull_mode: None,
453:             ..Default::default()
454:         },
455:         depth_stencil: None,
456:         multisample: Default::default(),
457:         fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
458:             module: &shader,
459:             entry_point: Some(fragment_entry),
460:             compilation_options: Default::default(),
461:             targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
462:                 format,
463:                 blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
464:                 write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
465:             })],
466:         }),
467:         multiview_mask: None,
468:         cache: None,
469:     })
470: }
````

````rust
115:     overlay: &HtmlElement,
116:     input: &Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,

127:             touch.borrow_mut().active = on;

131:                 input.set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);

136:             if let Some(ui) = &touch_ui {
137:                 let _ = ui
138:                     .style()
139:                     .set_property("display", if on { "flex" } else { "none" });
140:             }
141:         })

145: 
146: 
147:     {

154:         closure.forget();

156: 
157: 
158: 
159:     {
160:         let touch = touch.clone();
161:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
162:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
163:             if !st.active {
164:                 return;
165:             }
166:             e.prevent_default();
167:             let move_split = web_sys::window()
168:                 .and_then(|w| w.inner_width().ok())
169:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
170:                 .unwrap_or(800.0)
171:                 * 0.45;
172:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
173:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
174:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
175:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
176:                 if x < move_split && st.move_id.is_none() {
177:                     st.move_id = Some(t.identifier());
178:                     st.move_origin = (x, y);
179:                 } else if st.look_id.is_none() {
180:                     st.look_id = Some(t.identifier());
181:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
182:                 }
183:             }
184:         });
185:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchstart", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
186:         closure.forget();
187:     }
188: 
189:     {
190:         let input = input.clone();
191:         let touch = touch.clone();
192:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
193:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
194:             if !st.active {
195:                 return;
196:             }
197:             e.prevent_default();
198:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
199:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
200:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
201:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
202:                 if st.move_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
203:                     let dx = ((x - st.move_origin.0) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
204:                     let dy = ((y - st.move_origin.1) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
205: 
206:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(dx as f32, -dy as f32);
207:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
208:                     let (lx, ly) = st.look_last;
209:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
210:                     input.borrow_mut().mouse_delta(
211:                         (x - lx) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
212:                         (y - ly) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
213:                     );
214:                 }
215:             }
216:         });
217:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchmove", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
218:         closure.forget();
219:     }
220: 
221:     for event in ["touchend", "touchcancel"] {
222:         let input = input.clone();
223:         let touch = touch.clone();
224:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
225:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();

227:                 return;
228:             }
229:             e.prevent_default();

232:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };

234:                     st.move_id = None;
235:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);
236:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {

238:                 }
239:             }

241:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback(event, closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
242:         closure.forget();
243:     }
````

````rust
  4: pub struct LightRange {

  7: }
  8: 
  9: pub fn append_lights_reaching_bounds(
 10:     lights: &[LightSource],
 11:     bounds_min: [f32; 3],
 12:     bounds_max: [f32; 3],
 13:     clustered: &mut Vec<LightSource>,
 14: ) -> LightRange {
 15:     let first = clustered.len();
 16:     clustered.extend(
 17:         lights
 18:             .iter()
 19:             .copied()
 20:             .filter(|light| reaches_bounds(light, bounds_min, bounds_max)),
 21:     );
 22:     LightRange {
 23:         first: first.min(i32::MAX as usize) as i32,
 24:         count: clustered.len().saturating_sub(first).min(i32::MAX as usize) as i32,
 25:     }
 26: }
 27: 
 28: fn reaches_bounds(light: &LightSource, bounds_min: [f32; 3], bounds_max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
 29: 
 30: 
 31:     let expanded_min = [
 32:         bounds_min[0] - light.half_size[0],
 33:         bounds_min[1],
 34:         bounds_min[2] - light.half_size[1],
 35:     ];
 36:     let expanded_max = [
 37:         bounds_max[0] + light.half_size[0],
 38:         bounds_max[1],
 39:         bounds_max[2] + light.half_size[1],
 40:     ];
 41:     let mut distance_squared = 0.0;
 42:     for axis in 0..3 {
 43:         let delta = if light.position[axis] < expanded_min[axis] {
 44:             expanded_min[axis] - light.position[axis]
 45:         } else if light.position[axis] > expanded_max[axis] {
 46:             light.position[axis] - expanded_max[axis]
 47:         } else {
 48:             0.0
 49:         };
 50:         distance_squared += delta * delta;
 51:     }
 52:     distance_squared <= light.radius * light.radius
 53: }

 61: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
 62: pub struct LightSelectionCache {
 63:     entries: std::collections::HashMap<crate::application::ports::SurfaceChunkKey, Vec<u64>>,
 64: }
 65: 
 66: impl LightSelectionCache {
 67:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 68:         Self {
 69:             entries: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
 70:         }
 71:     }
 72: 
 73: 
 74:     pub fn select_lights_with_hysteresis(
 75:         &mut self,
 76:         key: crate::application::ports::SurfaceChunkKey,
 77:         candidate_lights: &[LightSource],
 78:         bounds_min: [f32; 3],
 79:         bounds_max: [f32; 3],
 80:         top_k: usize,
 81:     ) -> Vec<LightSource> {
 82:         let center = [
 83:             (bounds_min[0] + bounds_max[0]) * 0.5,
 84:             (bounds_min[1] + bounds_max[1]) * 0.5,
 85:             (bounds_min[2] + bounds_max[2]) * 0.5,
 86:         ];
 87: 
 88: 
 89:         let mut scored: Vec<(f32, &LightSource)> = candidate_lights
 90:             .iter()
 91:             .map(|light| {
 92:                 let dx = light.position[0] - center[0];
 93:                 let dy = light.position[1] - center[1];
 94:                 let dz = light.position[2] - center[2];
 95:                 let dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
 96:                 let score = light.intensity / (dist_sq + 1.0);
 97:                 (score, light)
 98:             })
 99:             .collect();
100:         scored.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
101: 
102:         let previous_ids = self.entries.get(&key);
103:         let mut selected = Vec::with_capacity(top_k.min(scored.len()));
104: 
105:         for (score, light) in scored {
106:             if selected.len() >= top_k {
107:                 break;
108:             }
109:             let is_previously_selected = previous_ids.map_or(false, |ids| ids.contains(&light.id));
110:             let effective_score = if is_previously_selected {
111:                 score * 1.20
112:             } else {
113:                 score
114:             };
115:             selected.push((effective_score, light));
116:         }
117: 
118:         selected.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
119:         let result: Vec<LightSource> = selected.into_iter().take(top_k).map(|(_, l)| *l).collect();
120:         self.entries.insert(key, result.iter().map(|l| l.id).collect());
121:         result
122:     }
123: }
````

````rust
10: pub fn upload_light_volume(gl: &Gl, mesh: &SurfaceMeshPayload) -> Result<WebGlTexture, JsValue> {
11:     let texture = gl
12:         .create_texture()
13:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("create light texture"))?;
14:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Some(&texture));
15:     gl.pixel_storei(Gl::UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
16: 
17:     let fallback = [0u8, 0u8, 0u8];
18:     let (width, height, depth, bytes) = if !mesh.light_volume_bytes.is_empty()
19:         && mesh.light_volume_dims[0] > 0
20:         && mesh.light_volume_dims[1] > 0
21:         && mesh.light_volume_dims[2] > 0
22:     {
23:         (
24:             mesh.light_volume_dims[0] as i32,
25:             mesh.light_volume_dims[1] as i32,
26:             mesh.light_volume_dims[2] as i32,
27:             mesh.light_volume_bytes.as_slice(),
28:         )
29:     } else {
30:         (1, 1, 1, fallback.as_slice())
31:     };
32: 
33:     gl.tex_image_3d_with_opt_u8_array(
34:         Gl::TEXTURE_3D,
35:         0,
36:         Gl::RGB8 as i32,
37:         width,
38:         height,
39:         depth,
40:         0,
41:         Gl::RGB,
42:         Gl::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
43:         Some(bytes),
44:     )?;
45:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Gl::TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, Gl::LINEAR as i32);
46:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Gl::TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, Gl::LINEAR as i32);
47:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_S, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
48:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_T, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
49:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_R, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
50:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, None);
51:     Ok(texture)
52: }
````

````rust
 49: pub fn select_lights<'a>(
 50:     fixtures: impl Iterator<Item = &'a LightSource>,
 51:     dynamic: &'a [LightSource],
 52:     frame: &FrameParams,
 53: ) -> SelectedLights {
 54:     let mut ranked: Vec<(&LightSource, f32)> = fixtures
 55:         .chain(dynamic.iter())
 56:         .map(|light| {
 57:             let dx = light.position[0] - frame.camera_pos[0];
 58:             let dy = light.position[1] - frame.camera_pos[1];
 59:             let dz = light.position[2] - frame.camera_pos[2];
 60:             let dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
 61:             (light, light.radius * light.intensity.sqrt() / (dist2 + 0.1))
 62:         })
 63:         .collect();
 64:     ranked.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.partial_cmp(&a.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
 65: 
 66:     let count = ranked.len().min(MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS);
 67:     let mut selected = SelectedLights {
 68:         count,
 69:         positions: [0.0; MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * 3],
 70:         colors: [0.0; MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * 3],
 71:         params: [0.0; MAX_SHADER_LIGHTS * 4],

 73:         hero_slot: -1,
 74:         hero_position: [0.0; 3],
 75:         hero_radius: 0.0,
 76:     };
 77:     for (i, (light, _)) in ranked[..count].iter().enumerate() {
 78:         selected.positions[i * 3..i * 3 + 3].copy_from_slice(&light.position);
 79:         selected.colors[i * 3..i * 3 + 3].copy_from_slice(&light.color);
 80:         selected.params[i * 4] = light.radius;
 81:         selected.params[i * 4 + 1] = light.intensity;
 82:         selected.params[i * 4 + 2] = light.half_size[0];
 83:         selected.params[i * 4 + 3] = light.half_size[1];
 84:         selected.kinds[i] = light.kind as i32;
 85:     }
 86: 
 87: 
 88:     if let Some(slot) = ranked[..count].iter().position(|(l, _)| !is_dynamic(l)) {
 89:         selected.hero_slot = slot as i32;
 90:         selected.hero_position = ranked[slot].0.position;
 91:         selected.hero_radius = ranked[slot].0.radius;
````

````rust
  6: pub fn camera_matrices(
  7:     frame: &FrameParams,
  8:     width: i32,
  9:     height: i32,

 13:     let (sy, cy) = frame.yaw.sin_cos();
 14:     let right = [cy, 0.0, -sy];
 15:     let up = [sp * sy, cp, sp * cy];
 16:     let forward = [-cp * sy, sp, -cp * cy];
 17:     let p = frame.camera_pos;
 18:     let dot = |a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]| a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
````
