````rust
 22:         -forward[0],
 23:         0.0,
 24:         right[1],
 25:         up[1],
 26:         -forward[1],
 27:         0.0,
 28:         right[2],
 29:         up[2],
 30:         -forward[2],
 31:         0.0,
 32:         -dot(right, p),
 33:         -dot(up, p),
 34:         dot(forward, p),
 35:         1.0,
 36:     ];
 37:     let near = 0.03;
 38:     let far = max_draw_distance;
 39:     let f = 1.0 / crate::drivers::webgl::fov_tan();
 40:     let aspect = width as f32 / height.max(1) as f32;
 41:     let projection = [
 42:         f / aspect,
 43:         0.0,
 44:         0.0,
 45:         0.0,
 46:         0.0,
 47:         f,
 48:         0.0,
 49:         0.0,
 50:         0.0,
 51:         0.0,
 52:         (far + near) / (near - far),
 53:         -1.0,
 54:         0.0,
 55:         0.0,
 56:         (2.0 * far * near) / (near - far),
 57:         0.0,
 58:     ];
 59:     (projection, view)

 61: 
 62: pub fn ortho_matrix(
 63:     left: f32,
 64:     right: f32,
 65:     bottom: f32,
 66:     top: f32,
 67:     near: f32,
 68:     far: f32,
 69: ) -> [f32; 16] {
 70:     let mut m = [0.0; 16];
 71:     m[0] = 2.0 / (right - left);
 72:     m[5] = 2.0 / (top - bottom);
 73:     m[10] = -2.0 / (far - near);
 74:     m[12] = -(right + left) / (right - left);
 75:     m[13] = -(top + bottom) / (top - bottom);
 76:     m[14] = -(far + near) / (far - near);
 77:     m[15] = 1.0;
 78:     m

 84:     let forward = [0.0, -1.0, 0.0];
 85:     let up = [0.0, 0.0, -1.0f32];
 86:     let right = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0f32];
 87: 
 88:     let mut m = [0.0; 16];
 89:     m[0] = right[0];
 90:     m[1] = up[0];
 91:     m[2] = -forward[0];
 92: 
 93:     m[4] = right[1];
 94:     m[5] = up[1];
 95:     m[6] = -forward[1];
 96: 
 97:     m[8] = right[2];
 98:     m[9] = up[2];
 99:     m[10] = -forward[2];
100: 
101:     m[12] = -(right[0] * eye[0] + right[1] * eye[1] + right[2] * eye[2]);
102:     m[13] = -(up[0] * eye[0] + up[1] * eye[1] + up[2] * eye[2]);
103:     m[14] = -(-forward[0] * eye[0] + -forward[1] * eye[1] + -forward[2] * eye[2]);
104:     m[15] = 1.0;
105:     m
106: }
107: 
108: pub fn multiply_matrices(a: &[f32; 16], b: &[f32; 16]) -> [f32; 16] {
109:     let mut m = [0.0; 16];
110:     for col in 0..4 {
111:         for row in 0..4 {
112:             m[col * 4 + row] = a[row] * b[col * 4]
113:                 + a[4 + row] * b[col * 4 + 1]
114:                 + a[8 + row] * b[col * 4 + 2]
115:                 + a[12 + row] * b[col * 4 + 3];
116:         }
117:     }
118:     m
119: }
````

````rust
47:         gl.delete_shader(Some(&shader));

58:     gl.attach_shader(&program, &vs);
````

````rust
 1: use js_sys::Object;
 2: use web_sys::{WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl, WebGlQuery};
 3: 
 4: 
 5: const TIME_ELAPSED_EXT: u32 = 0x88BF;
 6: const GPU_DISJOINT_EXT: u32 = 0x8FBB;
 7: 
 8: pub struct GpuFrameTimer {
 9:     extension: Option<Object>,
10:     pending: Option<WebGlQuery>,
11:     last_ms: Option<f32>,
12: }
13: 
14: impl GpuFrameTimer {
15: 
16: 
17:     pub fn new(gl: &Gl) -> Self {
18:         Self {
19:             extension: gl
20:                 .get_extension("EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2")
21:                 .ok()
22:                 .flatten(),
23:             pending: None,
24:             last_ms: None,
25:         }
26:     }
27: 
28:     pub fn last_ms(&self) -> Option<f32> {
29:         self.last_ms
30:     }
31: 
32: 
33: 
34:     pub fn poll(&mut self, gl: &Gl) {
35:         let Some(query) = self.pending.as_ref() else {
36:             return;
37:         };
38:         let available = gl
39:             .get_query_parameter(query, Gl::QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE)
40:             .as_bool()
41:             .unwrap_or(false);
42:         let disjoint = self.extension.is_some()
43:             && gl
44:                 .get_parameter(GPU_DISJOINT_EXT)
45:                 .ok()
46:                 .and_then(|value| value.as_bool())
47:                 .unwrap_or(false);
48:         if !available && !disjoint {
49:             return;
50:         }
51:         let query = self.pending.take().expect("pending timer exists");
52:         if available && !disjoint {
53:             self.last_ms = gl
54:                 .get_query_parameter(&query, Gl::QUERY_RESULT)
55:                 .as_f64()
56:                 .map(|nanos| (nanos as f32) * 1.0e-6);
57:         }
58:         gl.delete_query(Some(&query));
59:     }
60: 
61: 
62: 
63:     pub fn begin(&mut self, gl: &Gl, enabled: bool) -> bool {
64:         if !enabled {
65: 
66: 
67: 
68:             self.last_ms = None;
69:             return false;
70:         }
71:         if self.extension.is_none() || self.pending.is_some() {
72:             return false;
73:         }
74:         let Some(query) = gl.create_query() else {
75:             return false;
76:         };
77:         gl.begin_query(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT, &query);
78:         self.pending = Some(query);
79:         true
80:     }
81: 
82:     pub fn end(&self, gl: &Gl, started: bool) {
83:         if started {
84:             gl.end_query(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT);
85:         }
86:     }
87: }
````

````rust
  1: use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;

  5: 
  6: const PREFERRED_ROW_TEXELS: i32 = 1024;
  7: const TEXELS_PER_LIGHT: usize = 3;
  8: 
  9: pub struct SceneLightTexture {
 10:     texture: WebGlTexture,
 11:     width: i32,
 12:     maximum_size: i32,
 13:     staging: Vec<f32>,
 14:     last_lights: Vec<LightSource>,
 15:     uploaded: bool,
 16: }
 17: 
 18: impl SceneLightTexture {
 19:     pub fn create(gl: &Gl) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 20:         let texture = gl
 21:             .create_texture()
 22:             .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("failed to create scene-light texture"))?;
 23:         let maximum_size = gl
 24:             .get_parameter(Gl::MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE)?
 25:             .as_f64()
 26:             .unwrap_or(0.0) as i32;
 27:         if maximum_size < 1 {
 28:             return Err(JsValue::from_str("WebGL reported no 2-D texture capacity"));
 29:         }
 30:         let width = PREFERRED_ROW_TEXELS.min(maximum_size);
 31:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&texture));
 32:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, Gl::NEAREST as i32);
 33:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, Gl::NEAREST as i32);
 34:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_S, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
 35:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_T, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
 36:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, None);
 37:         Ok(Self {
 38:             texture,
 39:             width,
 40:             maximum_size,
 41:             staging: Vec::new(),
 42:             last_lights: Vec::new(),
 43:             uploaded: false,
 44:         })
 45:     }
 46: 
 47: 
 48:     pub fn upload(&mut self, gl: &Gl, lights: &[LightSource]) -> Result<i32, JsValue> {
 49:         if self.uploaded && self.last_lights == lights {
 50:             return Ok(lights.len().min(i32::MAX as usize) as i32);
 51:         }
 52:         let texel_count = lights.len().max(1) * TEXELS_PER_LIGHT;
 53:         let rows = (texel_count as i32 + self.width - 1) / self.width;
 54:         if rows > self.maximum_size || lights.len() > i32::MAX as usize {
 55:             return Err(JsValue::from_str(
 56:                 "resident fixture list exceeds the WebGL scene-light texture",
 57:             ));
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         self.staging.clear();
 61:         self.staging
 62:             .resize(self.width as usize * rows as usize * 4, 0.0);
 63:         for (index, light) in lights.iter().enumerate() {
 64:             let offset = index * TEXELS_PER_LIGHT * 4;
 65:             self.staging[offset..offset + 3].copy_from_slice(&light.position);
 66:             self.staging[offset + 3] = light.kind as u8 as f32;
 67:             self.staging[offset + 4..offset + 7].copy_from_slice(&light.color);
 68:             self.staging[offset + 7] = light.intensity;
 69:             self.staging[offset + 8] = light.radius;
 70:             self.staging[offset + 9] = light.half_size[0];
 71:             self.staging[offset + 10] = light.half_size[1];
 72:         }
 73: 
 74:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&self.texture));
 75:         gl.pixel_storei(Gl::UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);
 76:         let view = js_sys::Float32Array::from(self.staging.as_slice());
 77:         gl.tex_image_2d_with_i32_and_i32_and_i32_and_format_and_type_and_opt_array_buffer_view(
 78:             Gl::TEXTURE_2D,
 79:             0,
 80:             Gl::RGBA32F as i32,
 81:             self.width,
 82:             rows,
 83:             0,
 84:             Gl::RGBA,
 85:             Gl::FLOAT,
 86:             Some(&view),
 87:         )?;
 88:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, None);
 89:         self.last_lights.clear();
 90:         self.last_lights.extend_from_slice(lights);
 91:         self.uploaded = true;
 92:         Ok(lights.len() as i32)
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     pub fn bind(&self, gl: &Gl) {
 96:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&self.texture));
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     pub fn width(&self) -> i32 {
100:         self.width
101:     }
102: }
````

````rust
41:             normal,

49:     // Screen-space/voxel AO is only a model of indirect sky/room
50:     // visibility. Applying it to analytic or already-occluded cached

59:     }
````

````rust
 2: float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPosition, vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
 3:     vec4 clip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPosition + normal * 0.02, 1.0);
 4:     vec3 projected = clip.xyz / max(abs(clip.w), 1e-8);
 5:     vec2 uv = projected.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
 6:     float receiverDepth = projected.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
 7:     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0)))
 8:         || receiverDepth <= 0.0 || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
 9:         return 1.0;
10:     }
11: 
12:     vec2 texel = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(uShadowMap, 0));
13:     float bias = max(0.0015 * (1.0 - dot(normal, surfaceToLight)), 0.0005);
14:     float visible = 0.0;
15:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
16:         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
17:         vec2(-0.5, 0.5), vec2(0.5, 0.5)
18:     );
19:     for (int tap = 0; tap < 4; ++tap) {
20:         float storedDepth = texture(uShadowMap, uv + offsets[tap] * texel).r;
21:         visible += receiverDepth - bias <= storedDepth ? 1.0 : 0.0;
22:     }
23:     return visible * 0.25;
24: }
````

````rust
 8:         vec3 localOrigin = uCameraPosition - uChunkOrigins[chunkIndex];
 9:         RayBoxHit box = intersectBox(

11:             rayDirection,
12:             vec3(0.0),
13:             vec3(uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex])
14:         );
15:         if (!box.hit) continue;
16:

20:                 intervals[insertion] = intervals[insertion - 1];
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/decode_voxel_atlas.rs
````rust
 1: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
 2: struct AtlasNode {
 3:     bool leaf;
 4:     uint payload;
 5:     uint colorOrMask;
 6:     uint lightWord;
 7: };
 8: 
 9: struct VoxelLeaf {
10:     uint material;
11:     uint color;
12:     uint lightWord;
13:     vec3 boundsMin;
14:     vec3 boundsMax;
15: };
16: 
17: AtlasNode readAtlasNode(int nodeIndex) {
18:     ivec2 texel = ivec2(nodeIndex % 1024, nodeIndex / 1024);
19:     uvec4 packed = texelFetch(uNodeTexture, texel, 0);
20:     return AtlasNode(packed.x == 1u, packed.y, packed.z, packed.w);
21: }
22: 
23: VoxelLeaf lookupVoxelLeaf(
24:     vec3 point,
25:     int rootIndex,
26:     float worldSize,
27:     int svoDepth
28: ) {
29:     int nodeIndex = rootIndex;
30:     vec3 boundsMin = vec3(0.0);
31:     vec3 boundsMax = vec3(worldSize);
32: 
33:     // Generator validation bounds depth; the runtime value only shortens
34:     // this statically bounded loop for ordinary 6/8-level chunks.
35:     for (int level = 0; level <= 10; ++level) {
36:         AtlasNode node = readAtlasNode(nodeIndex);
37:         if (node.leaf || level >= svoDepth) {
38:             return VoxelLeaf(node.payload, node.colorOrMask, node.lightWord, boundsMin, boundsMax);
39:         }
40: 
41:         vec3 center = (boundsMin + boundsMax) * 0.5;
42:         int childX = point.x >= center.x ? 1 : 0;
43:         int childY = point.y >= center.y ? 1 : 0;
44:         int childZ = point.z >= center.z ? 1 : 0;
45:         int child = (childZ << 2) | (childY << 1) | childX;
46: 
47:         vec3 childMin = vec3(
48:             childX == 1 ? center.x : boundsMin.x,
49:             childY == 1 ? center.y : boundsMin.y,
50:             childZ == 1 ? center.z : boundsMin.z
51:         );
52:         vec3 childMax = vec3(
53:             childX == 1 ? boundsMax.x : center.x,
54:             childY == 1 ? boundsMax.y : center.y,
55:             childZ == 1 ? boundsMax.z : center.z
56:         );
57: 
58:         if ((node.colorOrMask & (1u << uint(child))) == 0u) {
59:             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, childMin, childMax);
60:         }
61:         nodeIndex = int(node.payload) + child;
62:         boundsMin = childMin;
63:         boundsMax = childMax;
64:     }
65:     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, boundsMin, boundsMax);
66: }
67: "#;
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/trace_voxel_scene/intersect_voxel_scene.rs
````rust
  1: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
  2: const float TRACE_INFINITY = 1e30;
  3: const float TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON = 1e-7;
  4: 
  5: struct RayBoxHit {
  6:     bool hit;
  7:     float entry;
  8:     float exit;
  9:     vec3 entryNormal;
 10: };
 11: 
 12: struct ChunkInterval {
 13:     int chunkIndex;
 14:     float entry;
 15:     float exit;
 16:     vec3 entryNormal;
 17: };
 18: 
 19: struct VoxelHit {
 20:     bool hit;
 21:     float distance;
 22:     vec3 normal;
 23:     uint material;
 24:     uint color;
 25:     uint lightWord;
 26: };
 27: 
 28: float inverseDirection(float direction) {
 29:     if (abs(direction) < 1e-20) {
 30:         return direction < 0.0 ? -TRACE_INFINITY : TRACE_INFINITY;
 31:     }
 32:     return 1.0 / direction;
 33: }
 34: 
 35: float distanceTieTolerance(float distance) {
 36:     return max(abs(distance) * 1e-6, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
 37: }
 38: 
 39: float traversalSampleBias(float voxelSize) {
 40:     // This moves classification points off an exactly shared plane; it must
 41:     // remain smaller than nearby, genuinely distinct boundary crossings.
 42:     // At the 0.2 m reference grid, 1e-4 skipped a 13 micrometre
 43:     // interval between a wall and ceiling and changed the reported face.
 44:     return max(voxelSize * 1e-5, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
 45: }
 46: 
 47: RayBoxHit intersectBox(vec3 rayOrigin, vec3 rayDirection, vec3 boundsMin, vec3 boundsMax) {
 48:     // Parallel axes are handled explicitly so a boundary value never forms
 49:     // the undefined product 0 * infinity.
 50:     if ((abs(rayDirection.x) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.x < boundsMin.x || rayOrigin.x > boundsMax.x))
 51:         || (abs(rayDirection.y) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.y < boundsMin.y || rayOrigin.y > boundsMax.y))
 52:         || (abs(rayDirection.z) < 1e-20 && (rayOrigin.z < boundsMin.z || rayOrigin.z > boundsMax.z))) {
 53:         return RayBoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3(0.0));
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     vec3 inverseRay = vec3(
 57:         inverseDirection(rayDirection.x),
 58:         inverseDirection(rayDirection.y),
 59:         inverseDirection(rayDirection.z)
 60:     );
 61:     vec3 first = (boundsMin - rayOrigin) * inverseRay;
 62:     vec3 second = (boundsMax - rayOrigin) * inverseRay;
 63:     vec3 nearTimes = min(first, second);
 64:     vec3 farTimes = max(first, second);
 65:     if (abs(rayDirection.x) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.x = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.x = TRACE_INFINITY; }
 66:     if (abs(rayDirection.y) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.y = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.y = TRACE_INFINITY; }
 67:     if (abs(rayDirection.z) < 1e-20) { nearTimes.z = -TRACE_INFINITY; farTimes.z = TRACE_INFINITY; }
 68: 
 69:     float entry = max(nearTimes.x, max(nearTimes.y, nearTimes.z));
 70:     float exit = min(farTimes.x, min(farTimes.y, farTimes.z));
 71:     if (entry > exit || exit < 0.0) {
 72:         return RayBoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3(0.0));
 73:     }
 74: 
 75:     vec3 normal;
 76:     if (entry <= 0.0) {
 77:         vec3 absoluteRay = abs(rayDirection);
 78:         if (absoluteRay.x >= absoluteRay.y && absoluteRay.x >= absoluteRay.z) normal = vec3(-sign(rayDirection.x), 0.0, 0.0);
 79:         else if (absoluteRay.y >= absoluteRay.z) normal = vec3(0.0, -sign(rayDirection.y), 0.0);
 80:         else normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -sign(rayDirection.z));
 81:     } else if (nearTimes.x >= nearTimes.y && nearTimes.x >= nearTimes.z) {
 82:         normal = vec3(rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 83:     } else if (nearTimes.y >= nearTimes.z) {
 84:         normal = vec3(0.0, rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0);
 85:     } else {
 86:         normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0);
 87:     }
 88:     return RayBoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
 89: }
 90: 
 91: float exitDistanceFromBox(
 92:     vec3 rayOrigin,
 93:     vec3 rayDirection,
 94:     vec3 boundsMin,
 95:     vec3 boundsMax,
 96:     out vec3 nextNormal
 97: ) {
 98:     vec3 exitTimes = vec3(TRACE_INFINITY);
 99:     if (abs(rayDirection.x) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.x = ((rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? boundsMax.x : boundsMin.x) - rayOrigin.x) / rayDirection.x;
100:     if (abs(rayDirection.y) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.y = ((rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? boundsMax.y : boundsMin.y) - rayOrigin.y) / rayDirection.y;
101:     if (abs(rayDirection.z) >= 1e-20) exitTimes.z = ((rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? boundsMax.z : boundsMin.z) - rayOrigin.z) / rayDirection.z;
102: 
103:     float nearest = min(exitTimes.x, min(exitTimes.y, exitTimes.z));
104:     // Traversal bias and tie tolerance solve different problems. The former
105:     // moves a sample into the next cell; using that comparatively large value
106:     // here incorrectly merges distinct, very close wall/ceiling crossings.
107:     float tolerance = distanceTieTolerance(nearest);
108:     // Use the same tolerant X/Y/Z precedence as finest-cell DDA. Without
109:     // this, a mathematically tied edge ray can acquire a different face
110:     // normal solely because one path jumped across a larger empty leaf.
111:     if (abs(exitTimes.x - nearest) <= tolerance) {
112:         nextNormal = vec3(rayDirection.x > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
113:         return nearest;
114:     }
115:     if (abs(exitTimes.y - nearest) <= tolerance) {
116:         nextNormal = vec3(0.0, rayDirection.y > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0, 0.0);
117:         return nearest;
118:     }
119:     nextNormal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, rayDirection.z > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0);
120:     return nearest;
121: }
122: 
123: VoxelHit traceChunkDda(
124:     vec3 rayOrigin,
125:     vec3 rayDirection,
126:     int rootIndex,
127:     float worldSize,
128:     float voxelSize,
129:     int svoDepth,
130:     RayBoxHit chunkBox
131: );
132: 
133: VoxelHit traceChunkSkippingEmptyLeaves(
134:     vec3 rayOrigin,
135:     vec3 rayDirection,
136:     int rootIndex,
137:     float worldSize,
138:     float voxelSize,
139:     int svoDepth,
140:     RayBoxHit chunkBox
141: ) {
142:     float distance = chunkBox.entry;
143:     vec3 normal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
144:     float sampleBias = traversalSampleBias(voxelSize);
145:     float refinementEntry = chunkBox.entry;
146:     vec3 refinementEntryNormal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
147: 
148:     for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < 768; ++stepIndex) {
149:         if (distance > chunkBox.exit) break;
150:         vec3 samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
151:         VoxelLeaf leaf = lookupVoxelLeaf(samplePoint, rootIndex, worldSize, svoDepth);
152:         if (leaf.material != 0u) {
153:             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Resolve the final
154:             // voxel-scale crossing with the diagnostic algorithm so both
155:             // policies produce one canonical distance, material, and normal.
156:             RayBoxHit refinementBox = RayBoxHit(
157:                 true, refinementEntry, chunkBox.exit, refinementEntryNormal
158:             );
159:             return traceChunkDda(
160:                 rayOrigin,
161:                 rayDirection,
162:                 rootIndex,
163:                 worldSize,
164:                 voxelSize,
165:                 svoDepth,
166:                 refinementBox
167:             );
168:         }
169: 
170:         vec3 crossedNormal;
171:         float nextDistance = exitDistanceFromBox(
172:             rayOrigin, rayDirection, leaf.boundsMin, leaf.boundsMax, crossedNormal
173:         );
174:         if (nextDistance <= distance + sampleBias * 0.25) {
175:             nextDistance = distance + sampleBias;
176:         }
177:         // A normalized ray moves at most one voxel per axis over this short
178:         // interval. Retaining it lets the exact resolver reconstruct every
179:         // potentially competing face without replaying the skipped octant.
180:         refinementEntry = max(distance, nextDistance - voxelSize);
181:         refinementEntryNormal = normal;
182:         distance = nextDistance;
183:         normal = crossedNormal;
184:     }
185:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u);
186: }
187: 
188: VoxelHit traceChunkDda(
189:     vec3 rayOrigin,
190:     vec3 rayDirection,
191:     int rootIndex,
192:     float worldSize,
193:     float voxelSize,
194:     int svoDepth,
195:     RayBoxHit chunkBox
196: ) {
197:     float sampleBias = traversalSampleBias(voxelSize);
198:     float distance = chunkBox.entry;
199:     vec3 samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
200:     vec3 cell = floor(samplePoint / voxelSize);
201:     vec3 directionStep = sign(rayDirection);
202:     vec3 normal = chunkBox.entryNormal;
203: 
204:     for (int stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < 768; ++stepIndex) {
205:         if (distance > chunkBox.exit) break;
206:         samplePoint = rayOrigin + rayDirection * min(distance + sampleBias, chunkBox.exit);
207:         VoxelLeaf leaf = lookupVoxelLeaf(samplePoint, rootIndex, worldSize, svoDepth);
208:         if (leaf.material != 0u) {
209:             return VoxelHit(true, distance, normal, leaf.material, leaf.color, leaf.lightWord);
210:         }
211: 
212:         // Recompute boundary times from the canonical integer cell each step.
213:         // Repeated `nextTime += deltaTime` accumulates enough rounding error
214:         // to reverse two distinct wall/ceiling crossings near a long ray.
215:         vec3 nextBoundary = (cell + max(directionStep, vec3(0.0))) * voxelSize;
216:         vec3 nextTimes = vec3(TRACE_INFINITY);
217:         if (abs(rayDirection.x) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.x = (nextBoundary.x - rayOrigin.x) / rayDirection.x;
218:         if (abs(rayDirection.y) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.y = (nextBoundary.y - rayOrigin.y) / rayDirection.y;
219:         if (abs(rayDirection.z) >= 1e-20) nextTimes.z = (nextBoundary.z - rayOrigin.z) / rayDirection.z;
220: 
221:         float nextDistance = min(nextTimes.x, min(nextTimes.y, nextTimes.z));
222:         if (nextDistance > chunkBox.exit) break;
223:         // Step every tied axis so a ray through an edge/corner cannot stall.
224:         // This is a floating-point equality tolerance, not the sampling bias.
225:         // Keeping them separate preserves the mathematically nearer face when
226:         // two boundaries are close but not actually coincident.
227:         float tieEpsilon = distanceTieTolerance(nextDistance);
228:         bool crossX = abs(nextTimes.x - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
229:         bool crossY = abs(nextTimes.y - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
230:         bool crossZ = abs(nextTimes.z - nextDistance) <= tieEpsilon;
231:         if (crossX) cell.x += directionStep.x;
232:         if (crossY) cell.y += directionStep.y;
233:         if (crossZ) cell.z += directionStep.z;
234:         if (crossX) normal = vec3(-directionStep.x, 0.0, 0.0);
235:         else if (crossY) normal = vec3(0.0, -directionStep.y, 0.0);
236:         else normal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -directionStep.z);
237:         distance = nextDistance;
238:     }
239:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u);
240: }
241: 
242: VoxelHit traceChunk(
243:     vec3 rayOrigin,
244:     vec3 rayDirection,
245:     int rootIndex,
246:     float worldSize,
247:     float voxelSize,
248:     int svoDepth,
249:     RayBoxHit chunkBox
250: ) {
251:     if (uEmptySpaceSkipEnabled == 1) {
252:         return traceChunkSkippingEmptyLeaves(
253:             rayOrigin, rayDirection, rootIndex, worldSize, voxelSize, svoDepth, chunkBox
254:         );
255:     }
256:     return traceChunkDda(
257:         rayOrigin, rayDirection, rootIndex, worldSize, voxelSize, svoDepth, chunkBox
258:     );
259: }
260: "#;
````

````rust
 1: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
 2: VoxelHit selectNearestVoxelHit(
 3:     vec3 rayDirection,
 4:     ChunkInterval intervals[25],
 5:     int intervalCount,
 6:     out int closestChunkIndex
 7: ) {
 8:     VoxelHit closest = VoxelHit(
 9:         false, TRACE_INFINITY, vec3(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u
10:     );
11:     closestChunkIndex = -1;
12:     for (int intervalIndex = 0; intervalIndex < intervalCount; ++intervalIndex) {
13:         ChunkInterval interval = intervals[intervalIndex];
14:         // Sorted traversal may stop only after every remaining AABB begins
15:         // beyond the nearest solid hit. Breaking after the first hit is wrong
16:         // because power-of-two padded chunk boxes overlap.
17:         if (uFrontToBackEnabled == 1 && interval.entry >= closest.distance) break;
18: 
19:         int chunkIndex = interval.chunkIndex;
20:         vec3 localOrigin = uCameraPosition - uChunkOrigins[chunkIndex];
21:         RayBoxHit box = RayBoxHit(
22:             true, interval.entry, interval.exit, interval.entryNormal
23:         );
24:         VoxelHit candidate = traceChunk(
25:             localOrigin,
26:             rayDirection,
27:             uChunkRootIndices[chunkIndex],
28:             uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex],
29:             uChunkVoxelSizes[chunkIndex],
30:             uChunkDepths[chunkIndex],
31:             box
32:         );
33:         if (candidate.hit && candidate.distance < closest.distance) {
34:             closest = candidate;
35:             closestChunkIndex = chunkIndex;
36:         }
37:     }
38:     return closest;
39: }
40: "#;
````

````rust
 2: bool isEmissiveVoxel(uint material) {
 3:     return material == 4u || material == 9u || material == 16u;
 4: }
 5: 
 6: vec3 decodePackedColor(uint packed) {
 7:     return vec3(
 8:         float((packed >> 16u) & 0xffu),
 9:         float((packed >> 8u) & 0xffu),
10:         float(packed & 0xffu)
11:     ) * (1.0 / 255.0);
12: }
13: 
14: bool isDownwardEmittingFace(vec3 normal) {
15:     return normal.y < -0.5;
16: }
17: 
18: vec3 emittedVoxelRadiance(uint material, vec3 albedo, vec3 normal) {
19:     if (!isDownwardEmittingFace(normal)) return vec3(0.0);
20:     if (material == 4u) return albedo * 10.0;
21:     if (material == 9u) return albedo * 8.0;
22:     if (material == 16u) return albedo * 0.9;
23:     return vec3(0.0);
24: }
25: 
26: vec3 shadeVoxel(
27:     VoxelHit hit,
28:     vec3 worldPosition,
29:     float receiverVoxelSize,
30:     int receiverChunkIndex
31: ) {
32:     vec3 albedo = srgbToLinear(decodePackedColor(hit.color));
33:     if (isEmissiveVoxel(hit.material) && isDownwardEmittingFace(hit.normal)) {
34:         return emittedVoxelRadiance(hit.material, albedo, hit.normal);
35:     }
36: 
37:     vec3 ambient = (uOutdoor == 1
38:         ? vec3(0.32, 0.38, 0.48)
39:         : vec3(0.045, 0.040, 0.024)) * uAmbientScale;
40:     vec3 analyticDirect = vec3(0.0);
41: 
42:     // Analytic fixtures are the sole static-light authority. A single packed
43:     // RGB value cannot describe the six incident face directions, so this
44:     // correctness path deliberately does not consume the optional surface
45:     // diffuse field.
46:     int lightFirst = uChunkLightFirst[receiverChunkIndex];
47:     int lightCount = uChunkLightCounts[receiverChunkIndex];
48:     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < lightCount; ++lightIndex) {
49:         SceneLight light = readSceneLight(lightFirst + lightIndex);
50:         analyticDirect += evaluateVisibleSceneLight(
51:             worldPosition, hit.normal, light, receiverVoxelSize
52:         );
53:     }
54:     for (int lightIndex = 0; lightIndex < 4; ++lightIndex) {
55:         if (lightIndex >= uDynamicLightCount) break;
56:         analyticDirect += evaluateVisiblePointLight(
57:             worldPosition,
58:             hit.normal,
59:             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].xyz,
60:             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].rgb,
61:             uDynamicPosRadius[lightIndex].w,
62:             uDynamicColorIntensity[lightIndex].a,
63:             receiverVoxelSize
64:         );
65:     }
66: 
67:     vec3 radiance = albedo * (
68:         ambient + analyticDirect
69:     ) * (1.0 / PI);
70:     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
71:         radiance += albedo * spotBeam(
72:             uCameraPosition, uCamForward, worldPosition, hit.normal
73:         );
74:     }
75:     return radiance;
76: }
````

````rust
  2: bool directSampleIsVisible(
  3:     vec3 surfacePosition,
  4:     vec3 surfaceNormal,
  5:     vec3 samplePosition,
  6:     float receiverVoxelSize
  7: ) {
  8:     if (uDirectVisibilityEnabled == 0) return true;
  9: 
 10:     float bias = max(receiverVoxelSize * 1e-3, 1e-5);
 11:     vec3 segmentOrigin = surfacePosition + surfaceNormal * bias;
 12:     vec3 segment = samplePosition - segmentOrigin;
 13:     float segmentLength = length(segment);
 14:     if (!(segmentLength > bias * 2.0)) return true;
 15:     vec3 direction = segment / segmentLength;
 16:     float blockerLimit = segmentLength - bias * 2.0;
 17: 
 18:     for (int chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < uNumChunks; ++chunkIndex) {
 19:         vec3 localOrigin = segmentOrigin - uChunkOrigins[chunkIndex];
 20:         RayBoxHit box = intersectBox(
 21:             localOrigin,
 22:             direction,
 23:             vec3(0.0),
 24:             vec3(uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex])
 25:         );
 26:         if (!box.hit || box.entry >= blockerLimit) continue;
 27:         box.exit = min(box.exit, blockerLimit);
 28:         VoxelHit blocker = traceChunk(
 29:             localOrigin,
 30:             direction,
 31:             uChunkRootIndices[chunkIndex],
 32:             uChunkWorldSizes[chunkIndex],
 33:             uChunkVoxelSizes[chunkIndex],
 34:             uChunkDepths[chunkIndex],
 35:             box
 36:         );
 37:         if (blocker.hit && blocker.distance < blockerLimit) return false;
 38:     }
 39:     return true;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: vec3 evaluateVisiblePointLight(
 43:     vec3 surfacePosition,
 44:     vec3 normal,
 45:     vec3 lightPosition,
 46:     vec3 lightColor,
 47:     float range,
 48:     float intensity,
 49:     float receiverVoxelSize
 50: ) {
 51:     vec3 delta = lightPosition - surfacePosition;
 52:     float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
 53:     vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
 54:     float weight = finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range)
 55:         * receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight);
 56:     if (!(weight > 0.0)
 57:         || !directSampleIsVisible(
 58:             surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, receiverVoxelSize
 59:         )) {
 60:         return vec3(0.0);
 61:     }
 62:     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0) * weight;
 63: }
 64: 
 65: vec3 evaluateVisibleSceneLight(
 66:     vec3 surfacePosition,
 67:     vec3 normal,
 68:     SceneLight light,
 69:     float receiverVoxelSize
 70: ) {
 71:     if (light.kind == LIGHT_POINT) {
 72:         return evaluateVisiblePointLight(
 73:             surfacePosition, normal, light.position, light.color,
 74:             light.range, light.intensity, receiverVoxelSize
 75:         );
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     float area = 4.0 * max(light.halfSize.x, 0.0) * max(light.halfSize.y, 0.0);
 79:     if (!(area > 0.0)) return vec3(0.0);
 80:     const float GAUSS = 0.5773502691896258;
 81:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
 82:         vec2(-GAUSS, -GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS, -GAUSS),
 83:         vec2(-GAUSS,  GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS,  GAUSS)
 84:     );
 85:     float integral = 0.0;
 86:     for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 4; ++sampleIndex) {
 87:         vec2 offset = offsets[sampleIndex] * light.halfSize;
 88:         vec3 samplePosition = light.position + vec3(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
 89:         vec3 delta = samplePosition - surfacePosition;
 90:         float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
 91:         vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
 92:         float weight = finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, light.range)
 93:             * receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight)
 94:             * emitterCosine(light.kind, surfaceToLight);
 95:         if (weight > 0.0
 96:             && directSampleIsVisible(
 97:                 surfacePosition, normal, samplePosition, receiverVoxelSize
 98:             )) {
 99:             integral += weight;
100:         }
101:     }
102:     return max(light.color, vec3(0.0)) * max(light.intensity, 0.0)
103:         * area * (integral * 0.25);
104: }
````

````rust
 2: float fogTransmittance(float distanceToCamera, float fogStart, float sigmaExtinction) {

 4:     return exp(-max(sigmaExtinction, 0.0) * distanceInMedium);

 7: vec3 applyDistanceFog(
 8:     vec3 surfaceRadiance,
 9:     vec3 mediumRadiance,
10:     float distanceToCamera,
11:     float fogStart,
12:     float sigmaExtinction
13: ) {
````

````rust
 13: pub const SPOT_CONE_GLSL: &str = r#"
 14: // --- flashlight cone (spec: adapters/cpu_splatter/flashlight.rs) ---
 15: const float SPOT_INNER_COS = 0.9816272; // cos(11 deg)
 16: const float SPOT_OUTER_COS = 0.9135455; // cos(24 deg)
 17: const float SPOT_RANGE_END = 14.0;
 18: const float SPOT_INTENSITY = 32.0;
 19: const float SPOT_MIN_DISTANCE = 0.25;
 20: const float SPOT_INV_PI = 0.3183098861837907;
 21: const vec3  SPOT_TINT = vec3(1.0, 0.91, 0.72);
 22: 
 23: // The hand-held lamp sits slightly forward of and below the eye.
 24: vec3 spotLampPos(vec3 camPos, vec3 camForward) {
 25:     return camPos + camForward * 0.18 - vec3(0.0, 0.10, 0.0);
 26: }
 27: 
 28: // Angular falloff: 1 inside the inner cone, 0 outside the outer.
 29: float spotCone(vec3 beam, vec3 camForward) {
 30:     return smoothstep(SPOT_OUTER_COS, SPOT_INNER_COS, dot(beam, camForward));
 31: }
 32: 
 33: // Finite-range inverse-square transport. The compact window and its first
 34: // derivative both reach zero at RANGE_END, so the beam has no hard rim.
 35: float spotAttenuation(float dist) {
 36:     if (!(dist >= 0.0) || dist >= SPOT_RANGE_END) return 0.0;
 37:     float normalizedSquared = (dist * dist) / (SPOT_RANGE_END * SPOT_RANGE_END);
 38:     float window = max(1.0 - normalizedSquared * normalizedSquared, 0.0);
 39:     float minimumSquared = SPOT_MIN_DISTANCE * SPOT_MIN_DISTANCE;
 40:     return (window * window) / max(dist * dist, minimumSquared);
 41: }
 42: 
 43: // Lambertian reflected-radiance factor at a surface point with normal N.
 44: // The CPU contract evaluates irradiance first and multiplies albedo / PI;
 45: // folding 1/PI here preserves that exact composition at GPU call sites.
 46: vec3 spotBeam(vec3 camPos, vec3 camForward, vec3 surfacePos, vec3 N) {
 47:     vec3 lamp = spotLampPos(camPos, camForward);
 48:     vec3 toSurf = surfacePos - lamp;
 49:     float dist = length(toSurf);
 50:     vec3 beam = toSurf / max(dist, 1e-4);
 51:     float cone = spotCone(beam, camForward);
 52:     float attenuation = spotAttenuation(dist);
 53:     float facing = max(-dot(beam, N), 0.0);
 54:     return SPOT_TINT * (SPOT_INTENSITY * SPOT_INV_PI * cone * attenuation * facing);
 55: }
 56: "#;

 61: pub fn material_color_glsl() -> String {
 62:     let mut source = String::from("vec3 materialColor(float material) {\n");
 63:     for (material, visual) in MATERIAL_VISUALS.iter().enumerate() {
 64:         let red = (visual.color >> 16) & 0xff;
 65:         let green = (visual.color >> 8) & 0xff;
 66:         let blue = visual.color & 0xff;
 67:         writeln!(
 68:             source,
 69:             "    if (material < {:.1}) return vec3({red}.0, {green}.0, {blue}.0) / 255.0;",
 70:             material as f32 + 0.5,
 71:         )
 72:         .expect("writing to a String cannot fail");
 73:     }
 74:     source.push_str("    return vec3(0.0);\n}\n");
 75:     source
 76: }

124: vec3 flareCoresThroughMedium(
125:     vec3 worldPos,
126:     vec3 camPos,
127:     float fogStart,
128:     float sigmaExtinction
129: ) {
130:     vec3 toFrag = worldPos - camPos;
131:     float fragDist = length(toFrag);
132:     vec3 rd = toFrag / max(fragDist, 1e-4);
133:     vec3 sum = vec3(0.0);
134:     for (int i = 0; i < uCoreCount; i++) {
135:         vec3 toLight = uCores[i].xyz - camPos;
136:         float along = dot(toLight, rd);
137:         if (along <= 0.05 || along >= fragDist) continue;
138:         float perp = length(toLight - rd * along);
139:         float coreSize = 0.06 + along * 0.004;
140:         float core = 1.0 - smoothstep(coreSize * 0.4, coreSize, perp);
141:         float mediumDistance = max(along - max(fogStart, 0.0), 0.0);
142:         float transmittance = exp(-max(sigmaExtinction, 0.0) * mediumDistance);
143:         sum += uCoreColors[i] * uCores[i].w * core * 1.4 * transmittance;
144:     }
145:     return sum;
146: }
147:

149:     return flareCoresThroughMedium(worldPos, camPos, 0.0, 0.0);
````

````rust
 1: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
 2: const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
 3: const int LIGHT_POINT = 0;
 4: const int LIGHT_CEILING_PANEL = 1;
 5: const int LIGHT_STRIP = 2;
 6: const int LIGHT_EMERGENCY = 3;
 7: 
 8: float finiteRangeInverseSquare(float distanceSquared, float range) {
 9:     if (!(range > 0.0) || !(distanceSquared >= 0.0)) return 0.0;
10:     float rangeSquared = range * range;
11:     float normalizedSquared = distanceSquared / rangeSquared;
12:     float window = max(1.0 - normalizedSquared * normalizedSquared, 0.0);
13:     return (window * window) / max(distanceSquared, 0.04);
14: }
15: 
16: float receiverCosine(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
17:     return max(dot(normal, surfaceToLight), 0.0);
18: }
19: 
20: float emitterCosine(int kind, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
21:     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) return 1.0;
22:     // Rectangular fixtures lie in XZ and point down. `surfaceToLight.y` is
23:     // positive exactly when the receiver is in their emitting hemisphere.
24:     return max(surfaceToLight.y, 0.0);
25: }
26: 
27: vec3 evaluatePointLight(
28:     vec3 surfacePosition,
29:     vec3 normal,
30:     vec3 lightPosition,
31:     vec3 lightColor,
32:     float range,
33:     float intensity
34: ) {
35:     vec3 delta = lightPosition - surfacePosition;
36:     float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
37:     vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
38:     float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight);
39:     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
40:         * finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
41: }
42: 
43: vec3 evaluateRectangleLight(
44:     vec3 surfacePosition,
45:     vec3 normal,
46:     vec3 lightPosition,
47:     vec2 halfSize,
48:     vec3 lightColor,
49:     float range,
50:     float intensity,
51:     int kind
52: ) {
53:     const float GAUSS = 0.5773502691896258;
54:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
55:         vec2(-GAUSS, -GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS, -GAUSS),
56:         vec2(-GAUSS,  GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS,  GAUSS)
57:     );
58:     vec3 integral = vec3(0.0);
59:     for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 4; ++sampleIndex) {
60:         vec2 offset = offsets[sampleIndex] * halfSize;
61:         vec3 samplePosition = lightPosition + vec3(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
62:         vec3 delta = samplePosition - surfacePosition;
63:         float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
64:         vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
65:         float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight)
66:             * emitterCosine(kind, surfaceToLight);
67:         integral += finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
68:     }
69:     float area = 4.0 * max(halfSize.x, 0.0) * max(halfSize.y, 0.0);
70:     if (!(area > 0.0)) return vec3(0.0);
71:     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
72:         * area * (integral * 0.25);
73: }
74: 
75: vec3 evaluateSceneLight(
76:     vec3 surfacePosition,
77:     vec3 normal,
78:     vec3 lightPosition,
79:     vec2 halfSize,
80:     vec3 lightColor,
81:     float range,
82:     float intensity,
83:     int kind
84: ) {
85:     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) {
86:         return evaluatePointLight(
87:             surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, lightColor, range, intensity
88:         );
89:     }
90:     return evaluateRectangleLight(
91:         surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, halfSize,
92:         lightColor, range, intensity, kind
93:     );
94: }
````

````rust
 48: vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
 49:     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
 50:     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
 51:     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
 52:     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
 53:     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 54:     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 55: }
 56: 
 57: // In-plane basis with U x V = outward normal, so the TRIANGLE_STRIP corner
 58: // order (-1,-1)(1,-1)(-1,1)(1,1) is counter-clockwise from the front.
 59: void faceBasis(float axis, out vec3 u, out vec3 v) {
 60:     if (axis < 0.5)      { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
 61:     else if (axis < 1.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
 62:     else if (axis < 2.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
 63:     else if (axis < 3.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
 64:     else if (axis < 4.5) { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
 65:     else                 { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
 66: }
 67: 
 68: // Face-center shadow visibility. Vertex shaders have no derivatives or
 69: // gl_FragCoord, so this uses a fixed symmetric tap pattern; tap count is a
 70: // spec-profile knob (1 on Pi-class, 4 on high).
 71: float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, vec3 lightDir) {
 72:     vec4 lightClip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPos + normal * 0.025, 1.0);
 73:     vec3 p = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
 74:     vec2 uv = p.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
 75:     float receiverDepth = p.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
 76:     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0))) || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
 77:         return 1.0;
 78:     }
 79:     float bias = max(0.003 * (1.0 - dot(normal, lightDir)), 0.0008);
 80:     float compare = receiverDepth - bias;
 81:     if (uShadowTaps <= 1) {
 82:         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv, 0.0).r;
 83:         return (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
 84:     }
 85:     vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(uShadowMap, 0));
 86:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
 87:         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
 88:         vec2(-0.5,  0.5), vec2(0.5,  0.5)
 89:     );
 90:     float shadow = 0.0;
 91:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
 92:         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv + offsets[i] * texelSize, 0.0).r;
 93:         shadow += (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
 94:     }
 95:     return shadow * 0.25;
 96: }
 97: 
 98: // Quantize the light magnitude while preserving its RGB ratio. Quantizing
 99: // channels independently makes warm yellow light jump toward neutral grey.
100: vec3 quantizeLighting(vec3 lightColor) {
101:     float peak = max(max(lightColor.r, lightColor.g), lightColor.b);
102:     if (peak < 0.0001) {
103:         return vec3(0.08, 0.07, 0.035);
104:     }
105:     float band = max(floor(peak * 6.0 + 0.5) / 6.0, 0.08);
106:     return lightColor * (band / peak);
107: }
108: 
109: void main() {
110:     vec2 corner = vec2(
111:         (gl_VertexID == 1 || gl_VertexID == 3) ? 1.0 : -1.0,
112:         (gl_VertexID >= 2) ? 1.0 : -1.0
113:     );
114:     vec3 N = normalForAxis(aFaceMeta.x);
115:     vec3 U, V;
116:     faceBasis(aFaceMeta.x, U, V);
117: 
118:     vec3 center = uChunkOrigin + aFacePos * (1.0 / 1024.0);
119:     float halfU = aFaceExtents.x * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
120:     float halfV = aFaceExtents.y * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
121:     vec3 world = center + corner.x * halfU * U + corner.y * halfV * V;
122:     vWorldPos = world;
123:     vNormal = N;
124:     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);

126:     vec3 albedo = materialColor(aFaceMeta.y);

128:     vEmissive = emissive ? 1.0 : 0.0;

130:     // (a bright ceiling plane turns grain into salt-and-pepper noise) or
131:     // emissive fixtures.
132:     bool isCeiling = aFaceMeta.y > 2.5 && aFaceMeta.y < 3.5;
133:     vGrainAmp = (emissive || isCeiling) ? 0.0 : 0.02;
134:     // Coffer beams live in shading, not geometry: downward ceiling faces
135:     // get a world-locked beam-grid darkening in the fragment shader.
136:     vBeamPattern = (isCeiling && aFaceMeta.x > 0.5 && aFaceMeta.x < 1.5) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
137:     if (emissive) {
138:         vColor = albedo * 1.5;
139:         return;
140:     }

142:     vec3 toCamera = uCameraPosition - center;

162:     float faceResponse = 0.8;

165:     } else if (N.y < -0.5) {

171:     float ao = mix(1.0, 0.22, clamp(aFaceMeta.w * 1.3, 0.0, 1.0));

173:     vec3 ambientUp = vec3(1.05, 1.0, 0.72) * irradiance;
174:     vec3 ambientDown = vec3(0.58, 0.52, 0.30) * irradiance;

177:         ambientDown = vec3(0.56, 0.58, 0.55) * irradiance;

179:     vec3 ambient = mix(ambientDown, ambientUp, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * ao * faceResponse * uAmbientScale;

181:     vec3 directDiffuse = vec3(0.0);

183:         if (i >= uLightCount) break;
184:         vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - center;
185:         float d2 = dot(toLight, toLight);
186:         float range = uLightParams[i].x;
187:         float range2 = range * range;
188:         if (d2 >= range2) continue;
189: 
190:         float d = sqrt(d2);
191:         vec3 L = toLight / max(d, 0.001);
192:         float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
193:         float x = clamp(d2 / range2, 0.0, 1.0);
194:         float falloff = (1.0 - x) * (1.0 - x);

196:         float visible = 1.0;
197:         if (i == uShadowedLightIndex) {

203:         vec3 lightColor = mix(uLightColors[i], vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85), 0.3);

207:     // Flashlight: the shared spotlight cone (spec in the CPU splatter),

210:     // and every light multiplies it, so the flashlight brightens yellow

223: const FRAGMENT_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
224: precision highp float;
225: // Fragment ints default to mediump; the vertex stage declares uOutdoor at
226: // its (highp) default, and linking demands the precisions match.
227: precision highp int;

229: in vec3 vWorldPos;
230: flat in vec3 vColor;
231: flat in vec3 vNormal;
232: flat in float vEmissive;
233: flat in float vGrainAmp;
234: flat in float vBeamPattern;
235: 
236: uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
237: uniform float uVoxelScale;
238: // Optimization/effect toggle: grain + banding dither (RenderToggles).
239: uniform int uDitherEnabled;
240: 
241: // Dropped-flare cores: xyz = world position, w = intensity (pre-flickered).
242: uniform int uCoreCount;
243: uniform vec4 uCores[4];
244: uniform vec3 uCoreColors[4];
245: 
246: // Level atmosphere: outdoors the fog fades to a bright sky haze instead of
247: // black (the framebuffer is cleared to the matching sky color).
248: uniform int uOutdoor;
249: uniform vec3 uFogColor;
250: 
251: out vec4 fragColor;
252: "#;
253: 
254: 
255: 
256: 
257: const FRAGMENT_BODY: &str = r#"
258: void main() {
259:     vec3 color = vColor;
260:     float distanceToCamera = length(uCameraPosition - vWorldPos);
261: 
262:     if (vEmissive < 0.5) {
263:         // World-locked per-voxel albedo grain: sample half a voxel inside
264:         // the surface so faces lying exactly on lattice planes hash stably.
265:         // Amplitude is per-face (zero on ceilings) so large bright planes
266:         // read as solid construction, not noise.
267:         vec3 lattice = floor((vWorldPos - vNormal * (0.5 * uVoxelScale)) / uVoxelScale);
268:         float grain = 1.0 + (hash3D(lattice) - 0.5) * 2.0 * vGrainAmp * float(uDitherEnabled);
269:         color *= grain;
270: 
271:         // Coffer beam grid on ceilings (matches the generator's
272:         // COFFER_PERIOD): intentional construction lines, zero geometry.
273:         if (vBeamPattern > 0.5) {
274:             bool onBeam = mod(vWorldPos.x, 2.8) < 0.22 || mod(vWorldPos.z, 2.8) < 0.22;
275:             if (onBeam) {
276:                 color *= 0.86;
277:             }
278:         }
279: 
280:     }
281: 
282:     // Warm haze nearby, fading all the way to black before the draw limit.
283:     // The framebuffer is cleared to the same black, so a not-yet-generated
284:     // chunk reads as void instead of a brown rectangle.
285:     float fogOnset = 14.0;
286:     float fogDist = max(0.0, distanceToCamera - fogOnset);
287:     float fogDensity = 0.032;
288:     float heightFactor = 1.0 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 3.4, vWorldPos.y);
289:     float fogAmount = 1.0 - exp(-fogDist * fogDensity * heightFactor);
290:     fogAmount = max(fogAmount, smoothstep(34.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera));
291: 
292:     float hNorm = clamp(vWorldPos.y / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0);
293:     vec3 heightFogColor = mix(
294:         vec3(0.055, 0.040, 0.014),
295:         vec3(0.055, 0.060, 0.020),
296:         hNorm
297:     );
298:     float farFade = smoothstep(28.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera);
299:     vec3 currentFogColor = mix(heightFogColor, vec3(0.0), farFade);
300:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
301:         currentFogColor = uFogColor;
302:     }
303:     color = mix(color, currentFogColor, clamp(fogAmount, 0.0, 1.0));
304: 
305:     // Flare cores (shared chunk; occluded by nearer surfaces).
306:     color += flareCores(vWorldPos, uCameraPosition);
307: 
308:     color = toneMap(color);
309:     color += (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * (1.0 / 128.0) * (1.0 - fogAmount) * float(uDitherEnabled);
310: 
311:     fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
312: }
````

````rust
 93: fn render_frame(

115: fn begin_main_frame(renderer: &SplatRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
116:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
117:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.width, renderer.height);
118: 
119:     let environment = frame.environment;
120:     if environment.outdoor {
121:         gl.clear_color(
122:             environment.sky_color[0],
123:             environment.sky_color[1],
124:             environment.sky_color[2],
125:             1.0,
126:         );
127:     } else {
128:         // Indoor fog reaches black before the draw limit, so unloaded space
129:         // and fogged geometry meet without a colored chunk boundary.
130:         gl.clear_color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
131:     }
132:     gl.clear_depth(1.0);
133:     gl.clear(Gl::COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | Gl::DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
134:     gl.enable(Gl::DEPTH_TEST);
135:     gl.depth_func(Gl::LEQUAL);
136:     gl.depth_mask(true);
137:     gl.enable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
138:     gl.cull_face(Gl::BACK);
139: }
140: 
141: /// OPTIMIZATION (rt_cull): conservative chunk sphere rejection. The
142: /// disabled reference path submits every resident chunk. Both paths retain
143: /// near-to-far ordering because the face budget deliberately drops whole
144: /// far chunks before nearby geometry.
145: fn collect_visible_chunks<'a>(
146:     resident: &[&'a SplatChunk],
147:     frame: &FrameParams,
148:     culling_enabled: bool,
149: ) -> Vec<&'a SplatChunk> {
150:     let mut ranked: Vec<(&SplatChunk, f32)> = resident
151:         .iter()
152:         .copied()
153:         .filter_map(|chunk| {
154:             let (center, radius) = chunk_bounding_sphere(chunk.origin, chunk.bounds_max);
155:             let distance2 = if culling_enabled {
156:                 sphere_visible(center, radius, frame, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE)?
157:             } else {
158:                 squared_distance(center, frame.camera_pos)
159:             };
160:             Some((chunk, distance2))
161:         })
162:         .collect();
163: 
164:     ranked.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
165:     ranked.into_iter().map(|(chunk, _)| chunk).collect()
166: }
167: 
168: fn squared_distance(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
169:     let dx = a[0] - b[0];
170:     let dy = a[1] - b[1];
171:     let dz = a[2] - b[2];
172:     dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
173: }

184: fn render_shadow_pass(
185:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
186:     casters: &[&SplatChunk],
187:     lights: &SelectedLights,
188:     enabled: bool,
189: ) -> ShadowState {
190:     if !enabled || lights.hero_slot < 0 {
191:         return ShadowState::default();
192:     }
193: 
194:     let range = lights.hero_radius;
195:     let ortho_half = (range * 0.55).clamp(7.0, 13.0);
196:     let projection = ortho_matrix(
197:         -ortho_half,
198:         ortho_half,
199:         -ortho_half,
200:         ortho_half,
201:         0.1,
202:         range * 1.2,
203:     );
204:     let view = look_at_matrix_down(lights.hero_position);
205:     let light_view_projection = multiply_matrices(&projection, &view);
206: 
207:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
208:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, Some(&renderer.shadow.fbo));
209:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.shadow.size, renderer.shadow.size);
210:     gl.color_mask(false, false, false, false);
211:     gl.clear_depth(1.0);
212:     gl.clear(Gl::DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
213:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.shadow_program));
214:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(
215:         renderer.shadow_uniforms.light_view_proj.as_ref(),
216:         false,
217:         &light_view_projection,
218:     );
219: 
220:     for chunk in casters {
221:         if chunk.shadow_index_count == 0 {
222:             continue;
223:         }
224:         gl.uniform3f(
225:             renderer.shadow_uniforms.chunk_origin.as_ref(),
226:             chunk.origin[0],
227:             chunk.origin[1],
228:             chunk.origin[2],
229:         );
230:         gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&chunk.shadow_vao));
231:         gl.draw_elements_with_i32(Gl::TRIANGLES, chunk.shadow_index_count, Gl::UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
232:     }
233: 
234:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, None);
235:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.width, renderer.height);
236:     gl.color_mask(true, true, true, true);
237: 
238:     ShadowState {
239:         light_index: lights.hero_slot,
240:         light_view_projection,
241:     }
242: }
243: 
244: fn bind_frame_uniforms(
245:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
246:     frame: &FrameParams,
247:     lights: &SelectedLights,
248:     shadow: &ShadowState,
249:     dither_enabled: bool,
250: ) {
251:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
252:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
253:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.program));
254: 
255:     let (projection, view) =
256:         camera_matrices(frame, renderer.width, renderer.height, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE);
257:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.projection.as_ref(), false, &projection);
258:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.view.as_ref(), false, &view);
259:     gl.uniform3f(
260:         uniforms.camera_position.as_ref(),
261:         frame.camera_pos[0],
262:         frame.camera_pos[1],
263:         frame.camera_pos[2],
264:     );
265: 
266: 
267: 
268:     let (sp, cp) = frame.pitch.sin_cos();
269:     let (sy, cy) = frame.yaw.sin_cos();
270:     gl.uniform3f(uniforms.cam_forward.as_ref(), -cp * sy, sp, -cp * cy);
271:     gl.uniform1i(
272:         uniforms.flashlight.as_ref(),
273:         if frame.flashlight { 1 } else { 0 },
274:     );
275:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.dither.as_ref(), if dither_enabled { 1 } else { 0 });
276: 
277:     let environment = frame.environment;
278:     gl.uniform1i(
279:         uniforms.outdoor.as_ref(),
280:         if environment.outdoor { 1 } else { 0 },
281:     );
282:     gl.uniform3f(
283:         uniforms.fog_color.as_ref(),
284:         environment.fog_color[0],
285:         environment.fog_color[1],
286:         environment.fog_color[2],
287:     );
288:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.ambient_scale.as_ref(), environment.ambient_scale);
289: 
290:     bind_light_uniforms(renderer, frame, lights, shadow);
291: }

293: fn bind_light_uniforms(
294:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
295:     frame: &FrameParams,
296:     lights: &SelectedLights,
297:     shadow: &ShadowState,
298: ) {
299:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
300:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
301:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.light_count.as_ref(), lights.count as i32);
302:     if lights.count > 0 {
303:         gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.light_positions.as_ref(), &lights.positions);
304:         gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.light_colors.as_ref(), &lights.colors);
305:         gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.light_params.as_ref(), &lights.params);
306:     }
307: 
308:     let cores = flare_cores(frame);
309:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.core_count.as_ref(), cores.count);
310:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.cores.as_ref(), &cores.pos_intensity);
311:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.core_colors.as_ref(), &cores.colors);
312: 
313: 
314: 
315:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE1);
316:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&renderer.shadow.texture));
317:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.shadow_map.as_ref(), 1);
318:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(
319:         uniforms.light_view_proj.as_ref(),
320:         false,
321:         &shadow.light_view_projection,
322:     );
323:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.shadowed_light_index.as_ref(), shadow.light_index);
324:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.shadow_taps.as_ref(), renderer.profile.shadow_taps);
325: }
326: 
327: fn draw_visible_chunks(
328:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
329:     visible: &[&SplatChunk],
330:     frame: &FrameParams,
331:     cell_culling_enabled: bool,
332:     face_budget_enabled: bool,
333: ) -> FrameStats {
334:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
335:     let mut stats = FrameStats::default();
336: 
337:     for chunk in visible {
338:         let total_faces = chunk.instance_count.max(0) as u32;
339:         let available_budget = if face_budget_enabled {
340:             renderer.profile.face_budget.saturating_sub(stats.faces_drawn)
341:         } else {
342:             u32::MAX
343:         };
344: 
345:         if available_budget == 0 {
346:             stats.faces_dropped = stats.faces_dropped.saturating_add(total_faces);
347:             continue;
348:         }
349: 
350:         bind_chunk(renderer, chunk);
351:         stats.chunks_drawn += 1;
352: 
353: 
354:         if cell_culling_enabled {
355:             let visible_cell_faces: u32 = chunk
356:                 .cells
357:                 .iter()
358:                 .filter_map(|range| {
359:                     let center = [
360:                         chunk.origin[0] + (range.cell[0] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
361:                         chunk.origin[1] + (range.cell[1] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
362:                         chunk.origin[2] + (range.cell[2] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
363:                     ];
364:                     sphere_visible(center, chunk.cell_size * 1.5, frame, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE)
365:                         .map(|_| range.count)
366:                 })
367:                 .sum();
368: 
369:             let faces_saved = total_faces.saturating_sub(visible_cell_faces);
370:             if faces_saved > 64 {
371:                 draw_visible_cells(renderer, chunk, frame, &mut stats);
372:             } else {
373:                 draw_instance_range(renderer, 0, total_faces.min(available_budget), &mut stats);
374:             }
375:         } else {
376:             draw_instance_range(renderer, 0, total_faces.min(available_budget), &mut stats);
377:         }
378:     }
379: 
380:     gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
381:     gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, None);
382:     stats
383: }

385: fn bind_chunk(renderer: &SplatRenderer, chunk: &SplatChunk) {
386:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
387:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
388:     gl.uniform3f(
389:         uniforms.chunk_origin.as_ref(),
390:         chunk.origin[0],
391:         chunk.origin[1],
392:         chunk.origin[2],
393:     );
394:     gl.uniform3f(
395:         uniforms.chunk_size.as_ref(),
396:         chunk.bounds_max[0],
397:         chunk.bounds_max[1],
398:         chunk.bounds_max[2],
399:     );
400:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.voxel_scale.as_ref(), chunk.voxel_scale);
401: 
402:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE0);
403:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Some(&chunk.light_texture));
404:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.light_volume.as_ref(), 0);
405:     gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&chunk.instance_vao));
406:     gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, Some(&chunk.instance_buffer));
407: }

409: fn draw_visible_cells(
410:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
411:     chunk: &SplatChunk,
412:     frame: &FrameParams,
413:     stats: &mut FrameStats,
414: ) {
415: 
416: 
417: 
418: 
419:     let cell_radius = chunk.cell_size * 1.5;
420:     let mut run_start = None;
421:     let mut run_count = 0u32;
422: 
423:     for range in &chunk.cells {
424:         let center = [
425:             chunk.origin[0] + (range.cell[0] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
426:             chunk.origin[1] + (range.cell[1] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
427:             chunk.origin[2] + (range.cell[2] as f32 + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
428:         ];
429:         if sphere_visible(center, cell_radius, frame, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE).is_some() {
430:             if run_start.is_none() {
431:                 run_start = Some(range.offset);
432:             }
433:             run_count = run_count.saturating_add(range.count);
434:         } else {
435:             stats.cells_culled += 1;
436:             flush_instance_run(renderer, &mut run_start, &mut run_count, stats);
437:         }
438:     }
439:     flush_instance_run(renderer, &mut run_start, &mut run_count, stats);
440: }

442: fn flush_instance_run(
443:     renderer: &SplatRenderer,
444:     start: &mut Option<u32>,
445:     count: &mut u32,
446:     stats: &mut FrameStats,
447: ) {
448:     if let Some(first) = start.take() {
449:         draw_instance_range(renderer, first, *count, stats);
450:     }
451:     *count = 0;
452: }
453: 
454: fn draw_instance_range(renderer: &SplatRenderer, first: u32, count: u32, stats: &mut FrameStats) {
455:     if count == 0 {
456:         return;
457:     }
458:     renderer.attribs.point_at(&renderer.gl, first);
459:     renderer
460:         .gl
461:         .draw_arrays_instanced(Gl::TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4, count.min(i32::MAX as u32) as i32);
462:     stats.faces_drawn = stats.faces_drawn.saturating_add(count);
463:     stats.draw_calls += 1;
464: }
````

````rust
126:             cam_forward: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uCamForward"),
127:             flashlight: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uFlashlightEnabled"),
128:             dither: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uDitherEnabled"),
129:             light_volume: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uLightVolume"),
130:             light_count: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uLightCount"),
131:             light_positions: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uLightPositions"),
132:             light_colors: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uLightColors"),
133:             light_params: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uLightParams"),
134:             core_count: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uCoreCount"),
135:             cores: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uCores"),
136:             core_colors: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uCoreColors"),
137:             shadow_map: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uShadowMap"),

143:             ambient_scale: gl.get_uniform_location(&program, "uAmbientScale"),
144:         };

148:         let shadow_uniforms = ShadowUniforms {

150:             chunk_origin: gl.get_uniform_location(&shadow_program, "uChunkOrigin"),
151:         };
````

````rust
 22: 
 23: impl InstanceAttribs {
 24:     pub(crate) fn resolve(gl: &Gl, program: &WebGlProgram) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 25:         let lookup = |name: &str| -> Result<u32, JsValue> {
 26:             let location = gl.get_attrib_location(program, name);
 27:             if location < 0 {
 28:                 return Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!("splat shader lost {name}")));
 29:             }
 30:             Ok(location as u32)
 31:         };
 32: 
 33:         Ok(Self {
 34:             pos: lookup("aFacePos")?,
 35:             extents: lookup("aFaceExtents")?,
 36:             meta: lookup("aFaceMeta")?,
 37:             flags: lookup("aFaceFlags")?,
 38:         })
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     fn enable(&self, gl: &Gl) {
 42:         for location in [self.pos, self.extents, self.meta, self.flags] {
 43:             gl.enable_vertex_attrib_array(location);
 44:             gl.vertex_attrib_divisor(location, 1);
 45:         }
 46:     }
 47: 
 48: 
 49: 
 50:     pub(crate) fn point_at(&self, gl: &Gl, first_instance: u32) {
 51:         let base = first_instance as i32 * INSTANCE_STRIDE;
 52:         gl.vertex_attrib_pointer_with_i32(
 53:             self.pos,
 54:             3,
 55:             Gl::UNSIGNED_SHORT,
 56:             false,
 57:             INSTANCE_STRIDE,
 58:             base,
 59:         );
 60:         gl.vertex_attrib_pointer_with_i32(
 61:             self.extents,
 62:             2,
 63:             Gl::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
 64:             false,
 65:             INSTANCE_STRIDE,
 66:             base + 6,
 67:         );
 68:         gl.vertex_attrib_pointer_with_i32(
 69:             self.meta,
 70:             4,
 71:             Gl::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
 72:             false,
 73:             INSTANCE_STRIDE,
 74:             base + 8,
 75:         );
 76:         gl.vertex_attrib_pointer_with_i32(
 77:             self.flags,
 78:             1,
 79:             Gl::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
 80:             false,
 81:             INSTANCE_STRIDE,
 82:             base + 12,
 83:         );
 84:     }
 85: }

 88: pub(crate) struct SplatChunk {

 93:     pub cell_size: f32,

100:     pub bounds_max: [f32; 3],

102: }
103: 
104: impl SplatRenderer {
105:     pub(crate) fn destroy_chunk(&self, chunk: SplatChunk) {
106:         let gl = &self.gl;
107:         gl.delete_vertex_array(Some(&chunk.instance_vao));
108:         gl.delete_buffer(Some(&chunk.instance_buffer));
109:         gl.delete_vertex_array(Some(&chunk.shadow_vao));
110:         gl.delete_buffer(Some(&chunk.shadow_vertex_buffer));
111:         gl.delete_buffer(Some(&chunk.shadow_index_buffer));
112:         gl.delete_texture(Some(&chunk.light_texture));
113:     }
114: 
115:     pub(crate) fn upload_surface(&mut self, chunk: SurfaceChunk<'_>) {
116:         if let Some(old) = self.chunks.remove(&chunk.key) {
117:             self.destroy_chunk(old);
118:         }
119:         if chunk.mesh.faces.instances.is_empty() {
120:             return;
121:         }
122: 
123:         let (instance_vao, instance_buffer) = self.upload_instance_page(chunk);
124:         let (shadow_vao, shadow_vertex_buffer, shadow_index_buffer) =
125:             self.upload_shadow_mesh(chunk);
126:         let light_texture =
127:             upload_light_volume(&self.gl, chunk.mesh).expect("upload splat light volume");
128: 
129:         self.chunks.insert(
130:             chunk.key,
131:             SplatChunk {
132:                 instance_vao,
133:                 instance_buffer,
134:                 instance_count: chunk.mesh.faces.instances.len().min(i32::MAX as usize) as i32,
135:                 cells: chunk.mesh.faces.cells.clone(),
136:                 cell_size: chunk.mesh.faces.cell_size,
137:                 voxel_scale: chunk.mesh.voxel_scale,
138:                 shadow_vao,
139:                 shadow_vertex_buffer,
140:                 shadow_index_buffer,
141:                 shadow_index_count: chunk.mesh.indices.len().min(i32::MAX as usize) as i32,
142:                 origin: chunk.origin,
143:                 bounds_max: chunk.mesh.bounds.max,
144:                 light_texture,
145: 
146:             },
147:         );
148:     }
149: 
150:     fn upload_instance_page(
151:         &self,
152:         chunk: SurfaceChunk<'_>,
153:     ) -> (WebGlVertexArrayObject, WebGlBuffer) {
154:         let gl = &self.gl;
155:         let vao = gl.create_vertex_array().expect("create splat VAO");
156:         let buffer = gl.create_buffer().expect("create splat instance buffer");
157:         let packed = pack_instances(chunk);
158: 
159:         gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&vao));
160:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, Some(&buffer));
161:         let bytes = Uint8Array::from(packed.as_slice());
162:         gl.buffer_data_with_array_buffer_view(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, &bytes, Gl::STATIC_DRAW);
163:         self.attribs.enable(gl);
164:         self.attribs.point_at(gl, 0);
165:         gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
166:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, None);
167: 
168:         (vao, buffer)
169:     }
170: 
171:     fn upload_shadow_mesh(
172:         &self,
173:         chunk: SurfaceChunk<'_>,
174:     ) -> (WebGlVertexArrayObject, WebGlBuffer, WebGlBuffer) {
175:         let gl = &self.gl;
176:         let vao = gl.create_vertex_array().expect("create splat shadow VAO");
177:         let vertex_buffer = gl
178:             .create_buffer()
179:             .expect("create splat shadow vertex buffer");
180:         let index_buffer = gl
181:             .create_buffer()
182:             .expect("create splat shadow index buffer");
183:         let packed_vertices = pack_shadow_vertices(chunk);
184: 
185:         gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&vao));
186:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, Some(&vertex_buffer));
187:         let vertices = Uint8Array::from(packed_vertices.as_slice());
188:         gl.buffer_data_with_array_buffer_view(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, &vertices, Gl::STATIC_DRAW);
189: 
190:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, Some(&index_buffer));
191:         let indices = Uint32Array::from(chunk.mesh.indices.as_slice());
192:         gl.buffer_data_with_array_buffer_view(Gl::ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, &indices, Gl::STATIC_DRAW);
193: 
194:         // The shared shadow shader declares `aPosition` at location zero.
195:         gl.enable_vertex_attrib_array(0);
196:         gl.vertex_attrib_pointer_with_i32(0, 3, Gl::UNSIGNED_SHORT, false, SHADOW_VERTEX_STRIDE, 0);
197:         gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
198:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ARRAY_BUFFER, None);
199:         gl.bind_buffer(Gl::ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, None);
200: 
201:         (vao, vertex_buffer, index_buffer)
202:     }
203: }
204: 
205: /// Serializes `PackedFaceInstance` explicitly so the GPU layout is stable
206: /// across Rust compiler versions and host alignment rules.
207: fn pack_instances(chunk: SurfaceChunk<'_>) -> Vec<u8> {
208:     let instances = &chunk.mesh.faces.instances;
209:     let mut packed = Vec::with_capacity(instances.len() * INSTANCE_STRIDE as usize);
210:     for instance in instances {
211:         packed.extend_from_slice(&instance.position[0].to_le_bytes());
212:         packed.extend_from_slice(&instance.position[1].to_le_bytes());
213:         packed.extend_from_slice(&instance.position[2].to_le_bytes());
214:         packed.push(instance.extent_u);
215:         packed.push(instance.extent_v);
216:         packed.push(instance.normal_axis);
217:         packed.push(instance.material);
218:         packed.push(instance.baked_light);
219:         packed.push(instance.ao);
220:         packed.push(instance.flags);
221:         packed.extend_from_slice(&[0, 0, 0]);
222:     }
223:     packed
224: }
225: 
226: 
227: 
228: 
229: fn pack_shadow_vertices(chunk: SurfaceChunk<'_>) -> Vec<u8> {
230:     let mut packed = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.mesh.vertices.len() * SHADOW_VERTEX_STRIDE as usize);
231:     for vertex in &chunk.mesh.vertices {
232:         packed.extend_from_slice(&vertex.position[0].to_le_bytes());
233:         packed.extend_from_slice(&vertex.position[1].to_le_bytes());
234:         packed.extend_from_slice(&vertex.position[2].to_le_bytes());
235:         packed.extend_from_slice(&[
236:             vertex.normal_axis,
237:             vertex.material,
238:             vertex.static_indirect,
239:             vertex.ao,
240:         ]);
241:     }
242:     packed
243: }
````

````rust
 87:         let _ = gl.tex_image_2d_with_i32_and_i32_and_i32_and_format_and_type_and_opt_u8_array(

118: fn render_frame(renderer: &mut SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams, toggles: RenderToggles) {
119:     begin_main_frame(renderer, frame);
120:     let (mut visible, clustered_lights) =
121:         prepare_visible_draws(renderer, frame, toggles.distance_cull);
122:     if renderer
123:         .scene_lights
124:         .upload(&renderer.gl, &clustered_lights)
125:         .is_err()
126:     {
127:         for draw in &mut visible {
128:             draw.lights.count = 0;
129:             draw.hero_local_index = -1;
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:     let (shadow, shadow_casters, shadow_draw_calls) =
134:         render_shadow_pass(renderer, frame, toggles.shadow_pass);
135: 
136:     bind_frame_uniforms(
137:         renderer,
138:         frame,
139:         &shadow,
140:         toggles.dither,
141:         toggles.baked_lighting,
142:     );
143:     let (triangles_drawn, main_draw_calls) = draw_visible_meshes(renderer, &visible, &shadow);
144:     draw_supply_labels(renderer, frame);
145: 
146:     renderer.stats = super::SurfaceFrameStats {
147:         visible_chunks: visible.len(),
148:         resident_chunks: renderer.meshes.len(),
149:         draw_calls: shadow_draw_calls + main_draw_calls,
150:         triangles_drawn,
151:         shadow_casters,
152:     };
153: }
154: 
155: /// Camera-facing product labels over nearby supply pickups. A cutout pass:
156: /// depth-tested and depth-writing, so it needs no ordering against the
157: /// opaque world and never x-rays through walls.
158: fn draw_supply_labels(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
159:     use crate::drivers::shaders::supply_labels;
160: 
161:     let Some(atlas) = renderer.label_atlas.as_ref() else {
162:         return;
163:     };
164:     if frame.supply_sprites.is_empty() {
165:         return;
166:     }
167:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
168:     let uniforms = &renderer.label_uniforms;
169:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.label_program));
170: 
171:     let (projection, view) =
172:         camera_matrices(frame, renderer.width, renderer.height, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE);
173:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.projection.as_ref(), false, &projection);
174:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.view.as_ref(), false, &view);
175: 
176:     let count = frame
177:         .supply_sprites
178:         .len()
179:         .min(supply_labels::MAX_SPRITES);
180:     let mut sprites = [0.0f32; supply_labels::MAX_SPRITES * 4];
181:     for (i, sprite) in frame.supply_sprites.iter().take(count).enumerate() {
182:         sprites[i * 4] = sprite.position[0];
183:         sprites[i * 4 + 1] = sprite.position[1];
184:         sprites[i * 4 + 2] = sprite.position[2];
185:         sprites[i * 4 + 3] = sprite.atlas_row as f32;
186:     }
187:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.sprites.as_ref(), &sprites);
188:     // Cylindrical billboard: turn with the player's yaw, stay upright.
189:     let right = [frame.yaw.cos(), 0.0, -frame.yaw.sin()];
190:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.cam_right.as_ref(), &right);
191:     gl.uniform2f(
192:         uniforms.half_size.as_ref(),
193:         supply_labels::HALF_WIDTH,
194:         supply_labels::HALF_HEIGHT,
195:     );
196:     gl.uniform3f(
197:         uniforms.camera_position.as_ref(),
198:         frame.camera_pos[0],
199:         frame.camera_pos[1],
200:         frame.camera_pos[2],
201:     );
202:     let environment = frame.environment;
203:     gl.uniform3f(
204:         uniforms.fog_color.as_ref(),
205:         environment.fog_color[0],
206:         environment.fog_color[1],
207:         environment.fog_color[2],
208:     );
209:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_density.as_ref(), environment.fog_density);
210:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_start.as_ref(), environment.fog_start);
211: 
212:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE7);
213:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(atlas));
214:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.atlas.as_ref(), 7);
215: 
216: 
217:     gl.disable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
218:     gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
219:     gl.draw_arrays(Gl::TRIANGLES, 0, (count * 6) as i32);
220:     gl.enable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
221: }

224: fn begin_main_frame(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
225:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
226:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.width, renderer.height);
227: 
228: 
229: 
230:     let environment = frame.environment;
231:     let atmosphere = if environment.outdoor {
232:         environment.sky_color
233:     } else {
234:         environment.fog_color
235:     };
236:     let clear = encode_display_color(atmosphere);
237:     gl.clear_color(clear[0], clear[1], clear[2], 1.0);
238:     gl.clear_depth(1.0);
239:     gl.clear(Gl::COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | Gl::DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
240:     gl.enable(Gl::DEPTH_TEST);
241:     gl.depth_func(Gl::LEQUAL);
242:     gl.depth_mask(true);
243:     gl.enable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
244:     gl.cull_face(Gl::BACK);
245: }

249: fn prepare_visible_draws(
250:     renderer: &SurfaceRenderer,
251:     frame: &FrameParams,
252:     culling_enabled: bool,
253: ) -> (
254:     Vec<VisibleDraw>,
255:     Vec<crate::application::ports::LightSource>,
256: ) {
257:     let mut draws = Vec::new();
258:     let mut clustered = Vec::new();
259:     let hero_id = frame.active_scene_lights().first().map(|light| light.id);
260:     for (&key, mesh) in &renderer.meshes {
261:         let visible = {
262:             if !culling_enabled {
263:                 true
264:             } else {
265:                 let (center, radius) = chunk_bounding_sphere(mesh.origin, mesh.bounds_max);
266:                 sphere_visible(center, radius, frame, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE).is_some()
267:             }
268:         };
269:         if !visible {
270:             continue;
271:         }
272:         let bounds_max = [
273:             mesh.origin[0] + mesh.bounds_max[0],
274:             mesh.origin[1] + mesh.bounds_max[1],
275:             mesh.origin[2] + mesh.bounds_max[2],
276:         ];
277:         let lights = append_lights_reaching_bounds(
278:             frame.active_scene_lights(),
279:             mesh.origin,
280:             bounds_max,
281:             &mut clustered,
282:         );
283:         let hero_local_index =
284:             if lights.count > 0 && hero_id == Some(clustered[lights.first as usize].id) {
285:                 0
286:             } else {
287:                 -1
288:             };
289:         draws.push(VisibleDraw {
290:             key,
291:             lights,
292:             hero_local_index,
293:         });
294:     }
295:     (draws, clustered)
296: }
````
