````wgsl
 31: };
 32: 
 33: struct BoxHit {
 34:     hit: bool,
 35:     entry: f32,
 36:     exit: f32,
 37:     normal: vec3<f32>,
 38: };
 39: 
 40: struct VoxelLeaf {
 41:     material: u32,
 42:     color: u32,
 43:     light_word: u32,
 44:     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
 45:     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
 46: };
 47: 
 48: struct VoxelHit {
 49:     hit: bool,
 50:     distance: f32,
 51:     normal: vec3<f32>,
 52:     material: u32,
 53:     color: u32,
 54:     light_word: u32,

 56: };
 57: 
 58: struct VisibilityTrace {
 59:     blocked: bool,
 60:     steps: u32,
 61: };
 62: 
 63: @vertex
 64: fn raymarch_vertex(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> FullscreenVertex {
 65:     var output: FullscreenVertex;
 66:     let x = select(-1.0, 3.0, vertex_index == 1u);
 67:     let y = select(-1.0, 3.0, vertex_index == 2u);
 68:     output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
 69:     return output;
 70: }
 71: 
 72: fn safe_inverse(direction: f32) -> f32 {
 73:     if abs(direction) < 1e-20 {
 74:         return select(TRACE_INFINITY, -TRACE_INFINITY, direction < 0.0);
 75:     }
 76:     return 1.0 / direction;
 77: }
 78: 
 79: fn distance_tie_tolerance(distance: f32) -> f32 {
 80:     return max(abs(distance) * 1e-6, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
 81: }
 82: 
 83: fn traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size: f32) -> f32 {
 84:     return max(voxel_size * 1e-5, TRACE_MIN_TIE_EPSILON);
 85: }
 86: 
 87: fn ray_policy_enabled(flag: u32) -> bool {
 88:     return (ray_scene.policy_flags & flag) != 0u;
 89: }
 90: 
 91: fn box_intersection(
 92:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
 93:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
 94:     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
 95:     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
 96: ) -> BoxHit {
 97:     if (abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.x < bounds_min.x || ray_origin.x > bounds_max.x))
 98:         || (abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.y < bounds_min.y || ray_origin.y > bounds_max.y))
 99:         || (abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.z < bounds_min.z || ray_origin.z > bounds_max.z)) {
100:         return BoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0));
101:     }
102:     let inverse = vec3<f32>(
103:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.x),
104:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.y),
105:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.z)
106:     );
107:     var near_times = min((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
108:     var far_times = max((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
109:     if abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 { near_times.x = -1e30; far_times.x = 1e30; }
110:     if abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 { near_times.y = -1e30; far_times.y = 1e30; }
111:     if abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 { near_times.z = -1e30; far_times.z = 1e30; }
112:     let entry = max(near_times.x, max(near_times.y, near_times.z));
113:     let exit = min(far_times.x, min(far_times.y, far_times.z));
114:     if entry > exit || exit < 0.0 {
115:         return BoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3<f32>(0.0));
116:     }
117:     var normal = vec3<f32>(0.0);
118:     if entry <= 0.0 {
119:         let absolute = abs(ray_direction);
120:         if absolute.x >= absolute.y && absolute.x >= absolute.z {
121:             normal = vec3<f32>(-sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
122:         } else if absolute.y >= absolute.z {
123:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
124:         } else {
125:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
126:         }
127:     } else if near_times.x >= near_times.y && near_times.x >= near_times.z {
128:         normal = vec3<f32>(select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.x > 0.0), 0.0, 0.0);
129:     } else if near_times.y >= near_times.z {
130:         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.y > 0.0), 0.0);
131:     } else {
132:         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.z > 0.0));
133:     }
134:     return BoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
135: }
136: 
137: fn lookup_leaf(point: vec3<f32>, chunk: RayChunk) -> VoxelLeaf {
138:     var node_index = chunk.indices.x;
139:     var bounds_min = vec3<f32>(0.0);
140:     var bounds_max = vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w);
141:     let depth = u32(chunk.voxel_depth.y);
142:     for (var level = 0u; level <= 10u; level += 1u) {
143:         let word = node_index * 4u;
144:         let node_type = atlas_words[word];
145:         let payload = atlas_words[word + 1u];
146:         let color_or_mask = atlas_words[word + 2u];
147:         let light_word = atlas_words[word + 3u];
148:         if node_type == 1u || level >= depth {
149:             return VoxelLeaf(payload, color_or_mask, light_word, bounds_min, bounds_max);
150:         }
151:         let center = (bounds_min + bounds_max) * 0.5;
152:         let child_x = select(0u, 1u, point.x >= center.x);
153:         let child_y = select(0u, 1u, point.y >= center.y);
154:         let child_z = select(0u, 1u, point.z >= center.z);
155:         let child = (child_z << 2u) | (child_y << 1u) | child_x;
156:         let child_min = vec3<f32>(
157:             select(bounds_min.x, center.x, child_x == 1u),
158:             select(bounds_min.y, center.y, child_y == 1u),
159:             select(bounds_min.z, center.z, child_z == 1u)
160:         );
161:         let child_max = vec3<f32>(
162:             select(center.x, bounds_max.x, child_x == 1u),
163:             select(center.y, bounds_max.y, child_y == 1u),
164:             select(center.z, bounds_max.z, child_z == 1u)
165:         );
166:         if (color_or_mask & (1u << child)) == 0u {
167:             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, child_min, child_max);
168:         }
169:         node_index = payload + child;
170:         bounds_min = child_min;
171:         bounds_max = child_max;
172:     }
173:     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, bounds_min, bounds_max);
174: }
175: 
176: fn next_leaf_exit(
177:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
178:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
179:     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
180:     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
181: ) -> vec4<f32> {
182:     var times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
183:     if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 {
184:         times.x = (select(bounds_min.x, bounds_max.x, ray_direction.x > 0.0) - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x;
185:     }
186:     if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 {
187:         times.y = (select(bounds_min.y, bounds_max.y, ray_direction.y > 0.0) - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y;
188:     }
189:     if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 {
190:         times.z = (select(bounds_min.z, bounds_max.z, ray_direction.z > 0.0) - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z;
191:     }
192:     let nearest = min(times.x, min(times.y, times.z));
193:     let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(nearest);
194:     // Match finest-DDA X/Y/Z precedence for mathematically tied exits. The
195:     // traversal bias is intentionally not reused as an equality tolerance.
196:     if abs(times.x - nearest) <= tolerance {
197:         return vec4<f32>(nearest, -sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
198:     }
199:     if abs(times.y - nearest) <= tolerance {
200:         return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
201:     }
202:     return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
203: }
204: 
205: fn trace_chunk_dda(
206:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
207:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
208:     chunk: RayChunk,
209:     interval: BoxHit,
210: ) -> VoxelHit {
211:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
212:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
213:     var distance = interval.entry;
214:     var normal = interval.normal;
215:     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
216:     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
217:     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
218:     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
219:     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
220:         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
221:             break;
222:         }
223:         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
224:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
225:         if leaf.material != 0u {
226:             return VoxelHit(
227:                 true,
228:                 distance,
229:                 normal,
230:                 leaf.material,
231:                 leaf.color,
232:                 leaf.light_word,
233:                 voxel_size
234:             );
235:         }
236: 
237:         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
238:         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
239:         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
240:         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
241:         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
242:         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
243:         if next_distance > interval.exit { break; }
244:         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
245:         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
246:         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
247:         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
248:         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
249:         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
250:         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
251:         if cross_x {
252:             normal = vec3<f32>(-direction_step.x, 0.0, 0.0);
253:         } else if cross_y {
254:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -direction_step.y, 0.0);
255:         } else {
256:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -direction_step.z);
257:         }
258:         distance = next_distance;
259:     }
260:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
261: }
262: 
263: fn trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
264:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
265:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
266:     chunk: RayChunk,
267:     interval: BoxHit,
268: ) -> VoxelHit {
269:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
270:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
271:     var distance = interval.entry;
272:     var normal = interval.normal;
273:     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
274:     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
275:     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
276: 
277:     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
278:         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
279:             break;
280:         }
281:         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
282:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
283:         if leaf.material != 0u {
284:             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Re-run the canonical
285:             // finest-cell DDA over the final short interval so skip on/off
286:             // returns one distance, material, and normal contract.
287:             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
288:                 true,
289:                 refinement_entry,
290:                 interval.exit,
291:                 refinement_entry_normal
292:             );
293:             return trace_chunk_dda(
294:                 ray_origin,
295:                 ray_direction,
296:                 chunk,
297:                 refinement_interval
298:             );
299:         }
300: 
301:         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
302:             ray_origin,
303:             ray_direction,
304:             leaf.bounds_min,
305:             leaf.bounds_max
306:         );
307:         var next_distance = exit.x;
308:         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
309:             next_distance = distance + bias;
310:         }
311:         // A normalized ray travels at most one finest voxel per axis over
312:         // this retained interval, which is enough for DDA to reconstruct all
313:         // potentially competing boundary crossings.
314:         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
315:         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
316:         distance = next_distance;
317:         normal = exit.yzw;
318:     }
319:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
320: }
321: 
322: fn trace_chunk(
323:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
324:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
325:     chunk: RayChunk,
326:     interval: BoxHit,
327: ) -> VoxelHit {
328:     if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP) {
329:         return trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
330:             ray_origin,
331:             ray_direction,
332:             chunk,
333:             interval
334:         );
335:     }
336:     return trace_chunk_dda(ray_origin, ray_direction, chunk, interval);
337: }
338: 
339: fn direct_visibility_bias(voxel_size: f32) -> f32 {
340:     return max(voxel_size * 1e-3, 1e-5);
341: }
342: 
343: // Secondary visibility has its own hard budget. It deliberately does not
344: // consult the primary-ray trace budget or empty-space policy toggle.
345: fn trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
346:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
347:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
348:     chunk: RayChunk,
349:     interval: BoxHit,
350:     step_budget: u32,
351: ) -> VisibilityTrace {
352:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
353:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
354:     var distance = interval.entry;
355:     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
356:     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
357:     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
358:     var steps = 0u;
359: 
360:     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
361:         if distance > interval.exit {
362:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
363:         }
364:         if steps >= step_budget {
365:             // Exhaustion is conservatively opaque, avoiding a light leak.
366:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
367:         }
368:         steps += 1u;
369:         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
370:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
371:         if leaf.material != 0u {
372:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
373:         }
374: 
375:         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
376:         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
377:         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
378:         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
379:         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
380:         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
381:         if next_distance > interval.exit {
382:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
383:         }
384:         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
385:         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
386:         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
387:         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
388:         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
389:         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
390:         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
391:         distance = next_distance;
392:     }
393:     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
394: }
395: 
396: // Coarse leaves prove only that an interval is empty. A non-empty leaf is
397: // resolved by the same finest-cell DDA contract as primary traversal, while
398: // both phases share one caller-supplied secondary-ray budget.
399: fn trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
400:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
401:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
402:     chunk: RayChunk,
403:     interval: BoxHit,
404:     step_budget: u32,
405: ) -> VisibilityTrace {
406:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
407:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
408:     var distance = interval.entry;
409:     var normal = interval.normal;
410:     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
411:     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
412:     var steps = 0u;
413: 
414:     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
415:         if distance > interval.exit {
416:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
417:         }
418:         if steps >= step_budget {
419:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
420:         }
421:         steps += 1u;
422:         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
423:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
424:         if leaf.material != 0u {
425:             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
426:                 true,
427:                 refinement_entry,
428:                 interval.exit,
429:                 refinement_entry_normal
430:             );
431:             let refined = trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
432:                 ray_origin,
433:                 ray_direction,
434:                 chunk,
435:                 refinement_interval,
436:                 step_budget - steps
437:             );
438:             return VisibilityTrace(refined.blocked, steps + refined.steps);
439:         }
440: 
441:         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
442:             ray_origin,
443:             ray_direction,
444:             leaf.bounds_min,
445:             leaf.bounds_max
446:         );
447:         var next_distance = exit.x;
448:         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
449:             next_distance = distance + bias;
450:         }
451:         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
452:         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
453:         distance = next_distance;
454:         normal = exit.yzw;
455:     }
456:     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
457: }
458: 
459: fn finite_segment_visible(
460:     receiver_world: vec3<f32>,
461:     receiver_normal: vec3<f32>,
462:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
463:     endpoint_world: vec3<f32>,
464: ) -> bool {
465:     let endpoint_bias = direct_visibility_bias(receiver_voxel_size);
466:     let biased_origin = receiver_world + receiver_normal * endpoint_bias;
467:     let segment = endpoint_world - biased_origin;
468:     let endpoint_distance = length(segment);
469:     if endpoint_distance <= endpoint_bias * 2.0 {
470:         return true;
471:     }
472:     let ray_direction = segment / endpoint_distance;
473:     // Do not classify the light fixture's own endpoint as an occluder.
474:     let maximum_distance = endpoint_distance - endpoint_bias;
475:     var remaining_steps = DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET;
476:     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
477: 
478:     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
479:         if remaining_steps == 0u {
480:             return false;
481:         }
482:         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
483:         let local_origin = biased_origin - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
484:         let slab = box_intersection(
485:             local_origin,
486:             ray_direction,
487:             vec3<f32>(0.0),
488:             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
489:         );
490:         let finite_exit = min(slab.exit, maximum_distance);
491:         if !slab.hit || finite_exit <= slab.entry {
492:             continue;
493:         }
494:         let interval = BoxHit(true, slab.entry, finite_exit, slab.normal);
495:         let trace = trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
496:             local_origin,
497:             ray_direction,
498:             chunk,
499:             interval,
500:             remaining_steps
501:         );
502:         remaining_steps -= min(trace.steps, remaining_steps);
503:         if trace.blocked {
504:             return false;
505:         }
506:     }
507:     return true;
508: }
509: 
510: fn has_positive_rgb(value: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
511:     return max(value.x, max(value.y, value.z)) > 0.0;
512: }
513: 
514: fn rectangle_visibility_sample_count() -> u32 {
515:     return select(1u, 4u, ray_scene._reserved.x == 4u);
516: }
517: 
518: fn evaluate_visible_scene_light(
519:     world: vec3<f32>,
520:     normal: vec3<f32>,
521:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
522:     light: GpuLight,
523: ) -> vec3<f32> {
524:     let kind = u32(max(light.half_size_kind.z, 0.0) + 0.5);
525:     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
526:         let endpoint = light.position_radius.xyz;
527:         let unoccluded = point_light_sample_irradiance(world, normal, light, endpoint);
528:         if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
529:             return vec3<f32>(0.0);
530:         }
531:         if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
532:             return unoccluded;
533:         }
534:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
535:     }
536: 
537:     if rectangle_visibility_sample_count() == 4u {
538:         var visible_integral = 0.0;
539:         for (var sample_index = 0u; sample_index < 4u; sample_index += 1u) {
540:             let endpoint = rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light, sample_index);
541:             let sample_weight = rectangle_light_sample_weight(
542:                 world,
543:                 normal,
544:                 light,
545:                 kind,
546:                 endpoint
547:             );
548:             let sample_irradiance = rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(
549:                 light,
550:                 sample_weight
551:             );
552:             if !has_positive_rgb(sample_irradiance) {
553:                 continue;
554:             }
555:             if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
556:                 visible_integral += sample_weight;
557:             }
558:         }
559:         return rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(light, visible_integral);
560:     }
561: 
562:     // Low quality retains the existing four-point unoccluded quadrature and
563:     // gates its integral with one finite segment to the rectangle center.
564:     let unoccluded = evaluate_rectangle_light(world, normal, light, kind);
565:     if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
566:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
567:     }
568:     if finite_segment_visible(
569:         world,
570:         normal,
571:         receiver_voxel_size,
572:         light.position_radius.xyz
573:     ) {
574:         return unoccluded;
575:     }
576:     return vec3<f32>(0.0);
577: }
578: 
579: fn raymarch_analytic_direct(
580:     world: vec3<f32>,
581:     normal: vec3<f32>,
582:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
583: ) -> vec3<f32> {
584:     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
585:     for (var index = 0u; index < frame.render_options.x; index += 1u) {
586:         let light = lights[index];
587:         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
588:             continue;
589:         }
590:         analytic_direct += evaluate_visible_scene_light(
591:             world,
592:             normal,
593:             receiver_voxel_size,
594:             light
595:         );
596:     }
597:     return analytic_direct;
598: }
599: 
600: fn camera_ray(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
601:     let viewport = max(frame.viewport_fov_start.xy, vec2<f32>(1.0));
602:     let normalized = pixel / viewport;
603:     let aspect = viewport.x / viewport.y;
604:     let screen = vec2<f32>(
605:         (normalized.x * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect,
606:         1.0 - normalized.y * 2.0
607:     ) * frame.viewport_fov_start.z;
608:     return normalize(
609:         frame.camera_forward.xyz
610:         + frame.camera_right.xyz * screen.x
611:         + frame.camera_up.xyz * screen.y
612:     );
613: }
614: 
615: @fragment
616: fn raymarch_fragment(@builtin(position) pixel: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
617:     let direction = camera_ray(pixel.xy);
618:     var nearest = VoxelHit(false, 1e30, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
619:     var nearest_source_index = 0xffffffffu;
620:     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
621:     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
622:         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
623:         let local_origin = frame.camera_position.xyz - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
624:         let interval = box_intersection(
625:             local_origin,
626:             direction,
627:             vec3<f32>(0.0),
628:             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
629:         );
630:         if !interval.hit || interval.entry > nearest.distance { continue; }
631:         // Never search past the closest candidate already found: a hit in
632:         // this chunk beyond nearest.distance could not win the comparison
633:         // below regardless, so there is nothing to gain by tracing that far.
634:         // Mirrors finite_segment_visible's shadow-ray clip to a light's own
635:         // distance (line ~490) — same reasoning, applied to primary rays.
636:         let clipped_interval = BoxHit(
637:             interval.hit,
638:             interval.entry,
639:             min(interval.exit, nearest.distance),
640:             interval.normal
641:         );
642:         let hit = trace_chunk(local_origin, direction, chunk, clipped_interval);
643:         let stable_tie = hit.distance == nearest.distance
644:             && chunk.indices.y < nearest_source_index;
645:         if hit.hit && (hit.distance < nearest.distance || stable_tie) {
646:             nearest = hit;
647:             nearest_source_index = chunk.indices.y;
648:         }
649:     }
650: 
651:     if !nearest.hit {
652:         return vec4<f32>(display_color(frame.sky_color_ambient.xyz), 1.0);
653:     }
654:     let world = frame.camera_position.xyz + direction * nearest.distance;
655:     let albedo = packed_srgb_to_linear(nearest.color);
656:     let emission = authored_emission_strength(nearest.material);
657:     let emits = emission > 0.0 && nearest.normal.y < -0.5;
658:     var radiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);
659:     if emits {
660:         radiance = albedo * emission;
661:     } else if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY) {
662:         let analytic_direct = raymarch_analytic_direct(
663:             world,
664:             nearest.normal,
665:             nearest.voxel_size
666:         );
667:         radiance = surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
668:             world,
669:             nearest.normal,
670:             albedo,
671:             0.0,
672:             1.0,
673:             analytic_direct
674:         );
675:     } else {
676:         radiance = surface_radiance(
677:             world,
678:             nearest.normal,
679:             albedo,
680:             0.0,
681:             1.0,
682:             0u,
683:             frame.render_options.x
684:         );
685:     }
686:     return present_radiance(radiance, world, pixel.xy);
687: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat_geometry.wgsl

````wgsl
 1: // Compact face expansion shared by visible and caster passes.
 2: 
 3: struct PackedFace {
 4:     xy: u32,
 5:     z_extents: u32,
 6:     surface: u32,
 7:     // low 24: domain sRGB color; high 8: authored emission over 0..=10.
 8:     visual: u32,
 9: };
10: 
11: @group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> packed_faces: array<PackedFace>;
12: 
13: fn face_u(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
14:     if axis <= 3u { return vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
15:     return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
16: }
17: 
18: fn face_v(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
19:     switch axis {
20:         case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
21:         case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
22:         case 2u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
23:         case 3u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
24:         case 4u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
25:         default: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
26:     }
27: }
28: 
29: fn splat_face_center(packed: PackedFace) -> vec3<f32> {
30:     let center_local = vec3<f32>(
31:         f32(packed.xy & 65535u),
32:         f32(packed.xy >> 16u),
33:         f32(packed.z_extents & 65535u)
34:     ) * (1.0 / 1024.0);
35:     return chunk.origin_world_size.xyz + center_local;
36: }
37: 
38: fn splat_face_world_position(packed: PackedFace, corner_index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
39:     let extent_u = f32((packed.z_extents >> 16u) & 255u);
40:     let extent_v = f32(packed.z_extents >> 24u);
41:     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
42:     let corner = vec2<f32>(
43:         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index == 1u || corner_index == 3u),
44:         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index >= 2u)
45:     );
46:     return splat_face_center(packed)
47:         + face_u(axis) * corner.x * extent_u * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5
48:         + face_v(axis) * corner.y * extent_v * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5;
49: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // Instanced face-splat strategy. One compact 16-byte record becomes a quad
 2: // in the vertex stage; face geometry is generated entirely on the GPU.
 3: 
 4: struct SplatVertex {
 5:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
 6:     @location(0) world: vec3<f32>,
 7:     @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
 8:     @location(2) @interpolate(flat) radiance: vec3<f32>,
 9: };
10: 
11: @vertex
12: fn splat_vertex(
13:     @builtin(vertex_index) corner_index: u32,
14:     @builtin(instance_index) face_index: u32,
15: ) -> SplatVertex {
16:     let packed = packed_faces[face_index];
17:     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
18:     let baked = f32((packed.surface >> 16u) & 255u) / 15.0;
19:     let ao = 1.0 - f32(packed.surface >> 24u) / 255.0;
20:     let normal = normal_for_axis(axis);
21:     let center = splat_face_center(packed);
22:     let world = splat_face_world_position(packed, corner_index);
23:     let albedo = packed_srgb_to_linear(packed.visual);
24:     let emission = f32(packed.visual >> 24u) / 25.5;
25:     let emits = emission > 0.0 && normal.y < -0.5;
26: 
27:     var output: SplatVertex;
28:     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
29:     output.world = world;
30:     output.normal = normal;
31:     output.radiance = select(
32:         raster_surface_radiance(center, normal, albedo, baked, ao, chunk.draw.x, chunk.draw.y),
33:         albedo * emission,
34:         emits
35:     );
36:     return output;
37: }
38: 
39: @fragment
40: fn splat_fragment(input: SplatVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
41:     return present_radiance(input.radiance, input.world, input.clip_position.xy);
42: }
````

````wgsl
 1: // Supply-item label overlay. A single point record expands into a
 2: // camera-facing quad in the vertex stage, so labels require no transient
 3: // vertex or index allocation.

 5: struct SupplySprite {

 8: };

10: @group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> supply_sprites: array<SupplySprite>;

13: 
14: struct SupplyVertex {
15:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
16:     @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
17:     @location(1) @interpolate(flat) atlas_row: f32,
18:     @location(2) world: vec3<f32>,
19: };
20: 
21: fn supply_corner(index: u32) -> vec2<f32> {
22:     switch index {
23:         case 0u: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0); }
24:         case 1u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0, -1.0); }
25:         case 2u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0,  1.0); }
26:         case 3u: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0); }
27:         case 4u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0,  1.0); }
28:         default: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0); }
29:     }
30: }
31: 
32: @vertex
33: fn supply_label_vertex(
34:     @builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32,
35:     @builtin(instance_index) sprite_index: u32,
36: ) -> SupplyVertex {
37:     let sprite = supply_sprites[sprite_index];
38:     let corner = supply_corner(vertex_index);
39:     let world = sprite.position_atlas_row.xyz
40:         + frame.camera_right.xyz * (corner.x * 0.26)
41:         + vec3<f32>(0.0, corner.y * 0.195, 0.0);
42: 
43:     var output: SupplyVertex;
44:     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
45:     output.uv = vec2<f32>(corner.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - corner.y * 0.5);
46:     output.atlas_row = sprite.position_atlas_row.w;
47:     output.world = world;
48:     return output;
49: }
50: 
51: @fragment
52: fn supply_label_fragment(input: SupplyVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
53:     let uv = vec2<f32>(input.uv.x, (input.uv.y + input.atlas_row) * 0.5);
54:     let label = textureSample(supply_atlas, supply_sampler, uv);
55:     if label.a < 0.5 {
56:         discard;
57:     }
58: 
59:     let view_distance = length(input.world - frame.camera_position.xyz);
60:     let fog_distance = max(view_distance - frame.viewport_fov_start.w, 0.0);
61:     let transmittance = exp(-max(frame.fog_color_density.w, 0.0) * fog_distance);
62:     let radiance = mix(frame.fog_color_density.xyz, label.rgb * 0.92, transmittance);
63:     return vec4<f32>(display_color(radiance), 1.0);
64: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/surface.wgsl

````wgsl
 1: // Indexed greedy-surface strategy. Packed vertices are pulled from a storage
 2: // buffer and decoded on the GPU, avoiding a CPU-side expanded vertex copy.
 3: 
 4: struct SurfaceVertex {
 5:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
 6:     @location(0) world: vec3<f32>,
 7:     @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
 8:     @location(2) @interpolate(flat) visual: u32,
 9:     @location(3) @interpolate(flat) baked: f32,
10:     @location(4) @interpolate(flat) ao: f32,
11: };
12: 
13: @vertex
14: fn surface_vertex(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> SurfaceVertex {
15:     let packed = packed_vertices[vertex_index];
16:     let normal_axis = (packed.z_normal_material >> 16u) & 255u;
17:     let world = surface_world_position(packed);
18: 
19:     var output: SurfaceVertex;
20:     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
21:     output.world = world;
22:     output.normal = normal_for_axis(normal_axis);
23:     output.visual = packed.visual;
24:     output.baked = f32(packed.light_ao & 255u) / 15.0;
25:     output.ao = 1.0 - f32((packed.light_ao >> 8u) & 255u) / 255.0;
26:     return output;
27: }
28: 
29: @fragment
30: fn surface_fragment(input: SurfaceVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
31:     let albedo = packed_srgb_to_linear(input.visual);
32:     let emission = f32(input.visual >> 24u) / 25.5;
33:     let emits = emission > 0.0 && input.normal.y < -0.5;
34:     let radiance = select(
35:         raster_surface_radiance(
36:             input.world,
37:             input.normal,
38:             albedo,
39:             input.baked,
40:             input.ao,
41:             chunk.draw.x,
42:             chunk.draw.y
43:         ),
44:         albedo * emission,
45:         emits
46:     );
47:     return present_radiance(radiance, input.world, input.clip_position.xy);
48: }
````

````rust
  1: use std::sync::{
  2:     Arc,
  3:     atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
  4: };
  5: 
  6: use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
  7: use web_sys::HtmlCanvasElement;
  8: 
  9: pub struct BrowserGpuContext {
 10:     _instance: wgpu::Instance,
 11:     surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
 12:     pub adapter_info: wgpu::AdapterInfo,
 13:     pub device: wgpu::Device,
 14:     pub queue: wgpu::Queue,
 15:     config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
 16:     device_lost: Arc<AtomicBool>,
 17: }
 18: 
 19: impl BrowserGpuContext {
 20:     pub async fn new(canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 21:         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor {
 22:             backends: wgpu::Backends::BROWSER_WEBGPU,
 23:             ..wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle()
 24:         });
 25:         let surface = instance
 26:             .create_surface(wgpu::SurfaceTarget::Canvas(canvas.clone()))
 27:             .map_err(js_error)?;
 28: 
 29: 
 30: 
 31: 
 32:         let default_options = wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
 33:             power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
 34:             compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
 35:             force_fallback_adapter: false,
 36:             apply_limit_buckets: true,
 37:         };
 38:         let adapter = match instance.request_adapter(&default_options).await {
 39:             Ok(adapter) => adapter,
 40:             Err(primary_error) => instance
 41:                 .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
 42:                     force_fallback_adapter: true,
 43:                     ..default_options
 44:                 })
 45:                 .await
 46:                 .map_err(|fallback_error| {
 47:                     js_error(format!(
 48:                         "no WebGPU adapter: {primary_error}; fallback adapter: {fallback_error}"
 49:                     ))
 50:                 })?,
 51:         };
 52:         let adapter_info = adapter.get_info();
 53: 
 54: 
 55: 
 56: 
 57:         let required_limits =
 58:             wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
 59:         let (device, queue) = adapter
 60:             .request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
 61:                 label: Some("vackrooms-webgpu-device"),
 62:                 required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
 63:                 required_limits,
 64:                 experimental_features: wgpu::ExperimentalFeatures::disabled(),
 65:                 memory_hints: wgpu::MemoryHints::MemoryUsage,
 66:                 trace: wgpu::Trace::Off,
 67:             })
 68:             .await
 69:             .map_err(js_error)?;
 70:         let device_lost = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
 71:         device.set_device_lost_callback({
 72:             let device_lost = Arc::clone(&device_lost);
 73:             move |reason, message| {
 74:                 device_lost.store(true, Ordering::Release);
 75:                 web_sys::console::error_1(
 76:                     &format!("WebGPU device lost ({reason:?}): {message}").into(),
 77:                 );
 78:             }
 79:         });
 80:         device.on_uncaptured_error(Arc::new(|error| {
 81:             web_sys::console::error_1(&format!("Uncaptured WebGPU error: {error}").into());
 82:         }));
 83: 
 84:         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
 85:         let format = capabilities
 86:             .formats
 87:             .iter()
 88:             .copied()
 89:             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
 90:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 91:                 JsValue::from_str(
 92:                     "WebGPU surface exposes no linear color format; Vackrooms encodes display color in WGSL",
 93:                 )
 94:             })?;
 95:         let present_mode = capabilities
 96:             .present_modes
 97:             .iter()
 98:             .copied()
 99:             .find(|mode| *mode == wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync)
100:             .or_else(|| capabilities.present_modes.first().copied())
101:             .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGPU surface exposes no present modes"))?;
102:         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
103:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
104:             format,
105:             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
106:             width: canvas.width().max(1),
107:             height: canvas.height().max(1),
108:             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
109:             present_mode,
110:             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
111:             view_formats: vec![],
112:         };
113:         surface.configure(&device, &config);
114: 
115:         Ok(Self {
116:             _instance: instance,
117:             surface,
118:             adapter_info,
119:             device,
120:             queue,
121:             config,
122:             device_lost,
123:         })
124:     }
125: 
126:     pub fn format(&self) -> wgpu::TextureFormat {
127:         self.config.format
128:     }
129: 
130:     pub fn width(&self) -> u32 {
131:         self.config.width
132:     }
133: 
134:     pub fn height(&self) -> u32 {
135:         self.config.height
136:     }
137: 
138:     pub fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
139:         let width = width.max(1);
140:         let height = height.max(1);
141:         if width == self.config.width && height == self.config.height {
142:             return;
143:         }
144:         self.config.width = width;
145:         self.config.height = height;
146:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
147:     }
148: 
149:     pub fn current_texture(&self) -> wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture {
150:         self.surface.get_current_texture()
151:     }
152: 
153:     pub fn reconfigure(&self) {
154:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
155:     }
156: 
157:     pub fn is_device_lost(&self) -> bool {
158:         self.device_lost.load(Ordering::Acquire)
159:     }
160: }
161: 
162: fn js_error(error: impl std::fmt::Display) -> JsValue {
163:     JsValue::from_str(&error.to_string())
164: }
````

````rust
469: }
470: 
471: impl RendererProfile {
472:     pub const fn for_renderer(renderer: RendererKind, quality: GpuQualityProfile) -> Self {
473:         match renderer {
474:             RendererKind::Surface => Self::Surface(SurfaceProfile::for_quality(quality)),
475:             RendererKind::Splat => Self::Splat(SplatProfile::for_quality(quality)),
476:             RendererKind::Raymarch => Self::Raymarch(RaymarchProfile::for_quality(quality)),
477:             RendererKind::Cpu => Self::Cpu(CpuPresentationProfile::for_quality(quality)),
478:         }
479:     }
480: 
481:     pub const fn renderer(self) -> RendererKind {
482:         match self {
483:             Self::Surface(_) => RendererKind::Surface,
484:             Self::Splat(_) => RendererKind::Splat,
485:             Self::Raymarch(_) => RendererKind::Raymarch,
486:             Self::Cpu(_) => RendererKind::Cpu,
487:         }
488:     }
489: 
490:     pub const fn common(&self) -> &CommonGpuConfig {
491:         match self {
492:             Self::Surface(profile) => &profile.common,
493:             Self::Splat(profile) => &profile.common,
494:             Self::Raymarch(profile) => &profile.common,
495:             Self::Cpu(profile) => &profile.common,
496:         }
497:     }

499:     pub const fn artifact_needs(self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
500:         self.renderer().artifact_needs()
501:     }

506:     pub const fn initial_gpu_render_scale(&self) -> Option<f32> {
507:         match self {
508:             Self::Surface(profile) => Some(profile.common.initial_render_scale),
509:             Self::Splat(profile) => Some(profile.common.initial_render_scale),
510:             Self::Raymarch(profile) => Some(profile.common.initial_render_scale),
511:             Self::Cpu(_) => None,
512:         }
513:     }

518: 
519:     pub fn apply_runtime_toggles(&self, requested: RenderToggles) -> RenderToggles {
520:         match self {
521:             Self::Surface(profile) => {
522:                 let mut applied = apply_common_gpu_toggles(&profile.common, requested);
523:                 applied.shadow_pass =
524:                     requested.shadow_pass && profile.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map;
525:                 applied.baked_lighting =
526:                     requested.baked_lighting && profile.optimizations.baked_surface_lighting;
527:                 applied
528:             }
529:             Self::Splat(profile) => {
530:                 let mut applied = apply_common_gpu_toggles(&profile.common, requested);
531:                 applied.front_to_back =
532:                     requested.front_to_back && profile.optimizations.cpu_front_to_back_submission;
533:                 applied.cell_culling =
534:                     requested.cell_culling && profile.optimizations.cpu_cell_range_culling;
535:                 applied.face_budget =
536:                     requested.face_budget && profile.optimizations.enforce_face_budget;
537:                 applied.shadow_pass =
538:                     requested.shadow_pass && profile.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map;
539:                 applied.baked_lighting =
540:                     requested.baked_lighting && profile.optimizations.baked_surface_lighting;
541:                 applied
542:             }
543:             Self::Raymarch(profile) => {
544:                 let mut applied = apply_common_gpu_toggles(&profile.common, requested);
545:                 applied.front_to_back =
546:                     requested.front_to_back && profile.optimizations.front_to_back_chunk_order;
547:                 applied.empty_space_skip =
548:                     requested.empty_space_skip && profile.optimizations.empty_space_skipping;
549:                 applied.shadow_pass =
550:                     requested.shadow_pass && profile.optimizations.direct_light_visibility;
551:                 applied
552:             }
553:             Self::Cpu(profile) => {
554:                 let mut applied = RenderToggles::disabled();
555:                 applied.hierarchical_z = requested.hierarchical_z;
556:                 applied.front_to_back = requested.front_to_back;
557:                 applied.mip_lod = requested.mip_lod;
558:                 applied.flashlight_occlusion = requested.flashlight_occlusion;
559:                 applied.deferred_shading = requested.deferred_shading;
560:                 applied.ambient_occlusion = requested.ambient_occlusion;
561:                 applied.baked_lighting = requested.baked_lighting;
562:                 applied.distance_cull =
563:                     requested.distance_cull && profile.common.optimizations.cull_invisible_chunks;
564:                 applied
565:             }
566:         }
567:     }
568: }
569: 
570: fn apply_common_gpu_toggles(common: &CommonGpuConfig, requested: RenderToggles) -> RenderToggles {
571:     let mut applied = RenderToggles::disabled();
572:     applied.distance_cull = requested.distance_cull && common.optimizations.cull_invisible_chunks;
573:     applied.dither = requested.dither && common.optimizations.dither_output;
574:     applied
575: }
````

````rust
 16: impl FrameResources {
 17:     pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
 18:         let layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
 19:             label: Some("webgpu.frame-layout"),
 20:             entries: &[
 21:                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
 22:                     binding: 0,
 23:                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
 24:                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
 25:                         ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
 26:                         has_dynamic_offset: false,
 27:                         min_binding_size: NonZeroU64::new(size_of::<GpuFrameUniforms>() as u64),
 28:                     },
 29:                     count: None,
 30:                 },
 31:                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
 32:                     binding: 1,
 33:                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
 34:                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
 35:                         ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
 36:                         has_dynamic_offset: false,
 37:                         min_binding_size: NonZeroU64::new(size_of::<GpuLight>() as u64),
 38:                     },
 39:                     count: None,
 40:                 },
 41:             ],
 42:         });
 43:         let frame_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
 44:             label: Some("webgpu.frame-uniforms"),
 45:             size: size_of::<GpuFrameUniforms>() as u64,
 46:             usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
 47:             mapped_at_creation: false,
 48:         });
 49:         let light_capacity = 1;
 50:         let light_buffer = create_light_buffer(device, light_capacity);
 51:         let bind_group = create_bind_group(device, &layout, &frame_buffer, &light_buffer);
 52:         Self {
 53:             layout,
 54:             frame_buffer,
 55:             light_buffer,
 56:             bind_group,
 57:             light_capacity,
 58:         }
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     pub fn layout(&self) -> &wgpu::BindGroupLayout {
 62:         &self.layout
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     pub fn bind_group(&self) -> &wgpu::BindGroup {
 66:         &self.bind_group
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     pub fn write(
 70:         &mut self,
 71:         device: &wgpu::Device,
 72:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
 73:         frame: &GpuFrameUniforms,
 74:         lights: &[GpuLight],
 75:     ) {
 76:         if lights.len().max(1) > self.light_capacity {
 77:             self.light_capacity = lights.len().max(1).next_power_of_two();
 78:             self.light_buffer = create_light_buffer(device, self.light_capacity);
 79:             self.bind_group =
 80:                 create_bind_group(device, &self.layout, &self.frame_buffer, &self.light_buffer);
 81:         }
 82:         queue.write_buffer(&self.frame_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(frame));
 83:         if lights.is_empty() {
 84:             queue.write_buffer(
 85:                 &self.light_buffer,
 86:                 0,
 87:                 bytemuck::bytes_of(&GpuLight::zeroed()),
 88:             );
 89:         } else {
 90:             queue.write_buffer(&self.light_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(lights));
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93: }
 94: 
 95: fn create_light_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, capacity: usize) -> wgpu::Buffer {
 96:     device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
 97:         label: Some("webgpu.frame-lights"),
 98:         contents: &vec![0; capacity * size_of::<GpuLight>()],
 99:         usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
100:     })
101: }
102: 
103: fn create_bind_group(
104:     device: &wgpu::Device,
105:     layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
106:     frame: &wgpu::Buffer,
107:     lights: &wgpu::Buffer,
108: ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
109:     device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
110:         label: Some("webgpu.frame-bind-group"),
111:         layout,
112:         entries: &[
113:             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
114:                 binding: 0,
115:                 resource: frame.as_entire_binding(),
116:             },
117:             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
118:                 binding: 1,
119:                 resource: lights.as_entire_binding(),
120:             },
121:         ],
122:     })
123: }
````

````rust
 17: const PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE: f32 = u8::MAX as f32 / 10.0;

 19: fn pack_material_visual(material: u8) -> u32 {

 22:     let quantized_emission = (emission * PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE)
 23:         .round()
 24:         .clamp(0.0, f32::from(u8::MAX)) as u32;
 25:     color | (quantized_emission << 24)
 26: }

257: impl GpuRayScene {

260:         empty_space_skip: bool,
261:         front_to_back: bool,
262:         direct_light_visibility: bool,
263:         area_light_visibility_samples: u8,
264:     ) -> Self {
265:         let mut policy_flags = 0;
266:         if empty_space_skip {
267:             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP;
268:         }
269:         if front_to_back {
270:             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_FRONT_TO_BACK;
271:         }
272:         if direct_light_visibility {
273:             policy_flags |= RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY;
274:         }
275:         Self {
276:             chunk_count,
277:             policy_flags,
278:             reserved: [
279:                 validated_area_light_visibility_samples(area_light_visibility_samples),
280:                 0,
281:             ],
282:         }
283:     }
284: }

286: const fn validated_area_light_visibility_samples(samples: u8) -> u32 {
287:     if samples == 4 { 4 } else { 1 }

371:     #[test]
372:     fn compact_surface_words_round_trip_fields() {
373:         let source = PackedVertex {
374:             position: [0x1234, 0xabcd, 0x789a],
375:             normal_axis: 5,
376:             material: 7,
377:             static_indirect: 13,
378:             ao: 201,
379:         };
380:         let packed = GpuPackedSurfaceVertex::from(&source);
381:         assert_eq!(packed.xy & 0xffff, 0x1234);
382:         assert_eq!(packed.xy >> 16, 0xabcd);
383:         assert_eq!(packed.z_normal_material & 0xffff, 0x789a);
384:         assert_eq!((packed.z_normal_material >> 16) & 0xff, 5);
385:         assert_eq!(packed.z_normal_material >> 24, 7);
386:         assert_eq!(packed.light_ao & 0xff, 13);
387:         assert_eq!((packed.light_ao >> 8) & 0xff, 201);
388:         assert_eq!(packed.visual & 0x00ff_ffff, MATERIAL_VISUALS[7].color);
389:     }
390: 
391:     #[test]
392:     fn packed_visuals_derive_palette_and_emission_from_the_domain_contract() {
393:         for (material, visual) in MATERIAL_VISUALS.iter().enumerate() {
394:             let material = material as u8;
395:             let packed = pack_material_visual(material);
396:             assert_eq!(packed & 0x00ff_ffff, visual.color, "material {material}");
397: 
398:             let decoded_emission = (packed >> 24) as f32 / PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE;
399:             let expected_emission = material_emission_strength(material).unwrap_or_default();
400:             let maximum_quantization_error = 0.5 / PACKED_EMISSION_UNITS_PER_RADIANCE;
401:             assert!(
402:                 (decoded_emission - expected_emission).abs()
403:                     <= maximum_quantization_error + f32::EPSILON,
404:                 "material {material}: expected {expected_emission}, decoded {decoded_emission}"
405:             );
406:         }
407:     }
408: }
````

````rust
 39: fn most_compatible_kind(info: &wgpu::AdapterInfo) -> RendererKind {
 40:     let name = info.name.to_ascii_lowercase();
 41:     let software = matches!(info.device_type, wgpu::DeviceType::Cpu)
 42:         || name.contains("swiftshader")
 43:         || name.contains("llvmpipe")
 44:         || name.contains("lavapipe");
 45:     if software {
 46:         RendererKind::Cpu
 47:     } else {
 48:         RendererKind::Surface
 49:     }
 50: }

 56:     pub async fn new_auto(
 57:         canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
 58:         requested: Option<RendererKind>,
 59:         quality: crate::drivers::webgpu::config::GpuQualityProfile,
 60:     ) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 61:         let context = BrowserGpuContext::new(canvas).await?;
 62:         let kind = match requested {
 63:             Some(kind) => kind,
 64:             None => {
 65:                 let kind = most_compatible_kind(&context.adapter_info);
 66:                 if kind != RendererKind::Surface {
 67:                     web_sys::console::info_1(
 68:                         &format!(

 70:                             kind.label(),

 72:                         )
 73:                         .into(),
 74:                     );
 75:                 }
 76:                 kind
 77:             }
 78:         };
 79:         Self::from_context(context, kind.profile(quality))
 80:     }

 82:     pub async fn new(

 87:         Self::from_context(context, profile)

 89: 
 90:     fn from_context(context: BrowserGpuContext, profile: RendererProfile) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 91:         let frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&context.device);
 92:         let strategy = match profile {
 93:             RendererProfile::Surface(settings) => {
 94:                 Strategy::Surface(SurfacePipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
 95:                     &context.device,
 96:                     context.format(),
 97:                     frame_resources.layout(),
 98:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
 99:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
100:                         settings.shadow_map,
101:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
102:                     ),
103:                 ))
104:             }
105:             RendererProfile::Splat(settings) => {
106:                 Strategy::Splat(SplatPipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
107:                     &context.device,
108:                     context.format(),
109:                     frame_resources.layout(),
110:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
111:                     settings.face_budget,
112:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
113:                         settings.shadow_map,
114:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
115:                     ),
116:                 ))
117:             }
118:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(settings) => {
119:                 let mut pipeline = RaymarchPipeline::new(
120:                     &context.device,
121:                     context.format(),
122:                     frame_resources.layout(),
123:                     settings.maximum_resident_chunks as usize,
124:                 );
125:                 pipeline.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(
126:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
127:                     settings.optimizations.direct_light_visibility,
128:                     settings.area_light_visibility_samples,
129:                 ));
130:                 Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline)
131:             }
132:             RendererProfile::Cpu(_) => Strategy::Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline::new(
133:                 &context.device,
134:                 context.format(),
135:                 context.width(),
136:                 context.height(),
137:             )),
138:         };
139:         let supply_labels =
140:             SupplyLabelPipeline::new(&context.device, context.format(), frame_resources.layout());
141:         let (depth_texture, depth_view) =
142:             create_depth_target(&context.device, context.width(), context.height());
143:         web_sys::console::info_1(
144:             &format!(
145:                 "WebGPU adapter: {} ({:?})",
146:                 context.adapter_info.name, context.adapter_info.backend
147:             )
148:             .into(),
149:         );
150:         Ok(Self {
151:             context,
152:             frame_resources,
153:             strategy,
154:             supply_labels,
155:             profile,
156:             depth_texture,
157:             depth_view,
158:         })
159:     }
160: 
161:     pub fn kind(&self) -> RendererKind {
162:         self.profile.renderer()
163:     }
164: 
165:     pub fn label(&self) -> &'static str {
166:         self.kind().label()
167:     }
168: 
169:     pub fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
170:         self.context.resize(width, height);
171:         if let Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) = &mut self.strategy {
172:             pipeline.resize(&self.context.device, width, height);
173:         }
174:         (self.depth_texture, self.depth_view) =
175:             create_depth_target(&self.context.device, width.max(1), height.max(1));
176:     }
177: 
178:     pub fn resolution_factor(&self) -> f64 {
179:         match self.profile.initial_gpu_render_scale() {
180:             Some(scale) => f64::from(scale),
181:             None => crate::get_cpu_settings().canvas_resolution_factor(),
182:         }
183:     }
184: 
185:     fn trace_budget(&self) -> u32 {
186:         match self.profile {
187:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(profile) => profile.maximum_trace_steps,
188:             _ => 1,
189:         }
190:     }
191: 
192:     fn render(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
193:         if self.context.is_device_lost() {
194:             return;
195:         }
196:         let lights = collect_frame_lights(frame);
197:         let toggles = self
198:             .profile
199:             .apply_runtime_toggles(crate::get_render_toggles());
200:         let common = self.profile.common();
201:         let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
202:             frame,
203:             self.context.width(),
204:             self.context.height(),
205:             super::camera_state::fov_tan(),
206:             common.maximum_draw_distance,
207:             self.trace_budget(),
208:             lights.len(),
209:             toggles,
210:         );
211:         self.frame_resources.write(
212:             &self.context.device,
213:             &self.context.queue,
214:             &uniforms,
215:             &lights,
216:         );
217: 
218:         let (surface_texture, should_reconfigure) = match self.context.current_texture() {
219:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture) => (texture, false),
220:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => (texture, true),
221:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost => {
222:                 self.context.reconfigure();
223:                 match self.context.current_texture() {
224:                     wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture) => (texture, false),
225:                     wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => (texture, true),
226:                     _ => return,
227:                 }
228:             }
229:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Timeout | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Occluded => return,
230:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Validation => {
231:                 web_sys::console::error_1(&"WebGPU surface validation error".into());
232:                 return;
233:             }
234:         };
235:         let view = surface_texture.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
236:         let mut encoder =
237:             self.context
238:                 .device
239:                 .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
240:                     label: Some("vackrooms.webgpu.frame"),
241:                 });
242:         match &mut self.strategy {
243:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
244:                 &self.context.queue,
245:                 &mut encoder,
246:                 &view,
247:                 &self.depth_view,
248:                 &self.frame_resources,
249:                 frame,
250:                 toggles,
251:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
252:             ),
253:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
254:                 &self.context.queue,
255:                 &mut encoder,
256:                 &view,
257:                 &self.depth_view,
258:                 &self.frame_resources,
259:                 frame,
260:                 toggles,
261:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
262:             ),
263:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
264:                 &self.context.queue,
265:                 &mut encoder,
266:                 &view,
267:                 &self.frame_resources,
268:                 frame,
269:                 chunks,
270:                 toggles,
271:             ),
272:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => {
273:                 let mut settings = crate::get_cpu_settings();
274:                 settings.fov_tan = super::camera_state::fov_tan();
275:                 settings.toggles = toggles;
276:                 pipeline.draw(
277:                     &self.context.queue,
278:                     &mut encoder,
279:                     &view,
280:                     frame,
281:                     chunks,
282:                     settings,
283:                 );
284:             }
285:         }
286:         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
287:             self.supply_labels.draw(
288:                 &self.context.queue,
289:                 &mut encoder,
290:                 &view,
291:                 &self.depth_view,
292:                 &self.frame_resources,
293:                 frame,
294:             );
295:         }
296:         self.context.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
297:         self.context.queue.present(surface_texture);
298:         if should_reconfigure {
299:             self.context.reconfigure();
300:         }
301:     }
302: }
303: 
304: impl RendererPort for WebGpuRenderer {
305:     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
306:         self.profile.artifact_needs()
307:     }
308: 
309:     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
310:         self.profile.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
311:     }
312: 
313:     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
314:         match &mut self.strategy {
315:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&self.context.device, chunks),
316:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&self.context.device, chunks),
317:             _ => {}
318:         }
319:     }
320: 
321:     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
322:         match &mut self.strategy {
323:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
324:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
325:             _ => {}
326:         }
327:     }
328: 
329:     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
330:         match &mut self.strategy {
331:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
332:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
333:             _ => {}
334:         }
335:     }
336: 
337:     fn cpu_telemetry_string(&self) -> Option<String> {
338:         match &self.strategy {
339:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => Some(pipeline.telemetry_string()),
340:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => {
341:                 let stats = pipeline.stats();
342:                 Some(format!(
343:                     "WebGPU splat F:{}/-{} C:{} D:{}",
344:                     stats.faces_drawn, stats.faces_dropped, stats.cells_culled, stats.draw_calls
345:                 ))
346:             }
347:             _ => None,
348:         }
349:     }
350: 
351:     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
352:         match &mut self.strategy {
353:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(&self.context.device, texels),
354:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(texels),
355:             _ => {}
356:         }
357:     }
358: 
359:     fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
360:         match &mut self.strategy {
361:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => {
362:                 pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(&self.context.queue, first_row, texels)
363:             }
364:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, texels),
365:             _ => false,
366:         }
367:     }
368: 
369:     fn upload_label_atlas(&mut self, rgba: &[u8], width: u32, height: u32) {
370:         self.supply_labels.upload_atlas(
371:             &self.context.device,
372:             &self.context.queue,
373:             rgba,
374:             width,
375:             height,
376:         );
377:     }
378: 
379:     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
380:         self.render(frame, chunks);
381:     }
382: }
383: 
384: fn create_depth_target(
385:     device: &wgpu::Device,
386:     width: u32,
387:     height: u32,
388: ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
389:     let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
390:         label: Some("webgpu.main-depth"),
391:         size: wgpu::Extent3d {
392:             width: width.max(1),
393:             height: height.max(1),
394:             depth_or_array_layers: 1,
395:         },
396:         mip_level_count: 1,
397:         sample_count: 1,
398:         dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
399:         format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
400:         usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
401:         view_formats: &[],
402:     });
403:     let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
404:     (texture, view)
405: }
````

````rust
106: fn material_emission_contract_wgsl() -> String {
107:     let mut source = String::from(
108:         "\n// Generated from voxel_grid::material_emission_strength.\n\
109:          fn authored_emission_strength(material: u32) -> f32 {\n\
110:              switch material {\n",
111:     );
112:     for material in 0..VOXEL_MATERIAL_COUNT {
113:         let material = material as u8;
114:         let Some(strength) = material_emission_strength(material) else {
115:             continue;
116:         };
117:         writeln!(
118:             source,
119:             "        case {material}u: {{ return {strength:.6}; }}"
120:         )
121:         .expect("writing WGSL to a String cannot fail");
122:     }
123:     source.push_str(
124:         "        default: { return 0.0; }\n\
125:              }\n\
126:          }\n",
127:     );
128:     source
129: }
````

````rust
116:             DriverRenderer::Splat(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
117:             DriverRenderer::WebGpu(r) => r.upload_surfaces(chunks),
118:             _ => {}
119:         }
120:     }

187: /// Complete backing-store scale after the global governor/override and the
188: /// selected renderer's own bounded workload factor are composed.
189: fn effective_resolution_scale(renderer: &DriverRenderer, governor_scale: f32) -> f64 {
190:     let forced =
191:         f32::from_bits(crate::RENDER_SCALE_BITS.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed));
192:     let global_scale = if forced > 0.0 {
193:         forced as f64
194:     } else {
195:         governor_scale as f64
196:     };
197:     global_scale * renderer.resolution_factor()
198: }

239: /// The embedded product-label atlas: row 0 almond water, row 1 rations.
240: /// The rations row stays transparent until a rations logo lands in
241: /// `wasm_frontend/assets/` and gets blitted here.
242: fn build_label_atlas() -> Option<(Vec<u8>, u32, u32)> {
243:     const ALMOND_LABEL_PNG: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../assets/almond_water_label.png");
244:     let label = image::load_from_memory(ALMOND_LABEL_PNG).ok()?.to_rgba8();
245:     let (width, row_height) = label.dimensions();
246:     let mut atlas = vec![0u8; (width * row_height * 2 * 4) as usize];
247:     atlas[..(width * row_height * 4) as usize].copy_from_slice(label.as_raw());
248:     Some((atlas, width, row_height * 2))
249: }

251: /// Saved backend preference, written by the Settings menu. Query params
252: /// always win so shared links stay exact reproductions.
253: fn stored_backend_pref(window: &Window) -> Option<String> {
254:     window
255:         .local_storage()
256:         .ok()
257:         .flatten()
258:         .and_then(|storage| storage.get_item("vackrooms_backend").ok())
259:         .flatten()
260: }
261: 
262: /// Backend, then renderer, selection.
263: ///
264: /// Backend: `?backend=webgl|webgpu` > saved preference > WebGL2. WebGL2 is
265: /// the compatibility floor (Firefox ESR, mobile); WebGPU stays an explicit
266: /// opt-in. Renderer within the backend: `?renderer=` (surface, splat,
267: /// raymarch, cpu), defaulting to surfaces — on WebGPU without an explicit
268: /// choice, the adapter's own compatibility decides (software adapters get
269: 
270: async fn create_renderer(
271:     window: &Window,
272:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
273:     status_msg: &HtmlElement,
274:     query: &str,
275:     quality: GpuQualityProfile,
276: ) -> Result<DriverRenderer, JsValue> {
277:     let backend = query_param(query, "backend")
278:         .map(str::to_owned)
279:         .or_else(|| stored_backend_pref(window))
280:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "webgl".to_owned());
281:     if backend == "webgpu" {
282:         webgpu_preflight(window, status_msg).await?;
283:         let requested = query_param(query, "renderer").and_then(RendererKind::parse);
284:         return WebGpuRenderer::new_auto(canvas, requested, quality)
285:             .await
286:             .map(DriverRenderer::WebGpu);
287:     }
288: 
289:     let renderer_choice = query_param(query, "renderer");
290:     if renderer_choice == Some("cpu") {
291:         return Ok(DriverRenderer::Cpu(CpuCanvasRenderer::new(canvas)?));
292:     }
293:     if renderer_choice == Some("raymarch") {
294:         return WebGl2Renderer::new(canvas).map(DriverRenderer::Raymarch);
295:     }
296:     if renderer_choice == Some("splat") {
297:         let profile = if quality == GpuQualityProfile::High {
298:             SplatProfile::high()
299:         } else {
300:             SplatProfile::low()
301:         };
302:         match SplatRenderer::new(canvas, profile) {
303:             Ok(gpu) => return Ok(DriverRenderer::Splat(gpu)),
304:             Err(err) => {
305:                 web_sys::console::warn_2(
306:                     &JsValue::from_str(
307:                         "splat renderer unavailable, falling back to surface meshes:",
308:                     ),
309:                     &err,
310:                 );
311:             }
312:         }
313:     }
314:     match SurfaceRenderer::new(canvas) {
315:         Ok(gpu) => Ok(DriverRenderer::Surface(gpu)),
316:         Err(err) => {
317:             web_sys::console::warn_2(
318:                 &JsValue::from_str(
319:                     "WebGL2 surface renderer unavailable, falling back to CPU splatting:",
320:                 ),
321:                 &err,
322:             );
323:             Ok(DriverRenderer::Cpu(CpuCanvasRenderer::new(canvas)?))
324:         }
325:     }
326: }

333: async fn webgpu_preflight(window: &Window, status_msg: &HtmlElement) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
334:     let gpu = js_sys::Reflect::get(&window.navigator(), &JsValue::from_str("gpu"))
335:         .unwrap_or(JsValue::UNDEFINED);
336:     if gpu.is_undefined() || gpu.is_null() {
337: 
338: 
339: 
340:         let msg = if !window.is_secure_context() {
341:             "WebGPU requires a secure context and this page was loaded over \
342:              plain HTTP. Serve it via https or localhost, or switch the \
343:              backend setting back to WebGL2."
344:         } else {
345:             "WebGPU is not available in this browser (navigator.gpu is missing). \
346:              Use Chrome/Edge 113+ or Safari 18+, or switch the backend \
347:              setting back to WebGL2."
348:         };
349:         status_msg.set_text_content(Some(msg));
350:         return Err(JsValue::from_str(msg));
351:     }
352:     if !probe_webgpu_adapter(&gpu).await {
353:         let msg = "This device exposes WebGPU but reports no usable graphics \
354:                    adapter. Check hardware acceleration (chrome://gpu), or \
355:                    switch the backend setting back to WebGL2.";
356:         status_msg.set_text_content(Some(msg));
357:         return Err(JsValue::from_str(msg));
358:     }
359:     Ok(())
360: }
361:

363:

365: 
366: async fn probe_webgpu_adapter(gpu: &JsValue) -> bool {
367:     let request = match js_sys::Reflect::get(gpu, &JsValue::from_str("requestAdapter"))
368:         .ok()
369:         .and_then(|value| value.dyn_into::<js_sys::Function>().ok())
370:     {
371:         Some(function) => function,
372:         None => return false,
373:     };
374:     let promise = match request
375:         .call0(gpu)
376:         .ok()
377:         .and_then(|value| value.dyn_into::<js_sys::Promise>().ok())
378:     {
379:         Some(promise) => promise,
380:         None => return false,
381:     };
382:     match wasm_bindgen_futures::JsFuture::from(promise).await {
383:         Ok(adapter) => !adapter.is_null() && !adapter.is_undefined(),
384:         Err(_) => false,
385:     }
386: }
````
