388: pub async fn boot() -> Result<(), JsValue> {
389:     let window = web_sys::window().ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("no window"))?;
390:     let document = window
391:         .document()
392:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("no document"))?;
393: 
394:     let canvas: HtmlCanvasElement =
395:         element(&document, "view").or_else(|_| element(&document, "game-canvas"))?;
396:     let overlay: HtmlElement = element(&document, "overlay")?;
397:     let status_msg: HtmlElement = element(&document, "status-msg")?;
398:     let play_msg: HtmlElement = element(&document, "play-msg")?;
399: 
400: 
401: 
402: 
403: 
404:     let query = window.location().search().unwrap_or_default();
405:     web_sys::console::log_1(&format!("BOOTING ENGINE: query={}", query).into());
406: 
407: 
408:     crate::init_render_toggles(&query);
409: 
410: 
411: 
412:     let quality = quality_profile_from_query(&query);
413:     let (resolved_seed, generator_config) =
414:         generator_setup_for_quality(&query, WORLD_SEED, quality);
415:     let high_spec = quality == GpuQualityProfile::High;
416: 
417: 
418: 
419:     let spawn_at = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point(resolved_seed);
420:     let spawn = [spawn_at.x, 1.7, spawn_at.z];
421: 
422:     let spawn_yaw = -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
423: 
424: 
425:     let initial_level = query_param(&query, "level")
426:         .and_then(|v| v.parse::<u32>().ok())
427:         .unwrap_or(0);
428:     let engine_config = if high_spec {
429:         EngineConfig {
430:             chunk_size: generator_config.chunk_size,
431:             chunk_radius: 2,
432:             seed: resolved_seed,
433:             spawn,
434:             spawn_yaw,
435: 
436: 
437:             fine_distance: 25.0,
438:             initial_level,
439:             ..EngineConfig::default()
440:         }
441:     } else {
442:         EngineConfig {
443:             chunk_size: generator_config.chunk_size,
444:             seed: resolved_seed,
445:             spawn,
446:             spawn_yaw,
447:             initial_level,
448:             ..EngineConfig::default()
449:         }
450:     };
451: 
452:     let renderer = Rc::new(RefCell::new(
453:         create_renderer(&window, &canvas, &status_msg, &query, quality).await?,
454:     ));
455:     if let Some((label_rgba, label_w, label_h)) = build_label_atlas() {
456:         renderer
457:             .borrow_mut()
458:             .upload_label_atlas(&label_rgba, label_w, label_h);
459:     }
460:     if let Ok(hud_renderer) = element::<HtmlElement>(&document, "hud-renderer") {
461:         hud_renderer.set_text_content(Some(renderer.borrow().label()));
462:     }
463: 
464: 
465:     let locator = Rc::new(RefCell::new(SectionLocator::new(
466:         resolved_seed,
467:         generator_config,
468:     )));
469: 
470: 
471: 
472: 
473:     let worker_preference = parse_generation_worker_preference(&query);
474:     let hardware_concurrency = window.navigator().hardware_concurrency();
475:     let generation_worker_count = worker_preference.resolve(hardware_concurrency);
476:     let source: Box<dyn crate::application::ports::ChunkSourcePort> =
477:         if generation_worker_count == 0 {
478:             web_sys::console::log_1(&"chunk generation: synchronous main thread".into());
479:             Box::new(LocalChunkSource::with_telemetry(
480:                 SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
481:                 resolved_seed,
482:                 generator_config,
483:                 &CONSOLE_TELEMETRY,
484:             ))
485:         } else {
486:             match crate::drivers::worker_source::WorkerChunkSource::new(
487:                 &query,
488:                 WORLD_SEED,
489:                 generation_worker_count,
490:             ) {
491:                 Ok(pool) => {
492:                     web_sys::console::log_1(
493:                         &format!("chunk generation: {} worker threads", pool.pool_size()).into(),
494:                     );
495:                     Box::new(pool)
496:                 }
497:                 Err(err) => {
498:                     web_sys::console::warn_2(
499:                         &JsValue::from_str(
500:                             "worker pool unavailable, falling back to in-thread generation:",
501:                         ),
502:                         &err,
503:                     );
504:                     Box::new(LocalChunkSource::with_telemetry(
505:                         SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
506:                         resolved_seed,
507:                         generator_config,
508:                         &CONSOLE_TELEMETRY,
509:                     ))
510:                 }
511:             }
512:         };
513:     let engine = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Engine::new(
514:         engine_config,
515:         Box::new(SharedRenderer(renderer.clone())),
516:         source,
517:     )));
518:     let input = Rc::new(RefCell::new(InputCollector::new()));
519:     let touch = Rc::new(RefCell::new(TouchState::default()));
520: 
521:     attach_input_listeners(&document, &canvas, &overlay, &input, &touch)?;
522:     attach_touch_listeners(&document, &canvas, &overlay, &input, &touch)?;
523:     run_frame_loop(
524:         window, document, canvas, overlay, status_msg, play_msg, renderer, engine, input, locator,
525:     )
526: }

530: fn diagnostic_sections_html(report: &str) -> String {
531:     fn escape(text: &str) -> String {
532:         text.replace('&', "&amp;")
533:             .replace('<', "&lt;")
534:             .replace('>', "&gt;")
535:     }
536:     let mut html = String::with_capacity(report.len() + 256);
537:     let mut open = false;
538:     for line in report.lines() {
539:         if let Some(title) = line.strip_prefix("§ ") {
540:             if open {
541:                 html.push_str("</pre></section>");
542:             }
543:             html.push_str("<section class=\"diag-section\"><h4>");
544:             html.push_str(&escape(title));
545:             html.push_str("</h4><pre>");
546:             open = true;
547:         } else if open {
548:             html.push_str(&escape(line));
549:             html.push('\n');
550:         } else {
551: 
552:             html.push_str("<section class=\"diag-section\"><pre>");
553:             html.push_str(&escape(line));
554:             html.push('\n');
555:             open = true;
556:         }
557:     }
558:     if open {
559:         html.push_str("</pre></section>");
560:     }
561:     html
562: }

564: fn element<T: JsCast>(document: &Document, id: &str) -> Result<T, JsValue> {
565:     document
566:         .get_element_by_id(id)
567:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str(&format!("missing #{id} element")))?
568:         .dyn_into::<T>()
569:         .map_err(|_| JsValue::from_str(&format!("#{id} has unexpected element type")))
570: }

572: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
573: fn run_frame_loop(
574:     window: Window,
575:     _document: Document,
576:     canvas: HtmlCanvasElement,
577:     _overlay: HtmlElement,
578:     status_msg: HtmlElement,
579:     play_msg: HtmlElement,
580:     renderer: Rc<RefCell<DriverRenderer>>,
581:     engine: Rc<RefCell<Engine>>,
582:     input: Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
583:     locator: Rc<RefCell<SectionLocator>>,
584: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
585:     let document = window.document().unwrap();
586: 
587: 
588:     let hud_fps: HtmlElement = element(&document, "hud-fps")?;
589:     let hud_chunks: HtmlElement = element(&document, "hud-chunks")?;
590:     let hud_nodes: HtmlElement = element(&document, "hud-nodes")?;
591:     let hud_scale: HtmlElement = element(&document, "hud-scale")?;
592:     let hud_gpu: HtmlElement = element(&document, "hud-gpu")?;
593: 
594: 
595:     let hud_section: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "hud-section").ok();
596:     let last_section_text = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
597:     let debug_overlay: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "debug-overlay").ok();
598: 
599: 
600: 
601:     let diagnostics_shell: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "diagnostics").ok();
602:     let debug_overlay_visible = Rc::new(Cell::new(false));
603: 
604: 
605: 
606: 
607:     let body_trace: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "body-trace").ok();
608:     let hud_bpm: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "hud-bpm").ok();
609:     let hud_steps: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "hud-steps").ok();
610:     let supply_water: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "supply-water").ok();
611:     let supply_ration: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "supply-ration").ok();
612:     let last_steps = Rc::new(Cell::new(u64::MAX));
613:     let last_bpm_text = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
614:     let last_signal = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
615:     let last_beat_period_ms = Rc::new(Cell::new(0i32));
616:     let last_supplies = Rc::new(Cell::new((u32::MAX, u32::MAX)));
617: 
618: 
619:     let route_anchor: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "route-anchor").ok();
620:     let route_target_el: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "route-target").ok();
621:     let route_bearing_el: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "route-bearing").ok();
622:     let route_range_el: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "route-range").ok();
623:     let route_visible = Rc::new(Cell::new(false));
624:     let last_route_text = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
625: 
626:     let death_overlay: Option<HtmlElement> = element(&document, "death-overlay").ok();
627:     let last_deaths = Rc::new(Cell::new(0u32));
628:     let death_shown_at = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0f64));
629: 
630:     let last_time = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0f64));
631:     let frame_count = Rc::new(Cell::new(0u32));
632:     let hud_window_start = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0f64));
633:     let was_ready = Rc::new(Cell::new(false));
634: 
635: 
636:     let raf_handle: Rc<RefCell<Option<Closure<dyn FnMut(f64)>>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(None));
637:     let raf_handle_clone = raf_handle.clone();
638: 
639:     let loop_window = window.clone();
640:     *raf_handle.borrow_mut() = Some(Closure::new(move |time_ms: f64| {
641:         let dt = if last_time.get() > 0.0 {
642:             ((time_ms - last_time.get()) / 1000.0) as f32
643:         } else {
644:             1.0 / 60.0
645:         };
646:         last_time.set(time_ms);
647: 
648: 
649: 
650: 
651:         {
652:             let scale = effective_resolution_scale(
653:                 &renderer.borrow(),
654:                 engine.borrow().stats().resolution_scale,
655:             );
656:             let target_w = (loop_window
657:                 .inner_width()
658:                 .ok()
659:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
660:                 .unwrap_or(800.0)
661:                 * scale)
662:                 .max(1.0) as u32;
663:             let target_h = (loop_window
664:                 .inner_height()
665:                 .ok()
666:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
667:                 .unwrap_or(600.0)
668:                 * scale)
669:                 .max(1.0) as u32;
670: 
671:             if canvas.width() != target_w || canvas.height() != target_h {
672:                 canvas.set_width(target_w);
673:                 canvas.set_height(target_h);
674:                 renderer.borrow_mut().resize(target_w, target_h);
675:             }
676:         }
677: 
678:         let frame_input = input.borrow_mut().take_frame();
679:         engine.borrow_mut().tick(dt, &frame_input);
680: 
681: 
682:         let stats = engine.borrow().stats();
683:         if stats.ready && !was_ready.get() {
684:             was_ready.set(true);
685:             let _ = status_msg.style().set_property("display", "none");
686:             let _ = play_msg.style().set_property("display", "block");
687:         }
688: 
689: 
690:         frame_count.set(frame_count.get() + 1);
691:         if frame_count.get() % HUD_INTERVAL == 0 {
692:             let elapsed = (time_ms - hud_window_start.get()) / 1000.0;

712:                 hud_gpu.set_text_content(Some(renderer.borrow().backend_label()));

716:

721:                     (engine_ref.level(), engine_ref.player().position)

723:                 let text = locator.borrow_mut().describe(level, pos[0], pos[2]);

727:                     *last = text;

733:             engine.borrow_mut().set_assisted_consumption(

744:                     crate::application::body::PulseSignal::Active => "active",

748:                 if *last_signal.borrow() != signal {

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/fs_artifact_sink.rs
````rust
 1: use crate::application::ports::{POSITION_FIXED_SCALE, SurfaceChunk};
 2: use crate::reference::artifact_sink::ArtifactSinkPort;
 3: use crate::reference::renderer::RenderedImage;
 4: use std::fs;
 5: use std::io::Write;
 6: use std::path::Path;
 7: 
 8: pub struct FsArtifactSink;
 9: 
10: impl ArtifactSinkPort for FsArtifactSink {
11:     fn write_png(&self, path: &Path, image: &RenderedImage) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
12: 
13:         image::save_buffer(
14:             path,
15:             &image.rgba,
16:             image.width,
17:             image.height,
18:             image::ExtendedColorType::Rgba8,
19:         )
20:         .map_err(|error| std::io::Error::other(error.to_string()))
21:     }
22: 
23:     fn write_obj(&self, path: &Path, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> {
24:         let mut file = fs::File::create(path)?;
25: 
26:         writeln!(file, "o backrooms_scene")?;
27: 
28:         let mut vertex_offset = 1;
29: 
30:         for chunk in chunks {
31:             writeln!(file, "g chunk_{}_{}", chunk.key.0, chunk.key.1)?;
32: 
33:             for v in &chunk.mesh.vertices {
34:                 let px = (v.position[0] as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE) + chunk.origin[0];
35:                 let py = (v.position[1] as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE) + chunk.origin[1];
36:                 let pz = (v.position[2] as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE) + chunk.origin[2];
37:                 writeln!(file, "v {:.6} {:.6} {:.6}", px, py, pz)?;
38:             }
39: 
40:             let mut i = 0;
41:             while i + 2 < chunk.mesh.indices.len() {
42:                 let i1 = (chunk.mesh.indices[i] as usize) + vertex_offset;
43:                 let i2 = (chunk.mesh.indices[i + 1] as usize) + vertex_offset;
44:                 let i3 = (chunk.mesh.indices[i + 2] as usize) + vertex_offset;
45:                 writeln!(file, "f {} {} {}", i1, i2, i3)?;
46:                 i += 3;
47:             }
48: 
49:             vertex_offset += chunk.mesh.vertices.len();
50:         }
51: 
52:         Ok(())
53:     }
54: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/generation_worker_requests.rs
````rust
  1: use std::collections::VecDeque;
  2: 
  3: use crate::application::ports::ChunkRequest;
  4: 
  5: #[derive(Debug)]
  6: struct WorkerRequests {
  7:     accepting_work: bool,
  8:     in_flight: VecDeque<ChunkRequest>,
  9: }
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: #[derive(Debug)]
 14: pub(crate) struct GenerationWorkerRequests {
 15:     workers: Vec<WorkerRequests>,
 16: }
 17: 
 18: impl GenerationWorkerRequests {
 19:     pub(crate) fn new(worker_count: usize) -> Self {
 20:         assert!(
 21:             worker_count > 0,
 22:             "a worker ledger needs at least one worker"
 23:         );
 24:         Self {
 25:             workers: (0..worker_count)
 26:                 .map(|_| WorkerRequests {
 27:                     accepting_work: true,
 28:                     in_flight: VecDeque::new(),
 29:                 })
 30:                 .collect(),
 31:         }
 32:     }
 33: 
 34: 
 35:     pub(crate) fn next_accepting(&self, start: usize) -> Option<usize> {
 36:         (0..self.workers.len())
 37:             .map(|offset| (start + offset) % self.workers.len())
 38:             .find(|&index| self.workers[index].accepting_work)
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     pub(crate) fn assign(&mut self, worker_index: usize, request: ChunkRequest) {
 42:         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
 43:         debug_assert!(worker.accepting_work);
 44:         worker.in_flight.push_back(request);
 45:     }
 46: 
 47: 
 48: 
 49:     pub(crate) fn finish_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> bool {
 50:         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed).is_some()
 51:     }
 52: 
 53: 
 54:     pub(crate) fn fail_exact(
 55:         &mut self,
 56:         worker_index: usize,
 57:         echoed: &ChunkRequest,
 58:     ) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 59:         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed)
 60:     }
 61: 
 62: 
 63: 
 64: 
 65:     pub(crate) fn fail_oldest(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 66:         self.workers[worker_index].in_flight.pop_front()
 67:     }
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71:     pub(crate) fn disable_and_drain(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
 72:         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
 73:         worker.accepting_work = false;
 74:         worker.in_flight.drain(..).collect()
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     fn take_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 78:         let queue = &mut self.workers[worker_index].in_flight;
 79:         let position = queue
 80:             .iter()
 81:             .position(|request| request.is_same_request(echoed))?;
 82:         queue.remove(position)
 83:     }
 84: }
 85: 
 86: #[cfg(test)]
 87: mod tests {
 88:     use super::*;
 89:     use crate::application::ports::RenderArtifactNeeds;
 90:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
 91: 
 92:     fn request(id: u32, x: f32) -> ChunkRequest {
 93:         ChunkRequest {
 94:             request_id: id,
 95:             origin_x: x,
 96:             origin_z: -4.0,
 97:             level: 0,
 98:             lod: 1,
 99:             artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH,
100:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     #[test]
105:     fn scheduling_wraps_and_skips_disabled_workers() {
106:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(3);
107:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(2), Some(2));
108:         requests.disable_and_drain(2);
109:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(2), Some(0));
110:         requests.disable_and_drain(0);
111:         requests.disable_and_drain(1);
112:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(0), None);
113:     }
114: 
115:     #[test]
116:     fn stale_reply_cannot_retire_current_work() {
117:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(1);
118:         let current = request(8, 12.0);
119:         requests.assign(0, current.clone());
120: 
121:         let mut stale = current.clone();
122:         stale.request_id = 7;
123:         assert!(!requests.finish_exact(0, &stale));
124:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(0, &current));
125:     }
126: 
127:     #[test]
128:     fn malformed_reply_fails_only_the_oldest_serial_request() {
129:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(1);
130:         let first = request(1, 0.0);
131:         let second = request(2, 16.0);
132:         requests.assign(0, first.clone());
133:         requests.assign(0, second.clone());
134: 
135:         assert_eq!(requests.fail_oldest(0), Some(first));
136:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(0, &second));
137:     }
138: 
139:     #[test]
140:     fn worker_failure_drains_its_work_without_affecting_other_workers() {
141:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(2);
142:         let first = request(1, 0.0);
143:         let second = request(2, 16.0);
144:         requests.assign(0, first.clone());
145:         requests.assign(1, second.clone());
146: 
147:         assert_eq!(requests.disable_and_drain(0), vec![first]);
148:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(0), Some(1));
149:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(1, &second));
150:         assert!(requests.disable_and_drain(0).is_empty());
151:     }
152: 
153:     #[test]
154:     fn explicit_failure_requires_the_exact_request_identity() {
155:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(1);
156:         let current = request(5, 0.0);
157:         requests.assign(0, current.clone());
158:         let mut wrong_identity = current.clone();
159:         wrong_identity.lod = 0;
160: 
161:         assert!(requests.fail_exact(0, &wrong_identity).is_none());
162:         assert_eq!(requests.fail_exact(0, &current), Some(current));
163:     }
164: 
165:     #[test]
166:     fn renderer_artifacts_are_part_of_worker_request_identity() {
167:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(1);
168:         let current = request(6, 0.0);

170: 
171:         let mut wrong_artifacts = current.clone();

173: 
174:         assert!(!requests.finish_exact(0, &wrong_artifacts));
175:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(0, &current));
176:     }
177: }

 20: fn raymarch_pixel(
 21:     cam: &Camera,
 22:     env: &Environment,
 23:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
 24:     atlas: &[u32],
 25:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 26:     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
 27:     ro: [f32; 3],
 28:     rd: [f32; 3],
 29: ) -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
 30:     let safe = |v: f32| {
 31:         if v.abs() < 1e-4 {
 32:             1e-4f32.copysign(v)
 33:         } else {
 34:             v
 35:         }
 36:     };
 37:     let rd = [safe(rd[0]), safe(rd[1]), safe(rd[2])];
 38:     let inv = [1.0 / rd[0], 1.0 / rd[1], 1.0 / rd[2]];
 39: 
 40:     let mut hits: Vec<(usize, f32)> = Vec::new();
 41:     for (i, d) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
 42:         let lro = [
 43:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
 44:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
 45:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
 46:         ];
 47:         let mut t_entry = f32::MIN;
 48:         let mut t_exit = f32::MAX;
 49:         for a in 0..3 {
 50:             let t1 = (0.0 - lro[a]) * inv[a];
 51:             let t2 = (d.world_size - lro[a]) * inv[a];
 52:             t_entry = t_entry.max(t1.min(t2));
 53:             t_exit = t_exit.min(t1.max(t2));
 54:         }
 55:         if t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0 {
 56:             hits.push((i, t_entry.max(0.0)));
 57:         }
 58:     }
 59:     hits.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
 60: 
 61:     for (i, t_min) in hits {
 62:         let d = &chunks[i];
 63:         let lro = [
 64:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
 65:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
 66:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
 67:         ];
 68:         if let Some((t, bmin, bmax, _vt, hit_leaf_node_idx)) =
 69:             raymarch_svo(atlas, lro, rd, d.root_index as usize, t_min, d.world_size)
 70:         {
 71:             let decoded = decode_node(atlas, hit_leaf_node_idx)?;
 72: 
 73:             let center = [
 74:                 (bmin[0] + bmax[0]) * 0.5 + d.origin[0],
 75:                 (bmin[1] + bmax[1]) * 0.5 + d.origin[1],
 76:                 (bmin[2] + bmax[2]) * 0.5 + d.origin[2],
 77:             ];
 78:             let world_size = bmax[0] - bmin[0];
 79: 
 80:             let surface = SplatSurface {
 81:                 center,
 82:                 world_size,
 83:                 dist: t,
 84:                 base_color: decoded.color,
 85:                 baked_irradiance: decoded.baked_rgb.map(f32::from),
 86:                 voxel_type: decoded.voxel_type,
 87:                 is_emissive: is_emissive(decoded.voxel_type),
 88: 
 89: 
 90: 
 91: 
 92: 
 93:                 exposure: decoded.exposure,
 94:                 crowded_siblings: 1,
 95:             };
 96: 
 97:             let rgb = shade_with_frame_lighting(
 98:                 cam,
 99:                 env,
100:                 settings,
101:                 atlas,
102:                 chunks,
103:                 FrameLighting::unshadowed(scene_lights),
104:                 &surface,
105:             );
106:             return Some(rgb);
107:         }
108:     }
109:     None
110: }
111: 
112: fn raymarch_svo(
113:     atlas: &[u32],
114:     ro: [f32; 3],
115:     rd: [f32; 3],
116:     chunk_root_idx: usize,
117:     t_entry: f32,
118:     world_size: f32,
119: ) -> Option<(f32, [f32; 3], [f32; 3], u32, usize)> {
120:     let mut t = t_entry;
121:     let mut p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
122: 
123:     let mut stack: Vec<(usize, [f32; 3], [f32; 3])> = Vec::new();
124:     let mut current_node = chunk_root_idx;
125:     let mut cmin = [0.0f32; 3];
126:     let mut cmax = [world_size; 3];
127: 
128:     for _ in 0..160 {
129:         if current_node * 4 + 2 >= atlas.len() {
130:             return None;
131:         }
132:         let tx = current_node * 4;
133:         let (is_leaf, a, b) = (atlas[tx] == 1, atlas[tx + 1], atlas[tx + 2]);
134: 
135:         if is_leaf {
136:             if a != 0 {
137:                 return Some((t, cmin, cmax, a, current_node));
138:             }
139:             let exit = |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
140:             let tx = exit(cmin[0], cmax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
141:             let ty = exit(cmin[1], cmax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
142:             let tz = exit(cmin[2], cmax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
143:             let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
144:             t = t_exit;
145:             p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
146:             if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
147:                 p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { cmax[0] } else { cmin[0] })
148:                     + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
149:             }
150:             if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
151:                 p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { cmax[1] } else { cmin[1] })
152:                     + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
153:             }
154:             if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
155:                 p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { cmax[2] } else { cmin[2] })
156:                     + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
157:             }
158:             while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
159:                 let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
160:                 current_node = f.0;
161:                 cmin = f.1;
162:                 cmax = f.2;
163:             }
164:         } else {
165:             let center = [
166:                 (cmin[0] + cmax[0]) * 0.5,
167:                 (cmin[1] + cmax[1]) * 0.5,
168:                 (cmin[2] + cmax[2]) * 0.5,
169:             ];
170:             let ox = (p[0] >= center[0]) as usize;
171:             let oy = (p[1] >= center[1]) as usize;
172:             let oz = (p[2] >= center[2]) as usize;
173:             let child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
174: 
175:             if b & (1 << child_idx) != 0 {
176:                 if stack.len() < 8 {
177:                     stack.push((current_node, cmin, cmax));
178:                 }
179:                 if ox == 1 {
180:                     cmin[0] = center[0]
181:                 } else {
182:                     cmax[0] = center[0]
183:                 }
184:                 if oy == 1 {
185:                     cmin[1] = center[1]
186:                 } else {
187:                     cmax[1] = center[1]
188:                 }
189:                 if oz == 1 {
190:                     cmin[2] = center[2]
191:                 } else {
192:                     cmax[2] = center[2]
193:                 }
194:                 current_node = a as usize + child_idx;
195:             } else {
196:                 let omin = [
197:                     if ox == 1 { center[0] } else { cmin[0] },
198:                     if oy == 1 { center[1] } else { cmin[1] },
199:                     if oz == 1 { center[2] } else { cmin[2] },
200:                 ];
201:                 let omax = [
202:                     if ox == 1 { cmax[0] } else { center[0] },
203:                     if oy == 1 { cmax[1] } else { center[1] },
204:                     if oz == 1 { cmax[2] } else { center[2] },
205:                 ];
206:                 let exit =
207:                     |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
208:                 let tx = exit(omin[0], omax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
209:                 let ty = exit(omin[1], omax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
210:                 let tz = exit(omin[2], omax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
211:                 let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
212:                 t = t_exit;
213:                 p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
214:                 if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
215:                     p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { omax[0] } else { omin[0] })
216:                         + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
217:                 }
218:                 if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
219:                     p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { omax[1] } else { omin[1] })
220:                         + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
221:                 }
222:                 if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
223:                     p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { omax[2] } else { omin[2] })
224:                         + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
225:                 }
226:                 while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
227:                     let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
228:                     current_node = f.0;
229:                     cmin = f.1;
230:                     cmax = f.2;
231:                 }
232:             }
233:         }
234:     }
235:     None
236: }
237: 
238: fn outside(p: [f32; 3], min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
239:     p[0] < min[0]
240:         || p[0] > max[0]
241:         || p[1] < min[1]
242:         || p[1] > max[1]
243:         || p[2] < min[2]
244:         || p[2] > max[2]
245: }
246: 
247: impl ReferenceRendererPort for RaymarchReferenceRenderer {
248:     fn render(
249:         &mut self,
250:         scene: &RenderSceneSnapshot,
251:         settings: &ReferenceRenderSettings,
252:     ) -> RenderedImage {
253:         let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (settings.width * settings.height * 4) as usize];
254:         let frame_params = settings.frame_params(&scene.scene_lights);
255:         let cpu_settings = settings.effective_cpu_settings();
256:         let background_radiance = if settings.environment.outdoor {
257:             settings.environment.sky_color
258:         } else {
259:             settings.environment.fog_color
260:         };
261:         let clear_color = encode_display_color(background_radiance)
262:             .map(|channel| (channel * 255.0).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8);
263: 
264:         let camera = Camera::new(
265:             &frame_params,
266:             settings.width as usize,
267:             settings.height as usize,
268:             &cpu_settings,
269:         );
270: 
271:         for y in 0..settings.height {
272:             for x in 0..settings.width {
273:                 let relative_x = x as f32 - camera.half_w;
274:                 let relative_y = camera.half_h - y as f32;
275: 
276:                 let dir_camera_space = [
277:                     relative_x / camera.focal_px,
278:                     relative_y / camera.focal_px,
279:                     1.0f32,
280:                 ];
281:                 let length = (dir_camera_space[0].powi(2)
282:                     + dir_camera_space[1].powi(2)
283:                     + dir_camera_space[2].powi(2))
284:                 .sqrt();
285:                 let dir_camera_space_normalized = [
286:                     dir_camera_space[0] / length,
287:                     dir_camera_space[1] / length,
288:                     dir_camera_space[2] / length,
289:                 ];
290: 
291:                 let rd = [
292:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[0]
293:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[0]
294:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[0],
295:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[1]
296:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[1]
297:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[1],
298:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[2]
299:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[2]
300:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[2],
301:                 ];
302: 
303:                 let color = raymarch_pixel(
304:                     &camera,
305:                     &settings.environment,
306:                     &cpu_settings,
307:                     &scene.atlas,
308:                     &scene.chunks,
309:                     &scene.scene_lights,
310:                     settings.camera.position,
311:                     rd,
312:                 )
313:                 .unwrap_or(clear_color);
314: 
315:                 let idx = ((y * settings.width + x) * 4) as usize;
316:                 rgba[idx] = color[0];
317:                 rgba[idx + 1] = color[1];
318:                 rgba[idx + 2] = color[2];
319:                 rgba[idx + 3] = 255;
320:             }
321:         }
322: 
323:         RenderedImage {
324:             width: settings.width,
325:             height: settings.height,
326:             rgba,
327:         }
328:     }
329: }

 36:     pub fn new(query: &str, default_seed: u32, pool_size: usize) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 37:         if !(1..=usize::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)).contains(&pool_size) {
 38:             return Err(JsValue::from_str(
 39:                 "generation worker pool size must be 1..=4",
 40:             ));
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         let completed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<CompletedChunk>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
 44:         let failed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
 45:         let requests = Rc::new(RefCell::new(GenerationWorkerRequests::new(pool_size)));
 46: 
 47: 
 48: 
 49:         let script_url = Reflect::get(&js_sys::global(), &"__VACKROOMS_WORKER_URL__".into())
 50:             .ok()
 51:             .and_then(|value| value.as_string())
 52:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "worker.js".to_string());
 53:         let mut workers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
 54:         let mut message_handlers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
 55:         let mut error_handlers = Vec::with_capacity(pool_size);
 56:         for worker_index in 0..pool_size {
 57:             let options = WorkerOptions::new();
 58:             options.set_type(WorkerType::Module);
 59: 
 60: 
 61: 
 62: 
 63:             let worker = Worker::new_with_options(&script_url, &options)?;
 64: 
 65:             let completed_sink = completed.clone();
 66:             let failed_sink = failed.clone();
 67:             let message_requests = requests.clone();
 68:             let worker_for_fatal_reply = worker.clone();
 69:             let handler = Closure::<dyn FnMut(MessageEvent)>::new(move |event: MessageEvent| {
 70:                 match parse_worker_reply(&event) {
 71:                     WorkerReply::Completed(done) => {
 72:                         if message_requests
 73:                             .borrow_mut()
 74:                             .finish_exact(worker_index, &done.request)
 75:                         {
 76:                             completed_sink.borrow_mut().push(done);
 77:                         }
 78:                     }
 79:                     WorkerReply::Failed(echoed) => {
 80:                         if let Some(failed_request) = message_requests
 81:                             .borrow_mut()
 82:                             .fail_exact(worker_index, &echoed)
 83:                         {
 84:                             failed_sink.borrow_mut().push(failed_request);
 85:                         }
 86:                     }
 87:                     WorkerReply::Fatal => {
 88:                         let abandoned = message_requests
 89:                             .borrow_mut()
 90:                             .disable_and_drain(worker_index);
 91:                         failed_sink.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
 92:                         worker_for_fatal_reply.terminate();
 93:                     }
 94:                     WorkerReply::Malformed => {
 95:                         if let Some(failed_request) =
 96:                             message_requests.borrow_mut().fail_oldest(worker_index)
 97:                         {
 98:                             failed_sink.borrow_mut().push(failed_request);
 99:                         }
100:                     }
101:                 }
102:             });
103:             worker.set_onmessage(Some(handler.as_ref().unchecked_ref()));
104: 
105:             let failed_sink = failed.clone();
106:             let error_requests = requests.clone();
107:             let worker_for_error = worker.clone();
108:             let error_handler = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |_event| {
109:                 let abandoned = error_requests.borrow_mut().disable_and_drain(worker_index);
110:                 failed_sink.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
111:                 worker_for_error.terminate();
112:             });
113:             worker.set_onerror(Some(error_handler.as_ref().unchecked_ref()));
114: 
115:             let init = js_sys::Object::new();
116:             Reflect::set(&init, &"type".into(), &"init".into())?;
117:             Reflect::set(&init, &"query".into(), &query.into())?;
118:             Reflect::set(&init, &"seed".into(), &(default_seed as f64).into())?;
119:             worker.post_message(&init)?;
120: 
121:             workers.push(worker);
122:             message_handlers.push(handler);
123:             error_handlers.push(error_handler);
124:         }
125: 
126:         let (seed, config) =
127:             crate::adapters::query_config::generator_setup_from_query(query, default_seed);
128:         Ok(Self {
129:             workers,
130:             next_worker: 0,
131:             completed,
132:             failed,
133:             requests,
134:             _message_handlers: message_handlers,
135:             _error_handlers: error_handlers,
136:             fallback: LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), seed, config),
137:             reported_emergency_fallback: false,
138:         })
139:     }

220:         set("reality", reality.into());
221:         let worker = &self.workers[worker_index];
222:         self.next_worker = (worker_index + 1) % self.workers.len();
223:         self.requests
224:             .borrow_mut()
225:             .assign(worker_index, request.clone());
226:         if let Err(error) = worker.post_message(&message) {
227: 
228: 
229: 
230:             let abandoned = self.requests.borrow_mut().disable_and_drain(worker_index);
231:             self.failed.borrow_mut().extend(abandoned);
232:             worker.terminate();
233:             web_sys::console::warn_2(
234:                 &"generation worker postMessage failed; disabling worker:".into(),
235:                 &error,
236:             );
237:         }
238:     }
239: 
240:     fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<CompletedChunk> {
241:         std::mem::take(&mut *self.completed.borrow_mut())
242:     }
243: 
244:     fn poll_failed_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
245:         std::mem::take(&mut *self.failed.borrow_mut())
246:     }
247: }
248: 
249: enum WorkerReply {
250:     Completed(CompletedChunk),
251:     Failed(ChunkRequest),
252:     Fatal,
253:     Malformed,
254: }
255: 
256: 
257: 
258: 
259: fn parse_worker_reply(event: &MessageEvent) -> WorkerReply {
260:     let data = event.data();
261:     let message_type = Reflect::get(&data, &"type".into())
262:         .ok()
263:         .and_then(|value| value.as_string());
264:     match message_type.as_deref() {
265:         Some("done") => parse_request(&data)
266:             .and_then(|request| {
267:                 parse_payload(&data).map(|payload| CompletedChunk { request, payload })
268:             })
269:             .map(WorkerReply::Completed)
270:             .unwrap_or(WorkerReply::Malformed),
271:         Some("failed") => parse_request(&data)
272:             .map(WorkerReply::Failed)
273:             .unwrap_or(WorkerReply::Malformed),
274:         Some("fatal") => WorkerReply::Fatal,
275:         _ => WorkerReply::Malformed,
276:     }
277: }
278: 
279: fn parse_request(data: &JsValue) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
280:     let field = |name: &str| Reflect::get(data, &name.into()).ok();
281:     Some(ChunkRequest {
282:         request_id: exact_u32(field("requestId")?)?,
283:         origin_x: finite_f32(field("ox")?)?,
284:         origin_z: finite_f32(field("oz")?)?,
285:         level: exact_u32(field("level")?)?,
286:         lod: u8::try_from(exact_u32(field("lod")?)?).ok()?,
287:         artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::from_bits(
288:             u8::try_from(exact_u32(field("artifacts")?)?).ok()?,
289:         )?,
290:         reality: {
291:             let encoded = field("reality")?;
292:             let words = encoded.dyn_into::<js_sys::Uint32Array>().ok()?.to_vec();
293:             RealitySnapshot::from_words(&words).ok()?
294:         },
295:     })
296: }
297: 
298: fn parse_payload(data: &JsValue) -> Option<ChunkPayload> {
299:     let buffer: ArrayBuffer = Reflect::get(data, &"buf".into()).ok()?.dyn_into().ok()?;
300:     let bytes = Uint8Array::new(&buffer).to_vec();
301:     decode_chunk_payload(&bytes)
302: }
303: 
304: fn exact_u32(value: JsValue) -> Option<u32> {
305:     let number = value.as_f64()?;
306:     (number.is_finite() && number.fract() == 0.0 && (0.0..=f64::from(u32::MAX)).contains(&number))
307:         .then_some(number as u32)
308: }
309: 
310: fn finite_f32(value: JsValue) -> Option<f32> {
311:     let number = value.as_f64()?;
312:     let narrowed = number as f32;
313:     (number.is_finite() && narrowed.is_finite()).then_some(narrowed)
314: }
````

65: fn fill_floor(voxels: &mut VoxelGrid) {
66:     for z in 0..ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS {
67:         for x in 0..ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS {
68:             voxels.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_FLOOR);
69:         }
70:     }
71: }
72: 
73: fn fill_boundary_walls(voxels: &mut VoxelGrid) {
74:     for y in 1..=ROOM_CEILING_Y {
75:         for edge in 0..ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS {
76:             voxels.set(0, y, edge, VOXEL_WALL);
77:             voxels.set(ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS - 1, y, edge, VOXEL_WALL);
78:             voxels.set(edge, y, 0, VOXEL_WALL);
79:             voxels.set(edge, y, ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS - 1, VOXEL_WALL);
80:         }
81:     }
82: }
83: 
84: fn fill_ceiling(voxels: &mut VoxelGrid) {
85:     for z in 1..ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS - 1 {
86:         for x in 1..ROOM_EDGE_VOXELS - 1 {
87:             voxels.set(x, ROOM_CEILING_Y, z, VOXEL_CEILING);
88:         }
89:     }

 5: use vackrooms::adapters::material_palette::DEFAULT_MATERIAL_PALETTE;
 6: use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VoxelGrid;
 7: use vackrooms::use_cases::build_octree::BuildOctreeUseCase;
 8: use vackrooms::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::{VoxelLightingSettings, bake_voxel_lighting};
 9: 
10: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
11: pub struct RenderSceneSnapshot {
12: 
13:     pub atlas: Vec<u32>,
14:     pub chunks: Vec<ChunkDraw>,
15: 
16: 
17: 
18:     pub scene_lights: Vec<LightSource>,
19: }
20: 
21: pub fn build_render_scene(scene: RoomScene) -> RenderSceneSnapshot {
22:     let (mut voxels, voxel_size, origin) = scene.into_parts();
23:     let svo_depth = cube_depth(&voxels);
24:     let world_size = voxels.width() as f32 * voxel_size;
25:     let scene_lights = collect_emissive_lights(&voxels, voxel_size, origin, 0);
26: 
27:     let lighting = VoxelLightingSettings::with_default_range(voxel_size)
28:         .expect("RoomScene guarantees a positive finite voxel size");
29:     bake_voxel_lighting(&mut voxels, lighting);
30: 
31:     let svo = BuildOctreeUseCase::new(&DEFAULT_MATERIAL_PALETTE)
32:         .execute(&voxels, svo_depth, world_size);
33:     let serialized = OctreeGpuSerializer::serialize_to_gpu_data(&svo);
34:     RenderSceneSnapshot {
35:         atlas: serialized.texel_data,
36:         chunks: vec![ChunkDraw {
37:             origin,
38:             root_index: svo.root as i32,
39:             world_size,
40:             voxel_size,
41:             svo_depth: svo_depth as u8,
42:         }],
43:         scene_lights,
44:     }
45: }
46: 
47: fn cube_depth(voxels: &VoxelGrid) -> u32 {
48:     let edge = voxels.width();
49:     assert!(
50:         edge.is_power_of_two(),
51:         "reference room edge must be a power of two"
52:     );
53:     assert_eq!(voxels.height(), edge, "reference room must be cubic");
54:     assert_eq!(voxels.depth(), edge, "reference room must be cubic");
55:     edge.ilog2()
56: }
57: 
58: #[cfg(test)]
59: mod tests {
60:     use super::*;
61:     use crate::application::ports::LightKind;
62: 
63:     #[test]
64:     fn reference_snapshot_keeps_the_analytic_ceiling_fixture() {
65:         let snapshot = build_render_scene(RoomScene::single_ceiling_fixture());
66: 
67:         assert_eq!(snapshot.scene_lights.len(), 1);
68:         let fixture = snapshot.scene_lights[0];
69:         assert!(fixture.enabled);
70:         assert_eq!(fixture.kind, LightKind::CeilingPanel);
71:         assert!(fixture.intensity > 0.0);
72:         assert!(fixture.radius > 0.0);
73:     }
74: }

 219:     let shadow_mode = CPU_SHADOWS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
 220: 
 221:     crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings {
 222:         internal_scale: scale,
 223:         lod_cutoff_px: lod_cutoff,
 224:         max_splat_radius_px: max_splat_radius,
 225:         max_virtual_depth,
 226:         min_mip_occupancy,
 227:         max_draw_distance: max_draw_dist,
 228:         shadows: crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuShadowMode::from_id(shadow_mode),
 229:         ..crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings::default()
 230:     }
 231:     .validated()
 232: }
 233: 
 234: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 235: fn update_cpu_settings(update: impl FnOnce(&mut crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings)) {
 236:     let mut settings = get_cpu_settings();
 237:     update(&mut settings);
 238:     store_cpu_settings(settings);
 239: }
 240: 
 241: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 242: fn store_cpu_settings(settings: crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings) {
 243:     let settings = settings.validated();
 244:     CPU_SCALE_BITS.store(settings.internal_scale.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 245:     CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS.store(settings.lod_cutoff_px.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 246:     CPU_MAX_SPLAT_RADIUS_BITS.store(settings.max_splat_radius_px.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 247:     CPU_MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH.store(settings.max_virtual_depth as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
 248:     CPU_MIN_MIP_OCCUPANCY_BITS.store(settings.min_mip_occupancy.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 249:     CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS.store(settings.max_draw_distance.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 250:     CPU_SHADOWS.store(settings.shadows.id(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 251: }

 253: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 254: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 255: pub fn get_blueprint_svg(seed: u32, rx: i32, rz: i32, voxel_scale: f32, size_world: f32) -> String {
 256:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 257:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 258:         seed,
 259:         vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(
 260:             rx as f32 * size_world,
 261:             rz as f32 * size_world,
 262:         ),
 263:         size_world,
 264:         &vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
 265:         &noise,
 266:     );
 267:     let chunk_size = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 { 20.0 } else { 10.0 };
 268:     let mut chunk_bounds = Vec::new();
 269:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 270:     for i in 0..steps {
 271:         for j in 0..steps {
 272:             let min_x = rx as f32 * size_world + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 273:             let min_z = rz as f32 * size_world + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 274:             let chunk_coord_x = (min_x / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 275:             let chunk_coord_z = (min_z / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 276:             chunk_bounds.push(vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::ChunkBounds {
 277:                 min_x,
 278:                 min_z,
 279:                 max_x: min_x + chunk_size,
 280:                 max_z: min_z + chunk_size,
 281:                 label: format!("[{}, {}]", chunk_coord_x, chunk_coord_z),
 282:             });
 283:         }
 284:     }
 285: 
 286:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintOptions {
 287:         pixels_per_unit: 10.0,
 288:         show_chunk_grid: true,
 289:         show_fixtures: true,
 290:         show_structure: true,
 291:         seed,
 292:         level: 0,
 293:         voxel_scale,
 294:     };
 295:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_region_blueprint_svg(
 296:         &plan,
 297:         &chunk_bounds,
 298:         options,
 299:     )
 300: }

 305: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 306: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 307: pub fn get_debug_region_json(seed: u32, region_x: i32, region_z: i32) -> String {
 308:     use std::fmt::Write;
 309:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 310: 
 311:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 312:     let size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 313:     let origin =
 314:         vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(
 315:             region_x as f32 * size,
 316:             region_z as f32 * size,
 317:         );
 318:     let config = vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 319:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 320:         seed, origin, size, &config, &noise,
 321:     );
 322:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(8192);
 323:     write!(
 324:         out,
 325:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"size\":{:.1},\"walls\":[",
 326:         origin.x, origin.z, size
 327:     )
 328:     .unwrap();
 329:     let mut first = true;
 330:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 331:         let vertices = &assembly.footprint.vertices;
 332:         for pair in vertices
 333:             .iter()
 334:             .zip(vertices.iter().cycle().skip(1))
 335:             .take(vertices.len())
 336:         {
 337:             if !first {
 338:                 out.push(',');
 339:             }
 340:             first = false;
 341:             write!(
 342:                 out,
 343:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 344:                 pair.0.0, pair.0.1, pair.1.0, pair.1.1
 345:             )
 346:             .unwrap();
 347:         }
 348:     }
 349:     out.push_str("],\"corridors\":[");
 350:     first = true;
 351:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 352:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 353:             if !first {
 354:                 out.push(',');
 355:             }
 356:             first = false;
 357:             write!(
 358:                 out,
 359:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 360:                 pair[0].x, pair[0].z, pair[1].x, pair[1].z, corridor.width
 361:             )
 362:             .unwrap();
 363:         }
 364:     }
 365:     out.push_str("],\"lights\":[");
 366:     first = true;
 367:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 368:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 369:             if !first {
 370:                 out.push(',');
 371:             }
 372:             first = false;
 373:             write!(
 374:                 out,
 375:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 376:                 fixture.at.x, fixture.at.z, fixture.half_x, fixture.half_z, fixture.lit
 377:             )
 378:             .unwrap();
 379:         }
 380:     }
 381:     out.push_str("],\"rooms\":[");
 382:     first = true;
 383:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 384:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 385:         if !first {
 386:             out.push(',');
 387:         }
 388:         first = false;
 389:         let kind = match assembly.program {
 390:             SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => "corridor",
 391:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "abandoned",
 392:             _ => "room",
 393:         };
 394:         write!(
 395:             out,
 396:             "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},\"{}\"]",
 397:             b.0, b.1, b.2, b.3, kind
 398:         )
 399:         .unwrap();
 400:     }
 401:     out.push_str("],\"anomalies\":[");
 402:     first = true;
 403:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 404:         if !first {
 405:             out.push(',');
 406:         }
 407:         first = false;
 408:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 409:         write!(
 410:             out,
 411:             "[\"{:?}\",\"{:016x}\",{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 412:             anomaly.kind,
 413:             anomaly.id,
 414:             b.min_x,
 415:             b.min_z,
 416:             b.max_x,
 417:             b.max_z,
 418:             anomaly.gates.len(),
 419:         )
 420:         .unwrap();
 421:     }
 422:     out.push_str("]}");
 423:     out
 424: }

 428: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 429: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 430: pub fn get_debug_chunk_json(seed: u32, chunk_x: f32, chunk_z: f32, voxel_scale: f32) -> String {
 431:     use std::fmt::Write;
 432:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 433:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 434:         VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL, VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_DRY_CARPET, VOXEL_FLOOR,
 435:         VOXEL_FLUID, VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_PALE_WALL, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
 436:         VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET, VOXEL_TREE, VOXEL_WALL, VOXEL_WATER,
 437:     };
 438: 
 439:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 440:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 441:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 442:     } else {
 443:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 444:     };
 445:     let chunk_origin = vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 446:     let generator =
 447:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 448:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_origin, seed, config.clone());
 449:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 450:     let region_origin = vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(
 451:         (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 452:         (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 453:     );
 454:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 455:         seed,
 456:         region_origin,
 457:         region_size,
 458:         &config,
 459:         &noise,
 460:     );
 461:     let width = grid.width().saturating_sub(2);
 462:     let depth = grid.depth().saturating_sub(2);
 463:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(width * depth + 4096);
 464:     write!(
 465:         out,
 466:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"scale\":{:.3},\"width\":{},\"depth\":{},\"cells\":\"",
 467:         chunk_x, chunk_z, voxel_scale, width, depth
 468:     )
 469:     .unwrap();
 470: 
 471: 
 472:     for z in 0..depth {
 473:         for x in 0..width {
 474:             let mut material = b'.';
 475:             for y in 0..grid.height() {
 476:                 material = match grid.get(x + 1, y, z + 1) {
 477:                     VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => b'R',
 478:                     VOXEL_LIGHT => b'L',
 479:                     VOXEL_GLIMMER => b'g',
 480:                     VOXEL_RED_WALL => b'X',
 481:                     VOXEL_WALL | VOXEL_TREE => b'#',
 482:                     VOXEL_PALE_WALL => b'P',
 483:                     VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL => b'D',
 484:                     VOXEL_CEILING => {
 485:                         if material == b'.' {
 486:                             b'^'
 487:                         } else {
 488:                             material
 489:                         }
 490:                     }
 491:                     VOXEL_FLOOR | VOXEL_GRASS | VOXEL_WATER => {
 492:                         if material == b'.' {
 493:                             b'_'
 494:                         } else {
 495:                             material
 496:                         }
 497:                     }
 498:                     VOXEL_DRY_CARPET => {
 499:                         if material == b'.' {
 500:                             b','
 501:                         } else {
 502:                             material
 503:                         }
 504:                     }
 505:                     VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET | VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET => {
 506:                         if material == b'.' {
 507:                             b'~'
 508:                         } else {
 509:                             material
 510:                         }
 511:                     }
 512:                     VOXEL_FLUID => {
 513:                         if material == b'.' {
 514:                             b'w'
 515:                         } else {
 516:                             material
 517:                         }
 518:                     }
 519:                     _ => material,
 520:                 };
 521:             }
 522:             out.push(material as char);
 523:         }
 524:     }
 525:     out.push_str("\",\"corridors\":[");
 526:     let mut first = true;
 527:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 528:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 529:             if !first {
 530:                 out.push(',');
 531:             }
 532:             first = false;
 533:             write!(
 534:                 out,
 535:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 536:                 (pair[0].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 537:                 (pair[0].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 538:                 (pair[1].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 539:                 (pair[1].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 540:                 corridor.width / voxel_scale,
 541:                 if corridor.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
 542:                     0
 543:                 } else {
 544:                     1
 545:                 }
 546:             )
 547:             .unwrap();
 548:         }
 549:     }
 550:     out.push_str("],\"boxes\":[");
 551:     first = true;
 552:     let mut box_out = |kind: &str, label: &str, bounds: (f32, f32, f32, f32), color: u8| {
 553:         if !first {
 554:             out.push(',');
 555:         }
 556:         first = false;
 557:         write!(
 558:             out,
 559:             "[\"{}\",\"{}\",{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 560:             kind,
 561:             label,
 562:             (bounds.0 - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 563:             (bounds.1 - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 564:             (bounds.2 - bounds.0) / voxel_scale,
 565:             (bounds.3 - bounds.1) / voxel_scale,
 566:             color
 567:         )
 568:         .unwrap();
 569:     };
 570:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 571:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 572:         let label = match assembly.program {
 573:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "ABANDONED",
 574:             _ => "ASSEMBLY",
 575:         };
 576:         box_out("assembly", label, b, 0);
 577:         for space in &assembly.spaces {
 578:             box_out("space", "SUB-ROOM", space.footprint.bounds(), 0);
 579:         }
 580:         for ceiling in &assembly.ceiling_zones {
 581:             box_out("ceiling", "CEILING ZONE", ceiling.area.bounds(), 0);
 582:         }
 583:         let s = &assembly.structure;
 584:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 585:         box_out(
 586:             "structure",
 587:             "COLUMN GRID",
 588:             (b.0 + s.phase.0, b.1 + s.phase.1, b.2, b.3),
 589:             0,
 590:         );
 591:         for opening in &assembly.entrances {
 592:             let half = opening.width * 0.5;
 593:             let b = if opening.through_x_wall {
 594:                 (
 595:                     opening.center.x - half,
 596:                     opening.center.z - 0.12,
 597:                     opening.center.x + half,
 598:                     opening.center.z + 0.12,
 599:                 )
 600:             } else {
 601:                 (
 602:                     opening.center.x - 0.12,
 603:                     opening.center.z - half,
 604:                     opening.center.x + 0.12,
 605:                     opening.center.z + half,
 606:                 )
 607:             };
 608:             box_out("portal", "PORTAL", b, 0);
 609:         }
 610:     }
 611:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 612:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 613:         let label = match anomaly.kind {
 614:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => "PILLAR EXPANSE",
 615:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => "BLACKOUT",
 616:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PitLattice => "PIT LATTICE",
 617:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom => "RED LOOP",
 618:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => "ARCH ANCHOR",
 619:         };
 620:         box_out("anomaly", label, (b.min_x, b.min_z, b.max_x, b.max_z), 1);
 621: 
 622: 
 623:         for gate in anomaly.traversal_gates() {
 624:             let gb = match gate.axis {
 625:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (
 626:                     gate.plane - 0.1,
 627:                     gate.span_min,
 628:                     gate.plane + 0.1,
 629:                     gate.span_max,
 630:                 ),
 631:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (
 632:                     gate.span_min,
 633:                     gate.plane - 0.1,
 634:                     gate.span_max,
 635:                     gate.plane + 0.1,
 636:                 ),
 637:             };
 638:             let glabel = format!(
 639:                 "{} {:08X}",
 640:                 match gate.kind {
 641:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::Remap => "GATE",
 642:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold =>
 643:                         "THRESHOLD",
 644:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedLoop => "RED LOOP",
 645:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedEscape => "ESCAPE",
 646:                 },
 647:                 (gate.instance_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32
 648:             );
 649:             box_out("gate", &glabel, gb, 1);
 650:         }
 651:         if anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 652:             && anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
 653:         {
 654:             let lane_a = anomaly.world_coords(-anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 655:             let lane_b = anomaly.world_coords(anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 656:             let hw = anomaly.skeleton_half_width;
 657:             let lane = (
 658:                 lane_a.x.min(lane_b.x) - hw,
 659:                 lane_a.z.min(lane_b.z) - hw,
 660:                 lane_a.x.max(lane_b.x) + hw,
 661:                 lane_a.z.max(lane_b.z) + hw,
 662:             );
 663:             box_out("skeleton", "PROTECTED ROUTE", lane, 1);
 664:         }
 665:     }
 666:     out.push_str("],\"fixtures\":[");
 667:     first = true;
 668:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 669:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 670:             if !first {
 671:                 out.push(',');
 672:             }
 673:             first = false;
 674:             write!(
 675:                 out,
 676:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 677:                 (fixture.at.x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 678:                 (fixture.at.z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 679:                 fixture.half_x / voxel_scale,
 680:                 fixture.half_z / voxel_scale,
 681:                 fixture.lit
 682:             )
 683:             .unwrap();
 684:         }
 685:     }
 686:     out.push_str("]}");
 687:     out
 688: }
 689: 
 690: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 691: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 692: pub fn get_chunk_blueprint_svg(
 693:     seed: u32,
 694:     chunk_x: f32,
 695:     chunk_z: f32,
 696:     voxel_scale: f32,
 697:     layer: String,
 698: ) -> String {
 699:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 700:     let chunk_pos = vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 701: 
 702:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 703:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 704:     } else {
 705:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 706:     };
 707: 
 708:     let generator =
 709:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 710:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_pos, seed, config);
 711: 
 712:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 713:     let rx = (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 714:     let rz = (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 715:     let semantics = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 716:         seed,
 717:         vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(rx, rz),
 718:         region_size,
 719:         &config,
 720:         &noise,
 721:     );
 722: 
 723:     let slice = match layer.as_str() {
 724:         "floor" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan,
 725:         "wall" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan,
 726:         "ceiling" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan,
 727:         _ => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite,
 728:     };
 729: 
 730:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_voxel_chunk_svg(
 731:         &grid,
 732:         chunk_pos,
 733:         &config,
 734:         slice,
 735:         Some(&semantics),
 736:     )
 737: }

 754: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 755: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 756: pub fn get_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 757:     seed: u32,
 758:     chunk_x: f32,
 759:     chunk_z: f32,
 760:     voxel_scale: f32,
 761:     pixels_per_voxel: f32,
 762:     show_grid: bool,
 763:     show_semantics: bool,
 764:     show_ceiling: bool,
 765: ) -> String {
 766:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 767:     let chunk_pos = vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 768: 
 769:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 770:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 771:     } else {
 772:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 773:     };
 774: 
 775: 
 776:     let generator =
 777:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 778:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_pos, seed, config.clone());
 779: 
 780: 
 781:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 782:     let rx = (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 783:     let rz = (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 784:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 785:         seed,
 786:         vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(rx, rz),
 787:         region_size,
 788:         &config,
 789:         &noise,
 790:     );
 791: 
 792:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::chunk_voxel_renderer::VoxelBlueprintOptions {

 810: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 811: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 812: pub fn get_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 813:     seed: u32,
 814:     rx_val: i32,
 815:     rz_val: i32,
 816:     voxel_scale: f32,
 817:     size_world: f32,
 818:     layer: String,
 819: ) -> String {
 820:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 821: 
 822:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 823:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 824:     } else {
 825:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 826:     };
 827: 
 828:     let chunk_size = config.chunk_size;
 829:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 830: 
 831: 
 832:     let rx_origin = rx_val as f32 * size_world;
 833:     let rz_origin = rz_val as f32 * size_world;
 834:     let semantics = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 835:         seed,
 836:         vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(rx_origin, rz_origin),
 837:         size_world,
 838:         &config,
 839:         &noise,
 840:     );
 841: 
 842: 
 843:     let generator =
 844:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 845: 
 846:     let chunk_w = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 847:     let chunk_d = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 848: 
 849:     let total_w = steps as usize * chunk_w;
 850:     let total_d = steps as usize * chunk_d;
 851: 
 852:     let mut combined_cells = vec![0u8; total_w * total_d];
 853: 
 854:     let slice = match layer.as_str() {
 855:         "floor" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan,
 856:         "wall" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan,
 857:         "ceiling" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan,
 858:         _ => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite,
 859:     };
 860: 
 861:     for i in 0..steps {
 862:         for j in 0..steps {
 863:             let chunk_x = rx_origin + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 864:             let chunk_z = rz_origin + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 865:             let grid = generator.execute(
 866:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::position::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z),
 867:                 seed,
 868:                 config.clone(),
 869:             );
 870: 
 871: 
 872:             for cz in 0..chunk_d {
 873:                 for cx in 0..chunk_w {
 874:                     let vx = cx + 1;
 875:                     let vz = cz + 1;
 876: 
 877:                     let mut has_wall = false;
 878:                     let mut has_red_wall = false;
 879:                     let mut has_light = false;
 880:                     let mut has_red_light = false;
 881:                     let mut has_floor = false;
 882:                     let mut has_ceiling = false;
 883:                     let mut has_tree = false;
 884:                     let mut has_grass = false;
 885:                     let mut has_water = false;
 886: 
 887:                     for y in 0..grid.height() {
 888:                         match grid.get(vx, y, vz) {
 889:                             1 => has_wall = true,
 890:                             5 => has_red_wall = true,
 891:                             4 => has_light = true,
 892:                             9 => has_red_light = true,
 893:                             2 => has_floor = true,
 894:                             3 => has_ceiling = true,
 895:                             8 => has_tree = true,
 896:                             6 => has_grass = true,
 897:                             7 => has_water = true,
 898:                             _ => {}
 899:                         }
 900:                     }
 901: 
 902:                     let cell_type = match slice {
 903:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan => {
 904:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 905:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 906:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 907:                                 if has_water {
 908:                                     7
 909:                                 } else if has_grass {
 910:                                     6
 911:                                 } else {
 912:                                     5
 913:                                 }
 914:                             } else {
 915:                                 0
 916:                             }
 917:                         }
 918:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan => {
 919:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 920:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 921:                             } else {
 922:                                 0
 923:                             }
 924:                         }
 925:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan => {
 926:                             if has_light || has_red_light {
 927:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 928:                             } else if has_ceiling {
 929:                                 9
 930:                             } else {
 931:                                 0
 932:                             }
 933:                         }
 934:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite => {
 935:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 936:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 937:                             } else if has_light || has_red_light {
 938:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 939:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 940:                                 if has_water {
 941:                                     7
 942:                                 } else if has_grass {
 943:                                     6
 944:                                 } else {
 945:                                     5
 946:                                 }
 947:                             } else {
 948:                                 0
 949:                             }
 950:                         }
 951:                     };
 952: 
 953:                     let target_x = i as usize * chunk_w + cx;
 954:                     let target_z = j as usize * chunk_d + cz;
 955:                     let idx = target_z * total_w + target_x;
 956:                     combined_cells[idx] = cell_type;
 957:                 }
 958:             }
 959:         }
 960:     }
 961: 
 962:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 963:         &combined_cells,
 964:         total_w,
 965:         total_d,
 966:         rx_origin,
 967:         rz_origin,
 968:         voxel_scale,
 969:         size_world,
 970:         slice,
 971:         Some(&semantics),
 972:         false,
 973:     )
 974: }

 86:             }
 87: 
 88:             let exit = |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;

 90:             let ty = exit(cmin[1], cmax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);

192: fn outside(p: [f32; 3], min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
193:     p[0] < min[0]
194:         || p[0] > max[0]
195:         || p[1] < min[1]
196:         || p[1] > max[1]
197:         || p[2] < min[2]
198:         || p[2] > max[2]

203: fn march_scene(
204:     atlas: &[u32],
205:     draws: &[wasm_frontend::application::ports::ChunkDraw],
206:     ro: [f32; 3],
207:     rd: [f32; 3],
208: ) -> Option<Hit> {
209:     let safe = |v: f32| {
210:         if v.abs() < 1e-4 {
211:             1e-4f32.copysign(v)
212:         } else {
213:             v
214:         }
215:     };
216: 
217:     let rd = [safe(rd[0]), safe(rd[1]), safe(rd[2])];
218:     let inv = [1.0 / rd[0], 1.0 / rd[1], 1.0 / rd[2]];
219: 
220:     let mut hits: Vec<(usize, f32)> = Vec::new();
221:     for (i, d) in draws.iter().enumerate() {
222:         let lro = [
223:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
224:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
225:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
226:         ];
227:         let mut t_entry = f32::MIN;
228:         let mut t_exit = f32::MAX;
229:         for a in 0..3 {
230:             let t1 = (0.0 - lro[a]) * inv[a];
231:             let t2 = (d.world_size - lro[a]) * inv[a];
232:             t_entry = t_entry.max(t1.min(t2));
233:             t_exit = t_exit.min(t1.max(t2));
234:         }
235:         if t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0 {
236:             hits.push((i, t_entry.max(0.0)));
237:         }
238:     }
239:     hits.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
240: 
241:     for (i, t_min) in hits {
242:         let d = &draws[i];
243:         let lro = [
244:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
245:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
246:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
247:         ];
248:         if let Some((t, bmin, bmax, vt)) =
249:             raymarch_svo(atlas, lro, rd, d.root_index as usize, t_min, d.world_size)
250:         {
251:             return Some(Hit {
252:                 chunk: i,
253:                 t,
254:                 box_min: bmin,
255:                 box_max: bmax,
256:                 voxel_type: vt,
257:             });
258:         }
259:     }
260:     None
261: }

294:         .map(|c| {
